gate-prompt:a1-arrival.en: Voss talks too fast. Ask him to say it again.
gate-prompt:a1-arrival.tr: Voss çok hızlı konuşuyor. Ondan tekrar söylemesini iste.

objective:a1-arrival:0.en: Meet Otto on the old platform

objective:a1-arrival:1.en: Read your ticket and the departure board

objective:a1-arrival:2.en: Voss talks too fast. Ask him to say it again.
objective:a1-arrival:2.tr: Voss çok hızlı konuşuyor. Ondan tekrar söylemesini iste.

dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-1.de: Moment. Du kommst von Bahnsteig sieben?
dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-1.en: Hang on. You came in on platform seven?
dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-1.tr: Dur bir dakika. Yedinci perondan mı geldin?

dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-2.de: Bahnsteig sieben ist seit zwölf Jahren zu.
dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-2.en: Platform seven has been closed for twelve years.
dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-2.tr: Yedinci peron on iki yıldır kapalı.

dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-3.de: Seit zwölf Jahren kommt hier kein Zug.
dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-3.en: No train has stopped here in twelve years.
dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-3.tr: On iki yıldır buraya tek bir tren uğramadı.

dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-4.de: Aber ich mache jeden Morgen die Laterne an.
dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-4.en: But I still light the lantern every morning.
dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-4.tr: Ama ben yine de her sabah feneri yakarım.

dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-5.de: Ordnung ist Ordnung. Auch ohne Zug.
dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-5.en: Rules are rules. Train or no train.
dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-5.tr: Düzen düzendir. Tren olsa da olmasa da.

dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-6.de: Und heute kommt dein Zug. Pünktlich!
dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-6.en: And today your train comes in. On time!
dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-6.tr: Bugün de senin trenin geldi. Tam zamanında!

dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-9.de: Hier steht {name}. Bahnsteig sieben. Unten: E.
dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-9.en: It says {name}. Platform seven. At the bottom: E.
dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-9.tr: Burada {name} yazıyor. Yedinci peron. Altta: E.

dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-11.de: Hier in Lindenhafen gehen Namen weg.

dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-12.de: Sag deinen Namen laut. Dann bleibt er.
dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-12.en: Say your name out loud. Then it stays.
dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-12.tr: Adını yüksek sesle söyle. O zaman kalır.

dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-13.de: Gut. Siehst du? Er ist wieder schwarz.
dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-13.en: Good. See? The ink is dark again.
dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-13.tr: İyi. Gördün mü? Mürekkep yine koyu.

dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-14.en: Good morning. Voss, from the Brass Office.

dialogue:a1-arrival-gate-0:variant:0.de: Fahrkarte nicht gültig. Bahnsteig sieben nicht im Plan.
dialogue:a1-arrival-gate-0:variant:0.en: Ticket not valid. Platform seven not on the timetable.
dialogue:a1-arrival-gate-0:variant:0.tr: Bilet geçersiz. Yedinci peron tarifede yok.

dialogue:a1-arrival-gate-1:variant:0.en: Hand it over, please. Thank you.

dialogue:a1-arrival-choice-0.de: Gern. Langsam: Ihre Fahrkarte ist nicht gültig.
dialogue:a1-arrival-choice-0.en: Certainly. Slowly: your ticket is not valid.

dialogue:a1-arrival-choice-1.de: Bahnsteig sieben steht nicht im Plan.
dialogue:a1-arrival-choice-1.en: Platform seven is not on the timetable.

dialogue:a1-arrival-choice-2.de: Der Zug war aber hier. Ich war da.
dialogue:a1-arrival-choice-2.en: But the train was here. I was there.

dialogue:a1-arrival-choice-3.de: Der Plan ist richtig, Herr Otto. Immer.
dialogue:a1-arrival-choice-3.en: The timetable is right, Otto. Always.
dialogue:a1-arrival-choice-3.tr: Tarife doğrudur, Otto Bey. Her zaman.

dialogue:a1-arrival-choice-4.de: Ihr Plan, Herr Voss. Mein Bahnsteig.
dialogue:a1-arrival-choice-4.en: Your timetable, Mr Voss. My platform.
dialogue:a1-arrival-choice-4.tr: Sizin tarifeniz, Voss Bey. Benim peronum.

dialogue:a1-arrival-choice-5.de: Die Fahrkarte kommt in mein Buch. Bitte.
dialogue:a1-arrival-choice-5.en: The ticket goes into my ledger. Please.

dialogue:a1-arrival-choice-6.de: Oder sie bleibt hier. Bei uns.
dialogue:a1-arrival-choice-6.en: Or it stays here. With us.

dialogue:a1-arrival-choice-7.de: Wer bekommt Ihre Fahrkarte: Otto oder ich?
dialogue:a1-arrival-choice-7.en: Who gets your ticket: Otto or me?
dialogue:a1-arrival-choice-7.tr: Biletinizi kim alacak: Otto mu, ben mi?

choice:a1-arrival:report.de: Bitte, Herr Voss. Hier ist die Fahrkarte.
choice:a1-arrival:report.en: Here you are, Mr Voss. Here is the ticket.

dialogue:a1-arrival-after-report-0.de: Danke. Jetzt ist alles in Ordnung.
dialogue:a1-arrival-after-report-0.en: Thank you. Now everything is in order.

dialogue:a1-arrival-after-report-1.de: Mein Buch für Sie. Dort steht alles.
dialogue:a1-arrival-after-report-1.en: A copy of my ledger, for you. Everything is in it.
dialogue:a1-arrival-after-report-1.tr: Size defterimin bir kopyası. Her şey içinde yazıyor.

dialogue:a1-arrival-after-report-2.de: Jetzt hat Voss deinen Namen. Sag ihn oft.
dialogue:a1-arrival-after-report-2.en: Now Voss has your name. Say it often.
dialogue:a1-arrival-after-report-2.tr: Artık Voss senin adını biliyor. Sık sık söyle.

dialogue:a1-arrival-after-protect-0.de: Gut. Ich komme wieder. Mit Formular.
dialogue:a1-arrival-after-protect-0.en: Fine. I will be back. With a form.

dialogue:a1-arrival-after-protect-1.de: Hier. Mein alter Schlüssel. Für Bahnsteig sieben.
dialogue:a1-arrival-after-protect-1.en: Here. My old key. For platform seven.
dialogue:a1-arrival-after-protect-1.tr: Al. Eski anahtarım. Yedinci peron için.

dialogue:a1-arrival-after-protect-2.de: Sag deinen Namen jeden Tag. Dann bleibt er.
dialogue:a1-arrival-after-protect-2.en: Say your name every day. Then it stays.
dialogue:a1-arrival-after-protect-2.tr: Adını her gün söyle. O zaman kalır.

dialogue:a1-arrival-complete-0.de: Du hast Hunger. Geh zu Marta ins Café.
dialogue:a1-arrival-complete-0.en: You are hungry. Go to Marta at the café.

dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-who-voss-0.de: Voss ist vom Messingamt. Er hat ein Buch.
dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-who-voss-0.en: Voss is from the Brass Office. He keeps a ledger.
dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-who-voss-0.tr: Voss Pirinç Daire'den. Bir defteri var.

dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-who-voss-1.de: Dort stehen alle Namen. Sagt er.
dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-who-voss-1.en: Every name is in it. So he says.
dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-who-voss-1.tr: İçinde bütün adlar yazılı. Öyle diyor.

dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-who-voss-2.de: Er schreibt auch das Wetter auf. Jeden Tag.
dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-who-voss-2.en: He writes down the weather too. Every day.

topic:a1-arrival:lantern.de: Warum machst du die Laterne an?
topic:a1-arrival:lantern.en: Why do you light the lantern?

dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-lantern-0.de: Das mache ich seit dreißig Jahren.
dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-lantern-0.en: I have done it for thirty years.

dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-lantern-1.de: Ein Bahnsteig ohne Licht ist kein Bahnsteig.
dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-lantern-1.en: A platform without a light is not a platform.

dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-who-e-0.de: Ich weiß es nicht. Nur E.
dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-who-e-0.en: I do not know. Just E.

dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-who-e-1.de: E. kennt deinen Namen. Kennst du E.?
dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-who-e-1.en: E. knows your name. Do you know E.?
dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-who-e-1.tr: E. senin adını biliyor. Sen E.'yi tanıyor musun?

evidence:a1-arrival:lindenhafen-noticebo.de: Bahnsteig eins bis sechs. Kein Bahnsteig sieben.
evidence:a1-arrival:lindenhafen-noticebo.en: Platforms one to six. No platform seven.
evidence:a1-arrival:lindenhafen-noticebo.tr: Bir'den altı'ya kadar peronlar. Yedinci peron yok.

gate-prompt:a1-timetable.en: Ask Otto when the train leaves.
gate-prompt:a1-timetable.tr: Otto'ya trenin ne zaman kalktığını sor.

objective:a1-timetable:0.en: Meet Otto at the timetable board

objective:a1-timetable:2.en: Ask Otto when the train leaves.
objective:a1-timetable:2.tr: Otto'ya trenin ne zaman kalktığını sor.

dialogue:a1-timetable-intro-0.de: Guten Morgen. Es ist sieben Uhr fünfzig.
dialogue:a1-timetable-intro-0.en: Good morning. It is ten to eight.

dialogue:a1-timetable-intro-1.de: Der Zug ist pünktlich. Das gefällt mir nicht!
dialogue:a1-timetable-intro-1.en: The train is on time. I do not like that!

dialogue:a1-timetable-intro-2.de: Du hast meinen Schlüssel. Sehr gut.
dialogue:a1-timetable-intro-2.en: You have my key. Very good.

dialogue:a1-timetable-intro-3.de: Voss hat deine Fahrkarte. Die Zeiten kenne ich.
dialogue:a1-timetable-intro-3.en: Voss has your ticket. I know the times.

dialogue:a1-timetable-intro-4.de: Sechs Bahnsteige, sechs Zeiten. Ich kenne alle.
dialogue:a1-timetable-intro-4.en: Six platforms, six times. I know them all.
dialogue:a1-timetable-intro-4.tr: Altı peron, altı saat. Hepsini bilirim.

dialogue:a1-timetable-intro-5.de: Bahnsteig eins: acht Uhr. Bahnsteig zwei: halb neun.
dialogue:a1-timetable-intro-5.en: Platform one: eight o’clock. Platform two: half past eight.
dialogue:a1-timetable-intro-5.tr: Bir numaralı peron: saat sekiz. İki numaralı peron: sekiz buçuk.

dialogue:a1-timetable-intro-6.de: Bahnsteig sieben steht auch hier. Achtzehn Uhr.
dialogue:a1-timetable-intro-6.en: Platform seven is on here too. Six p.m.
dialogue:a1-timetable-intro-6.tr: Yedinci peron da burada yazıyor. Saat on sekiz.

dialogue:a1-timetable-intro-7.de: Dort steht ein Wort. Nur das W ist da.
dialogue:a1-timetable-intro-7.en: A word is written there. Only the W is left.
dialogue:a1-timetable-intro-7.tr: Orada bir sözcük yazıyor. Sadece W kalmış.

dialogue:a1-timetable-gate-0.de: Du siehst lange auf die Tafel. Du willst fahren?
dialogue:a1-timetable-gate-0.en: You are looking at the board a long time. You want to travel?
dialogue:a1-timetable-gate-0.tr: Uzun süre tahtaya bakıyorsun. Yolculuğa mı çıkacaksın?

dialogue:a1-timetable-gate-0:variant:0.de: Du siehst auf die Tafel. Willst du fahren?
dialogue:a1-timetable-gate-0:variant:0.en: You are looking at the board. Do you want to travel?
dialogue:a1-timetable-gate-0:variant:0.tr: Tahtaya bakıyorsun. Yolculuğa çıkmak mı istiyorsun?

dialogue:a1-timetable-choice-0.de: Um acht Uhr zehn. Von Bahnsteig drei.
dialogue:a1-timetable-choice-0.en: At ten past eight. From platform three.
dialogue:a1-timetable-choice-0.tr: Sekizi on geçe. Üç numaralı perondan.

dialogue:a1-timetable-choice-1.de: Er kommt pünktlich. Das ist nicht gut.
dialogue:a1-timetable-choice-1.en: It arrives on time. That is not good.

dialogue:a1-timetable-choice-2.de: Ich kenne die Stadt seit zwanzig Jahren.
dialogue:a1-timetable-choice-2.en: I have known the town for twenty years.

dialogue:a1-timetable-choice-3.de: Aber ihren Namen kann ich nicht sagen.
dialogue:a1-timetable-choice-3.en: But I cannot say its name.

dialogue:a1-timetable-choice-4.de: Er ist weg. Das ist nicht gut.
dialogue:a1-timetable-choice-4.en: It is gone. That is not good.

dialogue:a1-timetable-choice-5.de: Soll die Laterne heute an sein oder aus?
dialogue:a1-timetable-choice-5.en: Should the lantern be on today, or off?
dialogue:a1-timetable-choice-5.tr: Fener bugün yansın mı, sönük mü kalsın?

dialogue:a1-timetable-after-light-0.de: Gut. Um achtzehn Uhr mache ich sie an.
dialogue:a1-timetable-after-light-0.en: Good. At six o’clock I will light it.

dialogue:a1-timetable-after-light-1.en: Maybe a train will come after all.

dialogue:a1-timetable-after-dark-1.de: Um achtzehn Uhr stehe ich aber hier.
dialogue:a1-timetable-after-dark-1.en: But at six o’clock I will stand here.
dialogue:a1-timetable-after-dark-1.tr: Ama saat on sekizde ben yine burada olacağım.

dialogue:a1-timetable-complete-0.en: I will read the board again.

dialogue:a1-timetable-complete-1.de: Moment. Wer ist die Frau dort am Plan?
dialogue:a1-timetable-complete-1.en: Wait. Who is the woman there at the board?
dialogue:a1-timetable-complete-1.tr: Bir dakika. Şu panodaki kadın kim?

topic:a1-timetable:seven.de: Wann kommt der Zug zu Bahnsteig sieben?
topic:a1-timetable:seven.en: When does the train come to platform seven?
topic:a1-timetable:seven.tr: Yedinci perona tren ne zaman geliyor?

dialogue:a1-timetable-topic-seven-0.de: Zwölf Jahre kein Zug. Nur heute Morgen deiner.
dialogue:a1-timetable-topic-seven-0.en: Twelve years without a train. Only yours, this morning.
dialogue:a1-timetable-topic-seven-0.tr: On iki yıl tren yok. Sadece bu sabah seninki.

dialogue:a1-timetable-topic-seven-1.de: Aber die Zeit steht noch auf der Tafel.
dialogue:a1-timetable-topic-seven-1.en: But the time is still on the board.

topic:a1-timetable:town.de: Wie heißt die Stadt mit W?
topic:a1-timetable:town.en: What is the town with W called?
topic:a1-timetable:town.tr: W ile başlayan kentin adı ne?

dialogue:a1-timetable-topic-town-0.de: Ich weiß es nicht. Das ist das Problem.
dialogue:a1-timetable-topic-town-0.en: I do not know. That is the problem.

dialogue:a1-timetable-topic-town-1.de: Sag Namen laut. Dann bleiben sie.
dialogue:a1-timetable-topic-town-1.en: Say names aloud. Then they stay.
dialogue:a1-timetable-topic-town-1.tr: Adları yüksek sesle söyle. O zaman kalırlar.

evidence:a1-timetable:lindenhafen-notice.de: Bahnsteig 1: acht Uhr. Bahnsteig 7: nach W… — 18 Uhr.
evidence:a1-timetable:lindenhafen-notice.en: Platform 1: eight o’clock. Platform 7: to W… — 6 p.m.
evidence:a1-timetable:lindenhafen-notice.tr: Peron 1: saat sekiz. Peron 7: W… yönüne - 18.00.

objective:a1-cafe:1.en: Read the note on the counter

dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-0.de: Hallo! Ich bin Marta. Willkommen im Café!
dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-0.en: Hello! I am Marta. Welcome to the café!
dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-0.tr: Merhaba! Ben Marta. Kafeye hoş geldin!

dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-1.de: Du hast Ottos Schlüssel? Den bekomme ich nie!
dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-1.en: You have Otto’s key? He never lends it to me!
dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-1.tr: Otto'nun anahtarı sende mi? Bana hiç vermez!

dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-2.de: Voss hat deine Fahrkarte? Er hat alles.
dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-2.en: Voss has your ticket? He has everything.
dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-2.tr: Biletin Voss'ta mı? O her şeye sahip.

dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-3.de: Hier liegt ein Papier. Für einen Gast.
dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-3.en: There is a note here. For a guest.
dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-3.tr: Burada bir kâğıt var. Bir misafir için.

dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-5.de: Du bist {name}? Dann ist das für dich.
dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-5.en: You are {name}? Then this is for you.
dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-5.tr: Sen {name} misin? O zaman bu senin.

dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-6.de: Eine Frau hat gestern für dich bezahlt.
dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-6.en: A woman paid for you yesterday.
dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-6.tr: Dün bir kadın senin için ödeme yaptı.

dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-7.de: Ihren Namen? Ich weiß ihn nicht mehr.
dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-7.en: Her name? I cannot remember it.

dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-8.de: Und ich frage jeden Gast nach dem Namen!
dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-8.en: And I ask every guest their name!

dialogue:a1-cafe-gate-0.de: So. Dein Kaffee ist schon bezahlt.
dialogue:a1-cafe-gate-0.en: So. Your coffee is already paid for.

dialogue:a1-cafe-gate-1:variant:0.en: What would you like to drink?

dialogue:a1-cafe-choice-1.en: The woman sat over there, alone.

dialogue:a1-cafe-choice-2.de: Sie war sehr müde. Ihre Hände waren schwarz.
dialogue:a1-cafe-choice-2.en: She was very tired. Her hands were black with ink.

dialogue:a1-cafe-choice-3.de: Ihren Tee hat sie nicht getrunken.
dialogue:a1-cafe-choice-3.en: She did not drink her tea.

dialogue:a1-cafe-choice-4.de: Hier ist deine Rechnung. Moment… ein Stempel?
dialogue:a1-cafe-choice-4.en: Here is your receipt. Wait… a stamp?
dialogue:a1-cafe-choice-4.tr: İşte fişin. Bir dakika… bu bir damga mı?

dialogue:a1-cafe-choice-5.de: Das ist der Stempel vom Messingamt.
dialogue:a1-cafe-choice-5.en: That is the Brass Office stamp.

dialogue:a1-cafe-choice-6.de: Sie hat mit einem alten Gutschein bezahlt.
dialogue:a1-cafe-choice-6.en: She paid with an old voucher.

dialogue:a1-cafe-choice-7.de: So einen gibt es seit Jahren nicht mehr.
dialogue:a1-cafe-choice-7.en: They have not made those for years.

dialogue:a1-cafe-choice-8.de: Voss hat schon deine Fahrkarte. Und jetzt das?
dialogue:a1-cafe-choice-8.en: Voss already has your ticket. And now this?
dialogue:a1-cafe-choice-8.tr: Voss'ta zaten biletin var. Şimdi de bu mu?

dialogue:a1-cafe-choice-9.de: Bekommt Voss die Rechnung, oder nimmst du sie?
dialogue:a1-cafe-choice-9.en: Does Voss get the receipt, or do you take it?
dialogue:a1-cafe-choice-9.tr: Fişi Voss mu alsın, yoksa sen mi alırsın?

dialogue:a1-cafe-after-report-0.de: Gut. Ich schreibe dir eine zweite Rechnung.
dialogue:a1-cafe-after-report-0.en: All right. I will write you a second receipt.
dialogue:a1-cafe-after-report-0.tr: Tamam. Sana ikinci bir fiş yazarım.

dialogue:a1-cafe-after-report-1.de: Voss liest gern. Rechnungen, Formulare, alles.
dialogue:a1-cafe-after-report-1.en: Voss loves reading. Receipts, forms, everything.
dialogue:a1-cafe-after-report-1.tr: Voss okumayı sever. Fişler, formlar, her şey.

dialogue:a1-cafe-after-protect-0.de: Gut. Voss muss nicht alles wissen.
dialogue:a1-cafe-after-protect-0.en: Good. Voss does not need to know everything.
dialogue:a1-cafe-after-protect-0.tr: İyi. Voss'un her şeyi bilmesi gerekmez.

dialogue:a1-cafe-after-protect-1.de: Ich schon. Ich will immer alles wissen!
dialogue:a1-cafe-after-protect-1.en: I do. I always want to know everything!
dialogue:a1-cafe-after-protect-1.tr: Ama benim gerekir. Ben hep her şeyi bilmek isterim!

dialogue:a1-cafe-complete-0.de: Du bleibst hier, oder? Du brauchst ein Zimmer.
dialogue:a1-cafe-complete-0.en: You are staying, right? You need a room.
dialogue:a1-cafe-complete-0.tr: Burada kalıyorsun, değil mi? Bir odaya ihtiyacın var.

dialogue:a1-cafe-topic-woman-1.de: Ihr Gesicht? Ich sehe es nicht mehr.
dialogue:a1-cafe-topic-woman-1.en: Her face? I cannot picture it any more.
dialogue:a1-cafe-topic-woman-1.tr: Yüzü mü? Artık gözümün önüne getiremiyorum.

dialogue:a1-cafe-topic-price-0.de: Drei Euro. Für dich heute: nichts!
dialogue:a1-cafe-topic-price-0.en: Three euros. For you today: nothing!
dialogue:a1-cafe-topic-price-0.tr: Üç avro. Ama senin için bugün: bedava!

gate-prompt:a1-room.en: Ask Marta if she has a room free.
gate-prompt:a1-room.tr: Marta'ya boş odası olup olmadığını sor.

objective:a1-room:0.en: Talk to Marta about a bed for tonight
objective:a1-room:0.tr: Marta ile bu geceki yatak hakkında konuş

objective:a1-room:2.en: Ask Marta if she has a room free.
objective:a1-room:2.tr: Marta'ya boş odası olup olmadığını sor.

dialogue:a1-room-intro-0.de: Noch einen Kaffee? Du siehst müde aus.

dialogue:a1-room-intro-1.de: Woher kommst du? Wohin fährst du? Wie lange?
dialogue:a1-room-intro-1.en: Where are you from? Where are you going? How long?
dialogue:a1-room-intro-1.tr: Nereden geliyorsun? Nereye gidiyorsun? Ne kadar kalacaksın?

dialogue:a1-room-intro-2.de: Entschuldigung. Ich frage viel. Ich weiß gern alles.
dialogue:a1-room-intro-2.en: Sorry. I ask a lot. I like to know everything.
dialogue:a1-room-intro-2.tr: Pardon. Çok soru soruyorum. Her şeyi bilmeyi severim.

dialogue:a1-room-intro-3.de: Die Rechnung ist bei Voss? Dann sehe ich sie nicht.
dialogue:a1-room-intro-3.en: The receipt is with Voss? Then I will not see it.
dialogue:a1-room-intro-3.tr: Fiş Voss'ta mı? O zaman onu göremeyeceğim.

dialogue:a1-room-intro-4.de: Du hast die Rechnung noch? Gut.
dialogue:a1-room-intro-4.en: You still have the receipt? Good.

dialogue:a1-room-intro-5.de: Otto hat die Laterne an? Ich sehe sie von hier.
dialogue:a1-room-intro-5.en: Otto has the lantern lit? I can see it from here.
dialogue:a1-room-intro-5.tr: Otto feneri yakmış mı? Buradan görebiliyorum.

dialogue:a1-room-intro-6.de: Oben sind fünf Zimmer. Vier sind frei.
dialogue:a1-room-intro-6.en: There are five rooms upstairs. Four are free.
dialogue:a1-room-intro-6.tr: Üst katta beş oda var. Dördü boş.

dialogue:a1-room-intro-7.de: Du hast eine Tasche, aber kein Bett für heute.
dialogue:a1-room-intro-7.en: You have a bag, but no bed for today.
dialogue:a1-room-intro-7.tr: Bir çantan var ama bugün için yatağın yok.

dialogue:a1-room-gate-0.de: Mein Haus ist klein, aber oben ist Platz. Und du?
dialogue:a1-room-gate-0.en: My house is small, but there is room upstairs. And you?
dialogue:a1-room-gate-0.tr: Evim küçük ama üst katta yer var. Peki sen?

dialogue:a1-room-gate-0:variant:0.de: Oben sind Zimmer. Du brauchst ein Bett?
dialogue:a1-room-gate-0:variant:0.en: There are rooms upstairs. Do you need a bed?
dialogue:a1-room-gate-0:variant:0.tr: Üst katta odalar var. Bir yatağa ihtiyacın var mı?

dialogue:a1-room-choice-0.de: Ja! Ein Zimmer kostet vierzig Euro.
dialogue:a1-room-choice-0.en: Yes! A room costs forty euros.

dialogue:a1-room-choice-1.de: Zimmer drei hat ein Bett und einen Tisch.
dialogue:a1-room-choice-1.en: Room three has a bed and a table.
dialogue:a1-room-choice-1.tr: Üç numaralı odada bir yatak ve bir masa var.

dialogue:a1-room-choice-2.de: Vor einer Woche war dort eine Frau.
dialogue:a1-room-choice-2.en: A week ago a woman was there.
dialogue:a1-room-choice-2.tr: Bir hafta önce orada bir kadın vardı.

dialogue:a1-room-choice-3.de: Im Gästebuch steht nur: E. Kein Name.
dialogue:a1-room-choice-3.en: In the guest book it only says: E. No name.
dialogue:a1-room-choice-3.tr: Misafir defterinde sadece şu yazıyor: E. Ad yok.

dialogue:a1-room-choice-4.de: Ihre Hände waren schwarz. Der Tisch auch.
dialogue:a1-room-choice-4.en: Her hands were black. So is the table.

dialogue:a1-room-choice-5.de: Der Tee steht noch da. Sie trinkt ihn nicht.
dialogue:a1-room-choice-5.en: The tea is still there. She is not drinking it.
dialogue:a1-room-choice-5.tr: Çay hâlâ orada duruyor. O içmiyor.

dialogue:a1-room-choice-6.de: Nimmst du Zimmer drei oder das ruhige Zimmer fünf?
dialogue:a1-room-choice-6.en: Will you take room three, or the quiet room five?
dialogue:a1-room-choice-6.tr: Üç numaralı odayı mı alırsın, yoksa sessiz beş numaralı odayı mı?

dialogue:a1-room-after-room-three-0.en: All right. Here is the key.

dialogue:a1-room-after-room-three-1.de: Der Tee bleibt da. Er ist für sie.
dialogue:a1-room-after-room-three-1.en: The tea stays. It is for her.
dialogue:a1-room-after-room-three-1.tr: Çay orada kalsın. O onun için.

dialogue:a1-room-after-room-five-0.en: All right. The room is quiet.

dialogue:a1-room-after-room-five-1.tr: Üç numaralı oda onun için kalır.

dialogue:a1-room-complete-0.de: Frühstück gibt es um acht Uhr.

dialogue:a1-room-complete-1.de: Fritz wartet auf dich. Geh wieder zu ihm.
dialogue:a1-room-complete-1.en: Fritz is waiting for you. Go back to him.
dialogue:a1-room-complete-1.tr: Fritz seni bekliyor. Yine ona git.

topic:a1-room:woman.de: Wie lange war die Frau hier?
topic:a1-room:woman.en: How long was the woman here?

dialogue:a1-room-topic-woman-0.de: Drei Tage. Dann war sie weg.
dialogue:a1-room-topic-woman-0.en: Three days. Then she was gone.

dialogue:a1-room-topic-woman-1.de: Sie hat alles bezahlt. Warum nur?
dialogue:a1-room-topic-woman-1.en: She paid for everything. But why?

evidence:a1-room:lindenhafen-cafe-receip.de: Gästebuch: Zimmer 3 — E, dann ein kleines L. Zimmer 5 — frei.
evidence:a1-room:lindenhafen-cafe-receip.en: Guest book: Room 3 — E, then a small L. Room 5 — free.
evidence:a1-room:lindenhafen-cafe-receip.tr: Misafir defteri: Oda 3 - E, sonra küçük bir L. Oda 5 - boş.

gate-prompt:a1-shopping.en: Ask Fritz what the bread costs.
gate-prompt:a1-shopping.tr: Fritz'e ekmeğin ne kadar olduğunu sor.

objective:a1-shopping:1.en: Look at the Friday guest names

objective:a1-shopping:2.en: Ask Fritz what the bread costs.
objective:a1-shopping:2.tr: Fritz'e ekmeğin ne kadar olduğunu sor.

objective:a1-shopping:3.en: Decide how much bread to buy
objective:a1-shopping:3.tr: Ne kadar ekmek alacağına karar ver

dialogue:a1-shopping-intro-0.de: Hallo! Das Wasser hier kostet nichts.
dialogue:a1-shopping-intro-0.en: Hello! The water here costs nothing.

dialogue:a1-shopping-intro-4.de: Am Freitag koche ich Suppe für alle.
dialogue:a1-shopping-intro-4.en: On Friday I cook soup for everyone.
dialogue:a1-shopping-intro-4.tr: Cuma günü herkes için çorba pişiriyorum.

dialogue:a1-shopping-intro-5.de: Hier sind die Namen: Otto, Marta, Lina, Emil, Greta.
dialogue:a1-shopping-intro-5.en: Here are the names: Otto, Marta, Lina, Emil, Greta.
dialogue:a1-shopping-intro-5.tr: İşte adlar: Otto, Marta, Lina, Emil, Greta.

dialogue:a1-shopping-intro-6.de: Dann kommt ein Platz. Dort steht kein Name.
dialogue:a1-shopping-intro-6.en: Then comes a place. There is no name there.
dialogue:a1-shopping-intro-6.tr: Sonra bir yer geliyor. Orada ad yok.

dialogue:a1-shopping-intro-7.de: Hier saß immer ein Gast. Aber wer?
dialogue:a1-shopping-intro-7.en: A guest always sat here. But who?
dialogue:a1-shopping-intro-7.tr: Burada hep bir misafir otururdu. Ama kim?

dialogue:a1-shopping-gate-0.de: Ich habe Brot, Milch, Eier und Fisch.
dialogue:a1-shopping-gate-0.en: I have bread, milk, eggs and fish.
dialogue:a1-shopping-gate-0.tr: Ekmeğim, sütüm, yumurtam ve balığım var.

dialogue:a1-shopping-gate-0:variant:0.de: Ich habe Brot, Milch und Eier.
dialogue:a1-shopping-gate-0:variant:0.en: I have bread, milk and eggs.

dialogue:a1-shopping-choice-0.de: Drei Euro. Für dich zwei fünfzig.
dialogue:a1-shopping-choice-0.en: Three euros. For you two fifty.
dialogue:a1-shopping-choice-0.tr: Üç avro. Senin için iki elli.

dialogue:a1-shopping-choice-1.de: Die Milch kostet einen Euro, der Fisch sechs.
dialogue:a1-shopping-choice-1.en: The milk costs one euro, the fish six.

dialogue:a1-shopping-choice-2.de: Ich schreibe jeden Namen auf. Jeden!
dialogue:a1-shopping-choice-2.en: I write down every name. Every one!

dialogue:a1-shopping-choice-3.de: Hier steht kein Name. Das gefällt mir nicht.
dialogue:a1-shopping-choice-3.en: There is no name here. I do not like that.
dialogue:a1-shopping-choice-3.tr: Burada ad yok. Bu hoşuma gitmiyor.

dialogue:a1-shopping-choice-4.de: Ich kaufe Brot für sechs. Oder sieben?
dialogue:a1-shopping-choice-4.en: I am buying bread for six. Or seven?
dialogue:a1-shopping-choice-4.tr: Altı kişilik ekmek alıyorum. Yoksa yedi mi?

dialogue:a1-shopping-choice-5.de: Kaufst du ein Brot oder zwei?
dialogue:a1-shopping-choice-5.en: Will you buy one loaf or two?
dialogue:a1-shopping-choice-5.tr: Bir ekmek mi alırsın, iki mi?

choice:a1-shopping:extra-bread.de: Zwei, bitte. Eins ist für den freien Platz.
choice:a1-shopping:extra-bread.en: Two, please. One is for the free place.
choice:a1-shopping:extra-bread.tr: İki tane, lütfen. Biri boş yer için.

choice:a1-shopping:own-bread.tr: Sadece bir tane, lütfen. Kendim için.

dialogue:a1-shopping-after-extra-bread-0.de: Gut. Zwei Brote. Das macht fünf Euro.
dialogue:a1-shopping-after-extra-bread-0.en: Good. Two loaves. That makes five euros.
dialogue:a1-shopping-after-extra-bread-0.tr: İyi. İki ekmek. Tutarı beş avro.

dialogue:a1-shopping-after-extra-bread-1.de: Ein Brot für den Gast. Er hat Hunger.
dialogue:a1-shopping-after-extra-bread-1.en: A loaf for the guest. He is hungry.
dialogue:a1-shopping-after-extra-bread-1.tr: Misafir için bir ekmek. O aç.

dialogue:a1-shopping-after-own-bread-0.de: Gut. Ein Brot. Das macht zwei fünfzig.
dialogue:a1-shopping-after-own-bread-0.en: Good. One loaf. That makes two fifty.
dialogue:a1-shopping-after-own-bread-0.tr: İyi. Bir ekmek. Tutarı iki elli.

dialogue:a1-shopping-after-own-bread-1.de: Der Platz bleibt frei. Ich warte.
dialogue:a1-shopping-after-own-bread-1.en: The place stays free. I will wait.

dialogue:a1-shopping-complete-0.de: Danke! Bis Freitag brauche ich viel.
dialogue:a1-shopping-complete-0.en: Thanks! I need a lot before Friday.
dialogue:a1-shopping-complete-0.tr: Sağ ol! Cumaya kadar çok şeye ihtiyacım var.

dialogue:a1-shopping-complete-1.de: Ich muss noch mehr kaufen. Komm bald wieder zu mir.
dialogue:a1-shopping-complete-1.en: I still have to buy more. Come back to me soon.
dialogue:a1-shopping-complete-1.tr: Daha çok alışveriş yapmam lazım. Yakında yine bana gel.

topic:a1-shopping:soup.en: What are you cooking on Friday?

dialogue:a1-shopping-topic-soup-0.de: Eine Suppe mit Brot. Und viel Platz.
dialogue:a1-shopping-topic-soup-0.en: A soup with bread. And lots of room.
dialogue:a1-shopping-topic-soup-0.tr: Ekmekli bir çorba. Ve bolca yer.

dialogue:a1-shopping-topic-soup-1.de: Alle essen zusammen. Keiner ist allein.
dialogue:a1-shopping-topic-soup-1.en: Everyone eats together. Nobody is alone.
dialogue:a1-shopping-topic-soup-1.tr: Herkes birlikte yer. Kimse yalnız değil.

dialogue:a1-shopping-topic-who-0.de: Das weiß ich nicht. Der Name ist weg.
dialogue:a1-shopping-topic-who-0.en: I do not know. The name is gone.

dialogue:a1-shopping-topic-who-1.de: Ich sehe nur den Platz. Er ist frei.
dialogue:a1-shopping-topic-who-1.en: I only see the place. It is free.

evidence:a1-shopping:lindenhafen-market-.de: Namen für Freitag: Otto, Marta, Lina, Emil, Greta, …
evidence:a1-shopping:lindenhafen-market-.en: Names for Friday: Otto, Marta, Lina, Emil, Greta, …
evidence:a1-shopping:lindenhafen-market-.tr: Cuma için adlar: Otto, Marta, Lina, Emil, Greta, …

gate-prompt:a1-market.tr: Fritz'e kaç elmaya ihtiyacın olduğunu söyle.

objective:a1-market:0.en: Meet Fritz at his market stall

objective:a1-market:1.en: Read the order slip at the stall

objective:a1-market:2.en: Tell Fritz how many apples you need.
objective:a1-market:2.tr: Fritz'e kaç elmaya ihtiyacın olduğunu söyle.

objective:a1-market:3.tr: Frau Berg'in adının nereye yazıldığına karar ver

dialogue:a1-market-intro-0.de: Da bist du ja! Heute ist Freitag. Suppe!
dialogue:a1-market-intro-0.en: There you are! It is Friday. Soup!

dialogue:a1-market-intro-1.de: Am Freitag essen hier alle zusammen.
dialogue:a1-market-intro-1.en: On Fridays everyone eats here together.
dialogue:a1-market-intro-1.tr: Cuma günleri burada herkes birlikte yemek yer.

dialogue:a1-market-intro-2.de: Dein Brot für den freien Platz ist hier. Danke.
dialogue:a1-market-intro-2.en: Your bread for the empty seat is here. Thank you.
dialogue:a1-market-intro-2.tr: Boş yer için aldığın ekmek burada. Sağ ol.

dialogue:a1-market-intro-3.de: Nur ein Brot für dich? Gut, ich habe viel.
dialogue:a1-market-intro-3.en: Only one loaf, for you? Fine, I have plenty.
dialogue:a1-market-intro-3.tr: Kendin için sadece bir ekmek mi? Peki, bende çok var.

dialogue:a1-market-intro-4.de: Guten Tag. Ich habe Ihre Rechnung. Und Ihren Namen.
dialogue:a1-market-intro-4.en: Good afternoon. I have your receipt. And your name.
dialogue:a1-market-intro-4.tr: İyi günler. Faturanız bende. Bir de adınız.

dialogue:a1-market-intro-5.de: Hier stehen meine Gäste. Ein Platz ist frei.
dialogue:a1-market-intro-5.en: Here are my guests. One seat is empty.
dialogue:a1-market-intro-5.tr: Burada misafirlerim yazıyor. Bir yer boş.

dialogue:a1-market-intro-6.de: Da sitzt jeden Freitag eine Frau. Aber wer?
dialogue:a1-market-intro-6.en: A woman sits there every Friday. But who?
dialogue:a1-market-intro-6.tr: Orada her cuma bir kadın oturur. Ama kim?

dialogue:a1-market-intro-7.de: Ich kenne jeden Gast. Jeden! Nur sie nicht.
dialogue:a1-market-intro-7.en: I know every guest. Every one! Except her.
dialogue:a1-market-intro-7.tr: Her misafiri tanırım. Hepsini! Sadece onu değil.

dialogue:a1-market-intro-8.de: Hier ist ein Papier von ihr.
dialogue:a1-market-intro-8.en: Here is an order slip of hers.

dialogue:a1-market-intro-9.en: Apples. Garden Street seven. No name.

dialogue:a1-market-intro-10.de: Und wie viel? Hier steht keine Nummer mehr.
dialogue:a1-market-intro-10.en: And how many? The number has faded.

dialogue:a1-market-gate-0.de: Komm, du kochst mit. Hier sind Äpfel.
dialogue:a1-market-gate-0.en: Come on, you are cooking with me. Here are apples.
dialogue:a1-market-gate-0.tr: Haydi, sen de benimle pişireceksin. İşte elmalar.

dialogue:a1-market-gate-1.de: Für die Suppe. Wie viel brauchst du?
dialogue:a1-market-gate-1.en: For the soup. How many do you need?

dialogue:a1-market-gate-1:variant:0.de: Wie viel brauchst du für die Suppe?
dialogue:a1-market-gate-1:variant:0.en: How many do you need for the soup?

dialogue:a1-market-choice-0.tr: İki elma. İki elma… dur bir dakika!

dialogue:a1-market-choice-1.de: Jeden Freitag zwei Äpfel. Immer zwei!
dialogue:a1-market-choice-1.en: Two apples every Friday. Always two!
dialogue:a1-market-choice-1.tr: Her cuma iki elma. Hep iki!

dialogue:a1-market-choice-2.de: Jetzt weiß ich es wieder. Frau Berg!

dialogue:a1-market-choice-3.de: Bei ihr hat die Stadt lesen gelernt.
dialogue:a1-market-choice-3.en: This whole town learned to read with her.
dialogue:a1-market-choice-3.tr: Bütün kent onun yanında okumayı öğrendi.

dialogue:a1-market-choice-5.de: Ihr Platz ist seit einer Woche frei.
dialogue:a1-market-choice-5.en: Her seat has been empty for a week.

dialogue:a1-market-choice-6.de: Eine Woche! Und ich habe nichts gesagt.
dialogue:a1-market-choice-6.en: A week! And I did not say a word.
dialogue:a1-market-choice-6.tr: Bir hafta! Ve ben tek söz etmedim.

dialogue:a1-market-choice-7.de: Bekommt Voss ihre Adresse, oder schreiben wir ihren Namen auf?
dialogue:a1-market-choice-7.en: Does Voss get her address, or do we write her name down?
dialogue:a1-market-choice-7.tr: Voss adresini alsın mı, yoksa adını biz mi yazalım?

choice:a1-market:report.de: Voss soll ihre Adresse in sein Buch schreiben.
choice:a1-market:report.en: Voss should put her address in his ledger.

choice:a1-market:protect.de: Ich schreibe ihren Namen auf. Für Freitag.
choice:a1-market:protect.en: I will write her name down. For Friday.

dialogue:a1-market-after-report-0.de: Gut. Dann steht sie bei Voss im Buch.
dialogue:a1-market-after-report-0.en: All right. Then she is in Voss’s ledger.
dialogue:a1-market-after-report-0.tr: Tamam. O zaman Voss'un defterinde yazılı olur.

dialogue:a1-market-after-report-1.de: Aber hier am Tisch ist ihr Platz noch frei.
dialogue:a1-market-after-report-1.en: But here at the table her seat is still empty.
dialogue:a1-market-after-report-1.tr: Ama burada masada yeri hâlâ boş.

dialogue:a1-market-after-protect-0.de: Frau Berg. So. Jetzt steht sie wieder da.
dialogue:a1-market-after-protect-0.en: Frau Berg. There. Now she is written down again.
dialogue:a1-market-after-protect-0.tr: Frau Berg. İşte. Şimdi yine yazılı.

dialogue:a1-market-after-protect-1.de: Nimm ihre Adresse mit. Gartenstraße sieben.
dialogue:a1-market-after-protect-1.en: Take her address with you. Garden Street seven.

dialogue:a1-market-complete-0.de: Linas Bruder Pip schreibt alle Namen auf. Am Wasser.
dialogue:a1-market-complete-0.en: Lina’s brother Pip writes down every name. By the water.
dialogue:a1-market-complete-0.tr: Lina’nın kardeşi Pip bütün isimleri yazıyor. Suyun kenarında.

dialogue:a1-market-topic-guests-0.de: Otto, Marta, Lina, Emil, Greta. Und ich.
dialogue:a1-market-topic-guests-0.en: Otto, Marta, Lina, Emil, Greta. And me.
dialogue:a1-market-topic-guests-0.tr: Otto, Marta, Lina, Emil, Greta. Bir de ben.

dialogue:a1-market-topic-guests-1.de: Otto kommt immer pünktlich. Zu pünktlich.
dialogue:a1-market-topic-guests-1.en: Otto is always on time. Too much on time.
dialogue:a1-market-topic-guests-1.tr: Otto hep zamanında gelir. Fazla zamanında.

dialogue:a1-market-topic-soup-0.tr: Patates, ekmek, elma. Bir de tuz.

dialogue:a1-market-topic-soup-1.de: Äpfel in der Suppe? Ja. Das ist gut!
dialogue:a1-market-topic-soup-1.en: Apples in soup? Yes. It is good!
dialogue:a1-market-topic-soup-1.tr: Çorbada elma mı? Evet. Güzel olur!

evidence:a1-market:lindenhafen-market-cr.tr: Bir sipariş fişi: … elmalar. Bahçe Sokağı 7. Ad yok.

gate-prompt:a1-neighbour.en: Ask Marta what Frau Berg is like.
gate-prompt:a1-neighbour.tr: Marta'ya Frau Berg'in nasıl biri olduğunu sor.

objective:a1-neighbour:2.en: Ask Marta what Frau Berg is like.
objective:a1-neighbour:2.tr: Marta'ya Frau Berg'in nasıl biri olduğunu sor.

objective:a1-neighbour:3.en: Decide how to keep a name
objective:a1-neighbour:3.tr: Bir adı nasıl koruyacağına karar ver

dialogue:a1-neighbour-intro-0.de: Da bist du. Fritz war heute hier.
dialogue:a1-neighbour-intro-0.en: There you are. Fritz was here today.

dialogue:a1-neighbour-intro-1.de: Er sagt: Frau Berg. Sie war meine Lehrerin!
dialogue:a1-neighbour-intro-1.en: He says: Frau Berg. She was my teacher!
dialogue:a1-neighbour-intro-1.tr: Frau Berg diyor. O benim öğretmenimdi!

dialogue:a1-neighbour-intro-2.de: Du hast ihren Namen gesagt. Danke.
dialogue:a1-neighbour-intro-2.en: You said her name. Thank you.

dialogue:a1-neighbour-intro-3.de: Sie saß jeden Morgen hier am Brunnen.
dialogue:a1-neighbour-intro-3.en: She sat here at the fountain every morning.
dialogue:a1-neighbour-intro-3.tr: Her sabah burada, çeşmenin yanında otururdu.

dialogue:a1-neighbour-intro-4.de: Seit einer Woche weiß ich ihren Namen nicht.
dialogue:a1-neighbour-intro-4.en: For a week I have not known her name.

dialogue:a1-neighbour-intro-5.de: Und ich wohne in ihrer Straße.
dialogue:a1-neighbour-intro-5.en: And I live on her street.

dialogue:a1-neighbour-intro-6.de: Du kennst Frau Berg nicht, oder?
dialogue:a1-neighbour-intro-6.en: You do not know Frau Berg, do you?

dialogue:a1-neighbour-intro-6:variant:0.en: You do not know her. Or do you?

dialogue:a1-neighbour-gate-0.de: Ich erzähle dir von ihr. Was willst du wissen?
dialogue:a1-neighbour-gate-0.en: I will tell you about her. What do you want to know?
dialogue:a1-neighbour-gate-0.tr: Sana ondan söz edeyim. Ne öğrenmek istiyorsun?

dialogue:a1-neighbour-gate-0:variant:0.de: Du kennst sie nicht. Was willst du wissen?
dialogue:a1-neighbour-gate-0:variant:0.en: You do not know her. What do you want to know?

dialogue:a1-neighbour-choice-0.de: Sie ist alt und sehr lieb.
dialogue:a1-neighbour-choice-0.en: She is old and very dear.

dialogue:a1-neighbour-choice-1.de: Aber streng! Ein Fehler? Schreib alles wieder!
dialogue:a1-neighbour-choice-1.en: But strict! One mistake? Write it all again!
dialogue:a1-neighbour-choice-1.tr: Ama sert! Bir hata mı? Hepsini yeniden yaz!

dialogue:a1-neighbour-choice-2.de: Jeder Brief von mir hat Fehler. Sie sieht alles!
dialogue:a1-neighbour-choice-2.en: Every letter of mine has mistakes. She sees everything!
dialogue:a1-neighbour-choice-2.tr: Benim her mektubumda hata var. O her şeyi görür!

dialogue:a1-neighbour-choice-3.de: Bei ihr hat halb Lindenhafen lesen gelernt.
dialogue:a1-neighbour-choice-3.en: Half of Lindenhafen learned to read with her.
dialogue:a1-neighbour-choice-3.tr: Lindenhafen'in yarısı onun yanında okumayı öğrendi.

dialogue:a1-neighbour-choice-4.de: Und ich weiß ihren Namen seit einer Woche nicht.
dialogue:a1-neighbour-choice-4.en: And for a week I have not known her name.
dialogue:a1-neighbour-choice-4.tr: Ben ise bir haftadır adını bilmiyorum.

dialogue:a1-neighbour-choice-5.de: Ihren Namen laut sagen oder auf die Tafel schreiben?
dialogue:a1-neighbour-choice-5.en: Say her name aloud, or write it on the board?
dialogue:a1-neighbour-choice-5.tr: Adını yüksek sesle mi söyleyelim, yoksa tahtaya mı yazalım?

choice:a1-neighbour:say-name.de: Ich sage ihren Namen laut. Frau Berg!
choice:a1-neighbour:say-name.en: I will say her name aloud. Frau Berg!
choice:a1-neighbour:say-name.tr: Adını yüksek sesle söylüyorum. Frau Berg!

choice:a1-neighbour:write-name.de: Ich schreibe ihren Namen auf die Tafel.
choice:a1-neighbour:write-name.en: I will write her name on the board.

dialogue:a1-neighbour-after-say-name-0.de: Frau Berg. Ja. Jetzt höre ich sie.
dialogue:a1-neighbour-after-say-name-0.en: Frau Berg. Yes. Now I can hear her.
dialogue:a1-neighbour-after-say-name-0.tr: Frau Berg. Evet. Şimdi onu duyuyorum.

dialogue:a1-neighbour-after-say-name-1.de: Das Wort bleibt. Ich sage es wieder.
dialogue:a1-neighbour-after-say-name-1.en: The word stays. I will say it again.

dialogue:a1-neighbour-after-write-name-0.de: Gut. Ich lese ihn jeden Tag laut.
dialogue:a1-neighbour-after-write-name-0.en: Good. I will read it aloud every day.
dialogue:a1-neighbour-after-write-name-0.tr: İyi. Onu her gün yüksek sesle okuyacağım.

dialogue:a1-neighbour-after-write-name-1.de: Frau Berg. Ohne Fehler. Das gefällt ihr.
dialogue:a1-neighbour-after-write-name-1.en: Frau Berg. No mistakes. She will like that.

dialogue:a1-neighbour-complete-1.de: Geh bitte zu Greta. Sie hat den Tee.
dialogue:a1-neighbour-complete-1.en: Please go to Greta. She has the tea.

dialogue:a1-neighbour-topic-where-0.de: Im Haus mit der Nummer sieben.
dialogue:a1-neighbour-topic-where-0.en: In the house with number seven.

topic:a1-neighbour:teacher.de: Wie war Frau Berg in der Schule?
topic:a1-neighbour:teacher.en: What was Frau Berg like at school?

dialogue:a1-neighbour-topic-teacher-0.de: Ruhig, klar und streng. Wir mochten sie.
dialogue:a1-neighbour-topic-teacher-0.en: Calm, clear and strict. We liked her.
dialogue:a1-neighbour-topic-teacher-0.tr: Sakin, net ve sert. Biz onu severdik.

dialogue:a1-neighbour-topic-teacher-1.de: Alle kannten ihren Namen. Bis jetzt.
dialogue:a1-neighbour-topic-teacher-1.en: Everyone knew her name. Until now.
dialogue:a1-neighbour-topic-teacher-1.tr: Herkes onun adını bilirdi. Şimdiye kadar.

evidence:a1-neighbour:lindenhafen-founta.de: Die Bank ist frei. Kein Buch, kein Mensch.
evidence:a1-neighbour:lindenhafen-founta.en: The bench is free. No book, nobody.
evidence:a1-neighbour:lindenhafen-founta.tr: Bank boş. Ne kitap var, ne de kimse.

gate-prompt:a1-pharmacy.en: Tell Greta what is wrong: you have a headache.
gate-prompt:a1-pharmacy.tr: Greta'ya neyin olduğunu söyle: başın ağrıyor.

objective:a1-pharmacy:1.en: Look at the bag of tea in the garden

objective:a1-pharmacy:2.en: Tell Greta what is wrong: you have a headache.
objective:a1-pharmacy:2.tr: Greta'ya neyin olduğunu söyle: başın ağrıyor.

objective:a1-pharmacy:3.en: Decide who takes the bag to Frau Berg
objective:a1-pharmacy:3.tr: Torbayı Frau Berg'e kimin götüreceğine karar ver

dialogue:a1-pharmacy-intro-0.de: Guten Tag! Das ist meine Apotheke.
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-intro-0.en: Good day! This is my pharmacy.

dialogue:a1-pharmacy-intro-1.de: Der Tee ist aus meinem Garten.
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-intro-1.en: The tea is from my garden.

dialogue:a1-pharmacy-intro-2.de: Hier liegt ein Beutel für Frau Berg.
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-intro-2.en: A bag for Frau Berg is lying here.
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-intro-2.tr: Burada Frau Berg için bir torba duruyor.

dialogue:a1-pharmacy-intro-3.de: Ich sehe den Namen nicht mehr gut.
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-intro-3.en: I cannot see the name well any more.

dialogue:a1-pharmacy-intro-said.de: Du hast am Brunnen ihren Namen gesagt. Gut.
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-intro-said.en: You said her name at the fountain. Good.

dialogue:a1-pharmacy-intro-written.de: Marta hat ihren Namen geschrieben. Gut.
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-intro-written.en: Marta wrote her name down. Good.

dialogue:a1-pharmacy-intro-6.de: Seit einer Woche kommt sie nicht mehr.
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-intro-6.en: She has not come for a week.

dialogue:a1-pharmacy-gate-request.de: Du siehst müde aus. Was hast du?
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-gate-request.en: You look tired. What is wrong?

dialogue:a1-pharmacy-gate-request:varian.de: Du bist müde. Was hast du?
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-gate-request:varian.en: You are tired. What is wrong?

dialogue:a1-pharmacy-gate-0.en: A headache? That is not good.
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-gate-0.tr: Baş ağrısı mı? Bu hiç iyi değil.

dialogue:a1-pharmacy-gate-1.de: Trink viel Wasser. Nicht nur Kaffee!
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-gate-1.en: Drink lots of water. Not only coffee!
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-gate-1.tr: Çok su iç. Sadece kahve değil!

dialogue:a1-pharmacy-gate-2.de: Otto sagt: Ich bin nie krank. Er kommt jede Woche.
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-gate-2.en: Otto says: I am never ill. He comes every week.
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-gate-2.tr: Otto, "Ben asla hasta olmam" diyor. Ama her hafta geliyor.

dialogue:a1-pharmacy-gate-3.de: Der Tee im Beutel ist für Frau Berg.
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-gate-3.en: The tea in the bag is for Frau Berg.

dialogue:a1-pharmacy-gate-4.de: Sie ist krank. Sie trinkt ihn jeden Tag.
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-gate-4.en: She is ill. She drinks it every day.

dialogue:a1-pharmacy-gate-5.de: Eine Woche ohne Tee. Ich habe nicht gefragt.
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-gate-5.en: A week without tea. I did not ask.

dialogue:a1-pharmacy-choice-0.de: Bringst du den Beutel, oder bringt Lina ihn?
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-choice-0.en: Will you take the bag yourself, or will Lina take it?
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-choice-0.tr: Torbayı sen mi götürürsün, yoksa Lina mı götürsün?

choice:a1-pharmacy:take-bag.de: Ich bringe den Beutel zu ihr.
choice:a1-pharmacy:take-bag.en: I will take the bag to her.

dialogue:a1-pharmacy-complete-0.de: Du findest Lina bei der Post. Sie kennt jede Straße.
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-complete-0.en: You will find Lina at the post office. She knows every street.
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-complete-0.tr: Lina'yı postanede bulursun. Her sokağı bilir.

dialogue:a1-pharmacy-after-take-bag-0.de: Gut. Hier, bitte. Am Morgen und am Abend.
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-after-take-bag-0.en: Good. Here you are. Morning and evening.
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-after-take-bag-0.tr: İyi. Al, buyur. Sabah ve akşam.

dialogue:a1-pharmacy-after-take-bag-1.de: Sag ihren Namen laut. Dann bleibt er.
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-after-take-bag-1.en: Say her name aloud. Then it stays.
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-after-take-bag-1.tr: Adını yüksek sesle söyle. O zaman kalır.

dialogue:a1-pharmacy-after-ask-lina-0.de: Gut. Lina ist schnell. Sie kennt jedes Haus.
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-after-ask-lina-0.en: Good. Lina is fast. She knows every house.
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-after-ask-lina-0.tr: İyi. Lina hızlıdır. Her evi bilir.

dialogue:a1-pharmacy-after-ask-lina-1.de: Ich schreibe den Namen wieder auf.
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-after-ask-lina-1.en: I will write the name again.

topic:a1-pharmacy:often.de: Wie oft nehme ich den Tee?
topic:a1-pharmacy:often.en: How often do I take the tea?

dialogue:a1-pharmacy-topic-often-0.en: In the morning and in the evening.

dialogue:a1-pharmacy-topic-often-1.de: Nach dem Essen, nicht vor dem Essen.

dialogue:a1-pharmacy-topic-berg-0.de: Eine alte Frau. Sie ist sehr gut.
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-topic-berg-0.en: An old woman. She is very kind.
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-topic-berg-0.tr: Yaşlı bir kadın. Çok iyi biri.

dialogue:a1-pharmacy-topic-berg-1.de: Sie liest jeden Morgen am Brunnen.
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-topic-berg-1.en: She reads at the fountain every morning.

evidence:a1-pharmacy:lindenhafen-garden.de: Zwei Beutel: Frau Berg und A. K. Beide gehen weg.
evidence:a1-pharmacy:lindenhafen-garden.en: Two bags: Frau Berg and A. K. Both names are fading.
evidence:a1-pharmacy:lindenhafen-garden.tr: İki torba: Frau Berg ve A. K. İki isim de siliniyor.

objective:a1-directions:0.en: Meet Lina with her delivery list

objective:a1-directions:1.en: Look at the door of Gartenstraße 7

objective:a1-directions:3.en: Decide how to leave Frau Berg’s name
objective:a1-directions:3.tr: Frau Berg'in adını nasıl bırakacağına karar ver

dialogue:a1-directions-intro-0.de: Moment! Ich muss noch Briefe bringen.
dialogue:a1-directions-intro-0.en: One moment! I still have letters to deliver.
dialogue:a1-directions-intro-0.tr: Bir dakika! Hâlâ götürmem gereken mektuplar var.

dialogue:a1-directions-intro-1.en: Every letter must arrive. Every one!

dialogue:a1-directions-intro-taken.de: Du hast Tee von Greta? Der ist für Nummer sieben.
dialogue:a1-directions-intro-taken.en: You have tea from Greta? It is for number seven.
dialogue:a1-directions-intro-taken.tr: Greta'dan çay mı aldın? O yedi numara için.

dialogue:a1-directions-intro-lina.de: Greta hat mir Tee gegeben. Für Nummer sieben.
dialogue:a1-directions-intro-lina.en: Greta gave me tea. For number seven.
dialogue:a1-directions-intro-lina.tr: Greta bana çay verdi. Yedi numara için.

dialogue:a1-directions-intro-4.de: Auf meinem Brief steht ein Haus, kein Name.
dialogue:a1-directions-intro-4.en: On my letter there is a house, no name.
dialogue:a1-directions-intro-4.tr: Mektubumda bir ev yazıyor, ad yok.

dialogue:a1-directions-gate-request.de: Du bist neu hier. Wohin willst du?
dialogue:a1-directions-gate-request.en: You are new here. Where do you want to go?

dialogue:a1-directions-gate-request:vari.de: Du bist neu hier. Wohin gehst du?
dialogue:a1-directions-gate-request:vari.en: You are new here. Where are you going?

dialogue:a1-directions-gate-1.en: Go straight ahead to the fountain.

dialogue:a1-directions-gate-2.de: Dort links. Der Brunnen ist bei der Schule.
dialogue:a1-directions-gate-2.en: Left there. The fountain is by the school.

dialogue:a1-directions-gate-3.de: Hier ist Nummer sieben, gegenüber von der Schule.
dialogue:a1-directions-gate-3.en: Here is number seven, opposite the school.

dialogue:a1-directions-gate-4.de: Am Haus steht kein Name mehr.
dialogue:a1-directions-gate-4.en: There is no name on the house any more.

dialogue:a1-directions-gate-5.de: Auf Papier steht: Bin gleich zurück. Eine Woche alt.
dialogue:a1-directions-gate-5.en: Paper says: Back soon. A week old.
dialogue:a1-directions-gate-5.tr: Kâğıtta şöyle yazıyor: Hemen döneceğim. Bir haftalık.

dialogue:a1-directions-gate-6.de: Eine Woche gleich zurück? Das ist nicht pünktlich.
dialogue:a1-directions-gate-6.en: A week of back soon? That is not punctual.
dialogue:a1-directions-gate-6.tr: Bir hafta hemen döneceğim mi? Bu dakik değil.

dialogue:a1-directions-choice-0.de: Sagst du ihren Namen laut, oder schreibst du ihn auf?
dialogue:a1-directions-choice-0.en: Will you say her name aloud, or write it down?
dialogue:a1-directions-choice-0.tr: Adını yüksek sesle mi söylersin, yoksa yazar mısın?

choice:a1-directions:knock.en: I will say aloud: Frau Berg!

choice:a1-directions:leave-note.de: Ich schreibe ihren Namen auf Papier.
choice:a1-directions:leave-note.en: I will write her name on paper.

dialogue:a1-directions-complete-0.de: Am Brunnen sitzt eine alte Frau. Sie liest.
dialogue:a1-directions-complete-0.en: An old woman is sitting by the fountain. She is reading.
dialogue:a1-directions-complete-0.tr: Çeşmenin yanında yaşlı bir kadın oturuyor. Okuyor.

dialogue:a1-directions-after-knock-0.de: Frau Berg! Frau Berg! Keiner antwortet.
dialogue:a1-directions-after-knock-0.en: Frau Berg! Frau Berg! Nobody answers.
dialogue:a1-directions-after-knock-0.tr: Frau Berg! Frau Berg! Kimse cevap vermiyor.

dialogue:a1-directions-after-knock-1.de: Aber die Straße hat den Namen gehört.
dialogue:a1-directions-after-knock-1.en: But the street has heard the name.

dialogue:a1-directions-after-leave-note-.de: Gut. Hier ist Papier für dich.
dialogue:a1-directions-after-leave-note-.en: Good. Here is paper for you.

dialogue:a1-directions-after-leave-note-.de: Frau Berg, wir warten. Das ist gut so.
dialogue:a1-directions-after-leave-note-.en: Frau Berg, we are waiting. That is good.

dialogue:a1-directions-topic-letter-0.de: Zu Gartenstraße sieben. Aber wer wohnt dort?
dialogue:a1-directions-topic-letter-0.en: To Gartenstraße seven. But who lives there?
dialogue:a1-directions-topic-letter-0.tr: Gartenstraße yediye. Ama orada kim oturuyor?

dialogue:a1-directions-topic-letter-1.de: Vielleicht Frau Berg. Der Brief sagt nichts.
dialogue:a1-directions-topic-letter-1.en: Maybe Frau Berg. The letter says nothing.
dialogue:a1-directions-topic-letter-1.tr: Belki Frau Berg. Mektup hiçbir şey söylemiyor.

dialogue:a1-directions-topic-post-0.de: Gegenüber vom Café. Du siehst sie gleich.
dialogue:a1-directions-topic-post-0.en: Opposite the café. You will see it right away.

topic:a1-directions:station.en: How do I get to the station?

dialogue:a1-directions-topic-station-0.de: Geradeaus, dann rechts. Es ist nicht weit.
dialogue:a1-directions-topic-station-0.en: Straight ahead, then right. It is not far.

evidence:a1-directions:lindenhafen-berg-.de: Ein Haus ohne Namen. Papier: Bin gleich zurück.
evidence:a1-directions:lindenhafen-berg-.en: A door without a name. A note: Back soon.
evidence:a1-directions:lindenhafen-berg-.tr: Adsız bir kapı. Bir not: Hemen döneceğim.

gate-prompt:a1-station.en: Ask the man on the bench if the seat is free.
gate-prompt:a1-station.tr: Banktaki adama yerin boş olup olmadığını sor.

objective:a1-station:0.en: Meet Otto at the station in the evening

objective:a1-station:1.en: Look at the bench and the departure board

objective:a1-station:2.en: Ask the man on the bench if the seat is free.
objective:a1-station:2.tr: Banktaki adama yerin boş olup olmadığını sor.

objective:a1-station:3.en: Decide what happens to the old station office
objective:a1-station:3.tr: Eski istasyon ofisine ne olacağına karar ver

dialogue:a1-station-intro-0.de: Guten Abend. Heute fährt kein Zug mehr.
dialogue:a1-station-intro-0.en: Good evening. No more trains today.
dialogue:a1-station-intro-0.tr: İyi akşamlar. Bugün artık tren yok.

dialogue:a1-station-intro-1.de: Die Laterne ist an. Siehst du sie?
dialogue:a1-station-intro-1.en: The lantern is lit. Can you see it?

dialogue:a1-station-intro-2.de: Die Laterne ist aus. Das ist nicht richtig.
dialogue:a1-station-intro-2.en: The lantern is dark. That is not right.

dialogue:a1-station-intro-3.de: Lina sagt, du warst bei Frau Berg.
dialogue:a1-station-intro-3.en: Lina says you went to Frau Berg’s house.

dialogue:a1-station-intro-4.de: Lina sagt, du hast Frau Berg geschrieben.
dialogue:a1-station-intro-4.en: Lina says you left Frau Berg a note.
dialogue:a1-station-intro-4.tr: Lina, Frau Berg'e not bıraktığını söylüyor.

dialogue:a1-station-intro-5.de: Das W steht immer noch auf dem Plan.
dialogue:a1-station-intro-5.en: The W is still on the board.

dialogue:a1-station-intro-6.de: Siehst du die Bank? Das ist Voss.
dialogue:a1-station-intro-6.en: See the bench? That is Voss.
dialogue:a1-station-intro-6.tr: Şu bankı görüyor musun? O Voss.

dialogue:a1-station-intro-7.de: Er kommt jeden Abend. Er fährt nie.
dialogue:a1-station-intro-7.en: He comes every evening. He never travels.
dialogue:a1-station-intro-7.tr: Her akşam gelir. Hiç yolculuk yapmaz.

dialogue:a1-station-intro-8.de: Er hat eine kleine Maschine. Er hört zu.
dialogue:a1-station-intro-8.en: He has a little machine. He listens to it.
dialogue:a1-station-intro-8.tr: Küçük bir makinesi var. Onu dinler.

dialogue:a1-station-intro-9.de: Er sitzt immer links. Rechts liegt seine Jacke.
dialogue:a1-station-intro-9.en: He always sits on the left. His coat takes the right.
dialogue:a1-station-intro-9.tr: Hep solda oturur. Sağda ceketi durur.

dialogue:a1-station-gate-0.de: Es gibt nur eine Bank. Komm.
dialogue:a1-station-gate-0.en: There is only one bench. Come on.

dialogue:a1-station-choice-0.de: Ja. Bitte. Die Jacke hat keine Fahrkarte.
dialogue:a1-station-choice-0.en: Yes. Please. The coat has no ticket.

dialogue:a1-station-choice-1.de: Einen Moment, bitte. Jetzt spricht sie.
dialogue:a1-station-choice-1.en: One moment, please. She is speaking now.
dialogue:a1-station-choice-1.tr: Bir dakika, lütfen. Şimdi o konuşuyor.

dialogue:a1-station-choice-2.de: Eine Frau. Sie spricht sehr leise.
dialogue:a1-station-choice-2.en: A woman. She speaks very quietly.
dialogue:a1-station-choice-2.tr: Bir kadın. Çok alçak sesle konuşuyor.

dialogue:a1-station-choice-3.de: Ist da jemand? Ich bin noch hier.
dialogue:a1-station-choice-3.en: Is anyone there? I am still here.
dialogue:a1-station-choice-3.tr: Orada biri var mı? Ben hâlâ buradayım.

dialogue:a1-station-choice-4.de: Ich höre sie jeden Abend. Sie hört mich nicht.
dialogue:a1-station-choice-4.en: I hear her every evening. She cannot hear me.
dialogue:a1-station-choice-4.tr: Onu her akşam duyuyorum. O beni duymuyor.

dialogue:a1-station-choice-5.de: Wer ist sie? Sie steht nicht in meinem Buch.
dialogue:a1-station-choice-5.en: Who is she? She is not in my ledger.

dialogue:a1-station-choice-6.de: Ihre Fahrkarte liegt in meinem Büro. Ihr Name ist weg.
dialogue:a1-station-choice-6.en: Your ticket is in my office. Your name has gone from it.
dialogue:a1-station-choice-6.tr: Biletiniz ofisimde duruyor. Üstündeki ad silinmiş.

dialogue:a1-station-choice-7.de: Frau Berg steht jetzt in meinem Buch. Ordnung ist Ordnung.
dialogue:a1-station-choice-7.en: Frau Berg is in my ledger now. Rules are rules.
dialogue:a1-station-choice-7.tr: Frau Berg artık defterimde. Düzen düzendir.

dialogue:a1-station-choice-8.de: Da ist mein altes Büro. Seit zwölf Jahren zu.
dialogue:a1-station-choice-8.en: That is my old office. Shut for twelve years.
dialogue:a1-station-choice-8.tr: Şurası benim eski ofisim. On iki yıldır kapalı.

dialogue:a1-station-choice-9.de: Schreibt Voss das W auf, oder öffnen wir das Büro?
dialogue:a1-station-choice-9.en: Does Voss write down the W, or do we open the office?
dialogue:a1-station-choice-9.tr: Voss W'yi yazsın mı, yoksa ofisi mi açalım?

choice:a1-station:report.de: Herr Voss, schreiben Sie das W auf.
choice:a1-station:report.en: Mr Voss, write down the W.

choice:a1-station:protect.de: Ich öffne das Büro mit Ottos Schlüssel.
choice:a1-station:protect.en: I will open the office with Otto’s key.

choice:a1-station:show-ledger.de: Herr Voss, hier ist Ihr Buch. Kommen Sie mit?
choice:a1-station:show-ledger.tr: Voss Bey, işte defteriniz. Benimle gelir misiniz?

choice:a1-station:ask-otto.de: Otto, hast du noch einen Schlüssel?
choice:a1-station:ask-otto.tr: Otto, bir anahtarın daha var mı?

dialogue:a1-station-after-report-0.de: Bahnsteig sieben, nach W. Ich schreibe es auf.
dialogue:a1-station-after-report-0.en: Platform seven, to W. I am writing it down.

dialogue:a1-station-after-report-1.de: Das W ist jetzt im Buch. Mein Büro bleibt zu.
dialogue:a1-station-after-report-1.en: The W is in the ledger now. My office stays shut.
dialogue:a1-station-after-report-1.tr: W artık defterde. Ofisim kapalı kalıyor.

dialogue:a1-station-after-protect-0.de: Noch einen Schlüssel? Klar. Ich habe immer zwei.
dialogue:a1-station-after-protect-0.en: Another key? Of course. I always have two.
dialogue:a1-station-after-protect-0.tr: Bir anahtar daha mı? Tabii. Hep iki tane taşırım.

dialogue:a1-station-after-protect-1.de: Ich komme mit. Ordnung ist Ordnung.
dialogue:a1-station-after-protect-1.en: I will come with you. Rules are rules.

dialogue:a1-station-after-protect-2.de: Das Büro ist auf. Alles ist noch da.
dialogue:a1-station-after-protect-2.en: The office is open. Everything is still there.

dialogue:a1-station-after-protect-3.de: Mein altes Buch. Und hier: Fahrkarten.
dialogue:a1-station-after-protect-3.en: My old register. And here: tickets.

dialogue:a1-station-after-protect-4.de: Hundert Fahrkarten für Bahnsteig sieben. Auf jeder steht E.
dialogue:a1-station-after-protect-4.en: A hundred tickets for platform seven. Every one says E.
dialogue:a1-station-after-protect-4.tr: Yedinci peron için yüz bilet. Hepsinde E yazıyor.

dialogue:a1-station-after-protect-5.de: Und ich habe sie nie verkauft. Nie.
dialogue:a1-station-after-protect-5.en: And I never sold them. Never.
dialogue:a1-station-after-protect-5.tr: Ve ben onları hiç satmadım. Hiç.

dialogue:a1-station-complete-0.de: Es ist spät. Morgen bin ich wieder hier.
dialogue:a1-station-complete-0.en: It is late. I will be here again in the morning.
dialogue:a1-station-complete-0.tr: Geç oldu. Sabah yine burada olurum.

dialogue:a1-station-topic-man-0.de: Voss. Er kommt jeden Abend. Immer allein.
dialogue:a1-station-topic-man-0.en: Voss. He comes every evening. Always alone.
dialogue:a1-station-topic-man-0.tr: Voss. Her akşam gelir. Hep yalnız.

dialogue:a1-station-topic-man-1.de: Er kauft nie eine Fahrkarte. Er fährt nie.
dialogue:a1-station-topic-man-1.en: He never buys a ticket. He never travels.
dialogue:a1-station-topic-man-1.tr: Hiç bilet almaz. Hiç yolculuk etmez.

dialogue:a1-station-topic-machine-0.de: Eine Frau. Immer nur zwei Sätze.
dialogue:a1-station-topic-machine-0.en: A woman. Always just two sentences.
dialogue:a1-station-topic-machine-0.tr: Bir kadın. Hep sadece iki cümle.

dialogue:a1-station-topic-machine-1.de: Er sagt, das ist Arbeit. Ich glaube das nicht.
dialogue:a1-station-topic-machine-1.en: He says it is work. I do not believe that.
dialogue:a1-station-topic-machine-1.tr: İş olduğunu söylüyor. Ben buna inanmıyorum.

evidence:a1-station:lindenhafen-bench.de: Die Bank am Bahnhof. Hier sitzt Voss jeden Abend.
evidence:a1-station:lindenhafen-bench.en: The bench at the station. Voss sits here every evening.
evidence:a1-station:lindenhafen-bench.tr: İstasyondaki bank. Voss her akşam burada oturur.

evidence:a1-station:lindenhafen-noticebo.de: Bahnsteig 7: Nach W… 18 Uhr. Kein Zug.
evidence:a1-station:lindenhafen-noticebo.en: Platform 7: To W… 6 pm. No train.

gate-prompt:a1-weather.en: Ask Otto what the weather is like tomorrow.
gate-prompt:a1-weather.tr: Otto'ya yarın havanın nasıl olacağını sor.

objective:a1-weather:0.en: Meet Otto at the station in the rain

objective:a1-weather:2.en: Ask Otto what the weather is like tomorrow.
objective:a1-weather:2.tr: Otto'ya yarın havanın nasıl olacağını sor.

objective:a1-weather:3.en: Decide what happens to Voss’s umbrella
objective:a1-weather:3.tr: Voss'un şemsiyesine ne olacağına karar ver

dialogue:a1-weather-intro-0.de: Guten Morgen. Es regnet. Der Regen ist pünktlich.
dialogue:a1-weather-intro-0.en: Good morning. It is raining. The rain is punctual.

dialogue:a1-weather-intro-1.de: Das gefällt mir nicht. Zu pünktlich.
dialogue:a1-weather-intro-1.en: I do not like that. Too punctual.

dialogue:a1-weather-intro-2.de: Die Laterne von Bahnsteig sieben ist weg.
dialogue:a1-weather-intro-2.en: The lantern of platform seven is gone.

dialogue:a1-weather-intro-3.de: Emil hat sie. Er repariert sie.
dialogue:a1-weather-intro-3.en: Emil has it. He is repairing it.

dialogue:a1-weather-intro-lit.de: Gestern Abend war sie noch hell.
dialogue:a1-weather-intro-lit.en: Last night it was still bright.

dialogue:a1-weather-intro-dark.de: Gestern Abend war sie nicht hell. Heute ist sie weg.
dialogue:a1-weather-intro-dark.en: Last night it was not bright. Today it is gone.
dialogue:a1-weather-intro-dark.tr: Dün akşam parlak değildi. Bugün de yok.

dialogue:a1-weather-gate-request.de: Heute regnet es. Du willst morgen gehen.
dialogue:a1-weather-gate-request.en: It is raining today. You want to leave tomorrow.
dialogue:a1-weather-gate-request.tr: Bugün yağmur yağıyor. Yarın gitmek istiyorsun.

dialogue:a1-weather-gate-request:variant.en: It is raining today. And tomorrow?

dialogue:a1-weather-gate-0.de: Morgen kommt die Sonne. Der Wind geht weg.
dialogue:a1-weather-gate-0.en: Tomorrow the sun comes. The wind goes away.

dialogue:a1-weather-gate-1.de: Heute ist es schlecht: Regen und Wind.
dialogue:a1-weather-gate-1.en: Today it is bad: rain and wind.
dialogue:a1-weather-gate-1.tr: Bugün hava kötü: yağmur ve rüzgâr.

dialogue:a1-weather-gate-2.de: Voss war gestern bis spät auf der Bank.
dialogue:a1-weather-gate-2.en: Voss was on the bench until late yesterday.
dialogue:a1-weather-gate-2.tr: Voss dün geç saate kadar bankta oturdu.

dialogue:a1-weather-gate-3.de: Er kommt jeden Abend. Seit zwölf Jahren.
dialogue:a1-weather-gate-3.en: He comes every evening. For twelve years.
dialogue:a1-weather-gate-3.tr: Her akşam gelir. On iki yıldır.

dialogue:a1-weather-gate-4.de: Auf Bahnsteig sieben fährt kein Zug mehr.
dialogue:a1-weather-gate-4.en: No train runs on platform seven any more.

dialogue:a1-weather-gate-5.de: Ich sagte: Nehmen Sie einen Schirm.

dialogue:a1-weather-gate-6.de: Er sagte: Regen steht nicht im Plan.
dialogue:a1-weather-gate-6.en: He said: Rain is not in the plan.
dialogue:a1-weather-gate-6.tr: O da dedi ki: Yağmur planda yok.

dialogue:a1-weather-gate-7.de: Sein Schirm ist noch auf der Bank.
dialogue:a1-weather-gate-7.en: His umbrella is still on the bench.

dialogue:a1-weather-choice-0.de: Bringst du Voss den Schirm, oder bleibt er dort?
dialogue:a1-weather-choice-0.en: Will you bring Voss the umbrella, or will it stay there?
dialogue:a1-weather-choice-0.tr: Şemsiyeyi Voss'a sen mi götürürsün, yoksa orada mı kalsın?

choice:a1-weather:return-umbrella.en: I will bring him the umbrella.

choice:a1-weather:leave-umbrella.de: Der Schirm bleibt auf der Bank.
choice:a1-weather:leave-umbrella.en: The umbrella stays on the bench.

dialogue:a1-weather-complete-0.de: Geh jetzt zu Emil. Er hat die Laterne.
dialogue:a1-weather-complete-0.en: Go to Emil now. He has the lantern.

dialogue:a1-weather-after-return-umbrell.de: Gut. Er sitzt schon wieder auf der Bank.
dialogue:a1-weather-after-return-umbrell.en: Good. He is sitting on the bench again.

dialogue:a1-weather-after-return-umbrell.de: Er sagt nicht Danke. Aber ich sehe es.
dialogue:a1-weather-after-return-umbrell.en: He will not say thank you. But I will see it.

dialogue:a1-weather-after-leave-umbrella.de: Gut. Der Schirm bleibt auf der Bank.
dialogue:a1-weather-after-leave-umbrella.en: Good. The umbrella stays on the bench.

dialogue:a1-weather-after-leave-umbrella.de: Heute Abend sieht er ihn. Er kommt ja immer.
dialogue:a1-weather-after-leave-umbrella.en: He will see it this evening. He always comes.
dialogue:a1-weather-after-leave-umbrella.tr: Bu akşam görür. Zaten hep gelir.

topic:a1-weather:yesterday.en: What was the weather like yesterday?

dialogue:a1-weather-topic-yesterday-0.de: Auch Regen. Aber nicht so schlecht.
dialogue:a1-weather-topic-yesterday-0.en: Rain too. But not so bad.
dialogue:a1-weather-topic-yesterday-0.tr: Yine yağmur. Ama bu kadar kötü değildi.

dialogue:a1-weather-topic-sun-0.de: Morgen am Mittag. Aber nicht pünktlich.
dialogue:a1-weather-topic-sun-0.en: Tomorrow at noon. But not punctually.

dialogue:a1-weather-topic-lantern-0.de: Bei Emil. Er hat sie heute geholt.
dialogue:a1-weather-topic-lantern-0.en: At Emil’s. He fetched it today.

evidence:a1-weather:lindenhafen-platform.de: Bahnsteig sieben. Die alte Laterne fehlt.
evidence:a1-weather:lindenhafen-platform.en: Platform seven. The old lantern is missing.

gate-prompt:a1-workshop.en: Tell Emil you need a lamp.
gate-prompt:a1-workshop.tr: Emil'e bir lambaya ihtiyacın olduğunu söyle.

objective:a1-workshop:2.en: Tell Emil you need a lamp.
objective:a1-workshop:2.tr: Emil'e bir lambaya ihtiyacın olduğunu söyle.

dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-0.de: Hallo! Vorsicht, hier liegt Glas. Und da. Und da!
dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-0.en: Hello! Careful, there is glass here. And there. And there!
dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-0.tr: Merhaba! Dikkat, burada cam var. Ve şurada. Ve şurada da!

dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-1.de: Ich bin Emil. Ich repariere alles. Meist.
dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-1.en: I am Emil. I repair everything. Mostly.
dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-1.tr: Ben Emil. Her şeyi onarırım. Çoğunlukla.

dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-2.de: Ottos altes Buch? Hundert Fahrkarten mit E? Das ist viel!
dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-2.en: Otto’s old register? A hundred tickets signed E? That is a lot!
dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-2.tr: Otto'nun eski defteri mi? E imzalı yüz bilet mi? Bu çok fazla!

dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-3.de: Voss war heute hier. Er schreibt auch meinen Kaffee auf.
dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-3.en: Voss was here today. He even writes down my coffee.
dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-3.tr: Voss bugün buradaydı. Benim kahvemi bile yazıyor.

dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-4.de: Du kommst von Otto? Die Laterne ist hier.
dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-4.en: Otto sent you? The lantern is here.
dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-4.tr: Otto mu gönderdi seni? Fener burada.

dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-5.de: Ich habe eine Lampe gemacht. Aus der alten Laterne.
dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-5.en: I made a lamp. Out of the old lantern.

dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-6.de: Neues Glas, neues Licht. Aber sie funktioniert nicht richtig.
dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-6.en: New glass, new light. But it does not work properly.
dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-6.tr: Yeni cam, yeni ışık. Ama düzgün çalışmıyor.

dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-7.de: Hier am Tisch ist sie hell. Dort geht sie aus.
dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-7.en: Here at the bench it is bright. Over there it goes out.

dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-8.de: Ist sie kaputt? Ich weiß es nicht.
dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-8.en: Is it broken? I do not know.

dialogue:a1-workshop-gate-0.de: Komm! Sieh! Bei dir ist sie hell.
dialogue:a1-workshop-gate-0.en: Come here. Look! Next to you it is bright.

dialogue:a1-workshop-gate-1.de: Alle brauchen mich. Und du? Was brauchst du?
dialogue:a1-workshop-gate-1.en: Everybody needs me. And you? What do you need?
dialogue:a1-workshop-gate-1.tr: Herkesin bana ihtiyacı var. Peki ya senin? Neye ihtiyacın var?

dialogue:a1-workshop-gate-1:variant:0.de: Und du? Was brauchst du von mir?
dialogue:a1-workshop-gate-1:variant:0.en: And you? What do you need from me?
dialogue:a1-workshop-gate-1:variant:0.tr: Peki ya sen? Benden neye ihtiyacın var?

dialogue:a1-workshop-choice-0.de: Eine Lampe? Gut. Bei dir funktioniert sie.
dialogue:a1-workshop-choice-0.en: A lamp? Good. It works for you.
dialogue:a1-workshop-choice-0.tr: Bir lamba mı? İyi. Sende çalışıyor.

dialogue:a1-workshop-choice-1.de: Bei deiner Fahrkarte ist sie sehr hell.
dialogue:a1-workshop-choice-1.en: Next to your ticket it is very bright.

dialogue:a1-workshop-choice-2.de: Bei dir ist sie hell. Bei deinem Namen, glaube ich.
dialogue:a1-workshop-choice-2.en: It is bright next to you. Next to your name, I think.
dialogue:a1-workshop-choice-2.tr: Senin yanında parlak. Sanırım adının yanında.

dialogue:a1-workshop-choice-3.de: Deine Rechnung von Marta! Auch hier ist sie hell.
dialogue:a1-workshop-choice-3.en: Your receipt from Marta! It is bright there too.
dialogue:a1-workshop-choice-3.tr: Marta'dan aldığın fiş! Orada da parlak.

dialogue:a1-workshop-choice-4.de: Gestern war ich in der Gartenstraße. Da ging sie aus.
dialogue:a1-workshop-choice-4.en: Yesterday I was on Garden Street. It went out there.

dialogue:a1-workshop-choice-5.de: Sieh, nach links zur Post: an, aus, an, aus.
dialogue:a1-workshop-choice-5.en: Look, to the left, towards the post office: on, off, on, off.
dialogue:a1-workshop-choice-5.tr: Bak, sola, postaneye doğru: yanıyor, sönüyor, yanıyor, sönüyor.

dialogue:a1-workshop-choice-6.de: Dort geht ein Name weg. Oder eine Adresse.
dialogue:a1-workshop-choice-6.en: A name is fading over there. Or an address.
dialogue:a1-workshop-choice-6.tr: Orada bir ad siliniyor. Ya da bir adres.

dialogue:a1-workshop-choice-7.de: Meine Uhr funktioniert meist. Die Lampe? Nicht so.
dialogue:a1-workshop-choice-7.en: My clock mostly works. The lamp? Not like that.
dialogue:a1-workshop-choice-7.tr: Saatim çoğunlukla çalışır. Lamba mı? Öyle değil.

dialogue:a1-workshop-choice-8.de: Schreibt Voss die Lampe auf, oder nimmst du sie mit?
dialogue:a1-workshop-choice-8.en: Does Voss write the lamp down, or do you take it with you?
dialogue:a1-workshop-choice-8.tr: Voss lambayı deftere mi yazsın, yoksa sen mi alırsın?

choice:a1-workshop:report.de: Voss soll die Lampe in sein Buch schreiben.
choice:a1-workshop:report.en: Voss should put the lamp in his ledger.

choice:a1-workshop:protect.en: I will take the lamp with me.

dialogue:a1-workshop-after-report-0.de: Gut. Voss gibt ihr eine Nummer. Lampe Nummer eins.
dialogue:a1-workshop-after-report-0.en: All right. Voss gives it a number. Lamp number one.
dialogue:a1-workshop-after-report-0.tr: Peki. Voss ona bir numara verir. Bir numaralı lamba.

dialogue:a1-workshop-after-report-1.de: Dann bekommst du sie. Mit Stempel, klar.
dialogue:a1-workshop-after-report-1.en: Then you get it. With a stamp, of course.

dialogue:a1-workshop-after-protect-0.de: Gut. Nimm sie mit. Sie funktioniert bei dir.
dialogue:a1-workshop-after-protect-0.en: Good. Take it. It works for you.

dialogue:a1-workshop-after-protect-1.de: Und bring sie zurück. Otto will seine Laterne wieder!
dialogue:a1-workshop-after-protect-1.en: And bring it back. Otto wants his lantern back!
dialogue:a1-workshop-after-protect-1.tr: Ve geri getir. Otto fenerini geri istiyor!

dialogue:a1-workshop-complete-0.de: Moment! Linas Fahrrad ist auch hier.
dialogue:a1-workshop-complete-0.en: Wait! Lina’s bike is here too.

topic:a1-workshop:origin.en: Where does the lantern come from?

dialogue:a1-workshop-topic-origin-0.de: Von Bahnsteig sieben. Sie war kaputt.
dialogue:a1-workshop-topic-origin-0.en: From platform seven. It was broken.

dialogue:a1-workshop-topic-origin-1.de: Otto hat sie mir gebracht. Er will sie zurück.
dialogue:a1-workshop-topic-origin-1.en: Otto brought it to me. He wants it back.

dialogue:a1-workshop-topic-how-0.de: Ich weiß es nicht. Noch nicht!
dialogue:a1-workshop-topic-how-0.en: I do not know. Not yet!

dialogue:a1-workshop-topic-how-1.de: Bei Namen ist sie hell. Ohne Namen geht sie aus.
dialogue:a1-workshop-topic-how-1.en: Near names it is bright. Without names it goes out.

evidence:a1-workshop:lindenhafen-workben.de: Glas, Papier, Kaffee. Und eine Lampe aus der alten Laterne.
evidence:a1-workshop:lindenhafen-workben.en: Glass, paper, coffee. And a lamp made from the old lantern.
evidence:a1-workshop:lindenhafen-workben.tr: Cam, kâğıt, kahve. Ve eski fenerden yapılmış bir lamba.

gate-prompt:a1-bike.en: Ask Emil when Lina’s bike will be ready.
gate-prompt:a1-bike.tr: Emil'e Lina'nın bisikletinin ne zaman hazır olacağını sor.

objective:a1-bike:2.en: Ask Emil when Lina’s bike will be ready.
objective:a1-bike:2.tr: Emil'e Lina'nın bisikletinin ne zaman hazır olacağını sor.

objective:a1-bike:3.en: Decide how to pay for Lina’s bike
objective:a1-bike:3.tr: Lina'nın bisikletini nasıl ödeyeceğine karar ver

dialogue:a1-bike-intro-0.de: Hallo! Ich finde alles. Nur nicht gleich.
dialogue:a1-bike-intro-0.en: Hello! I find everything. Just not right away.
dialogue:a1-bike-intro-0.tr: Merhaba! Her şeyi bulurum. Sadece hemen değil.

dialogue:a1-bike-intro-1.de: Das Fahrrad ist von Lina. Es war kaputt.
dialogue:a1-bike-intro-1.en: The bike is Lina’s. It was broken.

dialogue:a1-bike-intro-registered.de: Voss hat mein Licht in sein Buch geschrieben.
dialogue:a1-bike-intro-registered.en: Voss wrote my light in his book.

dialogue:a1-bike-gate-request.de: Du holst Linas Fahrrad? Es ist noch nicht fertig.
dialogue:a1-bike-gate-request.en: You are collecting Lina’s bike? It is not ready yet.
dialogue:a1-bike-gate-request.tr: Lina'nın bisikletini mi alıyorsun? Henüz hazır değil.

dialogue:a1-bike-gate-request:variant:0.de: Du holst das Fahrrad? Es ist nicht fertig.
dialogue:a1-bike-gate-request:variant:0.en: You are collecting the bike? It is not ready.

dialogue:a1-bike-gate-0.de: Heute Nachmittag. Das Fahrrad geht meistens.
dialogue:a1-bike-gate-0.en: This afternoon. The bike mostly works.
dialogue:a1-bike-gate-0.tr: Bu öğleden sonra. Bisiklet çoğunlukla çalışıyor.

dialogue:a1-bike-gate-2.de: Hier ist mein Buch. Alles steht hier.
dialogue:a1-bike-gate-2.en: Here is my book. Everything is written here.
dialogue:a1-bike-gate-2.tr: İşte defterim. Her şey burada yazılı.

dialogue:a1-bike-gate-3.de: Vor einer Woche hat eine Frau Glas gekauft.
dialogue:a1-bike-gate-3.en: A week ago a woman bought glass.
dialogue:a1-bike-gate-3.tr: Bir hafta önce bir kadın cam aldı.

dialogue:a1-bike-gate-4.de: Es war für eine alte Laterne. Sie hat bar bezahlt.
dialogue:a1-bike-gate-4.en: It was for an old lantern. She paid cash.
dialogue:a1-bike-gate-4.tr: Eski bir fener içindi. Nakit ödedi.

dialogue:a1-bike-gate-5.de: Unterschrift: E. Ihre Hände waren schwarz.
dialogue:a1-bike-gate-5.en: Signature: E. Her hands were black.

dialogue:a1-bike-gate-6.de: Ich kenne sie. Aber ihr Name ist weg.
dialogue:a1-bike-gate-6.en: I know her. But her name is gone.

dialogue:a1-bike-choice-0.de: Bezahlst du das Fahrrad jetzt, oder schreibe ich es auf?
dialogue:a1-bike-choice-0.en: Will you pay for the bike now, or shall I write it down?
dialogue:a1-bike-choice-0.tr: Bisikletin parasını şimdi mi ödersin, yoksa ben mi yazayım?

choice:a1-bike:pay-later.en: Please write it in the book.

dialogue:a1-bike-complete-0.de: Lina wartet auf ihr Fahrrad. Geh zur Post.
dialogue:a1-bike-complete-0.en: Lina is waiting for her bike. Go to the post office.

dialogue:a1-bike-after-pay-now-0.de: Danke! Zwanzig Euro. Das ist schnell.
dialogue:a1-bike-after-pay-now-0.en: Thanks! Twenty euros. That is quick.
dialogue:a1-bike-after-pay-now-0.tr: Sağ ol! Yirmi avro. Bu çabuk oldu.

dialogue:a1-bike-after-pay-now-1.de: Lina bekommt heute ein fertiges Fahrrad.
dialogue:a1-bike-after-pay-now-1.en: Lina gets a finished bike today.
dialogue:a1-bike-after-pay-now-1.tr: Lina bugün hazır bir bisiklet alıyor.

dialogue:a1-bike-after-pay-later-0.de: Kein Problem. Ich schreibe es ins Buch.
dialogue:a1-bike-after-pay-later-0.en: No problem. I will write it in the book.

dialogue:a1-bike-after-pay-later-1.de: Lina zahlt am Freitag. Dann steht es da.
dialogue:a1-bike-after-pay-later-1.en: Lina pays on Friday. Then it is there.
dialogue:a1-bike-after-pay-later-1.tr: Lina cuma günü öder. O zaman orada yazılı olur.

dialogue:a1-bike-topic-bike-0.en: At the back, by the lantern.

dialogue:a1-bike-topic-cost-0.de: Zwanzig Euro. Das ist nicht viel.
dialogue:a1-bike-topic-cost-0.en: Twenty euros. That is not much.

dialogue:a1-bike-topic-woman-0.de: Das weiß ich nicht mehr. Sie hatte keine Zeit.
dialogue:a1-bike-topic-woman-0.en: I do not remember. She had no time.

evidence:a1-bike:lindenhafen-workbench.de: Emils Buch: Glas für eine Laterne. Unterschrift: E.
evidence:a1-bike:lindenhafen-workbench.en: Emil’s book: glass for a lantern. Signed: E.
evidence:a1-bike:lindenhafen-workbench.tr: Emil'in defteri: bir fener için cam. İmza: E.

gate-prompt:a1-phone.en: Ask on the phone to speak to Otto.

objective:a1-phone:0.en: Meet Marta at the café counter

objective:a1-phone:1.en: Look at the telephone and the notes by it

objective:a1-phone:2.en: Ask on the phone to speak to Otto.

objective:a1-phone:3.en: Decide whether to spell your name for Voss
objective:a1-phone:3.tr: Voss için adını harf harf söyleyip söylemeyeceğine karar ver

dialogue:a1-phone-intro-1.de: Du musst ihn anrufen. Es ist wichtig.
dialogue:a1-phone-intro-1.en: You have to call him. It is important.

dialogue:a1-phone-intro-2.de: Die Nummer vom Bahnhof: drei, vier, sieben.
dialogue:a1-phone-intro-2.en: The station number: three, four, seven.

dialogue:a1-phone-intro-3.de: Ich höre nicht zu. Nur ein bisschen.
dialogue:a1-phone-intro-3.en: I am not listening. Only a little.

dialogue:a1-phone-intro-4.de: Hier, nimm das Telefon. Es ist für dich.
dialogue:a1-phone-intro-4.en: Here, take the telephone. It is for you.

dialogue:a1-phone-gate-0.de: Es dauert kurz. Dann antwortet ein Mann.
dialogue:a1-phone-gate-0.en: It takes a moment. Then a man answers.
dialogue:a1-phone-gate-0.tr: Biraz sürer. Sonra bir adam cevap verir.

dialogue:a1-phone-gate-1.de: Bahnhof Lindenhafen, Voss. Wen möchten Sie sprechen?
dialogue:a1-phone-gate-1.en: Lindenhafen station, Voss. Whom would you like to speak to?
dialogue:a1-phone-gate-1.tr: Lindenhafen istasyonu, Voss. Kiminle görüşmek istiyorsunuz?

dialogue:a1-phone-choice-0.de: Herr Otto ist auf Gleis sieben. Er kommt gleich.
dialogue:a1-phone-choice-0.en: Mr Otto is at platform seven. He is coming soon.
dialogue:a1-phone-choice-0.tr: Otto Bey yedinci rayda. Birazdan gelir.

dialogue:a1-phone-choice-1.de: Die Rechnung vom Café habe ich. Danke.
dialogue:a1-phone-choice-1.en: I have the receipt from the café. Thank you.

dialogue:a1-phone-choice-2.de: Die Rechnung haben Sie mitgenommen. Gut.
dialogue:a1-phone-choice-2.en: You took the receipt with you. Fine.

dialogue:a1-phone-choice-3.de: Ich buchstabiere: V, O, S, S. Verstanden?
dialogue:a1-phone-choice-3.en: I spell: V, O, S, S. Understood?
dialogue:a1-phone-choice-3.tr: Harf harf söylüyorum: V, O, S, S. Anlaşıldı mı?

dialogue:a1-phone-choice-4.de: Das weiß hier jeder, Herr Voss!
dialogue:a1-phone-choice-4.en: Everyone here knows that, Mr Voss!
dialogue:a1-phone-choice-4.tr: Bunu burada herkes bilir, Herr Voss!

dialogue:a1-phone-choice-5.de: Ich habe das Register vor mir. Gartenstraße sieben.
dialogue:a1-phone-choice-5.en: I have the register in front of me. Gartenstraße seven.
