gate-prompt:a1-office-window.tr: Frau Kessler’e bunu onun yazdığını söyle.

objective:a1-office-window:0.en: Go to the Brass Office window

objective:a1-office-window:2.en: Tell Frau Kessler that she wrote it.
objective:a1-office-window:2.tr: Frau Kessler’e bunu onun yazdığını söyle.

objective:a1-office-window:3.en: Choose what to take from the Office

dialogue:a1-office-window-topic-why-quie.de: Ruhig ist gut. Das sage ich immer.
dialogue:a1-office-window-topic-why-quie.en: Quiet is good. I always say so.

dialogue:a1-office-window-topic-why-quie.de: Wer nichts sagt, macht keine Fehler.
dialogue:a1-office-window-topic-why-quie.en: Whoever says nothing makes no mistakes.

dialogue:a1-office-window-topic-how-long.de: Seit einem Jahr. Jeden Tag. Auch am Sonntag.
dialogue:a1-office-window-topic-how-long.en: For a year. Every day. Sundays too.
dialogue:a1-office-window-topic-how-long.tr: Bir yıldır. Her gün. Pazar günleri de.

topic:a1-office-window:how-long.en: How long have you worked here?

evidence:a1-office-window:lindenhafen-of.de: Gartenstraße 7: kein Name. Daneben: Regel vier. Wie auf dem Zettel.
evidence:a1-office-window:lindenhafen-of.en: 7 Gartenstraße: no name. Beside it: Rule four. Written as on the notice.
evidence:a1-office-window:lindenhafen-of.tr: Gartenstraße 7: isim yok. Yanında: dördüncü kural. Nottaki gibi.

clue:a1-office-window:text:0.de: Im Register ist ein Name weg. Daneben steht: Regel vier.
clue:a1-office-window:text:0.en: A name is gone from the register. Beside it: Rule four.
clue:a1-office-window:text:0.tr: Kayıt defterinden bir isim silinmiş. Yanında: Dördüncü kural.

clue:a1-office-window:text:1.de: Frau Kessler macht laute Namen leise.
clue:a1-office-window:text:1.en: Frau Kessler makes loud names quiet.

clue:a1-office-window:text:2.de: Sie sagt: Herr Voss weiß das.
clue:a1-office-window:text:2.en: She says: Mr Voss knows about it.
clue:a1-office-window:text:2.tr: Diyor ki: Bay Voss bunu biliyor.

clue:a1-office-window:lead:0.de: Linas Fahrrad ist noch bei Emil.
clue:a1-office-window:lead:0.en: Lina’s bike is still at Emil’s.

clue:a1-office-window:letter:0.de: Ruhig ist nicht leer. Aber leer ist nicht ruhig.
clue:a1-office-window:letter:0.en: Quiet is not empty. But empty is not quiet.
clue:a1-office-window:letter:0.tr: Sessiz boş değildir. Ama boş da sessiz değildir.

grammar-note:a1-office-window.de: Das Perfekt hat zwei Teile: haben vorne, geschrieben am Ende.
grammar-note:a1-office-window.en: The perfect has two parts: haben near the front, geschrieben at the end.
grammar-note:a1-office-window.tr: Geçmiş zamanın iki parçası var: haben başta, geschrieben sonda.

dialogue:a1-cafe-topic-woman-2.de: Sie hat gesagt: Dann sagt man ihn laut.
dialogue:a1-cafe-topic-woman-2.en: She said: then someone will say it out loud.
dialogue:a1-cafe-topic-woman-2.tr: Şöyle dedi: O zaman biri onu yüksek sesle söyler.

dialogue:a1-neighbour-intro-7.de: Heute war eine Frau vom Messingamt hier.
dialogue:a1-neighbour-intro-7.en: A woman from the Brass Office was here today.
dialogue:a1-neighbour-intro-7.tr: Bugün Pirinç Dairesi’nden bir kadın buradaydı.

dialogue:a1-neighbour-intro-8.de: Sie hat mein Gästebuch mitgenommen. Regel vier, sagt sie.
dialogue:a1-neighbour-intro-8.en: She took my guest book. Rule four, she says.
dialogue:a1-neighbour-intro-8.tr: Misafir defterimi aldı. Dördüncü kural, diyor.

dialogue:a1-neighbour-intro-9.de: Pip sagt Namen laut. Ich höre ihn bis hier.
dialogue:a1-neighbour-intro-9.en: Pip says names out loud. I can hear him from here.
dialogue:a1-neighbour-intro-9.tr: Pip isimleri yüksek sesle söylüyor. Buradan duyuyorum.

dialogue:a1-pharmacy-intro-4.de: Noch ein Beutel. Für A. K. Wer ist das?
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-intro-4.en: Another bag. For A. K. Who is that?
dialogue:a1-pharmacy-intro-4.tr: Bir torba daha. A. K. için. O kim?

dialogue:a1-directions-complete-1.de: Ich muss gehen. Geh zu ihr.
dialogue:a1-directions-complete-1.en: I have to go. Go to her.

dialogue:a1-station-intro-10.de: Frau Berg ist wieder da? Das ist gut. Sehr gut.
dialogue:a1-station-intro-10.en: Frau Berg is back? That is good. Very good.
dialogue:a1-station-intro-10.tr: Frau Berg geri mi döndü? Bu iyi. Çok iyi.

dialogue:a1-weather-intro-4.de: Die Laterne ist weg? Sehr gut. Ruhig ist gut.
dialogue:a1-weather-intro-4.en: The lantern is gone? Very good. Quiet is good.
dialogue:a1-weather-intro-4.tr: Fener gitti mi? Çok iyi. Sessiz iyidir.

dialogue:a1-weather-intro-5.de: Frau Kessler kommt jetzt jeden Morgen. Mit einem Zettel.
dialogue:a1-weather-intro-5.en: Frau Kessler comes every morning now. With a notice.
dialogue:a1-weather-intro-5.tr: Frau Kessler artık her sabah geliyor. Bir notla.

dialogue:a1-phone-choice-9.de: Moment. Hier stand ein Name. Jetzt ist er weg.
dialogue:a1-phone-choice-9.en: One moment. A name was written here. Now it is gone.
dialogue:a1-phone-choice-9.tr: Bir dakika. Burada bir isim yazılıydı. Şimdi silinmiş.

dialogue:a1-phone-choice-10.de: Das ist nicht meine Hand. Wer war das?
dialogue:a1-phone-choice-10.en: That is not my hand. Who did that?
dialogue:a1-phone-choice-10.tr: Bu benim el yazım değil. Bunu kim yaptı?

dialogue:a1-invitation-choice-9.de: Heute kommt sie mit Marta. Um acht Uhr.
dialogue:a1-invitation-choice-9.en: Today she is coming with Marta. At eight o’clock.

dialogue:a1-invitation-choice-10.de: Sie bleibt an ihrer Bank. Ich bringe ihr Suppe.
dialogue:a1-invitation-choice-10.en: She is staying at her bench. I will take her soup.

dialogue:a1-invitation-choice-11.de: Martas Gästebuch ist wieder da. Jeder Gast steht im Buch.
dialogue:a1-invitation-choice-11.en: Marta’s guest book is back. Every guest is in the book.
dialogue:a1-invitation-choice-11.tr: Marta’nın misafir defteri geri geldi. Her misafir defterde.

dialogue:a1-lost-found-choice-7.de: Und hier: eine alte Fahrkarte. Gleis sieben.
dialogue:a1-lost-found-choice-7.en: And here: an old ticket. Platform seven.
dialogue:a1-lost-found-choice-7.tr: Ve burada: eski bir bilet. Yedinci peron.

dialogue:a1-lost-found-choice-8.de: Der Name ist noch da: Lenz.
dialogue:a1-lost-found-choice-8.en: The name is still there: Lenz.

dialogue:a1-lost-found-choice-9.de: Lenz. So heißen wir. Pip und ich.
dialogue:a1-lost-found-choice-9.en: Lenz. That is our name. Pip and I.
dialogue:a1-lost-found-choice-9.tr: Lenz. Bizim soyadımız bu. Pip’in ve benim.

clue:a1-lost-found:text:1.de: Auf der Bank bei Gleis sieben lag ein schwarzer Handschuh. Die Tinte ist neu.
clue:a1-lost-found:text:1.en: A black glove lay on the bench at platform seven. The ink is fresh.
clue:a1-lost-found:text:1.tr: Yedinci perondaki bankta siyah bir eldiven vardı. Mürekkep taze.

clue:a1-lost-found:text:2.de: In der Kiste liegt eine alte Fahrkarte für Gleis sieben. Der Name: Lenz.
clue:a1-lost-found:text:2.en: In the box is an old ticket for platform seven. The name: Lenz.
clue:a1-lost-found:text:2.tr: Kutuda yedinci peron için eski bir bilet var. İsim: Lenz.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-13.de: Und hier ist noch ein Brief. Für Frau Berg.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-13.en: And here is another letter. For Frau Berg.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-13.tr: Ve bir mektup daha var. Frau Berg için.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-14.de: Sie schläft bei Marta. Aber ihr Haus kennt sie nicht mehr.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-14.en: She sleeps at Marta’s. But her house no longer knows her.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-14.tr: Marta’nın yanında uyuyor. Ama evi artık onu tanımıyor.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-15.de: Sie sitzt an ihrer Bank. Aber ihr Haus kennt sie nicht mehr.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-15.en: She sits at her bench. But her house no longer knows her.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-15.tr: Bankında oturuyor. Ama evi artık onu tanımıyor.

dialogue:a1-departure-intro-8.de: Herr Voss, der Zug ist laut. Regel vier!
dialogue:a1-departure-intro-8.en: Mr Voss, the train is loud. Rule four!
dialogue:a1-departure-intro-8.tr: Bay Voss, tren gürültülü. Dördüncü kural!

dialogue:a1-departure-complete-2.de: Tschüss, {name}! Ich schreibe dich jeden Tag! Laut!
dialogue:a1-departure-complete-2.en: Bye, {name}! I will write you every day! Out loud!
dialogue:a1-departure-complete-2.tr: Hoşça kal, {name}! Seni her gün yazacağım! Yüksek sesle!

dialogue:a1-departure-complete-3.tr: Hoşça kal, {name}. Sessizce ama her gün.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-0.de: Schnell, {name}, komm rein! Ich halte die Tür. Heute führt sie nach Waldruh.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-0.en: Quick, {name}, come in! I am holding the door. Today it leads to Waldruh.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-0.tr: Çabuk, {name}, içeri gel! Kapıyı tutuyorum. Bugün Waldruh’a açılıyor.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-1.de: Vor fünf Minuten war dahinter noch meine Küche. Der Kaffee steht drüben.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-1.en: Five minutes ago my kitchen was behind it. The coffee is on the other side.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-1.tr: Beş dakika önce arkasında mutfağım vardı. Kahve öbür tarafta.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-2.de: Das Café und das Gasthaus haben eine Tür. Wenn sie klemmt, komme ich in keins.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-2.en: The café and the inn share one door. When it sticks, I cannot get into either.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-2.tr: Kafe ile hanın tek bir kapısı var. Sıkışınca hiçbirine giremiyorum.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-3.de: Guten Tag. Ich prüfe dieses Haus. Bitte halten Sie den Rahmen fest.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-3.en: Good afternoon. I am inspecting this building. Please hold the frame steady.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-3.tr: İyi günler. Bu binayı denetliyorum. Lütfen kasayı sabit tutun.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-4.de: Danke für die Adresse aus Lindenhafen. Sie hat mich direkt hierher geführt.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-4.en: Thank you for the address from Lindenhafen. It led me straight here.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-4.tr: Lindenhafen’den gelen adres için teşekkürler. Beni doğrudan buraya getirdi.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-5.de: Er kam durch meine Küche. Ohne zu klopfen. Mit drei Formularen.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-5.en: He came through my kitchen. Without knocking. With three forms.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-5.tr: Mutfağımdan geçti. Kapıyı çalmadan. Üç formla.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-6.de: Frau Kessler sagt, Sie haben ihre Liste. Darüber sprechen wir später.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-6.en: Frau Kessler says you have her list. We will talk about that later.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-6.tr: Frau Kessler listesinin sizde olduğunu söylüyor. Bunu sonra konuşuruz.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-7.de: In meiner Akte steht: Waldruh hat freiwillig aufgehört zu existieren.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-7.en: My file says Waldruh voluntarily stopped existing.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-7.tr: Dosyamda yazıyor: Waldruh kendi isteğiyle var olmayı bıraktı.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-8.de: Für ein Dorf, das es nicht gibt, haben wir sehr gute Kartoffeln.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-8.en: For a village that does not exist, we have very good potatoes.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-8.tr: Var olmayan bir köy için çok güzel patateslerimiz var.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-9.de: Diese Tür steht in keinem Register. Ohne Auftrag darf ich sie nicht reparieren.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-9.en: This door is in no register. Without a request I may not repair it.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-9.tr: Bu kapı hiçbir kayıtta yok. Talep olmadan onu tamir edemem.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-10.de: Am Brett hängt ein Mietvertrag. Mit deinem Namen. Ich habe dir gar kein Zimmer angeboten.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-10.en: There is a lease on the board. With your name. I never even offered you a room.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-10.tr: Panoda bir kira sözleşmesi asılı. Senin adınla. Sana oda bile teklif etmedim.

dialogue:a2-apartment-gate-0.de: Der Vertrag nennt Sie als Mieter. Wenn Sie es verlangen, fange ich an.
dialogue:a2-apartment-gate-0.en: The lease names you as the tenant. If you request it, I will begin.
dialogue:a2-apartment-gate-0.tr: Sözleşme sizi kiracı olarak gösteriyor. Siz isterseniz başlarım.

dialogue:a2-apartment-gate-0:variant:0.de: Sie sind der Mieter. Soll ich anfangen?
dialogue:a2-apartment-gate-0:variant:0.en: You are the tenant. Shall I begin?

choice:a2-apartment:restore.de: Wir lassen sie offen. Lindenhafen soll Waldruh sehen.
choice:a2-apartment:restore.en: We leave it open. Lindenhafen should see Waldruh.

choice:a2-apartment:consult.de: Wir fragen zuerst die Nachbarn hier.
choice:a2-apartment:consult.en: We ask the neighbours here first.

dialogue:a2-apartment-choice-0.de: Auftrag angenommen. Erst der Stempel, dann die Schraube.
dialogue:a2-apartment-choice-0.en: Request accepted. First the stamp, then the screw.
dialogue:a2-apartment-choice-0.tr: Talep kabul edildi. Önce mühür, sonra vida.

dialogue:a2-apartment-choice-1.de: Sie geht auf! Und mein Kaffee ist noch warm.
dialogue:a2-apartment-choice-1.en: It opens! And my coffee is still warm.

dialogue:a2-apartment-choice-2.de: Die Miete ist für ein Jahr bezahlt. Von Elise. Drei Monate vor Ihrer Ankunft.
dialogue:a2-apartment-choice-2.en: The rent is paid for a year. By Elise. Three months before your arrival.
dialogue:a2-apartment-choice-2.tr: Kira bir yıllığına ödenmiş. Elise tarafından. Gelişinizden üç ay önce.

dialogue:a2-apartment-choice-3.de: Am Vertrag hängt ein schwerer Schlüssel. Mit einer kleinen Laterne am Griff.
dialogue:a2-apartment-choice-3.en: A heavy key hangs from the lease. With a little lantern on the handle.
dialogue:a2-apartment-choice-3.tr: Sözleşmeye ağır bir anahtar asılı. Sapında küçük bir fener var.

dialogue:a2-apartment-choice-4.de: Den hat sie hiergelassen. Für dich. Ich weiß nicht, was er öffnet.
dialogue:a2-apartment-choice-4.en: She left it here. For you. I do not know what it opens.
dialogue:a2-apartment-choice-4.tr: Onu burada bıraktı. Senin için. Neyi açtığını bilmiyorum.

dialogue:a2-apartment-choice-5.de: Oben wohnt meine Großmutter. Siebzig Jahre in diesem Haus. Niemand hat sie je gefragt.
dialogue:a2-apartment-choice-5.en: My grandmother lives upstairs. Seventy years in this house. Nobody ever asked her.
dialogue:a2-apartment-choice-5.tr: Yukarıda büyükannem oturuyor. Bu evde yetmiş yıl. Kimse ona hiç sormadı.

dialogue:a2-apartment-choice-6.de: Eine offene Tür bringt jeden herein. Lassen wir sie offen, oder fragen wir zuerst die Nachbarn?
dialogue:a2-apartment-choice-6.en: An open door lets anyone in. Do we leave it open, or ask the neighbours first?
dialogue:a2-apartment-choice-6.tr: Açık kapı herkesi içeri alır. Açık mı bırakalım, yoksa önce komşulara mı soralım?

dialogue:a2-apartment-after-restore-0.de: Ich stelle einen Stuhl in die Tür.
dialogue:a2-apartment-after-restore-0.en: I will wedge a chair in the door.

dialogue:a2-apartment-after-restore-1.de: Post für Waldruh! Drei Briefe, alle von gestern.
dialogue:a2-apartment-after-restore-1.en: Post for Waldruh! Three letters, all from yesterday.
dialogue:a2-apartment-after-restore-1.tr: Waldruh’a posta! Üç mektup, hepsi dünden.

dialogue:a2-apartment-after-consult-0.de: Ich hänge einen Zettel an: Bitte zuerst klopfen.
dialogue:a2-apartment-after-consult-0.en: I will hang up a note: Please knock first.
dialogue:a2-apartment-after-consult-0.tr: Bir not asıyorum: Lütfen önce kapıyı çalın.

dialogue:a2-apartment-after-consult-1.de: Ich habe Klopfen gehört. Gibt es ein Treffen? Ich habe Suppe dabei.
dialogue:a2-apartment-after-consult-1.en: I heard knocking. Is there a meeting? I brought soup.
dialogue:a2-apartment-after-consult-1.tr: Kapı sesi duydum. Toplantı mı var? Çorba getirdim.

dialogue:a2-apartment-complete-0.de: Geh nach oben zu Oma Hilde. Sie wartet schon lange auf eine Frage.
dialogue:a2-apartment-complete-0.en: Go upstairs to Oma Hilde. She has been waiting a long time for a question.
dialogue:a2-apartment-complete-0.tr: Yukarı, Hilde Nine’ye çık. Uzun zamandır bir soru bekliyor.

objective:a2-apartment:0.en: Hold Marta’s door between two towns
objective:a2-apartment:0.tr: Marta’nın iki kasaba arasındaki kapısını tut

objective:a2-apartment:1.en: Read the lease on the housing board

objective:a2-apartment:2.en: Ask Inspector Voss politely whether he could please repair it.
objective:a2-apartment:2.tr: Müfettiş Voss’a bunu tamir edip edemeyeceğini kibarca sor.

objective:a2-apartment:3.en: Decide what happens to the open door
objective:a2-apartment:3.tr: Açık kapıya ne olacağına karar ver

dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-one-door-0.de: Früher war es ein Haus. Die Strecke lief mitten durch den Flur.
dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-one-door-0.en: It used to be one house. The route ran right through the hallway.
dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-one-door-0.tr: Eskiden tek bir evdi. Hat koridorun ortasından geçerdi.

dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-one-door-1.de: Dann war die Strecke weg, und das Haus stand in zwei Städten.
dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-one-door-1.en: Then the route was gone, and the house stood in two towns.
dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-one-door-1.tr: Sonra hat yok oldu ve ev iki kasabada birden kaldı.

dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-one-door-2.de: Die Tür ist geblieben. Türen sind treuer als Akten.
dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-one-door-2.en: The door stayed. Doors are more loyal than files.
dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-one-door-2.tr: Kapı kaldı. Kapılar dosyalardan daha sadıktır.

topic:a2-apartment:one-door.de: Warum haben das Café und das Gasthaus eine Tür?
topic:a2-apartment:one-door.en: Why do the café and the inn share a door?
topic:a2-apartment:one-door.tr: Kafe ile han neden tek kapıyı paylaşıyor?

dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-voss-stay-0.de: Bis die Akte und das Dorf dasselbe sagen.
dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-voss-stay-0.en: Until the file and the village say the same thing.
dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-voss-stay-0.tr: Dosya ile köy aynı şeyi söyleyene kadar.

dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-voss-stay-1.de: Bis dahin gilt die Akte. Sonst müsste ich jede Entscheidung meines Amtes prüfen.
dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-voss-stay-1.en: Until then, the file stands. Otherwise I would have to review every decision of my office.
dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-voss-stay-1.tr: O zamana kadar dosya geçerli. Yoksa dairemin her kararını incelemem gerekirdi.

topic:a2-apartment:voss-stay.de: Wie lange bleiben Sie in Waldruh, Herr Voss?
topic:a2-apartment:voss-stay.en: How long are you staying in Waldruh, Mr Voss?
topic:a2-apartment:voss-stay.tr: Waldruh’da ne kadar kalacaksınız, Bay Voss?

dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-key-0.de: Ich weiß es nicht. Elise hatte ihn immer bei sich.
dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-key-0.en: I do not know. Elise always kept it with her.
dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-key-0.tr: Bilmiyorum. Elise onu hep yanında taşırdı.

dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-key-1.de: Am Griff ist eine kleine Laterne. Wie an der Uhrenmühle.
dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-key-1.en: There is a little lantern on the handle. Like on the clockmill.
dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-key-1.tr: Sapında küçük bir fener var. Saat değirmenindeki gibi.

evidence:a2-apartment:waldruh-housing-bo.de: Mietvertrag, Zimmer 7. Mieter: {name}. Ein Jahr im Voraus bezahlt von Elise. Am Papier hängt ein Schlüssel.
evidence:a2-apartment:waldruh-housing-bo.en: Lease, Room 7. Tenant: {name}. Paid a year in advance by Elise. A key hangs from the paper.
evidence:a2-apartment:waldruh-housing-bo.tr: Kira sözleşmesi, Oda 7. Kiracı: {name}. Elise tarafından bir yıl peşin ödenmiş. Kâğıda bir anahtar asılı.

clue:a2-apartment:text:0.de: Marta hält eine Tür. Dahinter liegt Waldruh.
clue:a2-apartment:text:0.en: Marta holds a door. Waldruh lies behind it.
clue:a2-apartment:text:0.tr: Marta bir kapıyı tutuyor. Arkasında Waldruh var.

clue:a2-apartment:text:1.de: Elise hat Zimmer 7 für dich gemietet, ein Jahr im Voraus.
clue:a2-apartment:text:1.en: Elise rented Room 7 for you, a year in advance.
clue:a2-apartment:text:1.tr: Elise senin için Oda 7’yi bir yıl peşin kiralamış.

clue:a2-apartment:text:2.de: Am Vertrag hängt ein schwerer Schlüssel mit einer kleinen Laterne.
clue:a2-apartment:text:2.en: A heavy key with a little lantern hangs from the lease.
clue:a2-apartment:text:2.tr: Sözleşmede küçük fenerli ağır bir anahtar asılı.

clue:a2-apartment:lead:0.de: Oma Hilde wohnt oben im Gasthaus.
clue:a2-apartment:lead:0.en: Oma Hilde lives upstairs at the inn.
clue:a2-apartment:lead:0.tr: Hilde Nine hanın üst katında oturuyor.

clue:a2-apartment:letter:0.de: Das Fenster zeigt zum Wald. Ich habe es oft offen gelassen. Das Zimmer wartet auf dich, seit ich die Miete bezahlt habe.
clue:a2-apartment:letter:0.en: The window faces the forest. I often left it open. The room has waited for you since I paid the rent.
clue:a2-apartment:letter:0.tr: Pencere ormana bakıyor. Onu sık sık açık bırakırdım. Kirayı ödediğimden beri oda seni bekliyor.

quest:a2-upstairs:objective:0.en: Ask an older person politely for permission to ask
quest:a2-upstairs:objective:0.tr: Yaşlı birinden soru sormak için kibarca izin iste

quest:a2-upstairs:objective:1.en: Talk about the past with war and hatte
quest:a2-upstairs:objective:1.tr: war ve hatte ile geçmişten bahset

quest:a2-upstairs:objective:2.en: Decide whether Oma Hilde comes to the table
quest:a2-upstairs:objective:2.tr: Hilde Nine’nin masaya gelip gelmeyeceğine karar ver

quest:a2-upstairs:story:0.de: Oben im Gasthaus wohnt Martas Großmutter.
quest:a2-upstairs:story:0.en: Marta’s grandmother lives upstairs at the inn.
quest:a2-upstairs:story:0.tr: Marta’nın büyükannesi hanın üst katında oturuyor.

quest:a2-upstairs:story:1.de: Sie hat siebzig Jahre in diesem Haus gewohnt.
quest:a2-upstairs:story:1.en: She has lived in this house for seventy years.

quest:a2-upstairs:story:2.de: Niemand hat sie gefragt, als die Strecke zuging.
quest:a2-upstairs:story:2.en: Nobody asked her when the route closed.

dialogue:a2-upstairs-intro-0.de: Setz dich, Kind. Marta sagt, du hast ihre Tür repariert.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-intro-0.en: Sit down, child. Marta says you repaired her door.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-intro-0.tr: Otur, çocuğum. Marta kapısını tamir ettiğini söylüyor.

dialogue:a2-upstairs-intro-1.de: Ich bin Hilde. Für die ganze Straße bin ich die Großmutter.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-intro-1.en: I am Hilde. To the whole street I am the grandmother.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-intro-1.tr: Ben Hilde. Bütün sokak için ben nineyim.

dialogue:a2-upstairs-intro-2.de: Siebzig Jahre wohne ich in diesem Haus. Ich habe zwei Städte durch dieses Fenster gesehen.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-intro-2.en: I have lived in this house for seventy years. I saw two towns through this window.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-intro-2.tr: Yetmiş yıldır bu evde oturuyorum. Bu pencereden iki kasaba gördüm.

dialogue:a2-upstairs-intro-3.de: Am Morgen nach der Schließung kam ein Mann vom Amt. Er hatte ein Papier.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-intro-3.en: The morning after the closure a man from the Office came. He had a paper.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-intro-3.tr: Kapanıştan sonraki sabah daireden bir adam geldi. Elinde bir kâğıt vardı.

dialogue:a2-upstairs-intro-4.de: Auf dem Papier stand: freiwillig. Er hat mich nichts gefragt. Keiner hat das.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-intro-4.en: The paper said: voluntary. He asked me nothing. Nobody did.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-intro-4.tr: Kâğıtta “gönüllü” yazıyordu. Bana hiçbir şey sormadı. Kimse sormadı.

dialogue:a2-upstairs-intro-5.de: Die Tür nach Lindenhafen geht wieder auf? Dann hat das Haus wieder zwei Seiten.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-intro-5.en: The door to Lindenhafen opens again? Then the house has two sides again.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-intro-5.tr: Lindenhafen’e açılan kapı yine açılıyor mu? O zaman evin yine iki yüzü var.

dialogue:a2-upstairs-intro-6.de: Siehst du meinen Namen am Fenster? Mit neuer Tinte. Er wird trotzdem blass.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-intro-6.en: Do you see my name on the window? In new ink. It is fading anyway.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-intro-6.tr: Pencerede adımı görüyor musun? Yeni mürekkeple. Yine de soluyor.

dialogue:a2-upstairs-gate-0.de: Seit zwölf Jahren fragt mich niemand etwas. Man redet über mich, nicht mit mir.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-gate-0.en: For twelve years nobody has asked me anything. People talk about me, not to me.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-gate-0.tr: On iki yıldır kimse bana bir şey sormuyor. Benim hakkımda konuşuyorlar, benimle değil.

dialogue:a2-upstairs-gate-0:variant:0.de: Seit zwölf Jahren fragt mich niemand.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-gate-0:variant:0.en: For twelve years nobody has asked me.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-gate-0:variant:0.tr: On iki yıldır kimse bana sormuyor.

choice:a2-upstairs:hilde-invited.de: Sie kommt mit. Wir fragen sie vor allen anderen.
choice:a2-upstairs:hilde-invited.en: She comes along. We ask her before anyone else.
choice:a2-upstairs:hilde-invited.tr: Bizimle geliyor. Ona herkesten önce soracağız.

choice:a2-upstairs:hilde-rests.de: Sie ruht sich aus. Ich erzähle ihr später alles.
choice:a2-upstairs:hilde-rests.en: She rests. I will tell her everything later.
choice:a2-upstairs:hilde-rests.tr: Dinleniyor. Sonra ona her şeyi anlatırım.

dialogue:a2-upstairs-choice-1.de: An dem Abend kamen zwei aus Lindenhafen. Ein Mann mit einem roten Boot und eine Krankenschwester.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-choice-1.en: That evening two people came from Lindenhafen. A man with a red boat and a nurse.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-choice-1.tr: O akşam Lindenhafen’den iki kişi geldi. Kırmızı tekneli bir adam ve bir hemşire.

dialogue:a2-upstairs-choice-2.de: Sie haben auf ihre Kinder gewartet. Der Kinderzug kam um sechs. Er kam nie.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-choice-2.en: They waited for their children. The children’s train came at six. It never came.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-choice-2.tr: Çocuklarını beklediler. Çocuk treni altıda gelecekti. Hiç gelmedi.

dialogue:a2-upstairs-choice-3.de: Sie warten bis heute. Jeden Abend sitzen sie bei Fritz am Tisch.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-choice-3.en: They are still waiting today. Every evening they sit at Fritz’s table.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-choice-3.tr: Bugün hâlâ bekliyorlar. Her akşam Fritz’in masasında oturuyorlar.

dialogue:a2-upstairs-choice-4.de: Ein Mann auf dem Markt hat mir diese Tinte verkauft. Er sagt, sie bleibt für immer.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-choice-4.en: A man at the market sold me this ink. He says it stays forever.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-choice-4.tr: Pazardaki bir adam bana bu mürekkebi sattı. Sonsuza dek kaldığını söylüyor.

dialogue:a2-upstairs-choice-5.de: Oma, Fritz deckt heute für alle. Der Kreis kommt auch.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-choice-5.en: Oma, Fritz is setting the table for everyone today. The Circle is coming too.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-choice-5.tr: Nine, Fritz bugün herkes için sofra kuruyor. Çember de geliyor.

dialogue:a2-upstairs-choice-6.de: Kommt sie heute mit an den Tisch? Oder ist der Weg für sie zu weit?
dialogue:a2-upstairs-choice-6.en: Will she come to the table today? Or is the walk too far for her?
dialogue:a2-upstairs-choice-6.tr: Bugün masaya geliyor mu? Yoksa yol onun için çok mu uzun?

dialogue:a2-upstairs-after-hilde-invited.de: Dann hol meinen Stock. Und meinen besten Schal.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-after-hilde-invited.en: Then fetch my stick. And my best scarf.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-after-hilde-invited.tr: O zaman bastonumu getir. Ve en güzel atkımı.

dialogue:a2-upstairs-after-hilde-invited.de: Siebzig Jahre, und sie geht zum ersten Mal zu einer Versammlung.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-after-hilde-invited.en: Seventy years, and she is going to a meeting for the first time.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-after-hilde-invited.tr: Yetmiş yıl ve ilk kez bir toplantıya gidiyor.

dialogue:a2-upstairs-after-hilde-rests-0.de: Gut. Aber komm wirklich zurück. Das sagen alle.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-after-hilde-rests-0.en: Good. But really come back. Everyone says that.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-after-hilde-rests-0.tr: İyi. Ama gerçekten geri gel. Herkes böyle der.

dialogue:a2-upstairs-after-hilde-rests-1.de: Ich bringe ihr Suppe. Und jeden Namen, den ich höre.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-after-hilde-rests-1.en: I will bring her soup. And every name I hear.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-after-hilde-rests-1.tr: Ona çorba getiririm. Ve duyduğum her ismi.

dialogue:a2-upstairs-complete-0.de: In meiner Kiste liegen alte Fahrkarten. Mit Namen von hier. Nimm sie mit.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-complete-0.en: There are old tickets in my box. With names from here. Take them.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-complete-0.tr: Sandığımda eski biletler var. Buradan isimlerle. Onları al.

dialogue:a2-upstairs-complete-1.de: Fritz kocht unten am Kräutergarten. Geh hin, solange die Suppe warm ist.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-complete-1.en: Fritz is cooking down by the herb garden. Go while the soup is warm.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-complete-1.tr: Fritz aşağıda, şifalı otlar bahçesinde yemek yapıyor. Çorba sıcakken git.

gate-prompt:a2-upstairs.en: Ask Oma Hilde politely if you may ask her something.
gate-prompt:a2-upstairs.tr: Hilde Nine’ye ona bir şey sorup soramayacağını kibarca sor.

objective:a2-upstairs:1.en: Look at the name on her window

objective:a2-upstairs:2.en: Ask Oma Hilde politely if you may ask her something.
objective:a2-upstairs:2.tr: Hilde Nine’ye ona bir şey sorup soramayacağını kibarca sor.

objective:a2-upstairs:3.en: Decide whether Oma Hilde comes to the table
objective:a2-upstairs:3.tr: Hilde Nine’nin masaya gelip gelmeyeceğine karar ver

dialogue:a2-upstairs-topic-two-towns-0.de: Vorne war Lindenhafen, hinten Waldruh. Die Kinder rannten durch den Flur zur Schule.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-topic-two-towns-0.en: At the front was Lindenhafen, at the back Waldruh. The children ran through the hall to school.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-topic-two-towns-0.tr: Önde Lindenhafen, arkada Waldruh vardı. Çocuklar okula koridordan koşardı.

dialogue:a2-upstairs-topic-two-towns-1.de: Frau Berg hat oft hier Tee getrunken. Bevor sie in die Schule ging.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-topic-two-towns-1.en: Frau Berg often drank tea here. Before she went to the school.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-topic-two-towns-1.tr: Frau Berg sık sık burada çay içerdi. Okula gitmeden önce.

topic:a2-upstairs:two-towns.en: What was the house like before?

dialogue:a2-upstairs-topic-office-0.de: Jung, sehr höflich, mit Messingknöpfen. Er hatte Tinte an den Fingern.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-topic-office-0.en: Young, very polite, with brass buttons. He had ink on his fingers.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-topic-office-0.tr: Genç, çok kibar, pirinç düğmeli. Parmaklarında mürekkep vardı.

dialogue:a2-upstairs-topic-office-1.de: Er hat gezittert, als er unterschrieb. Ich habe das nie vergessen.
dialogue:a2-upstairs-topic-office-1.en: He trembled when he signed. I have never forgotten that.

topic:a2-upstairs:office.de: Wer war der Mann vom Amt?
topic:a2-upstairs:office.en: Who was the man from the Office?

evidence:a2-upstairs:waldruh-hilde-windo.de: Auf dem Fensterrahmen steht in blauer Tinte: Hilde. Die Tinte ist neu, der Name wird trotzdem blass.
evidence:a2-upstairs:waldruh-hilde-windo.en: On the window frame, in blue ink: Hilde. The ink is new, but the name is fading anyway.
evidence:a2-upstairs:waldruh-hilde-windo.tr: Pencere çerçevesinde mavi mürekkeple: Hilde. Mürekkep yeni ama isim yine de soluyor.

clue:a2-upstairs:text:0.de: Oma Hilde wohnt seit siebzig Jahren im Gasthaus.
clue:a2-upstairs:text:0.en: Oma Hilde has lived at the inn for seventy years.
clue:a2-upstairs:text:0.tr: Hilde Nine yetmiş yıldır handa oturuyor.

clue:a2-upstairs:text:1.de: Am Morgen nach der Schließung stand auf einem Papier: freiwillig. Niemand hat sie gefragt.
clue:a2-upstairs:text:1.en: The morning after the closure a paper said: voluntary. Nobody asked her.
clue:a2-upstairs:text:1.tr: Kapanışın ertesi sabahı bir kâğıtta “gönüllü” yazıyordu. Kimse ona sormadı.

clue:a2-upstairs:text:2.de: Zwei Eltern aus Lindenhafen warten seit zwölf Jahren auf den Kinderzug.
clue:a2-upstairs:text:2.en: Two parents from Lindenhafen have waited twelve years for the children’s train.
clue:a2-upstairs:text:2.tr: Lindenhafen’den iki ebeveyn on iki yıldır çocuk trenini bekliyor.

clue:a2-upstairs:lead:0.en: Fritz is cooking by the herb garden.
clue:a2-upstairs:lead:0.tr: Fritz şifalı otlar bahçesinde yemek yapıyor.

clue:a2-upstairs:letter:0.de: Hilde hat mir einmal Tee gemacht, als ich nicht schlafen konnte. Grüß sie von mir. Sie weiß, wer ich bin.
clue:a2-upstairs:letter:0.en: Hilde once made me tea when I could not sleep. Give her my regards. She knows who I am.
clue:a2-upstairs:letter:0.tr: Hilde bir keresinde uyuyamadığımda bana çay yapmıştı. Ona selamımı ilet. Kim olduğumu bilir.

grammar-note:a2-upstairs.de: Darf ich Sie etwas fragen? Mit dürfen bittest du höflich um Erlaubnis.
grammar-note:a2-upstairs.en: Darf ich Sie etwas fragen? With dürfen you politely ask for permission.
grammar-note:a2-upstairs.tr: Darf ich Sie etwas fragen? dürfen ile kibarca izin istersin.

quest:a2-evening-plans:story:0.de: Fritz kocht in Waldruh für alle.
quest:a2-evening-plans:story:0.en: Fritz is cooking for everyone in Waldruh.
quest:a2-evening-plans:story:0.tr: Fritz Waldruh’da herkes için yemek yapıyor.

quest:a2-evening-plans:story:1.de: Am Ende vom Tisch sitzen zwei Gäste, die keiner kennt.
quest:a2-evening-plans:story:1.en: At the end of the table sit two guests nobody knows.
quest:a2-evening-plans:story:1.tr: Masanın sonunda kimsenin tanımadığı iki misafir oturuyor.

quest:a2-evening-plans:story:2.de: Fritz lädt nie zu einer festen Zeit ein.
quest:a2-evening-plans:story:2.en: Fritz never invites people for a fixed time.
quest:a2-evening-plans:story:2.tr: Fritz kimseyi asla belirli bir saate davet etmez.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-0.de: Ah, {name}! Nimm eine Schüssel. Beim Essen streitet keiner. Meistens.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-0.en: Ah, {name}! Take a bowl. Nobody argues while eating. Usually.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-0.tr: Ah, {name}! Bir kâse al. Yemekte kimse tartışmaz. Genellikle.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-1.de: Ich bin gestern durch Martas Tür gekommen. Mit dem großen Topf.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-1.en: I came through Marta’s door yesterday. With the big pot.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-1.tr: Dün Marta’nın kapısından geldim. Büyük tencereyle.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-2.de: Ich auch. Die Klinik hier hat seit zwölf Jahren keine Ärztin. Jetzt hat sie mich.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-2.en: Me too. The clinic here has had no doctor for twelve years. Now it has me.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-2.tr: Ben de. Buradaki klinikte on iki yıldır doktor yok. Şimdi ben varım.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-3.de: Heute Abend senden wir ein Licht nach Lindenhafen. Damit sie sehen: Waldruh ist noch da.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-3.en: Tonight we send a light to Lindenhafen. So they see: Waldruh is still here.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-3.tr: Bu akşam Lindenhafen’e bir ışık gönderiyoruz. Görsünler: Waldruh hâlâ burada.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-4.de: Und die Leute hier? Niemand hat sie vor der Schließung gefragt. Wieder erfahren sie es als Letzte.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-4.en: And the people here? Nobody asked them before the closure. Again they will be the last to know.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-4.tr: Ya buradaki insanlar? Kapanıştan önce kimse onlara sormadı. Yine en son onlar öğrenecek.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-5.de: Mich fragt heute jemand. Das ist neu. Ich bleibe bis zum Nachtisch.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-5.en: Someone is asking me today. That is new. I am staying until dessert.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-5.tr: Bugün biri bana soruyor. Bu yeni. Tatlıya kadar kalıyorum.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-6.de: Frau Berg hat uns geschrieben. Ihr Haus ist weg, aber sie hat noch ihren Namen.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-6.en: Frau Berg wrote to us. Her house is gone, but she still has her name.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-6.tr: Frau Berg bize yazdı. Evi gitti ama adı hâlâ onda.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-7.de: Siehst du die zwei am Ende vom Tisch? Sie kommen jeden Abend um sechs.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-7.en: Do you see the two at the end of the table? They come every evening at six.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-7.tr: Masanın sonundaki ikisini görüyor musun? Her akşam altıda gelirler.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-8.de: Sie warten auf einen Zug. Wie sie heißen, weiß hier keiner mehr.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-8.en: They are waiting for a train. Nobody here knows their names any more.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-8.tr: Bir tren bekliyorlar. Burada kimse artık adlarını bilmiyor.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-9.de: Ich muss gleich weiter. Meine Briefe …
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-9.en: I have to go on in a moment. My letters …

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-gate-0.de: Morgen will ich alle an einen Tisch holen. Aber eine feste Zeit sage ich nie. Dann fehlt wieder einer.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-gate-0.en: Tomorrow I want to bring everyone to one table. But I never name a fixed time. Then someone is missing again.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-gate-0.tr: Yarın herkesi bir masaya toplamak istiyorum. Ama hiç belli bir saat söylemem. Sonra yine biri eksik kalır.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-gate-0:variant.de: Ich sage nie eine feste Zeit. Morgen vielleicht?
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-gate-0:variant.en: I never name a fixed time. Tomorrow, maybe?
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-gate-0:variant.tr: Hiç belli bir saat söylemem. Belki yarın?

choice:a2-evening-plans:restore.de: Wir senden das Licht heute Abend.

choice:a2-evening-plans:consult.de: Wir warten. Erst sagen alle hier, was sie wollen.
choice:a2-evening-plans:consult.en: We wait. First everyone here says what they want.
choice:a2-evening-plans:consult.tr: Bekliyoruz. Önce buradaki herkes ne istediğini söylesin.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-0.de: Morgen? Ja. Für dich habe ich Zeit. Und für alle anderen auch.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-0.en: Tomorrow? Yes. I have time for you. And for everyone else too.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-0.tr: Yarın mı? Evet. Senin için vaktim var. Diğer herkes için de.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-1.de: Halb sieben. Nicht sechs. Um sechs warten die zwei auf ihren Zug.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-1.en: Half past six. Not six. At six those two wait for their train.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-1.tr: Altı buçuk. Altı değil. Altıda o ikisi trenlerini bekler.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-2.de: Entschuldigung. Das Mädchen mit den Briefen … ist das Lina?
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-2.en: Excuse me. The girl with the letters … is that Lina?
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-2.tr: Affedersiniz. Mektuplu kız … o Lina mı?

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-3.en: How do you know my name?

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-4.de: Wir haben unsere Kinder in Lindenhafen gelassen. Für eine Stunde. Vor zwölf Jahren.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-4.en: We left our children in Lindenhafen. For one hour. Twelve years ago.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-4.tr: Çocuklarımızı Lindenhafen’de bıraktık. Bir saatliğine. On iki yıl önce.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-5.de: Ich heiße Lina Lenz. Mein Bruder heißt Pip.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-5.en: My name is Lina Lenz. My brother is called Pip.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-5.tr: Benim adım Lina Lenz. Kardeşimin adı Pip.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-6.de: Pip. Er war ein Baby. Ich bin Jakob Lenz. Ich bin dein Vater.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-6.en: Pip. He was a baby. I am Jakob Lenz. I am your father.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-6.tr: Pip. Bebekti. Ben Jakob Lenz. Ben senin babanım.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-7.de: Ich heiße Ruth. Sag es, Lina. Bitte. Einmal laut.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-7.en: My name is Ruth. Say it, Lina. Please. Once, out loud.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-7.tr: Benim adım Ruth. Söyle, Lina. Lütfen. Bir kez, yüksek sesle.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-8.de: Ruth. Jakob. Ich habe eure Namen nicht mehr gesagt. Es tat zu weh.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-8.en: Ruth. Jakob. I stopped saying your names. It hurt too much.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-8.tr: Ruth. Jakob. Adlarınızı artık söylemedim. Çok acıtıyordu.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-9.de: Ich schreibe die Namen auf den alten Stein. Dann bleiben sie.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-9.en: I will write the names on the old stone. Then they stay.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-9.tr: Adları eski taşa yazıyorum. O zaman kalırlar.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-10.en: Lindenhafen is waiting for a sign.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-11.de: Senden wir heute das Licht? Oder warten wir, bis hier alle etwas gesagt haben?
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-11.en: Do we send the light today? Or do we wait until everyone here has spoken?
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-11.tr: Işığı bugün mü gönderelim? Yoksa buradaki herkes konuşana kadar mı bekleyelim?

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-after-restore-.de: Lindenhafen antwortet! Drei kurze Blitze. Das ist Pip, ich weiß es.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-after-restore-.en: Lindenhafen is answering! Three short flashes. That is Pip, I know it.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-after-restore-.tr: Lindenhafen cevap veriyor! Üç kısa parıltı. Bu Pip, biliyorum.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-after-restore-.de: Pip an einer Lampe? Dann ist er groß geworden.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-after-restore-.en: Pip at a lamp? Then he has grown up.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-after-restore-.tr: Pip bir lambanın başında mı? Demek büyümüş.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-after-consult-.de: Die Leute kommen mit Stühlen aus dem Wald. Heute bleibt keiner draußen.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-after-consult-.en: People are coming out of the forest with chairs. Today nobody stays outside.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-after-consult-.tr: İnsanlar ormandan sandalyelerle geliyor. Bugün kimse dışarıda kalmıyor.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-after-consult-.de: Dann sage ich auch etwas: Ich will nach Hause. Aber nicht ohne die anderen.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-after-consult-.en: Then I will say something too: I want to go home. But not without the others.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-after-consult-.tr: O zaman ben de bir şey söyleyeyim: Eve gitmek istiyorum. Ama diğerleri olmadan değil.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-complete-0.de: Morgen, halb sieben. Mit kleinen Schüsseln. Für alle.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-complete-0.en: Tomorrow, half past six. With little bowls. For everyone.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-complete-0.tr: Yarın, altı buçuk. Küçük kâselerle. Herkes için.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-complete-1.de: Auf dem Marktplatz verkauft ein Mann Tinte. Er sagt, sie verblasst nie. Sieh ihn dir an.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-complete-1.en: On the market square a man is selling ink. He says it never fades. Have a look at him.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-complete-1.tr: Pazar yerinde bir adam mürekkep satıyor. Hiç solmadığını söylüyor. Bir bak ona.

objective:a2-evening-plans:0.en: Join Fritz’s table in the herb garden
objective:a2-evening-plans:0.tr: Şifalı otlar bahçesinde Fritz’in masasına katıl

objective:a2-evening-plans:2.en: Ask Fritz whether he has time tomorrow.
objective:a2-evening-plans:2.tr: Fritz’e yarın vakti olup olmadığını sor.

objective:a2-evening-plans:3.en: Decide when Waldruh sends its signal
objective:a2-evening-plans:3.tr: Waldruh’un işaretini ne zaman göndereceğine karar ver

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-circle-0.de: Alle, deren Namen einmal falsch oder gar nicht aufgeschrieben wurden.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-circle-0.en: Everyone whose name was once written down wrongly, or not at all.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-circle-0.tr: Adı bir zamanlar yanlış yazılan ya da hiç yazılmayan herkes.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-circle-1.de: Wir sagen jeden Morgen unsere Namen laut. Es hilft.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-circle-1.en: Every morning we say our names out loud. It helps.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-circle-1.tr: Her sabah adlarımızı yüksek sesle söyleriz. İşe yarıyor.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-lenz-0.de: Um sechs kam früher der Zug aus Lindenhafen.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-lenz-0.en: The train from Lindenhafen used to come at six.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-lenz-1.de: Sie sagen: Unsere Kinder kommen mit dem nächsten Zug.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-lenz-1.en: They say: our children are coming on the next train.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-lenz-1.tr: Diyorlar ki: Çocuklarımız bir sonraki trenle geliyor.

topic:a2-evening-plans:lenz.de: Warum warten die beiden jeden Abend?
topic:a2-evening-plans:lenz.en: Why do the two of them wait every evening?
topic:a2-evening-plans:lenz.tr: O ikisi neden her akşam bekliyor?

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-fritz-he.de: Durch Martas Tür. Mit einem Topf Suppe. Die Tür hat nichts gesagt.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-fritz-he.en: Through Marta’s door. With a pot of soup. The door said nothing.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-fritz-he.tr: Marta’nın kapısından. Bir tencere çorbayla. Kapı hiçbir şey demedi.

topic:a2-evening-plans:fritz-here.de: Wie bist du nach Waldruh gekommen, Fritz?
topic:a2-evening-plans:fritz-here.en: How did you get to Waldruh, Fritz?

evidence:a2-evening-plans:waldruh-herb-g.de: Ein langer Tisch im Kräutergarten. Am Ende stehen zwei Teller, die jeden Abend warten.
evidence:a2-evening-plans:waldruh-herb-g.en: A long table in the herb garden. At the end stand two plates that wait every evening.
evidence:a2-evening-plans:waldruh-herb-g.tr: Şifalı otlar bahçesinde uzun bir masa. Sonunda her akşam bekleyen iki tabak duruyor.

clue:a2-evening-plans:title.en: Two plates at the end of the table

clue:a2-evening-plans:text:0.de: Zwei Gäste warten jeden Abend um sechs auf einen Zug.
clue:a2-evening-plans:text:0.en: Two guests wait every evening at six for a train.
clue:a2-evening-plans:text:0.tr: İki misafir her akşam altıda bir tren bekliyor.

clue:a2-evening-plans:text:1.de: Es sind Jakob und Ruth Lenz, die Eltern von Lina und Pip.
clue:a2-evening-plans:text:1.en: They are Jakob and Ruth Lenz, Lina and Pip’s parents.
clue:a2-evening-plans:text:1.tr: Onlar Jakob ve Ruth Lenz; Lina ile Pip’in anne babası.

clue:a2-evening-plans:text:2.de: Lina hat ihre Namen zwölf Jahre lang nicht gesagt.
clue:a2-evening-plans:text:2.en: Lina did not say their names for twelve years.
clue:a2-evening-plans:text:2.tr: Lina on iki yıl boyunca adlarını söylemedi.

clue:a2-evening-plans:lead:0.de: Auf dem Marktplatz verkauft ein Mann Tinte.
clue:a2-evening-plans:lead:0.en: A man is selling ink on the market square.
clue:a2-evening-plans:lead:0.tr: Pazar yerinde bir adam mürekkep satıyor.

clue:a2-evening-plans:letter:0.de: Ich habe die beiden jeden Abend gesehen. Ich hätte sie fragen können. Ich habe es nicht getan.
clue:a2-evening-plans:letter:0.en: I saw the two of them every evening. I could have asked them. I did not.
clue:a2-evening-plans:letter:0.tr: O ikisini her akşam gördüm. Onlara sorabilirdim. Sormadım.

quest:a2-ink-seller:subtitle.en: Herr Falk has a bargain for you
quest:a2-ink-seller:subtitle.tr: Herr Falk’ın sana bir fırsatı var

quest:a2-ink-seller:objective:2.en: Decide whether to buy or to ask questions
quest:a2-ink-seller:objective:2.tr: Satın almaya mı soru sormaya mı karar ver

quest:a2-ink-seller:story:0.de: Auf dem Marktplatz steht ein Wagen voller Tinte.
quest:a2-ink-seller:story:0.en: On the market square stands a cart full of ink.
quest:a2-ink-seller:story:0.tr: Pazar yerinde mürekkeple dolu bir araba duruyor.

quest:a2-ink-seller:story:1.de: Herr Falk sagt: Diese Tinte verblasst nie.
quest:a2-ink-seller:story:1.en: Herr Falk says: this ink never fades.
quest:a2-ink-seller:story:1.tr: Herr Falk diyor ki: Bu mürekkep hiç solmaz.

quest:a2-ink-seller:story:2.de: Aber die Namen auf seinem Probeblatt sind schon blass.
quest:a2-ink-seller:story:2.en: But the names on his test sheet are already pale.
quest:a2-ink-seller:story:2.tr: Ama deneme kâğıdındaki isimler şimdiden solmuş.

dialogue:a2-ink-seller-intro-0.de: Tinte, die nie verblasst! Schreiben Sie Ihren Namen, und er bleibt für immer!
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-intro-0.en: Ink that never fades! Write your name, and it stays forever!
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-intro-0.tr: Hiç solmayan mürekkep! Adınızı yazın, sonsuza dek kalsın!

dialogue:a2-ink-seller-intro-1.de: Mein Name ist Falk. Sehr erfreut. Sie sehen aus wie jemand, der seinen Namen behalten will.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-intro-1.en: My name is Falk. Delighted. You look like someone who wants to keep their name.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-intro-1.tr: Adım Falk. Memnun oldum. Adını korumak isteyen birine benziyorsunuz.

dialogue:a2-ink-seller-intro-2.de: Oma Hilde hat schon gekauft. Fritz auch. Ganz Waldruh schreibt mit meiner Tinte.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-intro-2.en: Oma Hilde has already bought some. Fritz too. All of Waldruh writes with my ink.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-intro-2.tr: Hilde Nine çoktan aldı. Fritz de. Bütün Waldruh benim mürekkebimle yazıyor.

dialogue:a2-ink-seller-intro-3.de: Oma Hilde? Ihr Name am Fenster ist trotzdem blass? Das Licht oben ist schlecht.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-intro-3.en: Oma Hilde? Her name on the window is pale anyway? The light upstairs is poor.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-intro-3.tr: Hilde Nine mi? Penceredeki adı yine de soluk mu? Yukarıdaki ışık kötü.

dialogue:a2-ink-seller-intro-4.de: Sie haben ein Gästebuch gerettet? Dann brauchen Sie dringend gute Tinte.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-intro-4.en: You rescued a guest book? Then you urgently need good ink.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-intro-4.tr: Bir misafir defteri mi kurtardınız? O zaman acilen iyi mürekkebe ihtiyacınız var.

dialogue:a2-ink-seller-intro-5.de: Die große Flasche: fünfzig Euro. Für Sie heute nur fünfzig Euro.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-intro-5.en: The big bottle: fifty euros. For you today, only fifty euros.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-intro-5.tr: Büyük şişe: elli avro. Bugün size sadece elli avro.

dialogue:a2-ink-seller-gate-0.de: Fünfzig ist ein guter Preis für die Ewigkeit. Oder wollen Sie verhandeln?
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-gate-0.en: Fifty is a good price for eternity. Or do you want to haggle?
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-gate-0.tr: Elli, sonsuzluk için iyi bir fiyat. Yoksa pazarlık mı etmek istiyorsunuz?

dialogue:a2-ink-seller-gate-0:variant:0.de: Fünfzig Euro. Oder wollen Sie verhandeln?
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-gate-0:variant:0.en: Fifty euros. Or do you want to haggle?
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-gate-0:variant:0.tr: Elli avro. Yoksa pazarlık mı etmek istersiniz?

choice:a2-ink-seller:ink-bought.en: I will take the small bottle.

choice:a2-ink-seller:falk-questioned.de: Ich will wissen, woher Ihre Tinte kommt.
choice:a2-ink-seller:falk-questioned.en: I want to know where your ink comes from.

dialogue:a2-ink-seller-choice-0.de: Günstiger? Für Sie: die kleine Flasche. Zwölf Euro. Und ein Lächeln gratis.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-choice-0.en: Cheaper? For you: the small bottle. Twelve euros. And a free smile.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-choice-0.tr: Daha ucuz mu? Size: küçük şişe. On iki avro. Bir gülümseme de bedava.

dialogue:a2-ink-seller-choice-1.de: Mein Probeblatt? Die Namen sind von letzter Woche. Sie sind … sehr dezent.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-choice-1.en: My test sheet? The names are from last week. They are … very discreet.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-choice-1.tr: Deneme kâğıdım mı? İsimler geçen haftadan. Onlar … çok zarif.

dialogue:a2-ink-seller-choice-2.de: Ich habe an einer Flasche gerochen. Das ist ganz normale Tinte.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-choice-2.en: I smelled one of the bottles. It is completely ordinary ink.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-choice-2.tr: Şişelerden birini kokladım. Tamamen sıradan mürekkep.

dialogue:a2-ink-seller-choice-3.de: Normal? Die Rezeptur ist geheim! Sehr geheim. Ich weiß sie selbst kaum.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-choice-3.en: Ordinary? The recipe is secret! Very secret. I hardly know it myself.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-choice-3.tr: Sıradan mı? Tarifi gizli! Çok gizli. Ben bile zor biliyorum.

dialogue:a2-ink-seller-choice-4.de: An seiner Weste ist ein Knopf aus Messing. Wie beim Amt.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-choice-4.en: There is a brass button on his waistcoat. Like at the Office.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-choice-4.tr: Yeleğinde pirinç bir düğme var. Dairedekiler gibi.

dialogue:a2-ink-seller-choice-5.de: Also? Kaufen Sie die kleine Flasche? Oder stellen Sie lieber Fragen?
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-choice-5.en: So? Will you buy the small bottle? Or would you rather ask questions?
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-choice-5.tr: Peki? Küçük şişeyi alıyor musunuz? Yoksa soru sormayı mı tercih edersiniz?

dialogue:a2-ink-seller-after-ink-bought-.de: Eine kluge Wahl! Schreiben Sie schnell, bevor … ich meine: schreiben Sie, wann Sie wollen.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-after-ink-bought-.en: A wise choice! Write quickly, before … I mean: write whenever you like.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-after-ink-bought-.tr: Akıllıca bir seçim! Çabuk yazın, yoksa … yani: ne zaman isterseniz yazın.

dialogue:a2-ink-seller-after-ink-bought-.de: Zwölf Euro für normale Tinte. Gut, dass du einen Namen hast, der laut bleibt.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-after-ink-bought-.en: Twelve euros for ordinary ink. Good thing you have a name that stays when said aloud.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-after-ink-bought-.tr: Sıradan mürekkebe on iki avro. İyi ki yüksek sesle söylenince kalan bir adın var.

dialogue:a2-ink-seller-after-falk-questi.de: Woher? Aus … Nebelstadt. Aus einer Werkstatt am Hafen. Mehr sage ich nicht.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-after-falk-questi.en: From where? From … Nebelstadt. From a workshop at the harbour. I will say no more.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-after-falk-questi.tr: Nereden mi? … Nebelstadt’tan. Limandaki bir atölyeden. Daha fazlasını söylemem.

dialogue:a2-ink-seller-after-falk-questi.de: Bitte. Sagen Sie niemandem, dass ich das gesagt habe.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-after-falk-questi.en: Please. Tell nobody that I said that.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-after-falk-questi.tr: Lütfen. Bunu benim söylediğimi kimseye söylemeyin.

dialogue:a2-ink-seller-complete-0.de: Der Bahnhofsvorsteher sucht Sie. Sehr pünktlich, der Mann. Zu pünktlich für mein Geschäft.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-complete-0.en: The stationmaster is looking for you. Very punctual, that man. Too punctual for my business.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-complete-0.tr: İstasyon şefi sizi arıyor. Çok dakik biri. İşim için fazla dakik.

gate-prompt:a2-ink-seller.en: Ask Herr Falk if he has something cheaper.
gate-prompt:a2-ink-seller.tr: Herr Falk’a daha ucuz bir şeyi olup olmadığını sor.

objective:a2-ink-seller:0.en: Find the ink seller on the market square

objective:a2-ink-seller:2.en: Ask Herr Falk if he has something cheaper.
objective:a2-ink-seller:2.tr: Herr Falk’a daha ucuz bir şeyi olup olmadığını sor.

objective:a2-ink-seller:3.en: Decide whether to buy or to ask questions
objective:a2-ink-seller:3.tr: Satın almaya mı soru sormaya mı karar ver

dialogue:a2-ink-seller-topic-where-0.de: Von weit her. Sehr weit. Fragen Sie nicht, dann bleibt sie geheimnisvoll.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-topic-where-0.en: From far away. Very far. Do not ask, and it stays mysterious.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-topic-where-0.tr: Uzaklardan. Çok uzaklardan. Sormayın, gizemli kalsın.

topic:a2-ink-seller:where.en: Where does your ink come from?

dialogue:a2-ink-seller-topic-pale-0.de: Das Licht hier ist schlecht. Sehr schlecht. Gehen wir ins Licht!
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-topic-pale-0.en: The light here is bad. Very bad. Let us step into the light!
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-topic-pale-0.tr: Buradaki ışık kötü. Çok kötü. Işığa çıkalım!

dialogue:a2-ink-seller-topic-pale-1.de: Außerdem schreiben die Leute zu leise. Tinte braucht Mut.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-topic-pale-1.en: Besides, people write too quietly. Ink needs courage.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-topic-pale-1.tr: Hem insanlar çok sessiz yazıyor. Mürekkep cesaret ister.

topic:a2-ink-seller:pale.de: Warum sind die Namen auf Ihrem Blatt blass?
topic:a2-ink-seller:pale.en: Why are the names on your sheet pale?

dialogue:a2-ink-seller-topic-who-0.de: Ich? Niemand. Ein Mann mit schöner Schrift. Das ist lange her.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-topic-who-0.en: Me? Nobody. A man with beautiful lettering. That was long ago.
dialogue:a2-ink-seller-topic-who-0.tr: Ben mi? Kimse. Güzel yazısı olan bir adam. Uzun zaman önceydi.

topic:a2-ink-seller:who.de: Wer waren Sie, bevor Sie Tinte verkauft haben?
topic:a2-ink-seller:who.en: Who were you before you sold ink?

evidence:a2-ink-seller:waldruh-ink-cart.de: Ein Schild: Garantie! Verblasst nie! Daneben ein Probeblatt. Die Namen von letzter Woche sind schon blass.
evidence:a2-ink-seller:waldruh-ink-cart.en: A sign: Guaranteed! Never fades! Beside it a test sheet. The names from last week are already pale.
evidence:a2-ink-seller:waldruh-ink-cart.tr: Bir tabela: Garantili! Asla solmaz! Yanında bir deneme kâğıdı. Geçen haftanın isimleri şimdiden solmuş.

clue:a2-ink-seller:text:0.de: Herr Falk verkauft Tinte, die nie verblassen soll.
clue:a2-ink-seller:text:0.en: Herr Falk sells ink that is supposed never to fade.
clue:a2-ink-seller:text:0.tr: Herr Falk asla solmaması gereken mürekkep satıyor.

clue:a2-ink-seller:text:1.de: Emil sagt: Das ist ganz normale Tinte.
clue:a2-ink-seller:text:1.en: Emil says: it is completely ordinary ink.
clue:a2-ink-seller:text:1.tr: Emil diyor ki: Bu tamamen sıradan mürekkep.

clue:a2-ink-seller:text:2.de: An Falks Weste ist ein Knopf aus Messing, wie beim Amt.
clue:a2-ink-seller:text:2.en: Falk’s waistcoat has a brass button, like at the Office.
clue:a2-ink-seller:text:2.tr: Falk’ın yeleğinde Daire’dekiler gibi pirinç bir düğme var.

clue:a2-ink-seller:lead:0.de: Otto sucht dich am Bahnhof von Waldruh.
clue:a2-ink-seller:lead:0.en: Otto is looking for you at Waldruh station.

clue:a2-ink-seller:letter:0.de: Tinte hält keinen Namen. Nur eine Stimme hält ihn. Das hat er vergessen.
clue:a2-ink-seller:letter:0.en: Ink keeps no name. Only a voice keeps it. He has forgotten that.
clue:a2-ink-seller:letter:0.tr: Mürekkep hiçbir ismi tutmaz. Onu sadece bir ses tutar. Bunu unutmuş.

grammar-note:a2-ink-seller.de: Etwas Günstigeres: Der Komparativ bekommt nach etwas die Endung -es.
grammar-note:a2-ink-seller.en: Etwas Günstigeres: after etwas, the comparative takes the ending -es.
grammar-note:a2-ink-seller.tr: Etwas Günstigeres: etwas’tan sonra karşılaştırma -es eki alır.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-0.de: Zum Bahnsteig, {name}! Hörst du die Pfeife? Heute sehen wir den Zug selbst.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-0.en: To the platform, {name}! Hear that whistle? Today we see the train ourselves.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-0.tr: Perona, {name}! Düdüğü duyuyor musun? Bugün treni kendimiz göreceğiz.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-1.de: Der alte Fahrplan zeigt eine Verbindung nach Nebelstadt. Abfahrt: achtzehn Uhr. Wie auf deiner Fahrkarte.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-1.en: The old timetable lists a connection to Nebelstadt. Departure: six p.m. As on your ticket.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-1.tr: Eski tarife Nebelstadt’a bir bağlantı gösteriyor. Kalkış: on sekiz. Biletindeki gibi.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-2.de: Die Bahnhofsuhr zeigt noch nicht sechs. Aber die Türen sind schon zu.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-2.en: The station clock does not show six yet. But the doors are already shut.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-2.tr: İstasyon saati henüz altıyı göstermiyor. Ama kapılar çoktan kapalı.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-3.de: Ihre Fahrkarte, bitte. Diese Kontrolle darf ich nicht auslassen.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-3.en: Your ticket, please. I may not skip this inspection.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-4.de: Herr Voss, Sie sehen doch, er fährt!
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-4.en: Mr Voss, you can see it is leaving!

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-5.de: Gültig. Abfahrt achtzehn Uhr. Sie sind pünktlich hier. Der Zug sollte …
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-5.en: Valid. Departure six p.m. You are here on time. The train should …
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-5.tr: Geçerli. Kalkış on sekiz. Zamanında buradasınız. Trenin …

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-6.de: Weg. Wir standen vor der Tür. Er ist ohne uns gefahren.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-6.en: Gone. We were standing at the door. It left without us.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-7.de: In meiner Akte fährt hier kein Zug. Ich habe gerade einen gesehen. Ich schreibe beides auf.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-7.en: In my file no train runs here. I just saw one. I will write down both.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-7.tr: Dosyama göre burada tren işlemiyor. Az önce birini gördüm. İkisini de yazıyorum.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-8.de: Lina wollte nicht mitkommen. Sie steht hinten an den alten Schienen und zählt.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-8.en: Lina did not want to come. She is standing back by the old rails, counting.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-8.tr: Lina gelmek istemedi. Arkada, eski rayların yanında duruyor ve sayıyor.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-9.de: Die Farbe auf dem alten Schild blättert ab. Darunter steht ein Ziel. Die Zeit fehlt.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-9.en: The paint is peeling off the old sign. A destination is underneath. The time is missing.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-9.tr: Eski tabeladaki boya dökülüyor. Altında bir hedef yazıyor. Saat eksik.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-gate-0.de: Bahnhof Waldruh, Schalter eins. Die Fahrkarte ist gültig. Warum konnten Sie nicht weiterfahren?
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-gate-0.en: Waldruh station, window one. The ticket is valid. Why could you not continue your journey?
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-gate-0.tr: Waldruh istasyonu, gişe bir. Bilet geçerli. Neden yolculuğunuza devam edemediniz?

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-gate-0:variant:0.de: Die Fahrkarte ist gültig. Was ist passiert?
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-gate-0:variant:0.en: The ticket is valid. What happened?

choice:a2-rail-trip:restore.de: Wir stellen die Uhr. Morgen sollen die Leute den Zug bekommen.
choice:a2-rail-trip:restore.en: We set the clock. Tomorrow people should catch the train.
choice:a2-rail-trip:restore.tr: Saati ayarlıyoruz. Yarın insanlar trene yetişsin.

choice:a2-rail-trip:consult.de: Der Fehler bleibt sichtbar. Wir brauchen mehr Zeugen.
choice:a2-rail-trip:consult.en: The error stays visible. We need more witnesses.
choice:a2-rail-trip:consult.tr: Hata görünür kalsın. Daha çok tanığa ihtiyacımız var.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-choice-0.de: Anschluss verpasst. Ich vergleiche deine Fahrkarte mit der Uhr. Sie blieb stehen, als der Zug fuhr.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-choice-0.en: Missed connection. I will compare your ticket with the clock. It stopped when the train left.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-choice-0.tr: Aktarma kaçtı. Biletini saatle karşılaştırıyorum. Tren kalkınca durmuş.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-choice-1.de: 17:59. Auf deiner Fahrkarte steht 18:00. Wer der Fahrkarte folgt, findet einen leeren Bahnsteig.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-choice-1.en: 17:59. Your ticket says 18:00. Anyone who follows the ticket finds an empty platform.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-choice-1.tr: 17:59. Biletinde 18:00 yazıyor. Bilete uyan herkes boş bir peron bulur.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-choice-2.de: Unter der Farbe steht: von innen geschlossen, mit einem Hüterschlüssel. Eine Minute früher. Damit kein Zeuge kommt.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-choice-2.en: Under the paint it says: closed from inside, with a keeper’s key. One minute early. So no witness comes.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-choice-2.tr: Boyanın altında yazıyor: içeriden, bir bekçi anahtarıyla kapatıldı. Bir dakika erken. Hiçbir tanık gelmesin diye.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-choice-3.de: Von innen geschlossen. Das fehlt in meiner Akte. Ihre pünktliche Ankunft auch.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-choice-3.en: Closed from inside. That is missing from my file. So is your punctual arrival.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-choice-3.tr: İçeriden kapatıldı. Bu dosyamda yok. Zamanında gelişiniz de yok.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-choice-4.de: Ich kenne diese Pfeife. Sie ist auf meiner Aufnahme. Jeden Abend höre ich einen Zug, den es nicht gibt.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-choice-4.en: I know that whistle. It is on my recording. Every evening I hear a train that does not exist.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-choice-4.tr: Bu düdüğü tanıyorum. Kaydımda var. Her akşam olmayan bir treni duyuyorum.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-choice-5.de: Ich kann die Uhr stellen. Dann ändert sich der Fahrplan mit.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-choice-5.en: I can set the clock. Then the timetable changes with it.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-choice-5.tr: Saati ayarlayabilirim. O zaman tarife de değişir.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-choice-6.de: Stellen wir die Uhr für die Fahrgäste? Oder bleibt der Fehler sichtbar, bis mehr Zeugen kommen?
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-choice-6.en: Do we set the clock for the passengers? Or does the error stay visible until more witnesses come?
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-choice-6.tr: Saati yolcular için ayarlayalım mı? Yoksa daha çok tanık gelene kadar hata görünür mü kalsın?

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-after-restore-0.de: Eine Minute vor. Die Uhr läuft wieder. Nebelstadt, achtzehn Uhr. Diesmal stimmt es.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-after-restore-0.en: One minute forward. The clock is running again. Nebelstadt, six p.m. This time it is right.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-after-restore-0.tr: Bir dakika ileri. Saat yine çalışıyor. Nebelstadt, on sekiz. Bu sefer doğru.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-after-consult-0.de: Ich schreibe beide Zeiten an die Tafel. 17:59 und 18:00.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-after-consult-0.en: I will write both times on the board. 17:59 and 18:00.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-after-consult-0.tr: İki saati de panoya yazıyorum. 17:59 ve 18:00.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-after-consult-1.de: Morgen stehen hier Leute. Die kann keiner mehr aus dem Bericht lassen.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-after-consult-1.en: Tomorrow there will be people here. Nobody can leave them out of the report any more.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-after-consult-1.tr: Yarın burada insanlar olacak. Artık kimse onları rapordan çıkaramaz.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-complete-0.de: Ein Hüterschlüssel schließt keine normale Tür. Pass auf deinen Schlüssel auf.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-complete-0.en: A keeper’s key does not close an ordinary door. Look after your key.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-complete-0.tr: Bir bekçi anahtarı sıradan bir kapıyı kapatmaz. Anahtarına dikkat et.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-complete-1.de: Geh zu Lina an die alten Schienen. Sie zählt schon zu lange allein.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-complete-1.en: Go to Lina by the old rails. She has been counting alone for too long.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-complete-1.tr: Eski rayların yanına, Lina’ya git. Çok uzun zamandır yalnız sayıyor.

objective:a2-rail-trip:2.en: Tell Otto that you missed your connection.

objective:a2-rail-trip:3.en: Decide what happens to the station clock
objective:a2-rail-trip:3.tr: İstasyon saatine ne olacağına karar ver

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-punctual-0.de: Ein Zug kann pünktlich sein und trotzdem niemanden mitnehmen. Ab heute traue ich auch der Fahrkarte nicht.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-punctual-0.en: A train can be punctual and still take nobody. From today I do not trust the ticket either.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-punctual-0.tr: Bir tren dakik olup yine de kimseyi almayabilir. Bugünden itibaren bilete de güvenmiyorum.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-voss-how-0.de: Durch eine Küchentür. Das stand nicht im Dienstplan.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-voss-how-0.en: Through a kitchen door. That was not on the duty roster.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-voss-how-0.tr: Bir mutfak kapısından. Bu görev listesinde yoktu.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-voss-how-1.de: Seitdem schlafe ich schlecht. Das ist für mich ungewöhnlich.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-voss-how-1.en: I have slept badly since. That is unusual for me.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-voss-how-1.tr: O zamandan beri kötü uyuyorum. Bu benim için alışılmadık.

topic:a2-rail-trip:voss-how.de: Wie sind Sie nach Waldruh gekommen, Herr Voss?
topic:a2-rail-trip:voss-how.en: How did you get to Waldruh, Mr Voss?

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-destination-.de: Nach Nebelstadt, sagt das alte Schild. Das neue sagt: nirgendwohin.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-destination-.en: To Nebelstadt, says the old sign. The new one says: nowhere.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-destination-.tr: Eski tabela Nebelstadt diyor. Yenisi: hiçbir yere.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-destination-.de: Ich glaube dem alten. Altes Holz lügt seltener.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-destination-.en: I believe the old one. Old wood lies less often.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-destination-.tr: Eskisine inanıyorum. Eski tahta daha az yalan söyler.

topic:a2-rail-trip:destination.en: Where does the train actually go?

evidence:a2-rail-trip:waldruh-route-sign.de: Ein neues Schild: Hier gab es nie eine Strecke. Darunter, unter der Farbe: Verbindung nach Nebelstadt. Die Zeit fehlt.
evidence:a2-rail-trip:waldruh-route-sign.en: A new sign: There was never a route here. Underneath, under the paint: Connection to Nebelstadt. The time is missing.
evidence:a2-rail-trip:waldruh-route-sign.tr: Yeni bir tabela: Burada hiç hat olmadı. Altında, boyanın altında: Nebelstadt’a bağlantı. Saat eksik.

clue:a2-rail-trip:text:0.de: Der Zug nach Nebelstadt fährt um 17:59, nicht um 18:00.
clue:a2-rail-trip:text:0.en: The train to Nebelstadt leaves at 17:59, not at 18:00.

clue:a2-rail-trip:text:1.de: Die Strecke wurde von innen geschlossen, mit einem Hüterschlüssel.
clue:a2-rail-trip:text:1.en: The route was closed from inside, with a keeper’s key.
clue:a2-rail-trip:text:1.tr: Hat içeriden, bir bekçi anahtarıyla kapatıldı.

clue:a2-rail-trip:text:2.de: Voss kennt die Pfeife von seiner Aufnahme.
clue:a2-rail-trip:text:2.en: Voss knows the whistle from his recording.

clue:a2-rail-trip:lead:0.de: Lina zählt an den alten Schienen im Wald.
clue:a2-rail-trip:lead:0.en: Lina is counting by the old rails in the forest.
clue:a2-rail-trip:lead:0.tr: Lina ormandaki eski rayların yanında sayıyor.

clue:a2-rail-trip:letter:0.de: Du warst pünktlich da. Lass dir nichts anderes erzählen. Ich weiß, wie lang eine Minute sein kann.
clue:a2-rail-trip:letter:0.en: You were there on time. Do not let anyone tell you otherwise. I know how long one minute can be.
clue:a2-rail-trip:letter:0.tr: Zamanında oradaydın. Kimse sana aksini söylemesin. Bir dakikanın ne kadar uzun olabileceğini bilirim.

quest:a2-forest-rails:objective:0.en: Ask what happened in the past

quest:a2-forest-rails:objective:1.en: Tell a story with the perfect tense

quest:a2-forest-rails:objective:2.en: Decide how Pip learns his parents’ names
quest:a2-forest-rails:objective:2.tr: Pip’in anne babasının adını nasıl öğreneceğine karar ver

quest:a2-forest-rails:story:0.en: Old rails lie in the forest.

quest:a2-forest-rails:story:1.de: Lina steht dort und zählt Steine.

quest:a2-forest-rails:story:2.de: Sie war zehn, als der Kinderzug nicht abfuhr.
quest:a2-forest-rails:story:2.en: She was ten when the children’s train did not leave.

dialogue:a2-forest-rails-intro-0.de: Neun. Zehn. Elf. Elf Steine. Es sind immer elf.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-intro-0.en: Nine. Ten. Eleven. Eleven stones. There are always eleven.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-intro-0.tr: Dokuz. On. On bir. On bir taş. Hep on bir.

dialogue:a2-forest-rails-intro-1.de: Ich zähle, wenn ich nicht weinen will. Das hat Frau Berg mir beigebracht.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-intro-1.en: I count when I do not want to cry. Frau Berg taught me that.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-intro-1.tr: Ağlamak istemediğimde sayarım. Bunu bana Frau Berg öğretti.

dialogue:a2-forest-rails-intro-2.de: Hier fuhr der Kinderzug zur Klinik. Jeden Abend um sechs.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-intro-2.en: The children’s train to the clinic ran here. Every evening at six.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-intro-2.tr: Çocuk treni kliniğe buradan giderdi. Her akşam altıda.

dialogue:a2-forest-rails-intro-3.de: Ich hatte Husten. Pip war ein Baby. Mama und Papa sind vorgefahren.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-intro-3.en: I had a cough. Pip was a baby. Mum and Dad went on ahead.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-intro-3.tr: Öksürüğüm vardı. Pip bebekti. Annemle babam önden gitti.

dialogue:a2-forest-rails-intro-4.de: Ruth und Jakob. Ich sage es jetzt jeden Tag. Es tut weh, aber es bleibt.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-intro-4.en: Ruth and Jakob. I say it every day now. It hurts, but it stays.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-intro-4.tr: Ruth ve Jakob. Artık her gün söylüyorum. Acıtıyor ama kalıyor.

dialogue:a2-forest-rails-intro-5.de: Du hast die Uhr gestellt? Gut. Ein Zug soll nie wieder eine Minute zu früh fahren.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-intro-5.en: You set the clock? Good. A train should never again leave a minute early.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-intro-5.tr: Saati sen mi ayarladın? İyi. Hiçbir tren bir daha bir dakika erken kalkmasın.

dialogue:a2-forest-rails-gate-0.de: Du willst wissen, warum ich zähle. Alle wollen das. Keiner fragt.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-gate-0.en: You want to know why I count. Everyone does. Nobody asks.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-gate-0.tr: Neden saydığımı bilmek istiyorsun. Herkes ister. Kimse sormaz.

dialogue:a2-forest-rails-gate-0:variant:.de: Alle wollen es wissen. Keiner fragt.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-gate-0:variant:.en: Everyone wants to know. Nobody asks.

choice:a2-forest-rails:lina-tells-pip.de: Schreib ihm heute. Er soll die Namen sofort sagen.
choice:a2-forest-rails:lina-tells-pip.en: Write to him today. He should say the names right away.
choice:a2-forest-rails:lina-tells-pip.tr: Ona bugün yaz. Adları hemen söylesin.

choice:a2-forest-rails:lina-waits.de: Sag es ihm selbst. Er soll dein Gesicht dabei sehen.
choice:a2-forest-rails:lina-waits.en: Tell him yourself. He should see your face when you do.
choice:a2-forest-rails:lina-waits.tr: Ona kendin söyle. Söylerken yüzünü görsün.

dialogue:a2-forest-rails-choice-0.de: Wir saßen im Zug. Ich hatte Pip auf dem Schoß. Um sechs ist der Zug nicht abgefahren.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-choice-0.en: We were sitting in the train. I had Pip on my lap. At six the train did not leave.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-choice-0.tr: Trende oturuyorduk. Pip kucağımdaydı. Altıda tren kalkmadı.

dialogue:a2-forest-rails-choice-1.de: Der Schaffner hat gesagt: Steine auf den Schienen. Elf Stück. Wir wären gestorben.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-choice-1.en: The conductor said: stones on the rails. Eleven of them. We would have died.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-choice-1.tr: Kondüktör dedi ki: Raylarda taş var. On bir tane. Ölebilirdik.

dialogue:a2-forest-rails-choice-2.de: Am Gleis stand eine Frau mit schwarzen Händen. Sie hat geweint. Dann war sie weg.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-choice-2.en: A woman with black hands stood at the platform. She was crying. Then she was gone.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-choice-2.tr: Peronda siyah elli bir kadın duruyordu. Ağlıyordu. Sonra gitti.

dialogue:a2-forest-rails-choice-3.de: Danach ist kein Zug mehr gefahren. Mama und Papa waren auf der anderen Seite.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-choice-3.en: After that no train ran any more. Mum and Dad were on the other side.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-choice-3.tr: Ondan sonra hiç tren işlemedi. Annemle babam öbür taraftaydı.

dialogue:a2-forest-rails-choice-4.de: Frau Berg hat uns jeden Morgen Brot gebracht. Und Wörter. Und Zahlen.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-choice-4.en: Frau Berg brought us bread every morning. And words. And numbers.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-choice-4.tr: Frau Berg her sabah bize ekmek getirdi. Ve kelimeler. Ve sayılar.

dialogue:a2-forest-rails-choice-5.de: Pip weiß nichts. Er kennt Mama und Papa nur von meiner Wand.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-choice-5.en: Pip knows nothing. He only knows Mum and Dad from my wall.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-choice-5.tr: Pip hiçbir şey bilmiyor. Annemle babamı sadece duvarımdan biliyor.

dialogue:a2-forest-rails-choice-6.de: Schreibe ich ihm heute? Oder sage ich es ihm selbst, wenn ich zurück bin?
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-choice-6.en: Do I write to him today? Or do I tell him myself when I am back?
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-choice-6.tr: Ona bugün mü yazayım? Yoksa dönünce kendim mi söyleyeyim?

dialogue:a2-forest-rails-after-lina-tell.de: Lieber Pip. Mama heißt Ruth. Papa heißt Jakob. Sag es laut. Jeden Tag.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-after-lina-tell.en: Dear Pip. Mum is called Ruth. Dad is called Jakob. Say it out loud. Every day.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-after-lina-tell.tr: Sevgili Pip. Annemizin adı Ruth. Babamızın adı Jakob. Yüksek sesle söyle. Her gün.

dialogue:a2-forest-rails-after-lina-tell.de: Der Brief geht durch Martas Tür. Heute Abend steht es an seiner Wand.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-after-lina-tell.en: The letter goes through Marta’s door. Tonight it will be on his wall.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-after-lina-tell.tr: Mektup Marta’nın kapısından gidiyor. Bu akşam duvarında olacak.

dialogue:a2-forest-rails-after-lina-wait.de: Dann fahre ich mit dem ersten Zug. Mit beiden Namen im Mund.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-after-lina-wait.en: Then I will take the first train. With both names in my mouth.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-after-lina-wait.tr: O zaman ilk trenle giderim. İki ad da dilimde.

dialogue:a2-forest-rails-after-lina-wait.de: Bis dahin sage ich sie hier. Ruth. Jakob. Elf Steine.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-after-lina-wait.en: Until then I will say them here. Ruth. Jakob. Eleven stones.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-after-lina-wait.tr: O zamana kadar burada söylerim. Ruth. Jakob. On bir taş.

dialogue:a2-forest-rails-complete-0.de: Emil ist in der Uhrenmühle. Jede Nacht fehlt dort eine Stunde. Geh zu ihm.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-complete-0.en: Emil is at the clockmill. Every night an hour goes missing there. Go to him.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-complete-0.tr: Emil saat değirmeninde. Orada her gece bir saat kayboluyor. Ona git.

gate-prompt:a2-forest-rails.en: Ask Lina what happened back then.
gate-prompt:a2-forest-rails.tr: Lina’ya o zaman ne olduğunu sor.

objective:a2-forest-rails:0.en: Find Lina by the old rails

objective:a2-forest-rails:1.en: Look at the stones beside the track

objective:a2-forest-rails:2.en: Ask Lina what happened back then.
objective:a2-forest-rails:2.tr: Lina’ya o zaman ne olduğunu sor.

objective:a2-forest-rails:3.en: Decide how Pip learns his parents’ names
objective:a2-forest-rails:3.tr: Pip’in anne babasının adını nasıl öğreneceğine karar ver

dialogue:a2-forest-rails-topic-woman-0.de: Ich weiß es nicht. Sie hatte schwarze Hände. Wie von Tinte.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-topic-woman-0.en: I do not know. She had black hands. As if from ink.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-topic-woman-0.tr: Bilmiyorum. Elleri siyahtı. Mürekkepten olmuş gibi.

dialogue:a2-forest-rails-topic-woman-1.de: Sie hat zu mir gesagt: Zähl die Steine. Dann ist es nicht so schlimm.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-topic-woman-1.en: She said to me: count the stones. Then it is not so bad.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-topic-woman-1.tr: Bana dedi ki: Taşları say. O zaman o kadar kötü olmaz.

topic:a2-forest-rails:woman.de: Wer war die Frau am Gleis?
topic:a2-forest-rails:woman.en: Who was the woman at the platform?

dialogue:a2-forest-rails-topic-stones-0.de: Ordentlich, in einer Reihe. Jemand hat sie gezählt, bevor er sie weggelegt hat.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-topic-stones-0.en: Neatly, in a row. Someone counted them before putting them away.
dialogue:a2-forest-rails-topic-stones-0.tr: Düzgünce, sıra halinde. Biri onları kenara koymadan önce saymış.

topic:a2-forest-rails:stones.de: Wer hat die Steine zur Seite gelegt?

evidence:a2-forest-rails:waldruh-old-rai.de: Alte Schienen im Wald. Daneben elf Steine, ordentlich in einer Reihe.
evidence:a2-forest-rails:waldruh-old-rai.en: Old rails in the forest. Beside them eleven stones, neatly in a row.
evidence:a2-forest-rails:waldruh-old-rai.tr: Ormanda eski raylar. Yanında on bir taş, düzgünce sıralanmış.

clue:a2-forest-rails:text:0.de: Lina war zehn und saß mit Pip im Kinderzug.
clue:a2-forest-rails:text:0.en: Lina was ten and sat in the children’s train with Pip.
clue:a2-forest-rails:text:0.tr: Lina on yaşındaydı ve Pip’le birlikte çocuk trenindeydi.

clue:a2-forest-rails:text:1.de: Auf den Schienen lagen elf Steine. Der Zug fuhr nicht ab.
clue:a2-forest-rails:text:1.en: Eleven stones lay on the rails. The train did not leave.
clue:a2-forest-rails:text:1.tr: Raylarda on bir taş vardı. Tren kalkmadı.

clue:a2-forest-rails:text:2.de: Am Gleis stand eine Frau mit schwarzen Händen und weinte.
