clue:a2-forest-rails:text:2.en: A woman with black hands stood at the platform, crying.
clue:a2-forest-rails:text:2.tr: Peronda siyah elli bir kadın ağlayarak duruyordu.

clue:a2-forest-rails:lead:0.en: Emil is working at the clockmill.

clue:a2-forest-rails:letter:0.de: Ich habe die Steine gezählt, bevor ich sie weggelegt habe. Elf. Ich habe Lina gesagt, sie soll zählen. Sie hat nie damit aufgehört.
clue:a2-forest-rails:letter:0.en: I counted the stones before I moved them. Eleven. I told Lina to count. She never stopped.
clue:a2-forest-rails:letter:0.tr: Taşları kenara koymadan önce saydım. On bir. Lina’ya saymasını söyledim. Hiç durmadı.

grammar-note:a2-forest-rails.de: Was ist damals passiert? Passieren bildet das Perfekt mit sein.
grammar-note:a2-forest-rails.en: Was ist damals passiert? Passieren forms the perfect with sein.
grammar-note:a2-forest-rails.tr: Was ist damals passiert? passieren geçmiş zamanı sein ile kurar.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-0.de: Vorsicht, {name}! Der Boden hält. Nur die Stunde darauf verschwindet manchmal.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-0.en: Careful, {name}! The floor holds. Only the hour on it sometimes disappears.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-0.tr: Dikkat, {name}! Zemin sağlam. Sadece üstündeki saat bazen kayboluyor.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-1.de: Marta hat mich durch ihre Tür gelassen. Die Mühle braucht einen Mechaniker.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-1.en: Marta let me through her door. The mill needs a mechanic.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-1.tr: Marta beni kapısından geçirdi. Değirmenin bir tamirciye ihtiyacı var.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-2.de: Jede Nacht wiederholt die Mühle die Stunde vor Mitternacht. Draußen kommt der Morgen. Hier beginnt dieselbe Stunde neu.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-2.en: Every night the mill repeats the hour before midnight. Outside, morning comes. In here, the same hour starts again.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-2.tr: Değirmen her gece gece yarısından önceki saati tekrarlıyor. Dışarıda sabah oluyor. Burada aynı saat yeniden başlıyor.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-3.de: Nach jeder Runde fehlt ein Name auf dem Stein. Gestern kannte ich die Person. Heute kenne ich die Lücke.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-3.en: After every round a name is missing from the stone. Yesterday I knew the person. Today I know the gap.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-3.tr: Her turdan sonra taşta bir isim eksik oluyor. Dün o kişiyi tanıyordum. Bugün boşluğu tanıyorum.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-4.de: Meine Werkzeuge waren eine Nacht lang weg. Dann kamen sie sauber zurück. Mit einem Dankeszettel.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-4.en: My tools were gone for a night. Then they came back clean. With a thank-you note.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-4.tr: Aletlerim bir gece kayıptı. Sonra temizlenmiş olarak geri geldi. Bir teşekkür notuyla.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-5.de: Die Lampe aus Lindenhafen? Hier ist sie ganz dunkel. Hier fehlen viele Namen.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-5.en: The lamp from Lindenhafen? Here it is completely dark. Many names are missing here.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-5.tr: Lindenhafen’deki lamba mı? Burada tamamen karanlık. Burada çok isim eksik.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-6.de: Die Anleitung hängt an der Uhr. Vergleich sie mit dem Stein. Hier fehlt mehr als ein Zahnrad.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-6.en: The manual is hanging on the clock. Compare it with the stone. More than a cog is missing here.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-6.tr: Kılavuz saatte asılı. Onu taşla karşılaştır. Burada bir dişliden fazlası eksik.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-gate-0.de: Roter Hebel, blaue Verbindung. Die Zeichnung sieht einfach aus. Die Mühle folgt ihr nicht immer.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-gate-0.en: Red lever, blue connection. The drawing looks simple. The mill does not always follow it.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-gate-0.tr: Kırmızı kol, mavi bağlantı. Çizim basit görünüyor. Değirmen ona hep uymuyor.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-gate-0:variant:.de: Roter Hebel, blaue Verbindung. Ganz einfach. Oder?
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-gate-0:variant:.en: Red lever, blue connection. Very simple. Or is it?
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-gate-0:variant:.tr: Kırmızı kol, mavi bağlantı. Çok basit. Değil mi?

choice:a2-broken-clock:restore.de: Wir halten die Mühle jetzt an.

choice:a2-broken-clock:consult.de: Erst lesen wir alle Namen vor. Dann der Hebel.
choice:a2-broken-clock:consult.en: First we read every name aloud. Then the lever.
choice:a2-broken-clock:consult.tr: Önce bütün adları okuyoruz. Sonra kol.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-choice-0.de: Der rote Hebel hält die Mühle an. Die blaue Verbindung führt zum Streckensignal. Jemand hat sie durchgeschnitten. Sauber.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-choice-0.en: The red lever stops the mill. The blue connection leads to the route signal. Someone cut it. Cleanly.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-choice-0.tr: Kırmızı kol değirmeni durduruyor. Mavi bağlantı hat sinyaline gidiyor. Biri onu kesmiş. Temizce.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-choice-1.de: Am Rand steht: Nur im Notfall trennen. Danke für das Werkzeug.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-choice-1.en: The margin says: disconnect only in an emergency. Thank you for the tools.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-choice-1.tr: Kenarda yazıyor: Sadece acil durumda ayırın. Aletler için teşekkürler.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-choice-2.de: Leg den Mietvertrag daneben. Dasselbe E. Die Anleitung und der Dankeszettel sind in Elises Handschrift.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-choice-2.en: Put the lease beside it. The same E. The manual and the thank-you note are in Elise’s handwriting.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-choice-2.tr: Kira sözleşmesini yanına koy. Aynı E. Kılavuz da teşekkür notu da Elise’in el yazısıyla.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-choice-3.de: Elise hat die Verbindung getrennt. Mit meiner Zange. Sie lag auf dem Tisch. Ich habe nichts gehört.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-choice-3.en: Elise cut the connection. With my pliers. They were on the table. I heard nothing.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-choice-3.tr: Bağlantıyı Elise kesmiş. Benim pensemle. Masanın üstündeydi. Hiçbir şey duymadım.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-choice-4.de: Sie hat meine Zange geputzt. Auf dem Stein fehlt trotzdem ein Name. Was mache ich mit ihrem Dank?
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-choice-4.en: She cleaned my pliers. A name is still missing from the stone. What do I do with her thanks?
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-choice-4.tr: Pensemi temizlemiş. Taşta yine de bir isim eksik. Teşekkürünü ne yapayım?

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-choice-5.de: Auf dem Stein stehen auch die Namen von heute Abend. Jakob Lenz. Ruth Lenz. Sie sind schon blass.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-choice-5.en: Tonight’s names are on the stone too. Jakob Lenz. Ruth Lenz. They are already pale.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-choice-5.tr: Bu akşamın adları da taşta. Jakob Lenz. Ruth Lenz. Şimdiden solmuşlar.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-choice-6.de: Der Hebel stoppt die nächste Runde. Aber die Stunde wird überschrieben. Wer dann nicht gesagt wurde, bleibt weg.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-choice-6.en: The lever stops the next round. But the hour gets overwritten. Whoever has not been said stays gone.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-choice-6.tr: Kol bir sonraki turu durdurur. Ama saat üzerine yazılır. O ana kadar söylenmeyen kişi kayıp kalır.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-choice-7.de: Halten wir die Mühle jetzt an? Oder lesen wir zuerst alle Namen vor, bevor diese Stunde verschwindet?
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-choice-7.en: Do we stop the mill now? Or do we first read every name aloud before this hour disappears?
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-choice-7.tr: Değirmeni şimdi mi durduralım? Yoksa bu saat kaybolmadan önce bütün adları mı okuyalım?

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-after-restore-0.de: Der rote Hebel. Zum ersten Mal endet die Stunde.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-after-restore-0.en: The red lever. For the first time the hour ends.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-after-restore-0.tr: Kırmızı kol. İlk kez saat bitiyor.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-after-restore-1.de: Auf dem Stein ist eine Stelle glatt. Da stand ein Name. Ich weiß nicht mehr, wessen.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-after-restore-1.en: One spot on the stone is smooth. A name stood there. I no longer know whose.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-after-restore-1.tr: Taşta bir yer pürüzsüz. Orada bir isim vardı. Artık kimin olduğunu bilmiyorum.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-after-consult-0.de: Ich halte die Mühle mit der Hand. Lest, schnell!
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-after-consult-0.en: I will hold the mill by hand. Read, quickly!

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-after-consult-1.de: Wir haben alle gelesen. Auch Ruth Lenz und Jakob Lenz. Alle sind noch da.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-after-consult-1.en: We read them all. Ruth Lenz and Jakob Lenz too. Everyone is still there.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-after-consult-1.tr: Hepsini okuduk. Ruth Lenz’i ve Jakob Lenz’i de. Herkes hâlâ orada.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-complete-0.de: Greta hat einen Patienten mit Laternenfieber. Er erzählt von einer Reise, die es nie gab.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-complete-0.en: Greta has a patient with lantern fever. He talks about a journey that never happened.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-complete-0.tr: Greta’nın fener ateşi olan bir hastası var. Hiç olmamış bir yolculuktan bahsediyor.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-complete-1.de: Man hat ihn heute Nacht an den alten Schienen gefunden. Er hat auf einen Zug gewartet.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-complete-1.en: He was found at the old rails last night. He had been waiting for a train.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-complete-1.tr: Dün gece eski rayların yanında bulunmuş. Bir tren bekliyormuş.

objective:a2-broken-clock:1.en: Read the manual on the clock

objective:a2-broken-clock:2.en: Compare it with the memory stone

objective:a2-broken-clock:3.en: Ask Emil whether he can explain the manual to you.
objective:a2-broken-clock:3.tr: Emil’e sana kılavuzu açıklayıp açıklayamayacağını sor.

objective:a2-broken-clock:4.tr: Değirmenin ne zaman duracağına karar ver

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-topic-works-0.de: Die Mühle funktioniert meistens. Der Kaffee immer. Ich arbeite bis Mitternacht.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-topic-works-0.en: The mill mostly works. The coffee always does. I work until midnight.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-topic-works-0.tr: Değirmen çoğunlukla çalışıyor. Kahve her zaman. Ben gece yarısına kadar çalışıyorum.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-topic-works-1.de: Erst prüfe ich jedes Rad. Dann ziehe ich das rote Rad heraus und verbinde die Lampe mit dem blauen.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-topic-works-1.en: First I check every wheel. Then I pull out the red wheel and connect the lamp to the blue one.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-topic-works-1.tr: Önce her çarkı kontrol ediyorum. Sonra kırmızı çarkı çekip lambayı maviye bağlıyorum.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-topic-works-2.de: So kann ich sie reparieren. Ich erkläre dir jeden Schritt, wenn du willst.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-topic-works-2.en: That way I can repair it. I will explain every step to you, if you like.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-topic-works-2.tr: Böylece onu tamir edebilirim. İstersen sana her adımı açıklarım.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-topic-emil-here.de: Otto hat mir die alte Laterne gegeben. Er sagte: Bring sie dorthin, wo sie herkommt.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-topic-emil-here.en: Otto gave me the old lantern. He said: take it back to where it came from.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-topic-emil-here.tr: Otto bana eski feneri verdi. Dedi ki: Onu geldiği yere götür.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-topic-emil-here.de: Sie kommt von hier. Auf dem großen Rad ist dieselbe kleine Laterne.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-topic-emil-here.en: It comes from here. The same little lantern is on the big wheel.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-topic-emil-here.tr: Buradan geliyor. Büyük çarkta aynı küçük fener var.

topic:a2-broken-clock:emil-here.de: Warum bist du auch in Waldruh, Emil?
topic:a2-broken-clock:emil-here.en: Why are you in Waldruh too, Emil?

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-topic-builder-0.de: Das weiß keiner genau. Die alten Hüter der Strecke, sagt man.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-topic-builder-0.en: Nobody knows exactly. The old keepers of the route, people say.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-topic-builder-0.tr: Kimse tam bilmiyor. Hattın eski bekçileri, derler.

evidence:a2-broken-clock:waldruh-clock.de: Die Anleitung: Roter Hebel stoppt die Mühle. Blaue Verbindung zum Streckensignal. Am Rand zwei Zeilen in anderer Schrift.
evidence:a2-broken-clock:waldruh-clock.en: The manual: Red lever stops the mill. Blue connection to the route signal. Two lines in a different hand in the margin.
evidence:a2-broken-clock:waldruh-clock.tr: Kılavuz: Kırmızı kol değirmeni durdurur. Mavi bağlantı hat sinyaline. Kenarda başka bir el yazısıyla iki satır.

evidence:a2-broken-clock:waldruh-memory-.de: Der Stein trägt die Namen vom letzten Laternenfest. Einige sind glatt. Neu dazu: Jakob Lenz, Ruth Lenz.
evidence:a2-broken-clock:waldruh-memory-.en: The stone carries the names from the last lantern festival. Some are smooth. New: Jakob Lenz, Ruth Lenz.
evidence:a2-broken-clock:waldruh-memory-.tr: Taşta son fener şenliğinin adları var. Bazıları pürüzsüz. Yeni: Jakob Lenz, Ruth Lenz.

clue:a2-broken-clock:text:0.de: Die Uhrenmühle wiederholt die Stunde vor Mitternacht. Danach fehlt ein Name.
clue:a2-broken-clock:text:0.en: The clockmill repeats the hour before midnight. Afterwards a name is missing.
clue:a2-broken-clock:text:0.tr: Saat değirmeni gece yarısından önceki saati tekrarlıyor. Sonra bir isim eksik oluyor.

clue:a2-broken-clock:text:1.de: Der Dankeszettel und die Anleitung sind in Elises Handschrift.
clue:a2-broken-clock:text:1.en: The thank-you note and the manual are in Elise’s handwriting.
clue:a2-broken-clock:text:1.tr: Teşekkür notu ve kılavuz Elise’in el yazısıyla.

clue:a2-broken-clock:text:2.de: Elise hat die Verbindung zum Streckensignal getrennt.
clue:a2-broken-clock:text:2.en: Elise cut the connection to the route signal.
clue:a2-broken-clock:text:2.tr: Elise hat sinyaline olan bağlantıyı kesti.

clue:a2-broken-clock:lead:0.de: Greta hat in der Klinik einen Patienten mit Laternenfieber.
clue:a2-broken-clock:lead:0.en: Greta has a patient with lantern fever at the clinic.
clue:a2-broken-clock:lead:0.tr: Greta’nın klinikte fener ateşi olan bir hastası var.

clue:a2-broken-clock:letter:0.de: Ja, das ist meine Handschrift. Ich habe die Zange geputzt. Den Namen auf dem Stein kann ich nicht einfach zurückschreiben. Ich schulde Emil mehr als Dank.
clue:a2-broken-clock:letter:0.en: Yes, that is my handwriting. I cleaned the pliers. I cannot simply write the name back onto the stone. I owe Emil more than thanks.
clue:a2-broken-clock:letter:0.tr: Evet, bu benim el yazım. Penseyi temizledim. Taştaki ismi öylece geri yazamam. Emil’e teşekkürden fazlasını borçluyum.

dialogue:a2-clinic-intro-0.de: Bleib hinter der Linie, {name}. Hier warten viele.
dialogue:a2-clinic-intro-0.en: Stay behind the line, {name}. Many are waiting here.
dialogue:a2-clinic-intro-0.tr: Çizginin arkasında kal, {name}. Burada bekleyen çok.

dialogue:a2-clinic-intro-1.de: Laternenfieber. Die Leute schauen zu lange auf verschwundene Schienen. Die Augen suchen weiter, wenn die Beine nicht mehr können.
dialogue:a2-clinic-intro-1.en: Lantern fever. People look too long at vanished rails. Their eyes keep searching when their legs cannot go on.
dialogue:a2-clinic-intro-1.tr: Fener ateşi. İnsanlar kaybolmuş raylara çok uzun bakıyor. Bacakları gidemez olunca gözleri aramaya devam ediyor.

dialogue:a2-clinic-intro-2.de: Ich helfe Greta. Ich war früher Krankenschwester hier. Zwölf Jahre habe ich gewartet und nichts getan.
dialogue:a2-clinic-intro-2.en: I am helping Greta. I used to be a nurse here. For twelve years I waited and did nothing.
dialogue:a2-clinic-intro-2.tr: Greta’ya yardım ediyorum. Eskiden burada hemşireydim. On iki yıl bekledim ve hiçbir şey yapmadım.

dialogue:a2-clinic-intro-3.de: Eine Frau hat mir heute früh geholfen. Ich kenne ihren Namen nicht. Sie ist wieder gegangen.
dialogue:a2-clinic-intro-3.en: A woman helped me early today. I do not know her name. She has gone again.
dialogue:a2-clinic-intro-3.tr: Bugün erkenden bir kadın bana yardım etti. Adını bilmiyorum. Yine gitti.

dialogue:a2-clinic-intro-4.de: Mir fehlt nichts. Ich bin nur müde. Bitte schreiben Sie keine Diagnose auf.
dialogue:a2-clinic-intro-4.en: There is nothing wrong with me. I am merely tired. Please do not write down a diagnosis.
dialogue:a2-clinic-intro-4.tr: Bir şeyim yok. Sadece yorgunum. Lütfen bir teşhis yazmayın.

dialogue:a2-clinic-intro-5.de: Wir haben ihn am alten Bahnhof gefunden. Nasse Schuhe, kalte Hände. In der Hand eine leere Fahrkarte.
dialogue:a2-clinic-intro-5.en: We found him at the old station. Wet shoes, cold hands. A blank ticket in his hand.
dialogue:a2-clinic-intro-5.tr: Onu eski istasyonda bulduk. Islak ayakkabılar, soğuk eller. Elinde boş bir bilet.

dialogue:a2-clinic-intro-6.de: Ich bin diese Strecke nie gefahren. In meiner Akte steht jeder Tag im Büro.
dialogue:a2-clinic-intro-6.en: I have never travelled this route. My file records every day at the office.
dialogue:a2-clinic-intro-6.tr: Bu hatta hiç yolculuk etmedim. Dosyamda büroda geçen her gün yazılı.

dialogue:a2-clinic-intro-7.de: Im Fieber hat er drei Haltestellen genannt. Mit Hausnummern. Keine steht in seiner Akte.
dialogue:a2-clinic-intro-7.en: In his fever he named three stops. With house numbers. None is in his file.
dialogue:a2-clinic-intro-7.tr: Ateşliyken üç durak saydı. Kapı numaralarıyla. Hiçbiri dosyasında yok.

dialogue:a2-clinic-intro-8.de: Auf meinen Samentüten stehen alte Adressen. Vergleichen wir sie.
dialogue:a2-clinic-intro-8.en: My seed packets carry old addresses. Let us compare them.
dialogue:a2-clinic-intro-8.tr: Tohum paketlerimde eski adresler var. Karşılaştıralım.

dialogue:a2-clinic-gate-0.de: Drei Adressen stimmen. Er hat auch ein blaues Gartentor beschrieben.
dialogue:a2-clinic-gate-0.en: Three addresses match. He also described a blue garden gate.
dialogue:a2-clinic-gate-0.tr: Üç adres tutuyor. Bir de mavi bir bahçe kapısı anlattı.

dialogue:a2-clinic-gate-1.de: Ich muss zurück ins Büro. Wenn ich die Akte weiterlese, ergibt alles Sinn.
dialogue:a2-clinic-gate-1.en: I must go back to the office. If I keep reading the file, it will all make sense.
dialogue:a2-clinic-gate-1.tr: Büroya dönmem gerek. Dosyayı okumaya devam edersem her şey anlam kazanır.

dialogue:a2-clinic-gate-2.de: Sie haben beides gesehen, {name}. Meine Akte und mich. Was raten Sie mir?
dialogue:a2-clinic-gate-2.en: You have seen both, {name}. My file and me. What do you advise?
dialogue:a2-clinic-gate-2.tr: İkisini de gördünüz, {name}. Dosyamı ve beni. Bana ne tavsiye edersiniz?

choice:a2-clinic:restore.de: Wir lesen die Adressen heute vor.
choice:a2-clinic:restore.en: We read the addresses aloud today.

choice:a2-clinic:consult.de: Wir warten, bis Herr Voss selbst sprechen kann.
choice:a2-clinic:consult.en: We wait until Mr Voss can speak for himself.
choice:a2-clinic:consult.tr: Bay Voss kendisi konuşabilene kadar bekliyoruz.

dialogue:a2-clinic-choice-0.de: Ausruhen. Gut. Bitte lassen Sie die Tüten hier.
dialogue:a2-clinic-choice-0.en: Rest. Very well. Please leave the packets here.
dialogue:a2-clinic-choice-0.tr: Dinlenmek. Pekâlâ. Lütfen paketleri burada bırakın.

dialogue:a2-clinic-choice-1.de: Hinter dem blauen Tor gab es Pflaumenkuchen. Die Gastgeberin schnitt immer ein Stück mehr, als Gäste da waren.
dialogue:a2-clinic-choice-1.en: Behind the blue gate there was plum cake. The hostess always cut one piece more than there were guests.
dialogue:a2-clinic-choice-1.tr: Mavi kapının ardında erik pastası vardı. Ev sahibi hep misafir sayısından bir dilim fazla keserdi.

dialogue:a2-clinic-choice-2.de: Ich bin dorthin gefahren. Vor der Schließung. Meine Akte sagt, die Strecke gab es nie. Ich war dort.
dialogue:a2-clinic-choice-2.en: I travelled there. Before the closure. My file says the route never existed. I was there.
dialogue:a2-clinic-choice-2.tr: Oraya gittim. Kapanıştan önce. Dosyam hattın hiç olmadığını söylüyor. Ben oradaydım.

dialogue:a2-clinic-choice-3.de: Auf einer Tüte steht Frau Bergs Adresse. Ihre Äpfel waren die besten an der ganzen Strecke.
dialogue:a2-clinic-choice-3.en: One packet carries Frau Berg’s address. Her apples were the best on the whole route.
dialogue:a2-clinic-choice-3.tr: Bir pakette Frau Berg’in adresi var. Onun elmaları bütün hattın en iyileriydi.

dialogue:a2-clinic-choice-4.de: Er hat in der Nacht immer wieder gefragt: Ist da jemand?
dialogue:a2-clinic-choice-4.en: In the night he kept asking: is anyone there?
dialogue:a2-clinic-choice-4.tr: Gece boyunca durmadan sordu: Orada kimse var mı?

dialogue:a2-clinic-choice-5.de: Ich habe Menschen mit dieser Akte weggeschickt. Ich habe ihnen gesagt, ihre Erinnerung ist falsch.
dialogue:a2-clinic-choice-5.en: I used this file to send people away. I told them their memories were wrong.
dialogue:a2-clinic-choice-5.tr: Bu dosyayla insanları geri çevirdim. Onlara hatıralarının yanlış olduğunu söyledim.

dialogue:a2-clinic-choice-6.de: Legen Sie die Akte weg, Herr Voss. Heute müssen Sie nichts beweisen.
dialogue:a2-clinic-choice-6.en: Put the file down, Mr Voss. You do not have to prove anything today.
dialogue:a2-clinic-choice-6.tr: Dosyayı bırakın, Bay Voss. Bugün hiçbir şey kanıtlamak zorunda değilsiniz.

dialogue:a2-clinic-choice-7.de: Mit den Adressen erreichen wir die alten Laternen.
dialogue:a2-clinic-choice-7.en: With these addresses we can reach the old lanterns.

dialogue:a2-clinic-choice-8.de: Tun wir es heute? Oder warten wir, bis Voss selbst sprechen kann?
dialogue:a2-clinic-choice-8.en: Do we do it today? Or wait until Voss can speak for himself?
dialogue:a2-clinic-choice-8.tr: Bugün mü yapalım? Yoksa Voss kendisi konuşabilene kadar mı bekleyelim?

dialogue:a2-clinic-after-restore-0.de: Drei Laternen gehen an den Schienen an.
dialogue:a2-clinic-after-restore-0.en: Three lanterns light up along the rails.

dialogue:a2-clinic-after-restore-1.de: Das blaue Tor … noch ein Stück Kuchen. Für den Gast, der später kommt.
dialogue:a2-clinic-after-restore-1.en: The blue gate … one more piece of cake. For the guest who comes later.
dialogue:a2-clinic-after-restore-1.tr: Mavi kapı … bir dilim pasta daha. Sonra gelecek misafir için.

dialogue:a2-clinic-after-consult-0.de: Ich möchte sie selbst lesen. Wenn ich wieder stehen kann.
dialogue:a2-clinic-after-consult-0.en: I would like to read them myself. When I can stand again.
dialogue:a2-clinic-after-consult-0.tr: Onları kendim okumak istiyorum. Tekrar ayağa kalkabildiğimde.

dialogue:a2-clinic-after-consult-1.de: Zum ersten Mal heute schläft er ruhig.
dialogue:a2-clinic-after-consult-1.en: For the first time today he is sleeping peacefully.

dialogue:a2-clinic-complete-0.de: Jemand hat diese falsche Akte geschrieben. Das alte Archiv hat die Befehle von damals.
dialogue:a2-clinic-complete-0.en: Someone wrote that false file. The old archive has the orders from back then.
dialogue:a2-clinic-complete-0.tr: Biri bu sahte dosyayı yazdı. Eski arşivde o zamanki emirler var.

dialogue:a2-clinic-complete-1.de: Unter der Uhrenmühle ist ein Keller. Die Tür hat ein Schloss mit einer kleinen Laterne.
dialogue:a2-clinic-complete-1.en: There is a cellar under the clockmill. The door has a lock with a little lantern.
dialogue:a2-clinic-complete-1.tr: Saat değirmeninin altında bir kiler var. Kapısında küçük fenerli bir kilit var.

objective:a2-clinic:0.en: Visit Greta’s clinic in the conservatory

objective:a2-clinic:1.en: Compare the seed packets with Voss’s stops
objective:a2-clinic:1.tr: Tohum paketlerini Voss’un durakları ile karşılaştır

objective:a2-clinic:2.en: Advise Inspector Voss politely that he should rest.
objective:a2-clinic:2.tr: Müfettiş Voss’a kibarca dinlenmesi gerektiğini öğütle.

objective:a2-clinic:3.en: Decide what happens to the old addresses
objective:a2-clinic:3.tr: Eski adreslere ne olacağına karar ver

dialogue:a2-clinic-topic-lantern-fever-0.de: Man sieht Lichter, wo keine sind. Man erinnert sich an Wege, die es nicht gibt.
dialogue:a2-clinic-topic-lantern-fever-0.en: You see lights where there are none. You remember paths that do not exist.
dialogue:a2-clinic-topic-lantern-fever-0.tr: Olmayan yerlerde ışık görürsün. Olmayan yolları hatırlarsın.

dialogue:a2-clinic-topic-lantern-fever-1.de: Ruhe hilft. Und jemand, der zuhört. Akten sind schlechte Krankenschwestern.
dialogue:a2-clinic-topic-lantern-fever-1.en: Rest helps. And someone who listens. Files make poor nurses.
dialogue:a2-clinic-topic-lantern-fever-1.tr: Dinlenmek iyi gelir. Ve dinleyen biri. Dosyalar kötü hemşire olur.

dialogue:a2-clinic-topic-gate-0.de: An der dritten Haltestelle, sagt er. Ein Garten mit Pflaumenbäumen.
dialogue:a2-clinic-topic-gate-0.en: At the third stop, he says. A garden with plum trees.
dialogue:a2-clinic-topic-gate-0.tr: Üçüncü durakta, diyor. Erik ağaçlı bir bahçe.

dialogue:a2-clinic-topic-waiting-0.de: Heute? Bis jeder einmal gehört wurde. Das dauert. Das ist gut so.
dialogue:a2-clinic-topic-waiting-0.en: Today? Until everyone has been heard once. It takes time. That is as it should be.
dialogue:a2-clinic-topic-waiting-0.tr: Bugün mü? Herkes bir kez dinlenene kadar. Zaman alır. Böylesi iyi.

dialogue:a2-clinic-topic-waiting-1.de: Bring Wasser mit und geh langsam den Bach entlang. Gegen Abend prüfe ich jeden Patienten noch einmal.
dialogue:a2-clinic-topic-waiting-1.en: Bring water and walk slowly along the stream. Towards evening I check every patient once more.
dialogue:a2-clinic-topic-waiting-1.tr: Yanına su al ve dere boyunca yavaşça yürü. Akşama doğru her hastayı bir kez daha kontrol ediyorum.

dialogue:a2-clinic-topic-waiting-2.de: Das ist mein Rat. Mehr Medizin habe ich heute nicht.
dialogue:a2-clinic-topic-waiting-2.en: That is my advice. I have no more medicine today.
dialogue:a2-clinic-topic-waiting-2.tr: Benim tavsiyem bu. Bugün daha fazla ilacım yok.

topic:a2-clinic:waiting.de: Wie lange muss man hier warten?
topic:a2-clinic:waiting.en: How long do people have to wait here?

evidence:a2-clinic:waldruh-herb-garden.de: Sechs Samentüten mit alten Adressen an der Strecke. Greta hat drei markiert. Und ein blaues Gartentor, auf keiner Tüte.
evidence:a2-clinic:waldruh-herb-garden.en: Six seed packets with old addresses along the route. Greta has marked three. And a blue garden gate, on no packet.
evidence:a2-clinic:waldruh-herb-garden.tr: Hat boyunca eski adresleri taşıyan altı tohum paketi. Greta üçünü işaretlemiş. Ve hiçbir pakette olmayan mavi bir bahçe kapısı.

clue:a2-clinic:text:0.de: Voss hat im Fieber drei alte Haltestellen genannt.
clue:a2-clinic:text:0.en: In his fever Voss named three old stops.
clue:a2-clinic:text:0.tr: Voss ateşliyken üç eski durak saydı.

clue:a2-clinic:text:1.de: Er ist die Strecke vor der Schließung gefahren. Seine Akte sagt etwas anderes.
clue:a2-clinic:text:1.en: He travelled the route before the closure. His file says otherwise.
clue:a2-clinic:text:1.tr: Kapanıştan önce o hatta yolculuk etmiş. Dosyası başka bir şey söylüyor.

clue:a2-clinic:text:2.de: Unter der Uhrenmühle ist ein Keller mit einem Laternenschloss.
clue:a2-clinic:text:2.en: There is a cellar under the clockmill with a lantern lock.
clue:a2-clinic:text:2.tr: Saat değirmeninin altında fener kilitli bir kiler var.

clue:a2-clinic:lead:0.de: Der Keller unter der Uhrenmühle hat ein Laternenschloss.
clue:a2-clinic:lead:0.en: The cellar under the clockmill has a lantern lock.
clue:a2-clinic:lead:0.tr: Saat değirmeninin altındaki kilerin fenerli bir kilidi var.

clue:a2-clinic:letter:0.de: Ich erinnere mich an das blaue Tor. Dort bekam jeder ein Stück Kuchen für den Heimweg. Bitte pass auf Voss auf.
clue:a2-clinic:letter:0.en: I remember the blue gate. Everyone got a piece of cake there for the journey home. Please look after Voss.
clue:a2-clinic:letter:0.tr: Mavi kapıyı hatırlıyorum. Orada herkes eve dönüş için bir dilim pasta alırdı. Lütfen Voss’a göz kulak ol.

quest:a2-cellar:objective:0.en: Ask someone why they did something
quest:a2-cellar:objective:0.tr: Birine bir şeyi neden yaptığını sor

quest:a2-cellar:objective:2.en: Decide what happens to Herr Falk
quest:a2-cellar:objective:2.tr: Herr Falk’a ne olacağına karar ver

quest:a2-cellar:story:0.de: Unter der Uhrenmühle ist ein Keller.
quest:a2-cellar:story:0.en: There is a cellar under the clockmill.
quest:a2-cellar:story:0.tr: Saat değirmeninin altında bir kiler var.

dialogue:a2-cellar-intro-0.de: Der Schlüssel passt! Die kleine Laterne auf dem Griff und die auf dem Schloss sind gleich.
dialogue:a2-cellar-intro-0.en: The key fits! The little lantern on the handle and the one on the lock are the same.
dialogue:a2-cellar-intro-0.tr: Anahtar uyuyor! Saptaki küçük fener ile kilitteki aynı.

dialogue:a2-cellar-intro-1.de: Nicht schießen! Ich meine: guten Abend. Ich verkaufe hier … nichts.
dialogue:a2-cellar-intro-1.en: Don’t shoot! I mean: good evening. I am selling … nothing here.
dialogue:a2-cellar-intro-1.tr: Ateş etmeyin! Yani: iyi akşamlar. Burada … hiçbir şey satmıyorum.

dialogue:a2-cellar-intro-2.de: Herr Falk. Zwischen Tintenflaschen. Und einem Messingabzeichen vom Amt.
dialogue:a2-cellar-intro-2.en: Herr Falk. Among ink bottles. And a brass badge from the Office.
dialogue:a2-cellar-intro-2.tr: Herr Falk. Mürekkep şişelerinin arasında. Ve Daire’den pirinç bir rozet.

dialogue:a2-cellar-intro-3.de: Sie haben gefragt, woher meine Tinte kommt. Ich habe Angst bekommen.
dialogue:a2-cellar-intro-3.en: You asked where my ink comes from. I got scared.

dialogue:a2-cellar-intro-4.de: Sie haben meine Tinte gekauft. Ist Ihr Name schon blass? Es tut mir leid.
dialogue:a2-cellar-intro-4.en: You bought my ink. Is your name already pale? I am sorry.
dialogue:a2-cellar-intro-4.tr: Mürekkebimi aldınız. Adınız şimdiden soldu mu? Üzgünüm.

dialogue:a2-cellar-intro-5.de: Auf dem Tisch liegt eine alte Abschrift. Regel vier. Unterschrieben mit F.
dialogue:a2-cellar-intro-5.en: On the table lies an old copy. Rule four. Signed F.
dialogue:a2-cellar-intro-5.tr: Masada eski bir suret duruyor. Dördüncü kural. F ile imzalanmış.

dialogue:a2-cellar-gate-0.de: Ja. Das F bin ich. Und jetzt schauen Sie mich an, als hätte ich die Welt verkauft.
dialogue:a2-cellar-gate-0.en: Yes. The F is me. And now you look at me as if I had sold the world.
dialogue:a2-cellar-gate-0.tr: Evet. F benim. Şimdi bana dünyayı satmışım gibi bakıyorsunuz.

choice:a2-cellar:falk-released.de: Gehen Sie. Aber verkaufen Sie keine Versprechen mehr.
choice:a2-cellar:falk-released.en: Go. But sell no more promises.

choice:a2-cellar:falk-witness.de: Sie kommen mit ins Archiv. Als Zeuge.
choice:a2-cellar:falk-witness.en: You come with us to the archive. As a witness.

dialogue:a2-cellar-choice-0.de: Ich war Schreiber im Messingamt in Nebelstadt. Drei Jahre. Ich hatte die schönste Handschrift im Haus.
dialogue:a2-cellar-choice-0.en: I was a clerk at the Brass Office in Nebelstadt. Three years. I had the most beautiful handwriting in the building.
dialogue:a2-cellar-choice-0.tr: Nebelstadt’taki Pirinç Dairesi’nde kâtiptim. Üç yıl. Binadaki en güzel el yazısı bendeydi.

dialogue:a2-cellar-choice-1.de: Man gab mir einen Satz: Namen nicht laut sagen. Ich habe ihn schön geschrieben. Hundertmal.
dialogue:a2-cellar-choice-1.en: They gave me a sentence: do not say names out loud. I wrote it beautifully. A hundred times.
dialogue:a2-cellar-choice-1.tr: Bana bir cümle verdiler: İsimleri yüksek sesle söyleme. Onu güzelce yazdım. Yüz kez.

dialogue:a2-cellar-choice-2.de: Dann habe ich die Maschine am Hafen gesehen. Unter einer grauen Plane. Sie macht Namen leise.
dialogue:a2-cellar-choice-2.en: Then I saw the machine at the harbour. Under a grey tarpaulin. It makes names quiet.
dialogue:a2-cellar-choice-2.tr: Sonra limandaki makineyi gördüm. Gri bir brandanın altında. İsimleri sessizleştiriyor.

dialogue:a2-cellar-choice-3.de: Meine Regel hilft ihr. Wer schweigt, verschwindet schneller. Da bin ich gegangen.
dialogue:a2-cellar-choice-3.en: My rule helps it. Whoever stays silent disappears faster. That is when I left.
dialogue:a2-cellar-choice-3.tr: Benim kuralım ona yardım ediyor. Susan daha hızlı kayboluyor. O zaman ayrıldım.

dialogue:a2-cellar-choice-4.de: Jetzt verkaufe ich Tinte an Leute, die Angst haben. Weil ich auch Angst habe.
dialogue:a2-cellar-choice-4.en: Now I sell ink to people who are afraid. Because I am afraid too.
dialogue:a2-cellar-choice-4.tr: Şimdi korkan insanlara mürekkep satıyorum. Çünkü ben de korkuyorum.

dialogue:a2-cellar-choice-5.de: Normale Tinte gegen eine Maschine. Das funktioniert nicht mal meistens.
dialogue:a2-cellar-choice-5.en: Ordinary ink against a machine. That does not even mostly work.
dialogue:a2-cellar-choice-5.tr: Bir makineye karşı sıradan mürekkep. Bu çoğunlukla bile işe yaramaz.

dialogue:a2-cellar-choice-6.de: Lassen Sie mich gehen? Oder bringen Sie mich ins Archiv, vor alle?
dialogue:a2-cellar-choice-6.en: Will you let me go? Or will you take me to the archive, before everyone?
dialogue:a2-cellar-choice-6.tr: Gitmeme izin verecek misiniz? Yoksa beni arşive, herkesin önüne mi götüreceksiniz?

dialogue:a2-cellar-after-falk-released-0.de: Danke. Ich verschenke den Rest der Tinte. An Kinder. Zum Malen.
dialogue:a2-cellar-after-falk-released-0.en: Thank you. I will give away the rest of the ink. To children. For drawing.
dialogue:a2-cellar-after-falk-released-0.tr: Teşekkürler. Kalan mürekkebi hediye edeceğim. Çocuklara. Resim yapmaları için.

dialogue:a2-cellar-after-falk-released-1.de: Und er hat das Abzeichen hiergelassen. Das nehme ich mit.
dialogue:a2-cellar-after-falk-released-1.en: And he left the badge here. I will take it.
dialogue:a2-cellar-after-falk-released-1.tr: Rozeti de burada bırakmış. Onu ben alıyorum.

dialogue:a2-cellar-after-falk-witness-0.de: Als Zeuge. Das bin ich noch nie gewesen. Nur als Schreiber.
dialogue:a2-cellar-after-falk-witness-0.en: As a witness. I have never been that. Only a clerk.
dialogue:a2-cellar-after-falk-witness-0.tr: Tanık olarak. Hiç olmadım. Sadece kâtip.

dialogue:a2-cellar-after-falk-witness-1.de: Diesmal schreibt er nicht. Diesmal spricht er.
dialogue:a2-cellar-after-falk-witness-1.en: This time he does not write. This time he speaks.
dialogue:a2-cellar-after-falk-witness-1.tr: Bu sefer yazmıyor. Bu sefer konuşuyor.

dialogue:a2-cellar-complete-0.de: Das Archiv steht am Bahnhof, in einem alten Wagen. Ada kennt die Befehle von damals.
dialogue:a2-cellar-complete-0.en: The archive stands at the station, in an old carriage. Ada knows the orders from back then.
dialogue:a2-cellar-complete-0.tr: Arşiv istasyonda, eski bir vagonda. Ada o zamanki emirleri biliyor.

gate-prompt:a2-cellar.en: Ask Herr Falk why he did it.
gate-prompt:a2-cellar.tr: Herr Falk’a bunu neden yaptığını sor.

objective:a2-cellar:0.en: Open the cellar under the clockmill

objective:a2-cellar:2.en: Ask Herr Falk why he did it.
objective:a2-cellar:2.tr: Herr Falk’a bunu neden yaptığını sor.

objective:a2-cellar:3.en: Decide what happens to Herr Falk
objective:a2-cellar:3.tr: Herr Falk’a ne olacağına karar ver

dialogue:a2-cellar-topic-machine-0.de: Sie schickt einen dunklen Strahl die Strecke entlang. Wo er hinfällt, werden Namen leise.
dialogue:a2-cellar-topic-machine-0.en: It sends a dark beam along the route. Where it falls, names grow quiet.
dialogue:a2-cellar-topic-machine-0.tr: Hat boyunca karanlık bir ışın gönderiyor. Düştüğü yerde isimler sessizleşiyor.

topic:a2-cellar:machine.en: What exactly does the machine do?

dialogue:a2-cellar-topic-who-sent-0.de: Ein Zettel mit zwei Stempeln. Klack, klack. Mehr habe ich nie gesehen.
dialogue:a2-cellar-topic-who-sent-0.en: A note with two stamps. Clack, clack. I never saw more than that.
dialogue:a2-cellar-topic-who-sent-0.tr: İki mühürlü bir not. Tak, tak. Daha fazlasını hiç görmedim.

topic:a2-cellar:who-sent.de: Wer hat Ihnen die Regel gegeben?

lock:a2-cellar:waldruh-mill-cellar.de: Die Tür hat ein Schloss mit einer kleinen Laterne. Dein Schlüssel fehlt.
lock:a2-cellar:waldruh-mill-cellar.en: The door has a lock with a little lantern on it. You do not have its key.
lock:a2-cellar:waldruh-mill-cellar.tr: Kapının küçük fenerli bir kilidi var. Anahtarı sende değil.

evidence:a2-cellar:waldruh-mill-cellar.de: Ein Messingabzeichen, Tintenflaschen und eine alte Abschrift: Regel vier. Namen nicht laut sagen. Unterschrieben: F.
evidence:a2-cellar:waldruh-mill-cellar.en: A brass badge, ink bottles and an old copy: Rule four. Do not say names out loud. Signed: F.
evidence:a2-cellar:waldruh-mill-cellar.tr: Pirinç bir rozet, mürekkep şişeleri ve eski bir suret: Dördüncü kural. İsimleri yüksek sesle söyleme. İmza: F.

clue:a2-cellar:text:0.de: Herr Falk war Schreiber im Messingamt in Nebelstadt.
clue:a2-cellar:text:0.en: Herr Falk was a clerk at the Brass Office in Nebelstadt.
clue:a2-cellar:text:0.tr: Herr Falk Nebelstadt’taki Pirinç Dairesi’nde kâtipti.

clue:a2-cellar:text:1.de: Er hat Regel vier geschrieben. Dann hat er die Maschine am Hafen gesehen.
clue:a2-cellar:text:1.en: He wrote rule four. Then he saw the machine at the harbour.
clue:a2-cellar:text:1.tr: Dördüncü kuralı o yazdı. Sonra limandaki makineyi gördü.

clue:a2-cellar:text:2.de: Die Maschine schickt einen dunklen Strahl. Wer schweigt, verschwindet schneller.
clue:a2-cellar:text:2.en: The machine sends a dark beam. Whoever stays silent disappears faster.
clue:a2-cellar:text:2.tr: Makine karanlık bir ışın gönderiyor. Susan daha hızlı kayboluyor.

clue:a2-cellar:lead:0.de: Ada wartet im Archiv am Bahnhof.
clue:a2-cellar:lead:0.en: Ada is waiting in the archive at the station.

clue:a2-cellar:letter:0.de: Ich kenne die Maschine. Ich hätte sie anhalten können. Ich habe stattdessen eine Tür geschlossen.
clue:a2-cellar:letter:0.en: I know the machine. I could have stopped it. Instead I closed a door.
clue:a2-cellar:letter:0.tr: Makineyi tanıyorum. Onu durdurabilirdim. Onun yerine bir kapı kapattım.

grammar-note:a2-cellar.de: Warum haben Sie das gemacht? Die Antwort kommt oft mit weil, das Verb steht dann am Ende.
grammar-note:a2-cellar.en: Warum haben Sie das gemacht? The answer often comes with weil, and then the verb goes at the end.
grammar-note:a2-cellar.tr: Warum haben Sie das gemacht? Cevap sık sık weil ile gelir; o zaman fiil sona gider.

dialogue:a2-archive-intro-0.de: Sie suchen eine Unterschrift. Ich habe das Papier hier. Ich wollte warten, bis Sie weg sind.
dialogue:a2-archive-intro-0.en: You are looking for a signature. I have the paper here. I wanted to wait until you had gone.
dialogue:a2-archive-intro-0.tr: Bir imza arıyorsunuz. Kâğıt burada bende. Siz gidene kadar beklemek istemiştim.

dialogue:a2-archive-intro-1.de: Ich bin Ada. Ich ordne die Wahrheit alphabetisch. So weiß ich wenigstens, in welcher Schublade ich sie verstecke.
dialogue:a2-archive-intro-1.en: I am Ada. I file the truth alphabetically. At least that tells me which drawer I am hiding it in.
dialogue:a2-archive-intro-1.tr: Ben Ada. Gerçeği alfabetik sıraya koyarım. En azından onu hangi çekmeceye sakladığımı bilirim.

dialogue:a2-archive-intro-2.de: Mir wurde Ruhe verordnet. Ich höre zu. Ich habe die Akte mitgebracht.
dialogue:a2-archive-intro-2.en: I have been told to rest. I will listen. I brought the file.
dialogue:a2-archive-intro-2.tr: Bana dinlenme verildi. Dinleyeceğim. Dosyayı getirdim.

dialogue:a2-archive-intro-3.de: Ich bin als Zeuge hier. Ich habe Regel vier geschrieben. Ich sage alles.
dialogue:a2-archive-intro-3.en: I am here as a witness. I wrote rule four. I will tell everything.
dialogue:a2-archive-intro-3.tr: Buraya tanık olarak geldim. Dördüncü kuralı ben yazdım. Her şeyi anlatacağım.

dialogue:a2-archive-intro-4.de: Ich war Elises Lehrling. Sie hat um eine Woche gebeten. Ich habe die erste Schließung unterschrieben.
dialogue:a2-archive-intro-4.en: I was Elise’s apprentice. She asked for one week. I signed the first closure.
dialogue:a2-archive-intro-4.tr: Elise’in çırağıydım. Bir hafta istedi. İlk kapanışı ben imzaladım.

dialogue:a2-archive-intro-5.de: Ich wollte ihr zeigen, dass sie mir vertrauen kann. Ich habe den Kreis nicht gefragt. Ich hatte Zeit dafür.
dialogue:a2-archive-intro-5.en: I wanted to show her she could trust me. I did not ask the Circle. I had time to.
dialogue:a2-archive-intro-5.tr: Bana güvenebileceğini göstermek istedim. Çembere sormadım. Sormaya vaktim vardı.

dialogue:a2-archive-intro-6.de: Mein Befehl steht auf dem Gedenkstein. Darunter: Die Bewohner fragen. Den Satz habe ich selbst geschrieben.
dialogue:a2-archive-intro-6.en: My order is on the memorial stone. Beneath it: ask the residents. I wrote that sentence myself.
dialogue:a2-archive-intro-6.tr: Emrim anıt taşında yazılı. Altında: Sakinlere sorun. O cümleyi kendim yazdım.

dialogue:a2-archive-gate-0.de: Eine Woche. In meiner Akte steht: für immer. Beide Daten tragen dasselbe Siegel.
dialogue:a2-archive-gate-0.en: One week. My file says: permanent. Both dates carry the same seal.
dialogue:a2-archive-gate-0.tr: Bir hafta. Dosyamda “kalıcı” yazıyor. İki tarihte de aynı mühür var.

dialogue:a2-archive-gate-1.de: Das erste Papier liegt hier. Das zweite darunter. All die Jahre habe ich es nicht herausgenommen.
dialogue:a2-archive-gate-1.en: The first paper is here. The second is underneath. All these years I never took it out.
dialogue:a2-archive-gate-1.tr: İlk kâğıt burada. İkincisi altında. Bunca yıl onu hiç çıkarmadım.

choice:a2-archive:restore.de: Ich gehe jetzt. Elise muss es mir selbst erklären.
choice:a2-archive:restore.en: I am going now. Elise must explain it to me herself.
choice:a2-archive:restore.tr: Şimdi gidiyorum. Elise bunu bana kendisi açıklamalı.

choice:a2-archive:consult.de: Ich hole Zeugen. Kein Befehl soll wieder nur eine Seite hören.
choice:a2-archive:consult.en: I will bring witnesses. No order should hear only one side again.
choice:a2-archive:consult.tr: Tanık getireceğim. Hiçbir emir bir daha tek tarafı duymasın.

dialogue:a2-archive-choice-0.de: Mein Befehl galt eine Woche. Der zweite für immer. Meine Unterschrift hat ihm die Tür geöffnet.
dialogue:a2-archive-choice-0.en: My order lasted one week. The second was permanent. My signature opened the door for it.
dialogue:a2-archive-choice-0.tr: Benim emrim bir hafta geçerliydi. İkincisi kalıcıydı. İmzam ona kapıyı açtı.

dialogue:a2-archive-choice-1.de: Der zweite Befehl trägt zwei Zeichen: die Laterne von Elises Schlüssel und den Stempel des Messingamts.
dialogue:a2-archive-choice-1.en: The permanent order bears two marks: the lantern from Elise’s key and the Brass Office stamp.
dialogue:a2-archive-choice-1.tr: Kalıcı emirde iki işaret var: Elise’in anahtarındaki fener ve Pirinç Dairesi’nin mührü.

dialogue:a2-archive-choice-2.de: Unser Stempel ist echt. Meine Akte verschweigt diesen Befehl. Deshalb ist er nicht weniger wahr.
dialogue:a2-archive-choice-2.en: Our stamp is genuine. My file leaves out this order. That does not make it any less true.
dialogue:a2-archive-choice-2.tr: Mührümüz gerçek. Dosyam bu emri gizliyor. Bu onu daha az gerçek yapmaz.

dialogue:a2-archive-choice-3.de: Elise hat den Schlüssel von innen benutzt. Danach hat sie ihn weitergegeben. Zimmer 7. Ihr Vertrag.
dialogue:a2-archive-choice-3.en: Elise used the key from inside. Afterwards she passed it on. Room 7. Your lease.
dialogue:a2-archive-choice-3.tr: Elise anahtarı içeriden kullandı. Sonra onu devretti. Oda 7. Sizin sözleşmeniz.

dialogue:a2-archive-choice-4.de: Im Register steht: die Nachfolge der Hüterin. Darunter Ihr Name, {name}.
dialogue:a2-archive-choice-4.en: The register says: the Keeper’s successor. Beneath it, your name, {name}.
dialogue:a2-archive-choice-4.tr: Kayıtta yazıyor: Bekçinin halefi. Altında sizin adınız, {name}.

dialogue:a2-archive-choice-5.de: „Bevor du uns wieder auslöschst, komm.“ Sie meint den Schlüssel in Ihrer Tasche. Er kann die Strecke wieder schließen.
dialogue:a2-archive-choice-5.en: “Before you erase us again, come.” She means the key in your pocket. It can close the route again.
dialogue:a2-archive-choice-5.tr: “Bizi yeniden silmeden önce gel.” Cebinizdeki anahtarı kastediyor. Hattı yeniden kapatabilir.

dialogue:a2-archive-choice-6.de: Den zweiten Stempel habe ich gesehen. In Nebelstadt. Zweimal gedrückt. Klack, klack.
dialogue:a2-archive-choice-6.en: I saw the second stamp. In Nebelstadt. Pressed twice. Clack, clack.
dialogue:a2-archive-choice-6.tr: İkinci mührü gördüm. Nebelstadt’ta. İki kez basılmış. Tak, tak.

dialogue:a2-archive-choice-7.de: In jener Nacht hörte man ihre Stimme am Hafen und an der Sternwarte. Zur selben Zeit.
dialogue:a2-archive-choice-7.en: That night her voice was heard at the harbour and at the observatory. At the same time.
dialogue:a2-archive-choice-7.tr: O gece sesi limanda ve gözlemevinde duyuldu. Aynı anda.

dialogue:a2-archive-choice-8.de: Ich lege den Stift weg. Mein Name bleibt auf dem Papier. Ich streiche ihn nicht durch.
dialogue:a2-archive-choice-8.en: I am putting my pen down. My name stays on the paper. I will not cross it out.
dialogue:a2-archive-choice-8.tr: Kalemimi bırakıyorum. Adım kâğıtta kalıyor. Onu karalamayacağım.

dialogue:a2-archive-choice-9.de: Ich bin Ada. Wenn du willst, sagen wir jetzt du. Ich habe mich lange genug hinter Formularen versteckt.
dialogue:a2-archive-choice-9.en: I am Ada. If you like, we can say du now. I have hidden behind forms long enough.
dialogue:a2-archive-choice-9.tr: Ben Ada. İstersen artık sen diyelim. Yeterince uzun süre formların arkasına saklandım.

dialogue:a2-archive-choice-10.de: Ich bleibe beim Sie. Ich nehme meine Akte mit. Diesmal, um sie zu prüfen, nicht um sie zu verteidigen.
dialogue:a2-archive-choice-10.en: I will keep to Sie. I am taking my file. This time to examine it, not to defend it.
dialogue:a2-archive-choice-10.tr: Ben “siz”de kalıyorum. Dosyamı alıyorum. Bu sefer onu savunmak için değil, incelemek için.

dialogue:a2-archive-choice-11.de: Der zweite Stempel kam aus Nebelstadt. Gehst du jetzt? Oder holst du zuerst Zeugen für beide Befehle?
dialogue:a2-archive-choice-11.en: The second stamp came from Nebelstadt. Do you go now? Or do you first gather witnesses for both orders?
dialogue:a2-archive-choice-11.tr: İkinci mühür Nebelstadt’tan geldi. Şimdi mi gidiyorsun? Yoksa önce iki emir için tanık mı topluyorsun?

dialogue:a2-archive-after-restore-0.de: Heute ist pünktlich nicht so wichtig. Ich fahre dich.
dialogue:a2-archive-after-restore-0.en: Today punctuality matters less. I will take you.
dialogue:a2-archive-after-restore-0.tr: Bugün dakiklik o kadar önemli değil. Seni ben götürürüm.

dialogue:a2-archive-after-consult-0.de: Ich komme mit. Als die Frau, deren Name auf dem ersten Befehl steht.
dialogue:a2-archive-after-consult-0.en: I will come along. As the woman whose name is on the first order.
dialogue:a2-archive-after-consult-0.tr: Ben de geliyorum. İlk emirde adı yazan kadın olarak.

dialogue:a2-archive-after-consult-1.de: Drei Zeugen, zwei Bahnsteige. Diesmal bleibt kein Stuhl leer.
dialogue:a2-archive-after-consult-1.en: Three witnesses, two platforms. This time no chair stays empty.
dialogue:a2-archive-after-consult-1.tr: Üç tanık, iki peron. Bu sefer hiçbir sandalye boş kalmıyor.

dialogue:a2-archive-complete-0.de: Die Akten zum zweiten Stempel liegen in Nebelstadt. Die siebte Glocke lässt uns wenig Zeit.
dialogue:a2-archive-complete-0.en: The records for the second stamp are in Nebelstadt. The seventh bell leaves us little time.
dialogue:a2-archive-complete-0.tr: İkinci mührün kayıtları Nebelstadt’ta. Yedinci çan bize az zaman bırakıyor.

dialogue:a2-archive-complete-1.de: Aber diesmal weißt du, was du trägst.
dialogue:a2-archive-complete-1.en: But this time you know what you carry.
dialogue:a2-archive-complete-1.tr: Ama bu sefer ne taşıdığını biliyorsun.

objective:a2-archive:1.en: Read the first order on the memorial stone

objective:a2-archive:2.en: Ask Ada politely whether she can explain that more precisely.
objective:a2-archive:2.tr: Ada’ya bunu daha ayrıntılı açıklayıp açıklayamayacağını kibarca sor.

objective:a2-archive:3.en: Decide how you leave for Nebelstadt

dialogue:a2-archive-topic-how-long-0.de: Seit dem Morgen nach der Schließung. An dem Tag ist das Archiv losgefahren, und ich mit.
dialogue:a2-archive-topic-how-long-0.en: Since the morning after the closure. That day the archive set off, and I went with it.
dialogue:a2-archive-topic-how-long-0.tr: Kapanışın ertesi sabahından beri. O gün arşiv yola çıktı, ben de onunla.

topic:a2-archive:how-long.de: Wie lange arbeiten Sie schon hier?
topic:a2-archive:how-long.en: How long have you worked here?

dialogue:a2-archive-topic-truth-0.de: Unter W, für Wahrheit. Zwischen Wetter und Wünsche.
dialogue:a2-archive-topic-truth-0.en: Under W, for Wahrheit. Between weather and wishes.
dialogue:a2-archive-topic-truth-0.tr: W harfinin altına, Wahrheit için. Hava durumu ile dileklerin arasına.

dialogue:a2-archive-topic-truth-1.de: Die Wetter-Mappe ist viel dicker. Die Leute schreiben lieber über Regen.
dialogue:a2-archive-topic-truth-1.en: The weather folder is much thicker. People would rather write about rain.
dialogue:a2-archive-topic-truth-1.tr: Hava durumu dosyası çok daha kalın. İnsanlar yağmur hakkında yazmayı tercih ediyor.

topic:a2-archive:truth.de: Wo legen Sie die Wahrheit ab?
topic:a2-archive:truth.en: Where do you file the truth?

dialogue:a2-archive-topic-travelling-0.de: Ein Archiv, das stillsteht, wird vergessen. Eines, das reist, muss jeden Tag neu gefragt werden.
dialogue:a2-archive-topic-travelling-0.en: An archive that stands still gets forgotten. One that travels has to be asked again every day.
dialogue:a2-archive-topic-travelling-0.tr: Duran bir arşiv unutulur. Gezen bir arşive her gün yeniden sorulmak zorundadır.

evidence:a2-archive:waldruh-memory-stone.de: Vorübergehende Schließung der Strecke, eine Woche. Unterschrieben: Ada, Lehrling der Hüterin. Unter dem Siegel, sehr klein: Die Bewohner fragen.
evidence:a2-archive:waldruh-memory-stone.en: Temporary closure of the route, one week. Signed: Ada, the Keeper’s apprentice. Under the seal, very small: Ask the residents.
evidence:a2-archive:waldruh-memory-stone.tr: Hattın geçici olarak kapatılması, bir hafta. İmza: Ada, Bekçinin çırağı. Mührün altında, çok küçük: Sakinlere sorun.

clue:a2-archive:text:0.de: Ada hat die erste Schließung für eine Woche unterschrieben.
clue:a2-archive:text:0.en: Ada signed the first closure, for one week.
clue:a2-archive:text:0.tr: Ada ilk kapanışı bir haftalığına imzaladı.

clue:a2-archive:text:1.de: Der zweite Befehl trägt Elises Schlüssel und den Stempel des Messingamts.
clue:a2-archive:text:1.en: The second order bears Elise’s key and the Brass Office stamp.
clue:a2-archive:text:1.tr: İkinci emirde Elise’in anahtarı ve Pirinç Dairesi’nin mührü var.

clue:a2-archive:text:2.de: Im Register steht: die Nachfolge der Hüterin. Darunter dein Name.
clue:a2-archive:text:2.en: The register says: the Keeper’s successor. Beneath it, your name.
clue:a2-archive:text:2.tr: Kayıtta yazıyor: Bekçinin halefi. Altında senin adın.

clue:a2-archive:lead:0.de: Die Akten zum zweiten Stempel liegen in Nebelstadt.
clue:a2-archive:lead:0.en: The records for the second stamp are in Nebelstadt.

clue:a2-archive:letter:0.de: Ich habe dir den Schlüssel vor der Wahrheit gegeben. Das war falsch. Du darfst anders wählen als ich.
clue:a2-archive:letter:0.en: I gave you the key before I gave you the truth. That was wrong. You are allowed to choose differently from me.
clue:a2-archive:letter:0.tr: Sana anahtarı gerçekten önce verdim. Bu yanlıştı. Benden farklı seçebilirsin.

dialogue:b1-witness-intro-0.de: Die Anhörung beginnt. Zwei Berichte, dieselbe Stimme. Am Hafen und an der Sternwarte, zur selben Zeit.
dialogue:b1-witness-intro-0.en: The hearing begins. Two reports, the same voice. At the harbour and at the observatory, at the same time.
dialogue:b1-witness-intro-0.tr: Duruşma başlıyor. İki rapor, aynı ses. Limanda ve gözlemevinde, aynı anda.

dialogue:b1-witness-intro-1.de: Ich führe das Protokoll. Alphabetisch, wenn niemand widerspricht.
dialogue:b1-witness-intro-1.en: I will keep the minutes. Alphabetically, unless anyone objects.
dialogue:b1-witness-intro-1.tr: Tutanağı ben tutuyorum. Kimse itiraz etmezse alfabetik sırayla.

dialogue:b1-witness-intro-2.de: Marta hat in jener Nacht Tee zum Hafen gebracht. Sie sagt nur, was sie selbst gesehen und gehört hat.
dialogue:b1-witness-intro-2.en: Marta took tea to the harbour that night. She will only say what she herself saw and heard.
dialogue:b1-witness-intro-2.tr: Marta o gece limana çay götürdü. Sadece kendi gördüğünü ve duyduğunu söyleyecek.

dialogue:b1-witness-intro-3.de: Lina, ich komme mir vor wie vor Gericht. Und ohne Schürze.
dialogue:b1-witness-intro-3.en: Lina, I feel as if I am in court. And without my apron.
dialogue:b1-witness-intro-3.tr: Lina, kendimi mahkemede gibi hissediyorum. Hem de önlüksüz.

dialogue:b1-witness-intro-4.de: Heute kommt jede Antwort ins Protokoll. Deshalb sprechen auch wir heute förmlich.
dialogue:b1-witness-intro-4.en: Today every answer goes on record. That is why even we speak formally today.
dialogue:b1-witness-intro-4.tr: Bugün her cevap tutanağa geçiyor. Bu yüzden bugün biz de resmî konuşuyoruz.

dialogue:b1-witness-intro-5.de: Das Messingamt ist als Beobachter hier. Ich höre zu. Ich unterbreche nicht.
dialogue:b1-witness-intro-5.en: The Brass Office is attending as an observer. I will listen. I will not interrupt.
dialogue:b1-witness-intro-5.tr: Pirinç Dairesi gözlemci olarak burada. Dinleyeceğim. Sözünüzü kesmeyeceğim.

dialogue:b1-witness-intro-6.de: Ich bin der zweite Zeuge. Ich kenne den Stempel. Zweimal gedrückt.
dialogue:b1-witness-intro-6.en: I am the second witness. I know the stamp. Pressed twice.
dialogue:b1-witness-intro-6.tr: İkinci tanık benim. Mührü tanıyorum. İki kez basılmış.

dialogue:b1-witness-intro-7.de: Das Band liegt hier. Marta sitzt dort. Wir halten die Beweise getrennt.
dialogue:b1-witness-intro-7.en: The tape is here. Marta is sitting there. We keep the evidence separate.
dialogue:b1-witness-intro-7.tr: Bant burada. Marta orada oturuyor. Delilleri ayrı tutuyoruz.

dialogue:b1-witness-gate-0.de: Frau Zeugin, Ihre Tasse steht neben Ihnen. Wir sind bereit für Ihre Aussage.
dialogue:b1-witness-gate-0.en: Madam witness, your cup is beside you. We are ready for your statement.
dialogue:b1-witness-gate-0.tr: Sayın tanık, fincanınız yanınızda. İfadenize hazırız.

dialogue:b1-witness-gate-0:variant:0.de: Wir sind bereit für Ihre Aussage.
dialogue:b1-witness-gate-0:variant:0.en: We are ready for your statement.

choice:b1-witness:reopen.de: Wir hängen sie sofort am Hafen aus.
choice:b1-witness:reopen.en: We post it at the harbour right away.

choice:b1-witness:remember.de: Erst bekommt der Kreis eine geprüfte Abschrift.
choice:b1-witness:remember.en: First the Circle receives a checked copy.
choice:b1-witness:remember.tr: Önce Çember kontrol edilmiş bir suret alıyor.

dialogue:b1-witness-choice-0.de: Ich habe die Teekanne neben die Laterne gestellt. Dann hörte ich eine Frau im Nebel.
dialogue:b1-witness-choice-0.en: I put the teapot down beside the lantern. Then I heard a woman in the fog.
dialogue:b1-witness-choice-0.tr: Demliği fenerin yanına koydum. Sonra siste bir kadın duydum.

dialogue:b1-witness-choice-1.de: Sie rief: „Ist da jemand? Ich bin noch hier.“
dialogue:b1-witness-choice-1.en: She called: “Is anyone there? I am still here.”
dialogue:b1-witness-choice-1.tr: Seslendi: “Orada kimse var mı? Ben hâlâ buradayım.”

dialogue:b1-witness-choice-2.de: Dann ein Husten. Dann alles von vorn. Beim dritten Husten wusste ich es.
dialogue:b1-witness-choice-2.en: Then a cough. Then everything from the start. By the third cough I knew.
dialogue:b1-witness-choice-2.tr: Sonra bir öksürük. Sonra her şey baştan. Üçüncü öksürükte anladım.

dialogue:b1-witness-choice-3.de: Eine alte Aufnahme. Elise stand nicht an zwei Orten im Nebel.
dialogue:b1-witness-choice-3.en: An old recording. Elise was not standing in two places in the fog.
dialogue:b1-witness-choice-3.tr: Eski bir kayıt. Elise siste iki yerde birden durmuyordu.

dialogue:b1-witness-choice-4.de: Hafen und Sternwarte spielen dasselbe Band. Zwei Anschlüsse, eine Stimme.
dialogue:b1-witness-choice-4.en: The harbour and the observatory play the same tape. Two connections, one voice.
dialogue:b1-witness-choice-4.tr: Liman ve gözlemevi aynı bandı çalıyor. İki bağlantı, tek ses.

dialogue:b1-witness-choice-5.de: An der Maschine neben der Laterne stand jemand. Als ich näher kam, waren die Wörter auf meiner Teeliste weg.
dialogue:b1-witness-choice-5.en: Someone stood at the machine beside the lantern. When I came closer, the words on my tea list were gone.
dialogue:b1-witness-choice-5.tr: Fenerin yanındaki makinenin başında biri duruyordu. Yaklaşınca çay listemdeki kelimeler kaybolmuştu.

dialogue:b1-witness-choice-6.de: Sein Gesicht sah ich nicht. Aber sein Stempel klang wie Ihrer, Herr Voss. Zweimal: klack, klack.
dialogue:b1-witness-choice-6.en: I did not see his face. But his stamp sounded like yours, Mr Voss. Twice: clack, clack.
dialogue:b1-witness-choice-6.tr: Yüzünü görmedim. Ama mührü sizinki gibi ses çıkarıyordu, Bay Voss. İki kez: tak, tak.

dialogue:b1-witness-choice-7.de: Ich stand an der Maschine. Ihre Aussage ist richtig.
dialogue:b1-witness-choice-7.en: I was standing at the machine. Your statement is correct.
dialogue:b1-witness-choice-7.tr: Makinenin başında ben duruyordum. İfadeniz doğru.

dialogue:b1-witness-choice-8.de: Dann bleibt Ihr Name im Protokoll. Auch während wir auf Ihre Erklärung warten.
dialogue:b1-witness-choice-8.en: Then your name stays in the record. Even while we wait for your explanation.
dialogue:b1-witness-choice-8.tr: O zaman adınız tutanakta kalıyor. Açıklamanızı beklerken bile.

dialogue:b1-witness-choice-9.de: Veröffentlichen wir die Aussage sofort? Oder schicken wir dem Kreis zuerst eine geprüfte Abschrift?
dialogue:b1-witness-choice-9.en: Do we publish the statement right away? Or send the Circle a checked copy first?
dialogue:b1-witness-choice-9.tr: İfadeyi hemen mi yayımlayalım? Yoksa önce Çembere kontrol edilmiş bir suret mi gönderelim?

dialogue:b1-witness-after-reopen-0.de: Ich antworte hier. Vor denselben Leuten.
dialogue:b1-witness-after-reopen-0.en: I will answer here. Before these same people.
dialogue:b1-witness-after-reopen-0.tr: Burada cevap vereceğim. Aynı insanların önünde.

dialogue:b1-witness-after-remember-0.de: Ich prüfe jedes Wort. Dann kann es keiner ein Gerücht nennen.
dialogue:b1-witness-after-remember-0.en: I will check every word. Then nobody can call it a rumour.
dialogue:b1-witness-after-remember-0.tr: Her kelimeyi kontrol ediyorum. O zaman kimse buna dedikodu diyemez.

dialogue:b1-witness-after-remember-1.de: Ich lese es heute Abend dem Kreis vor.
dialogue:b1-witness-after-remember-1.en: I will read it to the Circle tonight.

dialogue:b1-witness-complete-0.de: Nächster Termin: Frau Kessler im Archiv des Amtes. Sie hat Zettel. Viele Zettel.
dialogue:b1-witness-complete-0.en: Next appointment: Frau Kessler in the Office archive. She has notices. Many notices.
dialogue:b1-witness-complete-0.tr: Sıradaki randevu: Daire arşivinde Frau Kessler. Notları var. Bir sürü not.

objective:b1-witness:0.en: Join the hearing at the harbour post office

objective:b1-witness:3.en: Politely ask the witness to describe what she saw (formal Sie).
objective:b1-witness:3.tr: Tanıktan gördüklerini kibarca anlatmasını iste (resmî Sie).

objective:b1-witness:4.en: Decide how the statement is shared

dialogue:b1-witness-topic-hearing-0.de: Jeder sagt, was er gesehen hat. Nicht, was er glaubt.
dialogue:b1-witness-topic-hearing-0.en: Everyone says what they saw. Not what they believe.
dialogue:b1-witness-topic-hearing-0.tr: Herkes ne gördüğünü söyler. Neye inandığını değil.

dialogue:b1-witness-topic-hearing-1.de: Und ich schreibe beides getrennt auf. Das ist schwerer, als es klingt.
dialogue:b1-witness-topic-hearing-1.en: And I write the two down separately. That is harder than it sounds.
dialogue:b1-witness-topic-hearing-1.tr: Ben de ikisini ayrı yazarım. Göründüğünden daha zordur.

dialogue:b1-witness-topic-machine-0.de: Am Hafen, neben der Signallaterne, unter einer grauen Plane. Keiner geht gern hin.
dialogue:b1-witness-topic-machine-0.en: At the harbour, next to the signal lantern, under a grey tarpaulin. Nobody likes going there.
dialogue:b1-witness-topic-machine-0.tr: Limanda, işaret fenerinin yanında, gri bir brandanın altında. Kimse oraya gitmeyi sevmez.

dialogue:b1-witness-topic-machine-1.de: Nachts brummt sie. Leise und gleichmäßig, wie jemand, der zählt.
dialogue:b1-witness-topic-machine-1.en: At night it hums. Quietly and evenly, like someone counting.
dialogue:b1-witness-topic-machine-1.tr: Geceleri vızıldar. Sessiz ve düzenli, sayan biri gibi.

evidence:b1-witness:nebelstadt-evidence-.de: Lieferscheine, Martas Teeliste von jener Nacht und eine Spule Tonband.
evidence:b1-witness:nebelstadt-evidence-.en: Delivery slips, Marta’s tea list from that night and a reel of tape.
evidence:b1-witness:nebelstadt-evidence-.tr: Teslim fişleri, Marta’nın o geceki çay listesi ve bir makara ses bandı.

evidence:b1-witness:nebelstadt-signal-la.de: Unter der Laterne hängt ein alter Rekorder mit einem Band ohne Ende.
evidence:b1-witness:nebelstadt-signal-la.en: An old recorder with an endless tape hangs beneath the lantern.
evidence:b1-witness:nebelstadt-signal-la.tr: Fenerin altında, sonsuz bantlı eski bir kayıt cihazı asılı.

clue:b1-witness:text:0.de: Elises Stimme am Hafen und an der Sternwarte war ein altes Band.
clue:b1-witness:text:0.en: Elise’s voice at the harbour and the observatory was an old tape.
clue:b1-witness:text:0.tr: Limandaki ve gözlemevindeki Elise’in sesi eski bir banttı.

clue:b1-witness:text:1.de: Marta hat jemanden an der Maschine gesehen. Der Stempel klang zweimal.
clue:b1-witness:text:1.en: Marta saw someone at the machine. The stamp sounded twice.
clue:b1-witness:text:1.tr: Marta makinenin başında birini gördü. Mühür iki kez ses çıkardı.

clue:b1-witness:text:2.de: Voss gibt zu: Ich stand an der Maschine.
clue:b1-witness:text:2.en: Voss admits: I was standing at the machine.
clue:b1-witness:text:2.tr: Voss kabul ediyor: Makinenin başında ben duruyordum.

clue:b1-witness:lead:0.de: Frau Kessler wartet im Archiv des Amtes.
clue:b1-witness:lead:0.en: Frau Kessler is waiting in the Office archive.

clue:b1-witness:letter:0.de: Du hast Marta zugehört, bevor du entschieden hast. Damals habe ich zuerst entschieden. Die Stimme auf dem Band ist meine. Ich bin nicht an zwei Orten. Ich bin hier, hinter einer geschlossenen Tür.
clue:b1-witness:letter:0.en: You listened to Marta before deciding. Back then I decided first. The voice on the tape is mine. I am not in two places. I am here, behind a closed door.
clue:b1-witness:letter:0.tr: Karar vermeden önce Marta’yı dinledin. O zaman ben önce karar verdim. Banttaki ses benim. İki yerde değilim. Buradayım, kapalı bir kapının ardında.

quest:b1-record-room:objective:0.tr: Belgeleri görmek için resmî olarak rica et

quest:b1-record-room:objective:2.en: Decide whether Frau Kessler speaks at the council
quest:b1-record-room:objective:2.tr: Frau Kessler’in kurulda konuşup konuşmayacağına karar ver

quest:b1-record-room:story:0.de: Im Archiv des Messingamts liegen die Wartungszettel.
quest:b1-record-room:story:0.en: The maintenance slips lie in the Brass Office archive.
quest:b1-record-room:story:0.tr: Bakım fişleri Pirinç Dairesi’nin arşivinde duruyor.

quest:b1-record-room:story:1.de: Frau Kessler hat sie alle selbst ausgefüllt.
quest:b1-record-room:story:1.en: Frau Kessler filled them all in herself.

quest:b1-record-room:story:2.de: Wer hat die Maschine am Leben gehalten?

dialogue:b1-record-room-intro-0.de: Sie schon wieder. Aus Lindenhafen. Sie sind sehr laut gereist.
dialogue:b1-record-room-intro-0.en: You again. From Lindenhafen. You travelled very loudly.
dialogue:b1-record-room-intro-0.tr: Yine siz. Lindenhafen’den. Çok gürültülü yolculuk ettiniz.

dialogue:b1-record-room-intro-1.de: Herr Voss ist zu einem Beobachter geworden. Ich nicht. Ich bin noch im Dienst.
dialogue:b1-record-room-intro-1.en: Mr Voss has become an observer. I have not. I am still on duty.
dialogue:b1-record-room-intro-1.tr: Bay Voss gözlemci oldu. Ben olmadım. Ben hâlâ görevdeyim.

dialogue:b1-record-room-intro-2.de: Sie haben meine Liste. Regel eins bis zehn. Sie gehört ins Archiv, nicht in Ihre Tasche.
dialogue:b1-record-room-intro-2.en: You have my list. Rules one to ten. It belongs in the archive, not in your bag.
dialogue:b1-record-room-intro-2.tr: Listem sizde. Birden ona kadar kurallar. Arşive aittir, çantanıza değil.

dialogue:b1-record-room-intro-3.de: Sie haben Martas Gästebuch genommen. Ihr Name steht seitdem in meinem Buch.
dialogue:b1-record-room-intro-3.en: You took Marta’s guest book. Your name has been in my book since then.
dialogue:b1-record-room-intro-3.tr: Marta’nın misafir defterini aldınız. O zamandan beri adınız benim defterimde.

dialogue:b1-record-room-intro-4.de: Ein Mann aus der Schreibstube war Zeuge? Herr Falk. Er hatte immer zu schöne Buchstaben.
dialogue:b1-record-room-intro-4.en: A man from the writing office was a witness? Herr Falk. His letters were always too beautiful.
dialogue:b1-record-room-intro-4.tr: Yazı odasından bir adam mı tanıktı? Herr Falk. Harfleri hep fazla güzeldi.

dialogue:b1-record-room-intro-5.de: Das Archiv ist verschlossen. Für Unbefugte. Und Sie sind sehr unbefugt.
dialogue:b1-record-room-intro-5.en: The archive is locked. To unauthorised persons. And you are very unauthorised.
dialogue:b1-record-room-intro-5.tr: Arşiv kilitli. Yetkisizlere. Ve siz çok yetkisizsiniz.

dialogue:b1-record-room-gate-0.de: Sie sind trotzdem drin. Mit einem Schlüssel, den es nicht geben dürfte. Was suchen Sie?
dialogue:b1-record-room-gate-0.en: You are inside anyway. With a key that should not exist. What are you looking for?
dialogue:b1-record-room-gate-0.tr: Yine de içeridesiniz. Var olmaması gereken bir anahtarla. Ne arıyorsunuz?

dialogue:b1-record-room-gate-0:variant:0.de: Sie sind trotzdem drin. Was suchen Sie?
dialogue:b1-record-room-gate-0:variant:0.en: You are inside anyway. What are you looking for?

choice:b1-record-room:kessler-invited.de: Sie sprechen selbst vor dem Rat. Mit Ihren Zetteln.
choice:b1-record-room:kessler-invited.en: You speak before the council yourself. With your slips.

choice:b1-record-room:slips-filed.de: Die Zettel kommen auf den Tisch. Sie müssen nichts sagen.
choice:b1-record-room:slips-filed.en: The slips go on the table. You need not say anything.
choice:b1-record-room:slips-filed.tr: Fişler masaya gidiyor. Bir şey söylemek zorunda değilsiniz.

dialogue:b1-record-room-choice-0.de: Dritte Schublade. Wartung, Hafen, Signal. Alles vollständig. Alles in Ordnung.
dialogue:b1-record-room-choice-0.en: Third drawer. Maintenance, harbour, signal. All complete. All in order.
dialogue:b1-record-room-choice-0.tr: Üçüncü çekmece. Bakım, liman, sinyal. Hepsi eksiksiz. Hepsi düzende.

dialogue:b1-record-room-choice-1.de: Drei Bestellungen für neue Spulen. März, Juli, Dezember. Ich habe sie ausgefüllt. Herr Voss hat unterschrieben.
dialogue:b1-record-room-choice-1.en: Three orders for new coils. March, July, December. I filled them in. Mr Voss signed.
dialogue:b1-record-room-choice-1.tr: Yeni bobinler için üç sipariş. Mart, temmuz, aralık. Ben doldurdum. Bay Voss imzaladı.

dialogue:b1-record-room-choice-2.de: Ich habe nie gefragt, was die Maschine tut. Das stand nicht auf dem Formular.
dialogue:b1-record-room-choice-2.en: I never asked what the machine does. That was not on the form.
dialogue:b1-record-room-choice-2.tr: Makinenin ne yaptığını hiç sormadım. Formda yazmıyordu.

dialogue:b1-record-room-choice-3.de: Auf jedem Zettel steht derselbe Satz unten: Wer schweigt, stimmt zu.
dialogue:b1-record-room-choice-3.en: The same sentence is at the bottom of every slip: whoever stays silent agrees.
dialogue:b1-record-room-choice-3.tr: Her fişin altında aynı cümle var: Susan kabul etmiş sayılır.

dialogue:b1-record-room-choice-4.de: Das ist keine Drohung. Das ist eine Vereinfachung. Wer nichts sagt, macht keine Arbeit.
dialogue:b1-record-room-choice-4.en: That is not a threat. That is a simplification. Whoever says nothing makes no work.
dialogue:b1-record-room-choice-4.tr: Bu bir tehdit değil. Bir sadeleştirme. Hiçbir şey söylemeyen iş çıkarmaz.

dialogue:b1-record-room-choice-5.de: Für Sie, Frau Kessler. Für die anderen war es ein Verschwinden.
dialogue:b1-record-room-choice-5.en: For you, Frau Kessler. For the others it was a disappearance.
dialogue:b1-record-room-choice-5.tr: Sizin için, Frau Kessler. Diğerleri için bir kayboluştu.

dialogue:b1-record-room-choice-6.de: Morgen tagt der Rat. Laden Sie mich ein? Oder legen Sie meine Zettel einfach auf den Tisch?
dialogue:b1-record-room-choice-6.en: The council meets tomorrow. Will you invite me? Or will you simply put my slips on the table?
dialogue:b1-record-room-choice-6.tr: Kurul yarın toplanıyor. Beni davet edecek misiniz? Yoksa fişlerimi öylece masaya mı koyacaksınız?

dialogue:b1-record-room-after-kessler-in.de: Ich habe noch nie vor Leuten gesprochen. Nur vor Formularen.
dialogue:b1-record-room-after-kessler-in.en: I have never spoken in front of people. Only in front of forms.
dialogue:b1-record-room-after-kessler-in.tr: İnsanların önünde hiç konuşmadım. Sadece formların önünde.

dialogue:b1-record-room-after-kessler-in.de: Dann fangen Sie morgen an. Wir hören zu. Auch bei einem Fehler.
dialogue:b1-record-room-after-kessler-in.en: Then you start tomorrow. We will listen. Even if you make a mistake.
dialogue:b1-record-room-after-kessler-in.tr: O zaman yarın başlayın. Dinleyeceğiz. Bir hata yapsanız bile.

dialogue:b1-record-room-after-slips-file.de: Natürlich. Wer schweigt … Nein. Das sage ich nicht mehr.
dialogue:b1-record-room-after-slips-file.en: Of course. Whoever stays silent … No. I will not say that any more.
dialogue:b1-record-room-after-slips-file.tr: Elbette. Susan … Hayır. Bunu artık söylemiyorum.

dialogue:b1-record-room-after-slips-file.de: Ich nehme die Zettel. Alphabetisch, nach Datum.
dialogue:b1-record-room-after-slips-file.en: I will take the slips. Alphabetically, by date.
dialogue:b1-record-room-after-slips-file.tr: Fişleri ben alıyorum. Alfabetik, tarihe göre.

dialogue:b1-record-room-complete-0.de: Otto wartet am Bahnkai. Er hat zwei Pläne für die Strecke und schlechte Laune.
dialogue:b1-record-room-complete-0.en: Otto is waiting on the railway quay. He has two plans for the route and a bad mood.
dialogue:b1-record-room-complete-0.tr: Otto demiryolu rıhtımında bekliyor. Hat için iki planı ve kötü bir ruh hali var.

gate-prompt:b1-record-room.en: Ask Frau Kessler formally to show you where the documents are.
gate-prompt:b1-record-room.tr: Frau Kessler’den belgelerin nerede olduğunu göstermesini resmî olarak rica et.

objective:b1-record-room:0.en: Find Frau Kessler at the Office archive

objective:b1-record-room:2.en: Ask Frau Kessler formally to show you where the documents are.
objective:b1-record-room:2.tr: Frau Kessler’den belgelerin nerede olduğunu göstermesini resmî olarak rica et.

objective:b1-record-room:3.en: Decide whether Frau Kessler speaks at the council
objective:b1-record-room:3.tr: Frau Kessler’in kurulda konuşup konuşmayacağına karar ver

dialogue:b1-record-room-topic-why-office.de: Weil dort alles einen Platz hat. Bei mir zu Hause hatte nichts einen Platz.
dialogue:b1-record-room-topic-why-office.en: Because everything there has a place. At home nothing had a place.
dialogue:b1-record-room-topic-why-office.tr: Çünkü orada her şeyin bir yeri var. Evde hiçbir şeyin yeri yoktu.

topic:b1-record-room:why-office.de: Warum arbeiten Sie für das Amt?
topic:b1-record-room:why-office.en: Why do you work for the Office?

dialogue:b1-record-room-topic-rule-four-.de: Aus dieser Schublade. Mit zwei Stempeln. Ich habe sie nie gelesen. Nur abgeschrieben.
dialogue:b1-record-room-topic-rule-four-.en: From this drawer. With two stamps. I never read it. I only copied it.
dialogue:b1-record-room-topic-rule-four-.tr: Bu çekmeceden. İki mühürle. Hiç okumadım. Sadece kopyaladım.

topic:b1-record-room:rule-four.en: Where does rule four come from?

lock:b1-record-room:nebelstadt-record-ro.de: Das Archiv ist verschlossen. Du brauchst einen Schlüssel oder ein Buch des Amtes.
lock:b1-record-room:nebelstadt-record-ro.en: The archive is locked. You need a key or one of the Office’s books.
lock:b1-record-room:nebelstadt-record-ro.tr: Arşiv kilitli. Bir anahtara ya da Dairenin bir defterine ihtiyacın var.

evidence:b1-record-room:nebelstadt-recor.de: Wartungszettel für die Maschine am Hafen. Drei Spulen. Alle in Frau Kesslers Schrift, alle mit Voss’ Unterschrift.
evidence:b1-record-room:nebelstadt-recor.en: Maintenance slips for the harbour machine. Three coils. All in Frau Kessler’s hand, all with Voss’s signature.
evidence:b1-record-room:nebelstadt-recor.tr: Liman makinesi için bakım fişleri. Üç bobin. Hepsi Frau Kessler’in el yazısıyla, hepsi Voss’un imzasıyla.

clue:b1-record-room:text:0.de: Frau Kessler hat drei Bestellungen für neue Spulen ausgefüllt.
clue:b1-record-room:text:0.en: Frau Kessler filled in three orders for new coils.
clue:b1-record-room:text:0.tr: Frau Kessler yeni bobinler için üç sipariş doldurdu.

clue:b1-record-room:text:2.de: Unter jedem Zettel steht: Wer schweigt, stimmt zu.
clue:b1-record-room:text:2.en: At the bottom of every slip: whoever stays silent agrees.
clue:b1-record-room:text:2.tr: Her fişin altında yazıyor: Susan kabul etmiş sayılır.

clue:b1-record-room:lead:0.de: Otto wartet am Bahnkai mit zwei Plänen.
clue:b1-record-room:lead:0.en: Otto is waiting on the quay with two plans.

clue:b1-record-room:letter:0.de: Sie hat nur abgeschrieben, sagt sie. Ich auch. Ich habe nur eine Tür geschlossen. So beginnt es immer.
clue:b1-record-room:letter:0.en: She only copied, she says. So did I. I only closed a door. That is how it always begins.
clue:b1-record-room:letter:0.tr: Sadece kopyaladığını söylüyor. Ben de. Ben sadece bir kapı kapattım. Hep böyle başlar.

grammar-note:b1-record-room.de: Könnten Sie mir zeigen, wo die Unterlagen sind? In der indirekten Frage steht das Verb am Ende.
grammar-note:b1-record-room.en: Könnten Sie mir zeigen, wo die Unterlagen sind? In the indirect question the verb goes at the end.
grammar-note:b1-record-room.tr: Könnten Sie mir zeigen, wo die Unterlagen sind? Dolaylı soruda fiil sona gider.

dialogue:b1-new-route-intro-0.de: Zwei Pläne für die Strecke nach Waldruh. Einer ist gut. Der andere ist von Greta.
dialogue:b1-new-route-intro-0.en: Two plans for the route to Waldruh. One is good. The other is Greta’s.
dialogue:b1-new-route-intro-0.tr: Waldruh hattı için iki plan. Biri iyi. Diğeri Greta’nın.

dialogue:b1-new-route-intro-2.de: Meine Linie ist gerade und vierzig Minuten schneller. Für die Leute in Waldruh zählt jede Fahrt.
dialogue:b1-new-route-intro-2.en: My line is straight and forty minutes faster. For the people of Waldruh every journey counts.
dialogue:b1-new-route-intro-2.tr: Benim hattım düz ve kırk dakika daha hızlı. Waldruh halkı için her yolculuk önemli.

dialogue:b1-new-route-intro-3.de: Deine gerade Linie geht mitten durch meinen Garten. Dort wachsen die letzten Samen aus verschwundenen Häusern.
dialogue:b1-new-route-intro-3.en: Your straight line goes right through my garden. The last seeds from vanished houses grow there.
dialogue:b1-new-route-intro-3.tr: Düz hattın tam bahçemin ortasından geçiyor. Orada kaybolmuş evlerden kalan son tohumlar yetişiyor.

dialogue:b1-new-route-intro-4.de: Frau Bergs Rhabarber wächst auch dort. Von ihrem Haus ist nur dieses Beet übrig.
dialogue:b1-new-route-intro-4.en: Frau Berg’s rhubarb grows there too. Only this bed is left of her house.
dialogue:b1-new-route-intro-4.tr: Frau Berg’in ravendi de orada yetişiyor. Evinden geriye sadece bu tarh kaldı.

dialogue:b1-new-route-intro-5.de: Die Klinik braucht Nachschub. Ich kann ihr keinen Garten als Fahrplan anbieten.
dialogue:b1-new-route-intro-5.en: The clinic needs supplies. I cannot offer it a garden as a timetable.
dialogue:b1-new-route-intro-5.tr: Kliniğin malzemeye ihtiyacı var. Ona tarife yerine bir bahçe sunamam.

dialogue:b1-new-route-intro-6.de: Die Laternenhüter haben übrigens schon Schienen bestellt. Ohne mich zu fragen. Typisch.
dialogue:b1-new-route-intro-6.en: The Lamplighters have already ordered rails, by the way. Without asking me. Typical.
dialogue:b1-new-route-intro-6.tr: Bu arada Fener Bekçileri rayları çoktan sipariş etmiş. Bana sormadan. Tipik.

dialogue:b1-new-route-intro-7.de: Dann zeichne eine Strecke, die uns heimbringt, ohne wieder etwas zurückzulassen.
dialogue:b1-new-route-intro-7.en: Then draw a route that brings us home without leaving something behind again.
dialogue:b1-new-route-intro-7.tr: O zaman bizi eve götüren, yine bir şeyi geride bırakmayan bir hat çiz.

dialogue:b1-new-route-gate-0.de: Ich halte den Stift, Greta hält die Karte fest. So kommt unsere Strecke nicht zurück.
dialogue:b1-new-route-gate-0.en: I am holding the pen; Greta is holding the map down. This will not bring our route back.
dialogue:b1-new-route-gate-0.tr: Kalemi ben tutuyorum, haritayı Greta tutuyor. Hattımız böyle geri gelmez.

dialogue:b1-new-route-gate-0:variant:0.de: So kommt unsere Strecke nicht zurück.
dialogue:b1-new-route-gate-0:variant:0.en: This will not bring our route back.

choice:b1-new-route:reopen.de: Die gerade Linie. Sie bringt die Leute schneller heim.
choice:b1-new-route:reopen.en: The straight line. It brings people home faster.
choice:b1-new-route:reopen.tr: Düz hat. İnsanları eve daha hızlı götürür.

choice:b1-new-route:remember.de: Die Kurve mit dem Halt an der Klinik.
choice:b1-new-route:remember.en: The curve with the stop at the clinic.

dialogue:b1-new-route-choice-0.de: Für alle. Dann sollte ich wohl meine zweite Zeichnung zeigen.
dialogue:b1-new-route-choice-0.en: For everyone. Then I suppose I should show my second drawing.
dialogue:b1-new-route-choice-0.tr: Herkes için. O zaman sanırım ikinci çizimimi göstermeliyim.

dialogue:b1-new-route-choice-1.de: Die Kurve folgt der Straße. Vierzig Minuten länger. Niemand hat viel zu feiern.
dialogue:b1-new-route-choice-1.en: The curve follows the road. Forty minutes longer. Nobody has much to celebrate.
dialogue:b1-new-route-choice-1.tr: Kavis yolu izliyor. Kırk dakika daha uzun. Kimsenin kutlayacak çok şeyi yok.

dialogue:b1-new-route-choice-2.de: Und ein Halt an der Klinik?
dialogue:b1-new-route-choice-2.en: And a stop at the clinic?

dialogue:b1-new-route-choice-3.de: Der Halt ist für Leute, die nicht laufen können. Deshalb konnte ich diesen Punkt nie ganz wegradieren.
dialogue:b1-new-route-choice-3.en: The stop is for people who cannot walk. That is why I could never quite erase that dot.
dialogue:b1-new-route-choice-3.tr: Durak, yürüyemeyenler için. Bu yüzden o noktayı hiç tamamen silemedim.

dialogue:b1-new-route-choice-4.de: Du hast recht. Meine zweite Zeichnung hätte nicht unter der ersten liegen dürfen.
dialogue:b1-new-route-choice-4.en: You are right. My second drawing should not have been hidden beneath the first.
dialogue:b1-new-route-choice-4.tr: Haklısın. İkinci çizimim birincinin altında saklanmamalıydı.

dialogue:b1-new-route-choice-5.de: Beide Strecken kosten etwas. Diesmal sehen wir den Preis, bevor jemand unterschreibt.
dialogue:b1-new-route-choice-5.en: Both routes cost something. This time we can see the price before anyone signs.
dialogue:b1-new-route-choice-5.tr: İki hattın da bir bedeli var. Bu sefer kimse imzalamadan bedeli görüyoruz.

dialogue:b1-new-route-choice-6.de: Welche Linie bleibt auf der Karte?
dialogue:b1-new-route-choice-6.en: Which line stays on the map?

dialogue:b1-new-route-after-reopen-0.de: Drei Beete müssen weichen. Die Klinik bekommt keinen Halt.
dialogue:b1-new-route-after-reopen-0.en: Three beds must go. The clinic gets no stop.
