dialogue:b1-new-route-after-reopen-0.tr: Üç tarh kaldırılmalı. Klinik durak almıyor.

dialogue:b1-new-route-after-reopen-1.de: Manche wachsen nur hier. Ich schreibe wenigstens ihre Adressen ab.
dialogue:b1-new-route-after-reopen-1.en: Some only grow here. I will copy their addresses, at least.
dialogue:b1-new-route-after-reopen-1.tr: Bazıları sadece burada yetişir. En azından adreslerini yazayım.

dialogue:b1-new-route-after-remember-0.de: Jede Fahrt dauert länger. An der Klinik halte ich, ohne dass jemand winken muss.
dialogue:b1-new-route-after-remember-0.en: Every journey takes longer. At the clinic I will stop without anyone having to wave.
dialogue:b1-new-route-after-remember-0.tr: Her yolculuk daha uzun sürer. Klinikte kimse el sallamadan dururum.

dialogue:b1-new-route-after-remember-1.de: Der Kreis pflegt die Beete. Du hast uns Arbeit gegeben, {name}.
dialogue:b1-new-route-after-remember-1.en: The Circle will tend the beds. You have given us work, {name}.
dialogue:b1-new-route-after-remember-1.tr: Tarhlara Çember bakacak. Bize iş verdin, {name}.

dialogue:b1-new-route-complete-0.de: Warte. Siehst du den Leuchtturm? Er leuchtet dunkel. Das geht doch gar nicht.
dialogue:b1-new-route-complete-0.en: Wait. Do you see the lighthouse? It is shining dark. That is not even possible.
dialogue:b1-new-route-complete-0.tr: Dur. Deniz fenerini görüyor musun? Karanlık parlıyor. Bu mümkün bile değil.

dialogue:b1-new-route-complete-1.de: Der Strahl zeigt nach Waldruh. Wo er hinfällt, gehen die Laternen aus.
dialogue:b1-new-route-complete-1.en: The beam points at Waldruh. Where it falls, the lanterns go out.
dialogue:b1-new-route-complete-1.tr: Işın Waldruh’u gösteriyor. Düştüğü yerde fenerler sönüyor.

dialogue:b1-new-route-complete-2.de: Am Signalturm sitzt ein Mann, der nicht spricht. Er kennt das Signal. Geh zu ihm.
dialogue:b1-new-route-complete-2.en: At the signal tower sits a man who does not speak. He knows the signal. Go to him.
dialogue:b1-new-route-complete-2.tr: İşaret kulesinde konuşmayan bir adam oturuyor. Sinyali bilir. Ona git.

objective:b1-new-route:0.en: Meet Otto and Greta on the railway quay
objective:b1-new-route:0.tr: Demiryolu rıhtımında Otto ve Greta ile buluş

objective:b1-new-route:1.en: Compare the two lines on the harbour chart

objective:b1-new-route:2.en: Say that we must find a solution that suits everyone.
objective:b1-new-route:2.tr: Herkese uyan bir çözüm bulmamız gerektiğini söyle.

objective:b1-new-route:3.en: Choose the line for the route home

dialogue:b1-new-route-topic-on-time-0.de: Ein Fahrplan ist ein Versprechen. Wenn der Zug kommt, hat jemand Wort gehalten.
dialogue:b1-new-route-topic-on-time-0.en: A timetable is a promise. When the train comes, someone kept their word.
dialogue:b1-new-route-topic-on-time-0.tr: Bir tarife bir sözdür. Tren gelince biri sözünü tutmuş demektir.

topic:b1-new-route:on-time.de: Warum ist dir Pünktlichkeit so wichtig?
topic:b1-new-route:on-time.en: Why does being on time matter so much to you?
topic:b1-new-route:on-time.tr: Dakiklik senin için neden bu kadar önemli?

dialogue:b1-new-route-topic-garden-0.de: Bohnen, Rhabarber und Samen von Häusern, die es nicht mehr gibt.
dialogue:b1-new-route-topic-garden-0.en: Beans, rhubarb and seeds from houses that no longer exist.
dialogue:b1-new-route-topic-garden-0.tr: Fasulye, ravent ve artık var olmayan evlerden tohumlar.

dialogue:b1-new-route-topic-builders-0.de: Die Laternenhüter, lange vor meiner Zeit. Schwelle für Schwelle, mit der Hand.
dialogue:b1-new-route-topic-builders-0.en: The Lamplighters, long before my time. Sleeper by sleeper, by hand.
dialogue:b1-new-route-topic-builders-0.tr: Fener Bekçileri, benden çok önce. Travers travers, elle.

dialogue:b1-new-route-topic-builders-1.de: Mein Großvater hat die Schrauben gezählt. Ich zähle Bahnsteige. Das liegt in der Familie.
dialogue:b1-new-route-topic-builders-1.en: My grandfather counted the bolts. I count platforms. It runs in the family.
dialogue:b1-new-route-topic-builders-1.tr: Dedem cıvataları sayardı. Ben peronları sayıyorum. Ailede var.

topic:b1-new-route:builders.de: Wer hat die alte Strecke gebaut?

evidence:b1-new-route:nebelstadt-harbor-.de: Eine gerade Linie durch Gretas Garten. Eine Kurve entlang der Straße. Daneben ein Punkt, dreimal wegradiert: Klinik?
evidence:b1-new-route:nebelstadt-harbor-.en: A straight line through Greta’s garden. A curve along the road. Beside it a dot, erased three times: Clinic?
evidence:b1-new-route:nebelstadt-harbor-.tr: Greta’nın bahçesinden geçen düz bir çizgi. Yol boyunca bir kavis. Yanında üç kez silinmiş bir nokta: Klinik?

clue:b1-new-route:text:0.de: Die gerade Linie ist schneller, aber sie geht durch Gretas Garten.
clue:b1-new-route:text:0.en: The straight line is faster, but it runs through Greta’s garden.
clue:b1-new-route:text:0.tr: Düz hat daha hızlı ama Greta’nın bahçesinden geçiyor.

clue:b1-new-route:text:1.de: Die Kurve ist länger und hält an der Klinik.
clue:b1-new-route:text:1.en: The curve is longer and stops at the clinic.
clue:b1-new-route:text:1.tr: Kavisli hat daha uzun ve klinikte duruyor.

clue:b1-new-route:text:2.de: Der Leuchtturm leuchtet dunkel. Wo der Strahl hinfällt, gehen die Laternen aus.
clue:b1-new-route:text:2.en: The lighthouse shines dark. Where the beam falls, the lanterns go out.
clue:b1-new-route:text:2.tr: Deniz feneri karanlık parlıyor. Işının düştüğü yerde fenerler sönüyor.

clue:b1-new-route:lead:0.de: Am Signalturm sitzt ein Mann, der nicht spricht.
clue:b1-new-route:lead:0.en: A man who does not speak sits at the signal tower.
clue:b1-new-route:lead:0.tr: İşaret kulesinde konuşmayan bir adam oturuyor.

clue:b1-new-route:letter:0.de: Du hast gesehen, was jede Strecke kostet. Damals wollte ich meinen eigenen Preis nicht sehen. Bald sage ich dir, warum ich die Tür geschlossen habe.
clue:b1-new-route:letter:0.en: You saw what each route costs. Back then I did not want to see my own price. Soon I will tell you why I closed the door.
clue:b1-new-route:letter:0.tr: Her hattın bedelini gördün. O zaman ben kendi bedelimi görmek istemedim. Yakında sana kapıyı neden kapattığımı anlatacağım.

quest:b1-signalman:subtitle.en: Jonas keeps the signal and says nothing
quest:b1-signalman:subtitle.tr: Jonas sinyali koruyor ve hiçbir şey söylemiyor

quest:b1-signalman:objective:0.en: Ask someone politely to do something
quest:b1-signalman:objective:0.tr: Birinden kibarca bir şey yapmasını rica et

quest:b1-signalman:objective:1.tr: zu ile mastar yan cümleleri kullan

quest:b1-signalman:objective:2.en: Decide how Jonas’s name is spoken
quest:b1-signalman:objective:2.tr: Jonas’ın adının nasıl söyleneceğine karar ver

quest:b1-signalman:story:0.de: Jonas hält das Signal am Hafen.
quest:b1-signalman:story:0.en: Jonas keeps the signal at the harbour.

quest:b1-signalman:story:1.de: Seit zwölf Jahren hat er kein Wort gesagt.
quest:b1-signalman:story:1.en: He has not said a word in twelve years.
quest:b1-signalman:story:1.tr: On iki yıldır tek kelime söylemedi.

quest:b1-signalman:story:2.de: Sein Name auf der Tafel wird blass.
quest:b1-signalman:story:2.en: His name on the slate is fading.

dialogue:b1-signalman-intro-0.de: Das ist Jonas. Er hält das Signal seit zwölf Jahren. Er spricht nicht. Er schreibt.
dialogue:b1-signalman-intro-0.en: This is Jonas. He has kept the signal for twelve years. He does not speak. He writes.
dialogue:b1-signalman-intro-0.tr: Bu Jonas. On iki yıldır sinyali tutuyor. Konuşmaz. Yazar.

dialogue:b1-signalman-intro-1.de: Er schreibt: Guten Abend. Bitte leise. Das Signal hört zu.
dialogue:b1-signalman-intro-1.en: He writes: Good evening. Quietly, please. The signal is listening.
dialogue:b1-signalman-intro-1.tr: Yazıyor: İyi akşamlar. Lütfen sessiz. Sinyal dinliyor.

dialogue:b1-signalman-intro-2.de: Das Amt hat ihm jedes Jahr eine Prämie gezahlt. Für null Beschwerden.
dialogue:b1-signalman-intro-2.en: The Office paid him a bonus every year. For zero complaints.
dialogue:b1-signalman-intro-2.tr: Daire ona her yıl prim ödedi. Sıfır şikâyet için.

dialogue:b1-signalman-intro-3.de: Er schreibt: Wer nichts sagt, verliert nichts. So stand es auf dem Formular.
dialogue:b1-signalman-intro-3.en: He writes: whoever says nothing loses nothing. That is what the form said.
dialogue:b1-signalman-intro-3.tr: Yazıyor: Hiçbir şey söylemeyen hiçbir şey kaybetmez. Formda böyle yazıyordu.

dialogue:b1-signalman-intro-4.de: Frau Kessler kommt zum Rat. Sie wird reden. Jonas, hörst du? Sogar sie.
dialogue:b1-signalman-intro-4.en: Frau Kessler is coming to the council. She will speak. Jonas, do you hear? Even her.
dialogue:b1-signalman-intro-4.tr: Frau Kessler kurula geliyor. Konuşacak. Jonas, duyuyor musun? O bile.

dialogue:b1-signalman-intro-5.de: Sieh auf seine Tafel. Sein eigener Name ist fast weg.
dialogue:b1-signalman-intro-5.en: Look at his slate. His own name is almost gone.
dialogue:b1-signalman-intro-5.tr: Yazı tahtasına bak. Kendi adı neredeyse silinmiş.

dialogue:b1-signalman-intro-6.de: Heute Nacht kommt der Sturm. Ohne Stimmen hält das Signal den Strahl nicht.
dialogue:b1-signalman-intro-6.en: Tonight the storm comes. Without voices the signal cannot hold off the beam.
dialogue:b1-signalman-intro-6.tr: Bu gece fırtına geliyor. Sesler olmadan sinyal ışını durduramaz.

dialogue:b1-signalman-gate-0.de: Er schreibt seinen Namen. Dann wischt er ihn weg. Dann schreibt er ihn wieder.
dialogue:b1-signalman-gate-0.en: He writes his name. Then he wipes it away. Then he writes it again.
dialogue:b1-signalman-gate-0.tr: Adını yazıyor. Sonra siliyor. Sonra yeniden yazıyor.

dialogue:b1-signalman-gate-0:variant:0.de: Er schreibt seinen Namen und wischt ihn weg.
dialogue:b1-signalman-gate-0:variant:0.en: He writes his name and wipes it away.

choice:b1-signalman:jonas-speaks.de: Ich warte. Er sagt ihn selbst.
choice:b1-signalman:jonas-speaks.en: I will wait. He will say it himself.

choice:b1-signalman:jonas-writes.de: Ich lese ihn für ihn. Laut.
choice:b1-signalman:jonas-writes.en: I will read it for him. Out loud.

dialogue:b1-signalman-choice-1.de: Seine Stimme ist zwölf Jahre alt. Sie muss sich erst erinnern.
dialogue:b1-signalman-choice-1.en: His voice is twelve years old. It has to remember first.
dialogue:b1-signalman-choice-1.tr: Sesi on iki yaşında. Önce hatırlaması gerek.

dialogue:b1-signalman-choice-2.de: Er schreibt: Wenn ich spreche, höre ich, wie leise ich geworden bin.
dialogue:b1-signalman-choice-2.en: He writes: when I speak, I hear how quiet I have become.
dialogue:b1-signalman-choice-2.tr: Yazıyor: Konuşunca ne kadar sessizleştiğimi duyuyorum.

dialogue:b1-signalman-choice-3.de: Das Signal hat drei Hebel. Einen für jede Stadt. Ein Name pro Hebel, laut, sonst rutscht er.
dialogue:b1-signalman-choice-3.en: The signal has three levers. One for each town. One name per lever, out loud, or it slips.
dialogue:b1-signalman-choice-3.tr: Sinyalin üç kolu var. Her kasaba için bir tane. Her kola bir isim, yüksek sesle, yoksa kayıyor.

dialogue:b1-signalman-choice-4.de: Lässt du ihm Zeit? Oder liest du seinen Namen jetzt laut für ihn?
dialogue:b1-signalman-choice-4.en: Will you give him time? Or will you read his name aloud for him now?
dialogue:b1-signalman-choice-4.tr: Ona zaman tanıyacak mısın? Yoksa adını şimdi onun için yüksek sesle mi okuyacaksın?

dialogue:b1-signalman-after-jonas-speaks.de: Hörst du? Das Signal ist heller. Nur ein Name, und es ist heller.
dialogue:b1-signalman-after-jonas-speaks.en: Do you hear? The signal is brighter. Just one name, and it is brighter.
dialogue:b1-signalman-after-jonas-speaks.tr: Duyuyor musun? Sinyal daha parlak. Sadece bir isim ve daha parlak.

dialogue:b1-signalman-after-jonas-writes.de: Er schreibt: Danke. Es ist leichter, wenn ihn jemand anders sagt.
dialogue:b1-signalman-after-jonas-writes.en: He writes: thank you. It is easier when someone else says it.
dialogue:b1-signalman-after-jonas-writes.tr: Yazıyor: Teşekkürler. Başkası söyleyince daha kolay.

dialogue:b1-signalman-after-jonas-writes.de: Das Signal hält. Leise, aber es hält.
dialogue:b1-signalman-after-jonas-writes.en: The signal holds. Quietly, but it holds.

dialogue:b1-signalman-complete-0.de: Am Reparaturdock liegt das Wartungsbuch der Maschine. Ich will es lesen, bevor ich irgendetwas anfasse.
dialogue:b1-signalman-complete-0.en: The machine’s maintenance ledger is at the repair dock. I want to read it before I touch anything.
dialogue:b1-signalman-complete-0.tr: Makinenin bakım defteri tamir rıhtımında. Bir şeye dokunmadan önce onu okumak istiyorum.

gate-prompt:b1-signalman.en: Ask Jonas politely to say it out loud once.
gate-prompt:b1-signalman.tr: Jonas’tan bunu bir kez yüksek sesle söylemesini kibarca rica et.

objective:b1-signalman:1.en: Read the slate beside the signal

objective:b1-signalman:2.en: Ask Jonas politely to say it out loud once.
objective:b1-signalman:2.tr: Jonas’tan bunu bir kez yüksek sesle söylemesini kibarca rica et.

objective:b1-signalman:3.en: Decide how Jonas’s name is spoken
objective:b1-signalman:3.tr: Jonas’ın adının nasıl söyleneceğine karar ver

dialogue:b1-signalman-topic-why-silent-0.de: Wer ruhig war, bekam mehr Geld. Nach zwölf Jahren war die Stimme weg.
dialogue:b1-signalman-topic-why-silent-0.en: Whoever kept quiet got more money. After twelve years the voice was gone.
dialogue:b1-signalman-topic-why-silent-0.tr: Sessiz kalan daha çok para aldı. On iki yıl sonra ses gitmişti.

dialogue:b1-signalman-topic-signal-0.de: Es schickt Licht die Strecke entlang. Gegen den dunklen Strahl. Mit Namen leuchtet es heller.
dialogue:b1-signalman-topic-signal-0.en: It sends light along the route. Against the dark beam. With names it shines brighter.
dialogue:b1-signalman-topic-signal-0.tr: Hat boyunca ışık gönderiyor. Karanlık ışına karşı. İsimlerle daha parlak yanıyor.

evidence:b1-signalman:nebelstadt-signal-.de: Eine Tafel neben dem Signal. Oben: Keine Beschwerden. Unten, fast weggewischt: Jonas.
evidence:b1-signalman:nebelstadt-signal-.en: A slate beside the signal. At the top: No complaints. At the bottom, almost wiped away: Jonas.
evidence:b1-signalman:nebelstadt-signal-.tr: Sinyalin yanında bir yazı tahtası. Üstte: Şikâyet yok. Altta, neredeyse silinmiş: Jonas.

clue:b1-signalman:text:0.de: Jonas hält das Signal seit zwölf Jahren und spricht nicht.
clue:b1-signalman:text:0.en: Jonas has kept the signal for twelve years and does not speak.
clue:b1-signalman:text:0.tr: Jonas on iki yıldır sinyali tutuyor ve konuşmuyor.

clue:b1-signalman:text:1.de: Das Amt hat ihm Geld für Schweigen gezahlt.
clue:b1-signalman:text:1.en: The Office paid him money for silence.
clue:b1-signalman:text:1.tr: Daire ona susması için para ödedi.

clue:b1-signalman:text:2.de: Mit Namen leuchtet das Signal heller.
clue:b1-signalman:text:2.en: With names the signal shines brighter.

clue:b1-signalman:lead:0.de: Emil liest am Reparaturdock das Wartungsbuch.
clue:b1-signalman:lead:0.en: Emil is reading the maintenance ledger at the repair dock.
clue:b1-signalman:lead:0.tr: Emil tamir rıhtımında bakım defterini okuyor.

clue:b1-signalman:letter:0.de: Ich kenne Jonas. Er hat einmal Lieder gesungen, am Hafen, für die Fischer. Ich hoffe, du hast seine Stimme gehört.
clue:b1-signalman:letter:0.en: I know Jonas. He used to sing songs at the harbour, for the fishermen. I hope you heard his voice.
clue:b1-signalman:letter:0.tr: Jonas’ı tanırım. Bir zamanlar limanda balıkçılar için şarkı söylerdi. Umarım sesini duymuşsundur.

grammar-note:b1-signalman.de: Ich bitte Sie, es zu sagen: Nach bitten folgt ein Infinitiv mit zu.
grammar-note:b1-signalman.en: Ich bitte Sie, es zu sagen: after bitten comes an infinitive with zu.
grammar-note:b1-signalman.tr: Ich bitte Sie, es zu sagen: bitten’den sonra zu ile mastar gelir.

dialogue:b1-work-intro-0.de: {name}! Ich brauche Hilfe. Diesmal schreibe ich den Auftrag auf, bevor wir anfangen.
dialogue:b1-work-intro-0.en: {name}! I need help. This time I will put the job in writing before we start.
dialogue:b1-work-intro-0.tr: {name}! Yardıma ihtiyacım var. Bu sefer başlamadan önce işi yazıya dökeceğim.

dialogue:b1-work-intro-1.de: Wir bauen das Hafensignal um. Es soll Namen zurücktragen.
dialogue:b1-work-intro-1.en: We are rebuilding the harbour signal. It should carry names back.
dialogue:b1-work-intro-1.tr: Liman sinyalini yeniden kuruyoruz. İsimleri geri taşımalı.

dialogue:b1-work-intro-2.de: Die Maschine unter der Plane funktioniert perfekt. Leider. Genau das ist das Problem.
dialogue:b1-work-intro-2.en: The machine under the tarpaulin works perfectly. Unfortunately. That is exactly the problem.
dialogue:b1-work-intro-2.tr: Brandanın altındaki makine kusursuz çalışıyor. Ne yazık ki. Sorun tam da bu.

dialogue:b1-work-intro-3.de: Drei neue Spulen. Jemand hat diese Maschine besser gepflegt als meinen Leuchtturm.
dialogue:b1-work-intro-3.en: Three new coils. Someone has looked after this machine better than my lighthouse.
dialogue:b1-work-intro-3.tr: Üç yeni bobin. Biri bu makineye benim deniz fenerimden daha iyi bakmış.

dialogue:b1-work-intro-4.de: Diese Anlage gehört dem Messingamt. Wer daran arbeitet, braucht eine Genehmigung.
dialogue:b1-work-intro-4.en: This installation belongs to the Brass Office. Anyone working on it needs a permit.
dialogue:b1-work-intro-4.tr: Bu tesis Pirinç Dairesi’ne ait. Üzerinde çalışan herkesin izne ihtiyacı var.

dialogue:b1-work-intro-5.de: Dann genehmigen Sie es. Sie haben doch einen Stempel.
dialogue:b1-work-intro-5.en: Then approve it. You have a stamp, after all.
dialogue:b1-work-intro-5.tr: O zaman onaylayın. Sonuçta bir mührünüz var.

dialogue:b1-work-intro-6.de: Heute bleibt mein Stempel unten. Zuerst sehen Sie das Wartungsbuch.
dialogue:b1-work-intro-6.en: Today my stamp stays down. First you will see the maintenance ledger.
dialogue:b1-work-intro-6.tr: Bugün mührüm aşağıda kalıyor. Önce bakım defterini göreceksiniz.

dialogue:b1-work-intro-7.de: Frau Kesslers Zettel liegen schon hier. Drei Bestellungen. Alles ordentlich.
dialogue:b1-work-intro-7.en: Frau Kessler’s slips are already here. Three orders. All tidy.
dialogue:b1-work-intro-7.tr: Frau Kessler’in fişleri zaten burada. Üç sipariş. Hepsi düzenli.

dialogue:b1-work-intro-8.de: Hast du noch das Buch, das Voss dir in Lindenhafen gegeben hat? Halte es bereit.
dialogue:b1-work-intro-8.en: Do you still have the ledger Voss gave you in Lindenhafen? Keep it ready.
dialogue:b1-work-intro-8.tr: Voss’un sana Lindenhafen’de verdiği defter hâlâ sende mi? Hazır tut.

dialogue:b1-work-intro-9.de: Bezahlung: Suppe. Ich spiele die Gefahr nicht herunter. Wir arbeiten an einer Löschmaschine.
dialogue:b1-work-intro-9.en: Pay: soup. I will not downplay the danger. We are working on an eraser machine.
dialogue:b1-work-intro-9.tr: Ücret: çorba. Tehlikeyi küçümsemeyeceğim. Bir silme makinesi üzerinde çalışıyoruz.

dialogue:b1-work-gate-0.de: Bevor du eine Schraube anfasst: Was willst du wissen?
dialogue:b1-work-gate-0.en: Before you touch a screw: what do you want to know?
dialogue:b1-work-gate-0.tr: Bir vidaya dokunmadan önce: Ne bilmek istiyorsun?

dialogue:b1-work-gate-0:variant:0.en: What do you want to know first?

choice:b1-work:reopen.de: Wir schalten die Spulen heute ab.
choice:b1-work:reopen.en: We switch off the coils today.

choice:b1-work:remember.de: Erst erklären wir den Umbau vor dem Rat.
choice:b1-work:remember.en: First we explain the conversion before the council.

dialogue:b1-work-choice-0.de: Ja. Bevor du eine Schraube anfasst, bleibt dieses Buch offen.
dialogue:b1-work-choice-0.en: Yes. Before you touch a screw, this ledger stays open.
dialogue:b1-work-choice-0.tr: Evet. Bir vidaya dokunmadan önce bu defter açık kalıyor.

dialogue:b1-work-choice-1.de: Drei neue Spulen, alle nach der Schließung bestellt: am zweiten März, am neunten Juli, am ersten Dezember.
dialogue:b1-work-choice-1.en: Three new coils, all ordered after the closure: on the second of March, the ninth of July, the first of December.
dialogue:b1-work-choice-1.tr: Üç yeni bobin, hepsi kapanıştan sonra sipariş edilmiş: iki mart, dokuz temmuz, bir aralık.

dialogue:b1-work-choice-2.de: Jedes Mal derselbe Stempel, zweimal gedrückt. Klack, klack.
dialogue:b1-work-choice-2.en: Every time the same stamp, pressed twice. Clack, clack.
dialogue:b1-work-choice-2.tr: Her seferinde aynı mühür, iki kez basılmış. Tak, tak.

dialogue:b1-work-choice-3.de: Und jetzt dein Buch aus Lindenhafen. Dieselbe Unterschrift. Derselbe schiefe Stempel.
dialogue:b1-work-choice-3.en: And now your ledger from Lindenhafen. The same signature. The same crooked stamp.
dialogue:b1-work-choice-3.tr: Şimdi de Lindenhafen’deki defterin. Aynı imza. Aynı yamuk mühür.

dialogue:b1-work-choice-4.de: Ich habe die dauerhafte Schließung persönlich genehmigt. Meine Unterschrift steht darunter.
dialogue:b1-work-choice-4.en: I personally authorised the permanent closure. My signature is beneath it.
dialogue:b1-work-choice-4.tr: Kalıcı kapanışı bizzat ben onayladım. İmzam altında.

dialogue:b1-work-choice-5.de: Und alle drei Löschspulen. Ich habe bezahlt, damit die Maschine läuft.
dialogue:b1-work-choice-5.en: And all three eraser coils. I paid to keep the machine running.
dialogue:b1-work-choice-5.tr: Ve üç silme bobininin hepsini. Makine çalışsın diye ben ödedim.

dialogue:b1-work-choice-6.de: Frau Kessler hat die Zettel ausgefüllt. Ich habe unterschrieben. Die Verantwortung trage ich.
dialogue:b1-work-choice-6.en: Frau Kessler filled in the slips. I signed. The responsibility is mine.
dialogue:b1-work-choice-6.tr: Fişleri Frau Kessler doldurdu. Ben imzaladım. Sorumluluk bende.

dialogue:b1-work-choice-7.de: Im Register stand: ruhig. Draußen fehlten Häuser. Ich habe mich für das Register entschieden.
dialogue:b1-work-choice-7.en: The register said: quiet. Outside, homes were missing. I chose to believe the register.
dialogue:b1-work-choice-7.tr: Kayıtta “sessiz” yazıyordu. Dışarıda evler eksikti. Kaydı seçtim.

dialogue:b1-work-choice-8.de: Als ich die dritte Spule bestellte, wusste ich von den fehlenden Namen. Ich habe sie trotzdem bestellt.
dialogue:b1-work-choice-8.en: When I ordered the third coil, I knew about the missing names. I ordered it anyway.
dialogue:b1-work-choice-8.tr: Üçüncü bobini sipariş ettiğimde eksik isimleri biliyordum. Yine de sipariş ettim.

dialogue:b1-work-choice-9.de: Ich habe sie eingebaut. Auf dem Auftrag stand: Leuchtturm. Kein Wort von Namen.
dialogue:b1-work-choice-9.en: I installed them. The work order said: lighthouse. Not a word about names.
dialogue:b1-work-choice-9.tr: Onları ben taktım. İş emrinde “deniz feneri” yazıyordu. İsimlerden tek kelime yoktu.

dialogue:b1-work-choice-10.de: Sie haben meinen Auftrag ausgeführt. Ich habe verschwiegen, was Ihre Arbeit tun würde.
dialogue:b1-work-choice-10.en: You carried out my order. I concealed what your work would do.
dialogue:b1-work-choice-10.tr: Emrimi yerine getirdiniz. İşinizin ne yapacağını ben sakladım.

dialogue:b1-work-choice-11.de: Dann unterschreiben Sie genau das. Und ich lese jede Zeile, bevor ich wieder eine Spule einbaue.
dialogue:b1-work-choice-11.en: Then sign exactly that. And I will read every line before I install another coil.
dialogue:b1-work-choice-11.tr: O zaman tam olarak bunu imzalayın. Ben de bir bobin daha takmadan önce her satırı okuyacağım.

dialogue:b1-work-choice-12.de: Schalten wir die neuen Spulen heute ab? Oder erklären wir zuerst den Umbau? Welches Risiko nehmen wir zuerst?
dialogue:b1-work-choice-12.en: Do we switch off the new coils today? Or explain the conversion first? Which risk do we take first?
dialogue:b1-work-choice-12.tr: Yeni bobinleri bugün mü kapatalım? Yoksa önce dönüşümü mü açıklayalım? Önce hangi riski alalım?

dialogue:b1-work-after-reopen-0.de: Strom aus. Voss, halten Sie die Lampe.
dialogue:b1-work-after-reopen-0.en: Power off. Voss, hold the lamp.

dialogue:b1-work-after-reopen-1.de: Der Strahl wird schwächer. Die alte Leitung brummt noch. Für den Rest brauche ich Leute, die antworten.
dialogue:b1-work-after-reopen-1.en: The beam is weakening. The old wiring still hums. For the rest I need people who answer.
dialogue:b1-work-after-reopen-1.tr: Işın zayıflıyor. Eski kablo hâlâ vızıldıyor. Gerisi için cevap veren insanlara ihtiyacım var.

dialogue:b1-work-after-remember-0.de: Der Plan hängt im Rat. Ich bewache den Schalter.
dialogue:b1-work-after-remember-0.en: The plan is posted at the council. I will guard the switch.
dialogue:b1-work-after-remember-0.tr: Plan kurulda asılı. Şalteri ben bekliyorum.

dialogue:b1-work-after-remember-1.de: Schreiben Sie meinen Namen daneben. Wer beim Warten etwas verliert, soll wissen, wo er mich findet.
dialogue:b1-work-after-remember-1.en: Write my name beside it. Anyone who loses something while we wait must know where to find me.
dialogue:b1-work-after-remember-1.tr: Adımı yanına yazın. Beklerken bir şey kaybeden beni nerede bulacağını bilmeli.

dialogue:b1-work-complete-0.de: Ada ruft den Rat für morgen früh zusammen. Alle sollen kommen. Wirklich alle.
dialogue:b1-work-complete-0.en: Ada is calling the council for tomorrow morning. Everyone should come. Really everyone.
dialogue:b1-work-complete-0.tr: Ada kurulu yarın sabaha topluyor. Herkes gelmeli. Gerçekten herkes.

dialogue:b1-work-complete-1.de: Ich bringe mein Buch mit und öffne es vor allen. Es war lange genug zu.
dialogue:b1-work-complete-1.en: I will bring my ledger and open it in front of everyone. It has been shut long enough.
dialogue:b1-work-complete-1.tr: Defterimi getirip herkesin önünde açacağım. Yeterince uzun süre kapalı kaldı.

objective:b1-work:0.en: Meet Emil at the repair dock

objective:b1-work:2.en: Say that before starting you want to clarify the conditions.
objective:b1-work:2.tr: Başlamadan önce koşulları netleştirmek istediğini söyle.

objective:b1-work:3.en: Decide which risk to face first
objective:b1-work:3.tr: Önce hangi riskle yüzleşeceğine karar ver

dialogue:b1-work-topic-mostly-0.de: Es heißt: Es funktioniert. Meistens. Ich finde das ehrlich.
dialogue:b1-work-topic-mostly-0.en: It means: it works. Mostly. I find that honest.
dialogue:b1-work-topic-mostly-0.tr: Şu demek: Çalışıyor. Çoğunlukla. Bence bu dürüstlük.

dialogue:b1-work-topic-mostly-1.de: Die Maschine unter der Plane funktioniert immer. Das macht mir Angst.
dialogue:b1-work-topic-mostly-1.en: The machine under the tarpaulin always works. That scares me.
dialogue:b1-work-topic-mostly-1.tr: Brandanın altındaki makine her zaman çalışıyor. Bu beni korkutuyor.

dialogue:b1-work-topic-office-0.de: Nach der Schließung hat das Amt jede Anlage am Hafen übernommen. So steht es in Abschnitt zwölf.
dialogue:b1-work-topic-office-0.en: After the closure, the Office took over every installation at the harbour. Section twelve says so.
dialogue:b1-work-topic-office-0.tr: Kapanıştan sonra Daire limandaki her tesisi devraldı. On ikinci bölümde böyle yazıyor.

dialogue:b1-work-topic-office-1.de: Abschnitt zwölf habe ich selbst geschrieben. Ich sage das nicht gern.
dialogue:b1-work-topic-office-1.en: I wrote section twelve myself. I do not enjoy saying so.
dialogue:b1-work-topic-office-1.tr: On ikinci bölümü ben yazdım. Bunu söylemekten hoşlanmıyorum.

topic:b1-work:office.de: Warum gehört die Maschine dem Amt?
topic:b1-work:office.en: Why does the machine belong to the Office?

evidence:b1-work:nebelstadt-repair-ledge.de: Wartungsbuch, Löschmaschine am Hafen. Drei neue Spulen, alle nach der Schließung. Genehmigt mit zwei Stempeln und einer Unterschrift.
evidence:b1-work:nebelstadt-repair-ledge.en: Maintenance ledger, harbour eraser machine. Three new coils, all after the closure. Approved with two stamps and one signature.
evidence:b1-work:nebelstadt-repair-ledge.tr: Bakım defteri, liman silme makinesi. Üç yeni bobin, hepsi kapanıştan sonra. İki mühür ve bir imzayla onaylanmış.

clue:b1-work:title.en: The hand that kept it running

clue:b1-work:text:0.de: Voss hat die dauerhafte Schließung genehmigt.

clue:b1-work:text:1.de: Er hat drei Löschspulen bezahlt, auch als er von den fehlenden Namen wusste.
clue:b1-work:text:1.en: He paid for three eraser coils, even when he knew about the missing names.
clue:b1-work:text:1.tr: Eksik isimleri bildiği halde üç silme bobinini ödedi.

clue:b1-work:text:2.de: Emil hat sie eingebaut. Auf dem Auftrag stand nur: Leuchtturm.
clue:b1-work:text:2.en: Emil installed them. The work order only said: lighthouse.
clue:b1-work:text:2.tr: Onları Emil taktı. İş emrinde sadece “deniz feneri” yazıyordu.

clue:b1-work:lead:0.en: Ada is calling the council together.

clue:b1-work:letter:0.de: Voss hat gesagt, was seine Unterschrift erlaubt hat. Meine Antwort fehlt noch. Mein Schlüssel hat die Strecke von innen geschlossen. Ohne ihn hätte sein Stempel diese Tür nie erreicht.
clue:b1-work:letter:0.en: Voss said what his signature authorised. My answer is still missing. My key closed the route from inside. Without it, his stamp would never have reached that door.
clue:b1-work:letter:0.tr: Voss imzasının neye izin verdiğini söyledi. Benim cevabım hâlâ eksik. Anahtarım hattı içeriden kapattı. O olmasa mührü o kapıya hiç ulaşamazdı.

dialogue:b1-council-intro-0.de: Die Sitzung ist eröffnet. Sieben Stühle, acht Meinungen und ein Topf Suppe.
dialogue:b1-council-intro-0.en: The session is open. Seven chairs, eight opinions and a pot of soup.
dialogue:b1-council-intro-0.tr: Oturum açıldı. Yedi sandalye, sekiz görüş ve bir tencere çorba.

dialogue:b1-council-intro-1.de: Die Suppe ist neutral. Sie hat keine Meinung, nur Kartoffeln.
dialogue:b1-council-intro-1.en: The soup is neutral. It has no opinions, only potatoes.
dialogue:b1-council-intro-1.tr: Çorba tarafsız. Görüşü yok, sadece patatesi var.

dialogue:b1-council-intro-2.de: Auf der Tafel steht die Regel des Amtes: Wer schweigt, stimmt zu. Die Maschine folgt dieser Regel.
dialogue:b1-council-intro-2.en: The board carries the Office’s rule: whoever stays silent agrees. The machine follows that rule.
dialogue:b1-council-intro-2.tr: Panoda Dairenin kuralı yazıyor: Susan kabul etmiş sayılır. Makine bu kurala uyuyor.

dialogue:b1-council-intro-3.de: Fritz! Du hast drei Sekunden nichts gesagt, und der Strahl wurde heller!
dialogue:b1-council-intro-3.en: Fritz! You said nothing for three seconds, and the beam got brighter!
dialogue:b1-council-intro-3.tr: Fritz! Üç saniye hiçbir şey söylemedin ve ışın parladı!

dialogue:b1-council-intro-4.de: Nein! Ich meine: nein. Ich habe nur gekaut.
dialogue:b1-council-intro-4.en: No! I mean: no. I was only chewing.

dialogue:b1-council-intro-5.de: Der leere Stuhl kann nicht widersprechen, Ada. Das heißt nicht, dass er zustimmt.
dialogue:b1-council-intro-5.en: The empty chair cannot object, Ada. That does not mean it agrees.
dialogue:b1-council-intro-5.tr: Boş sandalye itiraz edemez, Ada. Bu, kabul ettiği anlamına gelmez.

dialogue:b1-council-intro-6.de: Heute sitzt dort jemand, den wir nicht mehr kennen. Ich spüre es.
dialogue:b1-council-intro-6.en: Today someone we no longer know is sitting there. I can feel it.
dialogue:b1-council-intro-6.tr: Bugün orada artık tanımadığımız biri oturuyor. Hissediyorum.

dialogue:b1-council-intro-7.de: Die Laternenhüter sagen: öffnen. Heute, alles, sofort.
dialogue:b1-council-intro-7.en: The Lamplighters say: open it. Today, all of it, right now.
dialogue:b1-council-intro-7.tr: Fener Bekçileri diyor ki: açın. Bugün, hepsini, hemen.

dialogue:b1-council-intro-8.de: Der Kreis sagt: Nichts öffnet sich, bevor jede Stadt gefragt wurde. Genau das fehlte letztes Mal.
dialogue:b1-council-intro-8.en: The Circle says: nothing opens before every town has been asked. That is exactly what was missing last time.
dialogue:b1-council-intro-8.tr: Çember diyor ki: Her kasabaya sorulmadan hiçbir şey açılmaz. Geçen sefer eksik olan tam buydu.

dialogue:b1-council-intro-9.de: Und ich sage: Fragt die Alten zuerst. Wir haben am längsten gewartet.
dialogue:b1-council-intro-9.en: And I say: ask the old ones first. We have waited the longest.
dialogue:b1-council-intro-9.tr: Ben de diyorum ki: Önce yaşlılara sorun. En uzun biz bekledik.

dialogue:b1-council-intro-10.de: Ich leite diese Sitzung nicht. Ich habe die Schließung genehmigt. Ich beantworte eure Fragen.
dialogue:b1-council-intro-10.en: I am not chairing this meeting. I authorised the closure. I will answer your questions.
dialogue:b1-council-intro-10.tr: Bu toplantıyı ben yönetmiyorum. Kapanışı ben onayladım. Sorularınızı cevaplayacağım.

dialogue:b1-council-intro-11.de: Mein Name ist Voss. Der Titel hilft hier niemandem. Wenn ihr einverstanden seid, sagen wir du.
dialogue:b1-council-intro-11.en: My name is Voss. The title helps nobody here. If you agree, we can use du.
dialogue:b1-council-intro-11.tr: Adım Voss. Unvan burada kimseye yardım etmiyor. Kabul ederseniz “sen” diyelim.

dialogue:b1-council-intro-12.de: Ich bin Frau Kessler. Ich habe die Zettel geschrieben. Ich bleibe beim Sie. Aber ich spreche.
dialogue:b1-council-intro-12.en: I am Frau Kessler. I wrote the slips. I will keep to Sie. But I am speaking.
dialogue:b1-council-intro-12.tr: Ben Frau Kessler. Fişleri ben yazdım. “Siz” demeye devam edeceğim. Ama konuşuyorum.

dialogue:b1-council-intro-13.de: Der Kreis hat die alten Einwände mitgebracht. Vierzig Seiten. Damals hat sie keiner gelesen.
dialogue:b1-council-intro-13.en: The Circle has brought the old objections. Forty pages. Back then nobody read them.
dialogue:b1-council-intro-13.tr: Çember eski itirazları getirdi. Kırk sayfa. O zaman kimse okumadı.

dialogue:b1-council-gate-0.de: Eine ganze Strecke auf einmal, und alle sollen sofort antworten. Gibt es einen kleineren ersten Schritt, {name}?
dialogue:b1-council-gate-0.en: A whole route at once, with everyone answering immediately. Is there a smaller first step, {name}?
dialogue:b1-council-gate-0.tr: Bütün bir hat birden ve herkes hemen cevap versin. Daha küçük bir ilk adım var mı, {name}?

dialogue:b1-council-gate-0:variant:0.de: Gibt es einen kleineren ersten Schritt?
dialogue:b1-council-gate-0:variant:0.en: Is there a smaller first step?
dialogue:b1-council-gate-0:variant:0.tr: Daha küçük bir ilk adım var mı?

choice:b1-council:reopen.de: Der erste Zug. Mit den Laternenhütern an Bord.
choice:b1-council:reopen.en: The first train. With the Lamplighters on board.
choice:b1-council:reopen.tr: İlk tren. Fener Bekçileri de içinde.

choice:b1-council:remember.de: Die erste Abstimmung. In jeder Stadt.
choice:b1-council:remember.en: The first vote. In every town.

choice:b1-council:publish-ledger.de: Das Buch des Amtes wird öffentlich ausgehängt. Wir prüfen jede Entscheidung.
choice:b1-council:publish-ledger.en: The Office’s ledger goes on public display. We review every decision.
choice:b1-council:publish-ledger.tr: Dairenin defteri herkesin göreceği yere asılsın. Her kararı inceliyoruz.

choice:b1-council:kessler-list.de: Frau Kessler liest ihre Liste vor. Alle Regeln, öffentlich.
choice:b1-council:kessler-list.en: Frau Kessler reads her list aloud. Every rule, in public.
choice:b1-council:kessler-list.tr: Frau Kessler listesini okusun. Bütün kurallar, herkesin önünde.

dialogue:b1-council-choice-0.de: Schrittweise. Ein Bahnhof nach dem anderen. Damit kann ich leben. Langsam.
dialogue:b1-council-choice-0.en: Step by step. One station after another. I can live with that. Slowly.
dialogue:b1-council-choice-0.tr: Adım adım. Bir istasyon diğerinin ardından. Buna katlanabilirim. Yavaşça.

dialogue:b1-council-choice-1.de: Vor jedem Schritt fragen wir die Stadt. Auch ein Nein kommt ins Protokoll.
dialogue:b1-council-choice-1.en: Before each step we ask the town. A no goes on record too.
dialogue:b1-council-choice-1.tr: Her adımdan önce kasabaya soruyoruz. Bir hayır da tutanağa geçer.

dialogue:b1-council-choice-2.de: Die Einwände stehen jetzt im Protokoll. Hört ihr? Der Strahl wird schwächer.
dialogue:b1-council-choice-2.en: The objections are on record now. Do you hear? The beam is weakening.
dialogue:b1-council-choice-2.tr: İtirazlar artık tutanakta. Duyuyor musunuz? Işın zayıflıyor.

dialogue:b1-council-choice-3.de: Und die Genehmigungen müssen lesbar sein. Ein Stempel darf nie wieder eine Antwort ersetzen.
dialogue:b1-council-choice-3.en: And the authorisations must be readable. A stamp must never again replace an answer.
dialogue:b1-council-choice-3.tr: Ve onaylar okunabilir olmalı. Bir mühür bir daha asla bir cevabın yerini almamalı.

dialogue:b1-council-choice-4.de: Mein Ja steht im Protokoll. Jetzt kann ich endlich die Kartoffel schlucken.
dialogue:b1-council-choice-4.en: My yes is in the record. Now I can finally swallow this potato.
dialogue:b1-council-choice-4.tr: Evetim tutanakta. Şimdi nihayet bu patatesi yutabilirim.

dialogue:b1-council-choice-5.de: Ein Schritt muss zuerst kommen. Der erste Zug oder die erste Abstimmung?
dialogue:b1-council-choice-5.en: One step has to come first. The first train or the first vote?
dialogue:b1-council-choice-5.tr: Önce bir adım gelmeli. İlk tren mi, ilk oylama mı?

dialogue:b1-council-after-reopen-0.de: Wer Angst vor dem ersten Zug hat, bekommt einen Platz neben mir.
dialogue:b1-council-after-reopen-0.en: Anyone afraid of the first train gets a seat beside me.
dialogue:b1-council-after-reopen-0.tr: İlk trenden korkan herkes yanımda bir yer alır.

dialogue:b1-council-after-remember-0.de: Ich trage die Frage in jede Stadt. Und die Post der Klinik.
dialogue:b1-council-after-remember-0.en: I will carry the question to every town. And the clinic’s post.
dialogue:b1-council-after-remember-0.tr: Soruyu her kasabaya taşıyacağım. Kliniğin postasını da.

dialogue:b1-council-after-publish-ledger.de: Niemand muss mehr an meiner Bürotür um eine Erklärung bitten.
dialogue:b1-council-after-publish-ledger.en: Nobody has to beg for an explanation at my office door again.
dialogue:b1-council-after-publish-ledger.tr: Artık kimse büromun kapısında açıklama dilenmek zorunda değil.

dialogue:b1-council-after-kessler-list-0.de: Regel eins bis zehn. Ich lese sie laut. Dann streiche ich Regel vier. Selbst.
dialogue:b1-council-after-kessler-list-0.en: Rules one to ten. I will read them aloud. Then I will strike out rule four. Myself.
dialogue:b1-council-after-kessler-list-0.tr: Birden ona kadar kurallar. Yüksek sesle okuyorum. Sonra dördüncü kuralı ben çiziyorum. Kendim.

dialogue:b1-council-after-kessler-list-1.de: Zum ersten Mal hört jeder, was er vorher nur unterschreiben durfte.
dialogue:b1-council-after-kessler-list-1.en: For the first time everyone hears what they were only allowed to sign before.
dialogue:b1-council-after-kessler-list-1.tr: İlk kez herkes daha önce sadece imzalayabildiği şeyi duyuyor.

dialogue:b1-council-complete-0.de: Hört ihr den Wind? Der Sturm kommt vor der nächsten Glocke.
dialogue:b1-council-complete-0.en: Do you hear the wind? The storm is coming before the next bell.
dialogue:b1-council-complete-0.tr: Rüzgârı duyuyor musunuz? Fırtına bir sonraki çandan önce geliyor.

dialogue:b1-council-complete-1.de: {name}, Voss wartet an der Sternwarte. Bevor der Sturm kommt, musst du etwas über deinen Schlüssel wissen.
dialogue:b1-council-complete-1.en: {name}, Voss is waiting at the observatory. Before the storm comes, you must know something about your key.
dialogue:b1-council-complete-1.tr: {name}, Voss gözlemevinde bekliyor. Fırtına gelmeden önce anahtarın hakkında bir şey bilmen gerek.

objective:b1-council:0.en: Join the council in the archive

objective:b1-council:2.en: Look at both routes on the chart

objective:b1-council:3.en: Propose opening the route gradually as a compromise.
objective:b1-council:3.tr: Uzlaşma olarak hattın kademeli açılmasını öner.

objective:b1-council:4.tr: Hangi adımın önce geleceğine karar ver

dialogue:b1-council-topic-silence-0.de: Das Amt hat die Regel auf seine Formulare gedruckt. Wer nicht antworten konnte, verlor trotzdem seine Strecke.
dialogue:b1-council-topic-silence-0.en: The Office printed the rule on its forms. People unable to answer still lost their route.
dialogue:b1-council-topic-silence-0.tr: Daire kuralı formlarına bastı. Cevap veremeyenler yine de hatlarını kaybetti.

dialogue:b1-council-topic-silence-1.de: Ich nannte es einfach. Für mich war es einfach. Für die Menschen vor meiner Tür war es eine Drohung.
dialogue:b1-council-topic-silence-1.en: I called it simple. It was simple for me. For the people outside my door it was a threat.
dialogue:b1-council-topic-silence-1.tr: Basit dedim. Benim için basitti. Kapımın önündeki insanlar için bir tehditti.

topic:b1-council:silence.en: Why does silence count as yes?

dialogue:b1-council-topic-empty-chair-0.de: Er ist für alle, deren Namen schon fehlen.
dialogue:b1-council-topic-empty-chair-0.en: It is for everyone whose names are already missing.
dialogue:b1-council-topic-empty-chair-0.tr: Adları zaten eksik olan herkes için.

dialogue:b1-council-topic-empty-chair-1.de: Wir lesen ihre Einwände laut, damit ihr Schweigen nicht zählt.
dialogue:b1-council-topic-empty-chair-1.en: We read their objections aloud, so their silence does not count.
dialogue:b1-council-topic-empty-chair-1.tr: İtirazlarını yüksek sesle okuyoruz ki sessizlikleri sayılmasın.

dialogue:b1-council-topic-soup-0.de: Kartoffeln aus Lindenhafen, Lauch aus Waldruh und Fisch aus Nebelstadt.
dialogue:b1-council-topic-soup-0.en: Potatoes from Lindenhafen, leeks from Waldruh and fish from Nebelstadt.
dialogue:b1-council-topic-soup-0.tr: Lindenhafen’den patates, Waldruh’dan pırasa ve Nebelstadt’tan balık.

dialogue:b1-council-topic-soup-1.de: Drei Städte in einem Topf, und keiner beschwert sich. Das nenne ich Politik.
dialogue:b1-council-topic-soup-1.en: Three towns in one pot, and nobody complains. That is what I call politics.
dialogue:b1-council-topic-soup-1.tr: Bir tencerede üç kasaba ve kimse şikâyet etmiyor. Ben buna siyaset derim.

evidence:b1-council:nebelstadt-council-b.de: Drei Aushänge: Sofort öffnen! Erst fragen! Suppe ab zwölf. Darunter eine alte Regel des Amtes: Wer schweigt, stimmt zu.
evidence:b1-council:nebelstadt-council-b.en: Three notices: Open now! Ask first! Soup from twelve. Beneath them an old Office rule: whoever stays silent agrees.
evidence:b1-council:nebelstadt-council-b.tr: Üç duyuru: Hemen açın! Önce sorun! Çorba on ikiden itibaren. Altında Dairenin eski bir kuralı: Susan kabul etmiş sayılır.

evidence:b1-council:nebelstadt-harbor-ch.de: Die Karte mit beiden Linien. Eine Notiz von Otto: Erst fragen, dann zeichnen.
evidence:b1-council:nebelstadt-harbor-ch.en: The chart with both lines. A note from Otto: ask first, then draw.
evidence:b1-council:nebelstadt-harbor-ch.tr: İki hattın olduğu harita. Otto’dan bir not: Önce sor, sonra çiz.

clue:b1-council:text:0.de: Wer schweigt, stimmt zu: Das war die Regel des Amtes, nicht die Regel des Atlas.
clue:b1-council:text:0.en: Whoever stays silent agrees: that was the Office’s rule, not the Atlas’s.
clue:b1-council:text:0.tr: Susan kabul etmiş sayılır: Bu Dairenin kuralıydı, Atlasın değil.

clue:b1-council:text:1.de: Der Rat öffnet die Strecke Schritt für Schritt.
clue:b1-council:text:1.en: The council opens the route step by step.

clue:b1-council:lead:0.de: Voss wartet an der Treppe zur Sternwarte.
clue:b1-council:lead:0.en: Voss is waiting at the observatory stairs.

clue:b1-council:letter:0.de: Der leere Stuhl gehörte dorthin. Jemand, den meine Entscheidung weggenommen hat, hätte darauf sitzen sollen. Du hast ihr Schweigen nicht als Ja gezählt.
clue:b1-council:letter:0.en: The empty chair belonged there. Someone my decision took away should have been sitting in it. You did not count their silence as a yes.
clue:b1-council:letter:0.tr: Boş sandalye oraya aitti. Kararımın götürdüğü biri orada oturmalıydı. Onların sessizliğini evet saymadın.

quest:b1-temptation:subtitle.en: You could close the route again

quest:b1-temptation:objective:1.en: Talk about conditions with wenn and falls
quest:b1-temptation:objective:1.tr: wenn ve falls ile koşullardan bahset

quest:b1-temptation:objective:2.en: Decide whether to turn the key

quest:b1-temptation:story:0.de: Der dunkle Strahl ist so stark wie nie.
quest:b1-temptation:story:0.en: The dark beam is stronger than ever.
quest:b1-temptation:story:0.tr: Karanlık ışın hiç olmadığı kadar güçlü.

quest:b1-temptation:story:1.de: Mit dem Schlüssel könntest du die Strecke heute Nacht schließen.
quest:b1-temptation:story:1.en: With the key you could close the route tonight.

quest:b1-temptation:story:2.de: Dann hört der Strahl auf. Aber Waldruh wird wieder dunkel.
quest:b1-temptation:story:2.en: Then the beam stops. But Waldruh goes dark again.
quest:b1-temptation:story:2.tr: O zaman ışın durur. Ama Waldruh yeniden kararır.

dialogue:b1-temptation-intro-0.de: Die Treppe zur Sternwarte ist verschlossen. Mit einem Laternenschloss. Du weißt, welcher Schlüssel passt.
dialogue:b1-temptation-intro-0.en: The stairs to the observatory are locked. With a lantern lock. You know which key fits.
dialogue:b1-temptation-intro-0.tr: Gözlemevinin merdiveni kilitli. Fenerli bir kilitle. Hangi anahtarın uyduğunu biliyorsun.

dialogue:b1-temptation-intro-1.de: Oben am Pult ist der Ort, an dem Elise die Strecke damals geschlossen hat.
dialogue:b1-temptation-intro-1.en: Up at the desk is the place where Elise closed the route back then.
dialogue:b1-temptation-intro-1.tr: Yukarıdaki kürsü, Elise’in o zaman hattı kapattığı yer.

dialogue:b1-temptation-intro-2.de: Der Strahl ist heute Nacht stärker als je zuvor. Die Spulen sind aus, aber die alte Leitung reicht.
dialogue:b1-temptation-intro-2.en: The beam is stronger tonight than ever. The coils are off, but the old wiring is enough.
dialogue:b1-temptation-intro-2.tr: Işın bu gece her zamankinden güçlü. Bobinler kapalı ama eski kablo yetiyor.

dialogue:b1-temptation-intro-3.de: Die Spulen laufen noch. Der Rat wollte zuerst den Plan. Jetzt zahlen wir dafür.
dialogue:b1-temptation-intro-3.en: The coils are still running. The council wanted the plan first. Now we are paying for it.
dialogue:b1-temptation-intro-3.tr: Bobinler hâlâ çalışıyor. Kurul önce planı istedi. Şimdi bedelini ödüyoruz.

dialogue:b1-temptation-intro-4.de: Der Strahl läuft die Strecke entlang. Wo sie offen ist, erreicht er die Namen.
dialogue:b1-temptation-intro-4.en: The beam runs along the route. Where it is open, it reaches the names.
dialogue:b1-temptation-intro-4.tr: Işın hat boyunca ilerliyor. Hattın açık olduğu yerde isimlere ulaşıyor.

dialogue:b1-temptation-intro-5.de: Hör mal. Das Band läuft wieder.
dialogue:b1-temptation-intro-5.en: Listen. The tape is running again.

dialogue:b1-temptation-gate-0.de: Ich sage dir nicht, was du tun sollst. Ich habe einmal für andere entschieden. Das war genug.
dialogue:b1-temptation-gate-0.en: I will not tell you what to do. I decided for others once. That was enough.
dialogue:b1-temptation-gate-0.tr: Sana ne yapman gerektiğini söylemeyeceğim. Bir kez başkaları adına karar verdim. O kadarı yetti.

dialogue:b1-temptation-gate-0:variant:0.de: Ich sage dir nicht, was du tun sollst.
dialogue:b1-temptation-gate-0:variant:0.en: I will not tell you what to do.

choice:b1-temptation:route-closed-again.de: Ich drehe ihn. Nur für diese Nacht.
choice:b1-temptation:route-closed-again.en: I will turn it. Just for tonight.

choice:b1-temptation:key-refused.de: Nein. Wir halten den Sturm aus. Zusammen.
choice:b1-temptation:key-refused.en: No. We weather the storm. Together.

dialogue:b1-temptation-choice-0.de: Dann schließt sich die Strecke. Eine Minute, eine Drehung. Der Strahl hat keinen Weg mehr.
dialogue:b1-temptation-choice-0.en: Then the route closes. One minute, one turn. The beam has no path any more.
dialogue:b1-temptation-choice-0.tr: O zaman hat kapanır. Bir dakika, bir çevirme. Işının artık yolu kalmaz.

dialogue:b1-temptation-choice-1.de: Heute Nacht wäre Ruhe. Kein Sturm über den Namen. Morgen fängst du neu an.
dialogue:b1-temptation-choice-1.en: Tonight there would be peace. No storm over the names. Tomorrow you start again.
dialogue:b1-temptation-choice-1.tr: Bu gece huzur olurdu. İsimlerin üstünde fırtına olmazdı. Yarın yeniden başlarsın.

dialogue:b1-temptation-choice-2.de: Aber Waldruh wäre wieder dunkel. Alle neuen Namen dort, auf dem Stein und am Tisch.
dialogue:b1-temptation-choice-2.en: But Waldruh would be dark again. All the new names there, on the stone and at the table.
dialogue:b1-temptation-choice-2.tr: Ama Waldruh yeniden kararır. Oradaki bütün yeni isimler, taşta ve masada.

dialogue:b1-temptation-choice-3.de: Ich habe das schon einmal gemacht. Eine Unterschrift. Es ist leicht. Das ist das Schlimme daran.
dialogue:b1-temptation-choice-3.en: I have done this once before. One signature. It is easy. That is the terrible thing about it.
dialogue:b1-temptation-choice-3.tr: Bunu daha önce bir kez yaptım. Bir imza. Kolaydır. Kötü olan da bu.

dialogue:b1-temptation-choice-4.de: Vom Hafen her, leise: „Ist da jemand? Ich bin noch hier.“
dialogue:b1-temptation-choice-4.en: From the harbour, quietly: “Is anyone there? I am still here.”
dialogue:b1-temptation-choice-4.tr: Limandan, sessizce: “Orada kimse var mı? Ben hâlâ buradayım.”

dialogue:b1-temptation-choice-5.de: Drehst du den Schlüssel heute Nacht? Oder halten wir den Sturm ohne ihn aus?
dialogue:b1-temptation-choice-5.en: Will you turn the key tonight? Or do we weather the storm without it?
dialogue:b1-temptation-choice-5.tr: Anahtarı bu gece çevirecek misin? Yoksa fırtınaya onsuz mu dayanacağız?

dialogue:b1-temptation-after-route-close.de: Der Strahl bricht ab. Über dem Hafen ist es still.
dialogue:b1-temptation-after-route-close.en: The beam breaks off. It is quiet over the harbour.

dialogue:b1-temptation-after-route-close.de: Waldruh ist dunkel. Ich sehe kein einziges Licht mehr. Auch nicht am Tisch.
dialogue:b1-temptation-after-route-close.en: Waldruh is dark. I cannot see a single light any more. Not even at the table.
dialogue:b1-temptation-after-route-close.tr: Waldruh karanlık. Tek bir ışık bile göremiyorum. Masada bile.

dialogue:b1-temptation-after-route-close.de: Jetzt weißt du, wie leicht es ist. Ich verurteile dich nicht. Ich erkenne dich.
dialogue:b1-temptation-after-route-close.en: Now you know how easy it is. I do not judge you. I recognise you.
dialogue:b1-temptation-after-route-close.tr: Artık ne kadar kolay olduğunu biliyorsun. Seni yargılamıyorum. Seni tanıyorum.

dialogue:b1-temptation-after-key-refused.de: Dann halten wir es aus. Der Schlüssel bleibt in deiner Tasche.
dialogue:b1-temptation-after-key-refused.en: Then we weather it. The key stays in your pocket.
dialogue:b1-temptation-after-key-refused.tr: O zaman dayanıyoruz. Anahtar cebinde kalıyor.

dialogue:b1-temptation-after-key-refused.de: Damals hätte jemand Nein sagen sollen. Heute hat es jemand gesagt.
dialogue:b1-temptation-after-key-refused.en: Back then someone should have said no. Today someone did.
dialogue:b1-temptation-after-key-refused.tr: O zaman birinin hayır demesi gerekirdi. Bugün biri dedi.

dialogue:b1-temptation-complete-0.de: Hörst du den Wind? Greta ist schon im Garten. Das Wasser steigt.
dialogue:b1-temptation-complete-0.en: Do you hear the wind? Greta is already in the garden. The water is rising.
dialogue:b1-temptation-complete-0.tr: Rüzgârı duyuyor musun? Greta çoktan bahçede. Su yükseliyor.

gate-prompt:b1-temptation.en: Ask Voss what happens if you turn the key.
gate-prompt:b1-temptation.tr: Voss’a anahtarı çevirirsen ne olacağını sor.

objective:b1-temptation:2.en: Ask Voss what happens if you turn the key.
objective:b1-temptation:2.tr: Voss’a anahtarı çevirirsen ne olacağını sor.

objective:b1-temptation:3.en: Decide whether to turn the key

dialogue:b1-temptation-topic-elise-did-0.de: Das soll sie dir selbst sagen. Oben. Ich habe es lange genug für sie getragen.
dialogue:b1-temptation-topic-elise-did-0.en: She should tell you herself. Upstairs. I carried it for her long enough.
dialogue:b1-temptation-topic-elise-did-0.tr: Bunu sana kendisi söylemeli. Yukarıda. Onun yerine yeterince uzun taşıdım.

topic:b1-temptation:elise-did.de: Warum hat Elise ihn damals gedreht?
topic:b1-temptation:elise-did.en: Why did Elise turn it back then?
topic:b1-temptation:elise-did.tr: Elise onu o zaman neden çevirdi?

dialogue:b1-temptation-topic-tape-0.de: Elise. In der ersten Nacht. Sie wollte, dass jemand antwortet, auch wenn sie schläft.
dialogue:b1-temptation-topic-tape-0.en: Elise. On the first night. She wanted someone to answer, even while she slept.
dialogue:b1-temptation-topic-tape-0.tr: Elise. İlk gece. O uyurken bile birinin cevap vermesini istedi.

lock:b1-temptation:nebelstadt-observator.de: Die Treppe ist verschlossen. Am Schloss ist eine kleine Laterne.
lock:b1-temptation:nebelstadt-observator.en: The stairs are locked. There is a little lantern on the lock.
lock:b1-temptation:nebelstadt-observator.tr: Merdiven kilitli. Kilidinde küçük bir fener var.

evidence:b1-temptation:nebelstadt-observ.de: Eine Treppe nach oben. Am Schloss eine kleine Laterne. Dein Schlüssel passt.
evidence:b1-temptation:nebelstadt-observ.en: A staircase leading up. A little lantern on the lock. Your key fits.
evidence:b1-temptation:nebelstadt-observ.tr: Yukarı çıkan bir merdiven. Kilidinde küçük bir fener. Anahtarın uyuyor.

clue:b1-temptation:text:0.de: Mit dem Schlüssel kann man die Strecke von der Sternwarte aus schließen.
clue:b1-temptation:text:0.en: With the key the route can be closed from the observatory.

clue:b1-temptation:text:1.de: Dann hört der Strahl auf. Aber Waldruh wird wieder dunkel.
clue:b1-temptation:text:1.en: Then the beam stops. But Waldruh goes dark again.
clue:b1-temptation:text:1.tr: O zaman ışın durur. Ama Waldruh yeniden kararır.

clue:b1-temptation:text:2.de: Voss sagt: Es ist leicht. Das ist das Schlimme daran.
clue:b1-temptation:text:2.en: Voss says: it is easy. That is the terrible thing about it.
clue:b1-temptation:text:2.tr: Voss diyor ki: Kolaydır. Kötü olan da bu.

clue:b1-temptation:lead:0.de: Greta braucht dich im Garten. Der Sturm ist da.
clue:b1-temptation:lead:0.en: Greta needs you in the garden. The storm is here.
clue:b1-temptation:lead:0.tr: Greta’nın bahçede sana ihtiyacı var. Fırtına geldi.

clue:b1-temptation:letter:0.de: Ich stand an derselben Stelle. Ich hatte Angst und eine Minute Zeit. Was du auch gewählt hast: Du hast es nicht allein gewählt.
clue:b1-temptation:letter:0.en: I stood in the same place. I was afraid and had one minute. Whatever you chose: you did not choose it alone.
clue:b1-temptation:letter:0.tr: Aynı yerde durdum. Korkuyordum ve bir dakikam vardı. Ne seçtiysen seç: Yalnız seçmedin.

grammar-note:b1-temptation.de: Wenn ich den Schlüssel drehe: Im wenn-Satz steht das Verb am Ende, danach beginnt der Hauptsatz.
grammar-note:b1-temptation.en: Wenn ich den Schlüssel drehe: in the wenn-clause the verb goes last, then the main clause begins.
grammar-note:b1-temptation.tr: Wenn ich den Schlüssel drehe: wenn cümlesinde fiil sona gider, sonra ana cümle başlar.

dialogue:b1-storm-intro-0.de: Das Wasser steht schon zwischen den Beeten. Jetzt die Menschen.
dialogue:b1-storm-intro-0.en: The water is already between the beds. Now the people.
dialogue:b1-storm-intro-0.tr: Su çoktan tarhların arasında. Şimdi sıra insanlarda.

dialogue:b1-storm-intro-1.de: Das Signal flackert. Der Strahl drückt dagegen wie eine Hand auf einen Mund.
dialogue:b1-storm-intro-1.en: The signal is flickering. The beam presses against it like a hand over a mouth.
dialogue:b1-storm-intro-1.tr: Sinyal titriyor. Işın ona bir ağzı kapatan el gibi bastırıyor.

dialogue:b1-storm-intro-2.de: Kein Strahl heute. Nur Sturm. Aber Waldruh ist dunkel, und das Signal findet die Namen dort nicht.
dialogue:b1-storm-intro-2.en: No beam tonight. Only storm. But Waldruh is dark, and the signal cannot find the names there.
dialogue:b1-storm-intro-2.tr: Bu gece ışın yok. Sadece fırtına. Ama Waldruh karanlık ve sinyal oradaki isimleri bulamıyor.

dialogue:b1-storm-intro-3.de: Ich habe Tee, Decken und eine Liste. Greta, wer fehlt noch?
dialogue:b1-storm-intro-3.en: I have tea, blankets and a list. Greta, who is still missing?
dialogue:b1-storm-intro-3.tr: Çayım, battaniyelerim ve bir listem var. Greta, kim eksik?

dialogue:b1-storm-intro-4.de: Die Familie aus Waldruh, mit dem roten Boot. Ich sehe ihr Licht hinter den Beeten.
dialogue:b1-storm-intro-4.en: The family from Waldruh, with the red boat. I can see their light beyond the beds.
dialogue:b1-storm-intro-4.tr: Kırmızı tekneli Waldruh ailesi. Işıklarını tarhların ötesinde görüyorum.

dialogue:b1-storm-intro-5.de: Ich habe ihre Namen aufgeschrieben. Nur ein nasser Streifen ist übrig. Gestern konnte ich sie noch lesen.
dialogue:b1-storm-intro-5.en: I wrote their names down. Only a wet streak is left. Yesterday I could still read them.
dialogue:b1-storm-intro-5.tr: Adlarını yazmıştım. Sadece ıslak bir iz kaldı. Dün hâlâ okuyabiliyordum.

dialogue:b1-storm-intro-6.de: Das Lager des Amtes ist offen. Sandsäcke, Seile, Lampen. Keine Formulare.
dialogue:b1-storm-intro-6.en: The Office storehouse is open. Sandbags, ropes, lamps. No forms.
dialogue:b1-storm-intro-6.tr: Dairenin deposu açık. Kum torbaları, halatlar, lambalar. Form yok.

dialogue:b1-storm-intro-7.de: Meine Leute kommen auch. Ihr habt uns Beweise statt Gerüchte gebracht.
dialogue:b1-storm-intro-7.en: My staff are coming too. You brought us evidence instead of rumours.
dialogue:b1-storm-intro-7.tr: Benim adamlarım da geliyor. Bize dedikodu yerine delil getirdiniz.

dialogue:b1-storm-intro-8.de: Ich habe das Lager aufgeschlossen. Ohne Formular. Es fühlt sich falsch an. Und richtig.
dialogue:b1-storm-intro-8.en: I unlocked the storehouse. Without a form. It feels wrong. And right.
dialogue:b1-storm-intro-8.tr: Depoyu ben açtım. Formsuz. Yanlış hissettiriyor. Ve doğru.

dialogue:b1-storm-intro-9.de: Der Kreis ist da. Seine Leute kennen jeden Weg zur Klinik, auch die auf keiner Karte.
dialogue:b1-storm-intro-9.en: The Circle is here. Its people know every way to the clinic, even those on no map.
dialogue:b1-storm-intro-9.tr: Çember burada. İnsanları kliniğe giden her yolu biliyor, hiçbir haritada olmayanları bile.

dialogue:b1-storm-intro-10.de: Die Laternenhüter sind da, mit Leitern und Werkzeug. Du hast Wort gehalten. Jetzt halten wir unseres.
dialogue:b1-storm-intro-10.en: The Lamplighters are here, with ladders and tools. You kept your word. Now we keep ours.
dialogue:b1-storm-intro-10.tr: Fener Bekçileri burada, merdivenler ve aletlerle. Sözünü tuttun. Şimdi biz tutuyoruz.

dialogue:b1-storm-intro-11.de: Der Klinikzug steht am Halt. Er kann Leute aus dem Wasser holen. Gut, dass wir die Kurve gewählt haben.
dialogue:b1-storm-intro-11.en: The clinic train is at the stop. It can take people out of the water. Good that we chose the curve.
dialogue:b1-storm-intro-11.tr: Klinik treni durakta. İnsanları sudan alabilir. İyi ki kavisli hattı seçmişiz.

dialogue:b1-storm-intro-12.de: Jonas ruft vom Turm: Hier! Hier ist das Signal!
dialogue:b1-storm-intro-12.en: Jonas calls from the tower: here! The signal is here!
dialogue:b1-storm-intro-12.tr: Jonas kuleden sesleniyor: Burada! Sinyal burada!

dialogue:b1-storm-intro-13.de: Ich steige zur Laterne. Aber jemand muss die Leiter halten, und meine Leute stehen schon im Wasser.
dialogue:b1-storm-intro-13.en: I will climb to the lantern. But someone must hold the ladder, and my people are already in the water.
dialogue:b1-storm-intro-13.tr: Fenere tırmanacağım. Ama biri merdiveni tutmalı ve benim adamlarım çoktan suda.

dialogue:b1-storm-intro-14.de: Die Leiter rutscht. Die Seile sind da. Jede Gruppe braucht Hände aus einer anderen.
dialogue:b1-storm-intro-14.en: The ladder is slipping. The ropes are here. Every group needs hands from another.
dialogue:b1-storm-intro-14.tr: Merdiven kayıyor. Halatlar burada. Her grubun başka bir gruptan ellere ihtiyacı var.

dialogue:b1-storm-gate-0.de: Jeder für sich, und wir haben nicht einmal genug Hände für die Leiter.
dialogue:b1-storm-gate-0.en: Each on their own, and we do not even have enough hands for the ladder.
dialogue:b1-storm-gate-0.tr: Herkes kendi başına olursa merdiven için bile yeterince elimiz yok.

dialogue:b1-storm-gate-0:variant:0.de: Allein haben wir nicht genug Hände.
dialogue:b1-storm-gate-0:variant:0.en: Alone we do not have enough hands.

choice:b1-storm:reopen.de: Zum Signal. Dann holen wir die Familien über das Gewächshausdach.
choice:b1-storm:reopen.en: To the signal. Then we bring the families out over the greenhouse roof.
choice:b1-storm:reopen.tr: Sinyale. Sonra aileleri seranın çatısından çıkarırız.

choice:b1-storm:remember.de: Zum Garten. Emil hält das Signal mit der Hand.
choice:b1-storm:remember.en: To the garden. Emil holds the signal by hand.

dialogue:b1-storm-choice-0.de: Voss, halt die Leiter mit mir. Lina, gib Greta das Seil. Emil klettert.
dialogue:b1-storm-choice-0.en: Voss, hold the ladder with me. Lina, pass the rope to Greta. Emil climbs.
dialogue:b1-storm-choice-0.tr: Voss, merdiveni benimle tut. Lina, halatı Greta’ya ver. Emil tırmanıyor.

dialogue:b1-storm-choice-1.de: Haltet die Hände dort. Lindenhafen, Waldruh, Nebelstadt. Jetzt hält das Signal!
dialogue:b1-storm-choice-1.en: Keep your hands there. Lindenhafen, Waldruh, Nebelstadt. Now the signal holds!
dialogue:b1-storm-choice-1.tr: Ellerinizi orada tutun. Lindenhafen, Waldruh, Nebelstadt. Şimdi sinyal tutuyor!

dialogue:b1-storm-choice-2.de: Lenz! Die Familie Lenz! Jetzt weiß ich es wieder.
dialogue:b1-storm-choice-2.en: Lenz! The Lenz family! Now I remember.

dialogue:b1-storm-choice-5.de: Das Signal kippt wieder. Im Garten steigt das Wasser. Wohin bringen wir die starken Seile zuerst?
dialogue:b1-storm-choice-5.en: The signal is tipping again. Water is rising in the garden. Where do we take the strong ropes first?
dialogue:b1-storm-choice-5.tr: Sinyal yine devriliyor. Bahçede su yükseliyor. Sağlam halatları önce nereye götürelim?

dialogue:b1-storm-after-reopen-0.de: Das Signal hält. Die Familie Lenz winkt aus der Halle. Ihr rotes Boot treibt ohne sie davon.
dialogue:b1-storm-after-reopen-0.en: The signal holds. The Lenz family waves from the hall. Their red boat drifts away without them.
dialogue:b1-storm-after-reopen-0.tr: Sinyal tutuyor. Lenz ailesi salondan el sallıyor. Kırmızı tekneleri onlarsız sürükleniyor.

dialogue:b1-storm-after-remember-0.de: Achtzehn Menschen und zwei Hunde. Alle im Trockenen. Emil braucht eine neue Stütze.
dialogue:b1-storm-after-remember-0.en: Eighteen people and two dogs. All dry. Emil needs a new support.
dialogue:b1-storm-after-remember-0.tr: On sekiz insan ve iki köpek. Hepsi kuru yerde. Emil’in yeni bir desteğe ihtiyacı var.

dialogue:b1-storm-complete-0.de: Der Wind dreht sich. Siehst du das Licht oben in der Sternwarte? Dort hat seit Jahren keine Lampe gebrannt.
dialogue:b1-storm-complete-0.en: The wind is turning. Do you see the light up in the observatory? No lamp has burned there for years.
dialogue:b1-storm-complete-0.tr: Rüzgâr dönüyor. Gözlemevinin yukarısındaki ışığı görüyor musun? Orada yıllardır lamba yanmadı.

dialogue:b1-storm-complete-1.de: Post für dich. Absender: der alte Signalraum. Unterschrieben: E.
dialogue:b1-storm-complete-1.en: Mail for you. Sender: the old signal room. Signed: E.
dialogue:b1-storm-complete-1.tr: Sana posta. Gönderen: eski sinyal odası. İmza: E.

dialogue:b1-storm-complete-2.de: Wir bleiben bei den Familien. Geh nach oben, {name}. Diesmal muss Elise ihre eigene Tür öffnen.
dialogue:b1-storm-complete-2.en: We will stay with the families. Go upstairs, {name}. This time Elise must open her own door.
dialogue:b1-storm-complete-2.tr: Biz ailelerle kalıyoruz. Yukarı çık, {name}. Bu sefer Elise kendi kapısını açmalı.

objective:b1-storm:0.en: Reach the lighthouse steps in the storm

objective:b1-storm:2.en: Say that we can only solve the problem together.

objective:b1-storm:3.en: Decide where the strong ropes go first
objective:b1-storm:3.tr: Sağlam halatların önce nereye gideceğine karar ver

dialogue:b1-storm-topic-festival-0.de: Wegen des Sturms wurde das Hafenfest abgesagt. Die Gäste sind jetzt in der Halle.
dialogue:b1-storm-topic-festival-0.en: Because of the storm the harbour festival was cancelled. The guests are in the hall now.
dialogue:b1-storm-topic-festival-0.tr: Fırtına yüzünden liman şenliği iptal edildi. Misafirler şimdi salonda.

dialogue:b1-storm-topic-festival-1.de: Fritz kocht dort weiter. Er sagt, Suppe ist auch eine Art Dach.
dialogue:b1-storm-topic-festival-1.en: Fritz is still cooking there. He says soup is a kind of roof too.
dialogue:b1-storm-topic-festival-1.tr: Fritz orada yemek yapmaya devam ediyor. Çorbanın da bir çeşit çatı olduğunu söylüyor.

topic:b1-storm:festival.en: Why was the festival called off?

dialogue:b1-storm-topic-beam-0.de: Er macht es leiser. Ein Signal, das nicht antworten kann, ist nur noch ein Licht.
dialogue:b1-storm-topic-beam-0.en: It makes it quieter. A signal that cannot answer is just a light.
dialogue:b1-storm-topic-beam-0.tr: Onu sessizleştiriyor. Cevap veremeyen bir sinyal sadece bir ışıktır.

topic:b1-storm:beam.de: Was macht der Strahl mit dem Signal?
topic:b1-storm:beam.en: What is the beam doing to the signal?

evidence:b1-storm:nebelstadt-signal-lant.de: Die Signallaterne flackert im Sturm. Drei Hebel, einer für jede Stadt.
evidence:b1-storm:nebelstadt-signal-lant.en: The signal lantern flickers in the storm. Three levers, one for each town.
evidence:b1-storm:nebelstadt-signal-lant.tr: İşaret feneri fırtınada titriyor. Üç kol, her kasaba için bir tane.

clue:b1-storm:text:0.de: Nur mit Händen aus allen drei Städten hält das Signal.
clue:b1-storm:text:0.en: Only with hands from all three towns does the signal hold.
clue:b1-storm:text:0.tr: Sinyal ancak üç kasabanın elleriyle tutuyor.

clue:b1-storm:text:1.de: Marta erinnert sich wieder: die Familie Lenz, mit dem roten Boot.
clue:b1-storm:text:1.en: Marta remembers again: the Lenz family, with the red boat.
clue:b1-storm:text:1.tr: Marta yeniden hatırlıyor: Kırmızı tekneli Lenz ailesi.

clue:b1-storm:text:2.de: Oben in der Sternwarte brennt ein Licht. Elise wartet.
clue:b1-storm:text:2.en: A light burns up in the observatory. Elise is waiting.
clue:b1-storm:text:2.tr: Gözlemevinin yukarısında bir ışık yanıyor. Elise bekliyor.

clue:b1-storm:lead:0.de: Elise wartet oben in der Sternwarte.
clue:b1-storm:lead:0.en: Elise is waiting up in the observatory.

clue:b1-storm:letter:0.de: Ich sehe eure Lampen. Eine steigt die Leiter hinauf, die anderen gehen zum Garten. Ihr bleibt zusammen, nachdem ihr gestritten habt. Die Tür ist offen. Der Tee ist fertig.
clue:b1-storm:letter:0.en: I can see your lamps. One climbs the ladder; the others head for the garden. You stay together after arguing. The door is open. The tea is ready.
clue:b1-storm:letter:0.tr: Lambalarınızı görüyorum. Biri merdivene tırmanıyor, diğerleri bahçeye gidiyor. Tartıştıktan sonra bile birlikte kalıyorsunuz. Kapı açık. Çay hazır.

dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-0.de: {name}. Ich habe die Tür offengelassen. Trotzdem habe ich mich erschrocken, als du geklopft hast.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-0.en: {name}. I left the door open. Even so, your knock frightened me.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-0.tr: {name}. Kapıyı açık bıraktım. Yine de kapıyı çaldığında irkildim.

dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-1.de: Du hast den Schlüssel gedreht. Jetzt weißt du, wie leicht es ist. Ich verurteile dich nicht.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-1.en: You turned the key. Now you know how easy it is. I do not condemn you.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-1.tr: Anahtarı çevirdin. Artık ne kadar kolay olduğunu biliyorsun. Seni kınamıyorum.

dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-2.de: Du hast den Schlüssel nicht gedreht. Ich habe es vom Fenster aus gesehen.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-2.en: You did not turn the key. I saw it from the window.

dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-3.de: Und jetzt fällt mir nur ein: Möchtest du Tee? Er ist leider schon kalt.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-3.en: And now all I can think of is: would you like some tea? I am afraid it is already cold.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-3.tr: Ve şimdi aklıma sadece şu geliyor: Çay ister misin? Maalesef çoktan soğudu.

dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-4.de: Die Briefe an dich liegen neben meinen Entwürfen. Hier habe ich jedes Wort gestrichen, das nach einer Entschuldigung klang.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-4.en: My letters to you are beside my drafts. Here I crossed out every word that sounded like an excuse.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-4.tr: Sana yazdığım mektuplar taslaklarımın yanında. Burada özür gibi duran her kelimeyi çizdim.

dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-5.de: Im Brief stand: „Bevor du uns wieder auslöschst, komm.“ Ich hatte Angst vor diesem Schlüssel.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-5.en: The letter said: “Before you erase us again, come.” I was afraid of this key.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-5.tr: Mektupta yazıyordu: “Bizi yeniden silmeden önce gel.” Bu anahtardan korkuyordum.

dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-6.de: Und später: „Ich bin nicht an zwei Orten.“ Ich war hier. Hinter einer Tür, die ich selbst geschlossen hatte.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-6.en: And later: “I am not in two places.” I was here. Behind a door I had closed myself.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-6.tr: Ve sonra: “İki yerde değilim.” Buradaydım. Kendi kapattığım bir kapının ardında.

dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-7.de: Leg den Schlüssel zwischen uns. Ich lasse ihn liegen, während ich dir alles erzähle.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-7.en: Lay the key between us. I will leave it there while I tell you everything.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-7.tr: Anahtarı aramıza koy. Sana her şeyi anlatırken orada dursun.

dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-8.de: Lina hat dir von den Steinen erzählt. Elf. Ich habe sie gezählt, bevor ich sie weggelegt habe.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-8.en: Lina told you about the stones. Eleven. I counted them before I moved them.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-8.tr: Lina sana taşlardan bahsetti. On bir. Onları kenara koymadan önce saydım.

dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-9.de: Am Bahnhof lagen Steine auf den Gleisen. Der nächste Zug sollte Kinder zur Klinik bringen.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-9.en: There were stones on the tracks at the station. The next train was meant to take children to the clinic.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-9.tr: İstasyonda raylarda taşlar vardı. Bir sonraki tren çocukları kliniğe götürecekti.

dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-10.de: Ich wollte verhindern, dass er losfuhr. Um 17:59 schloss ich die Strecke von innen. Für eine Woche.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-10.en: I wanted to stop it leaving. At 17:59 I closed the route from inside. For one week.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-10.tr: Kalkmasını önlemek istedim. 17:59’da hattı içeriden kapattım. Bir haftalığına.

dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-11.de: Ich nenne es meinen ersten Fehler: Ich nahm den Menschen die Entscheidung ab, um sie zu schützen.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-11.en: I call it my first mistake: I took people’s choice away to keep them safe.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-11.tr: Buna ilk hatam diyorum: Onları korumak için insanların kararını ellerinden aldım.

dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-12.de: Nach einer Woche wollte ich erst sicher sein, dass alle meiner Lösung zustimmten. Die Türen blieben geschlossen.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-12.en: After a week I wanted to be sure everyone agreed with my solution first. The doors stayed closed.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-12.tr: Bir hafta sonra önce herkesin çözümüme katıldığından emin olmak istedim. Kapılar kapalı kaldı.

dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-13.de: Als Voss die Schließung dauerhaft machte, widersprach ich nicht. Ich ließ ihn ausführen, was ich begonnen hatte.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-13.en: When Voss made the closure permanent, I did not object. I let him carry out what I had begun.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-13.tr: Voss kapanışı kalıcı yaptığında itiraz etmedim. Başladığım şeyi onun yürütmesine izin verdim.

dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-14.de: Ich habe deinen Kaffee bei Marta bezahlt. Dann musste jemand deinen Namen laut sagen.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-14.en: I paid for your coffee at Marta’s. Then someone had to say your name aloud.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-14.tr: Kahveni Marta’da ben ödedim. O zaman birinin adını yüksek sesle söylemesi gerekiyordu.

dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-15.de: Du kanntest die Städte noch nicht. Ich hoffte, du würdest ihre Türen öffnen. Meine wollte ich geschlossen halten.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-15.en: You did not know the towns yet. I hoped you would open their doors. I wanted to keep mine closed.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-15.tr: Kasabaları henüz tanımıyordun. Onların kapılarını açacağını umdum. Benimkini kapalı tutmak istedim.

dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-16.de: Du hast den Brief bewahrt. Heute bekommt Ada die Entwürfe dazu. Auch die Sätze, die ich gestrichen habe.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-16.en: You kept the letter. Today Ada gets its drafts too. Even the sentences I crossed out.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-16.tr: Mektubu sakladın. Bugün taslaklarını da Ada alıyor. Çizdiğim cümleleri bile.

dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-17.de: Du hast dem Amt meine Adresse gegeben. Ich versteckte mich damals noch. Heute weiß jeder, wo ich bin.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-17.en: You gave the Office my address. I was still hiding then. Today everyone knows where I am.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-17.tr: Daireye adresimi verdin. O zaman hâlâ saklanıyordum. Bugün herkes nerede olduğumu biliyor.

dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-18.de: Ein Brief liegt ganz oben. Für Lina. Ich habe den Zug angehalten, in dem sie saß.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-18.en: One letter is right on top. For Lina. I stopped the train she was sitting in.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-18.tr: En üstte bir mektup var. Lina için. İçinde oturduğu treni ben durdurdum.

dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-19.de: Elise. Ich habe deine Stimme jeden Abend gehört. Jetzt warte ich auf keine Aufnahme mehr.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-19.en: Elise. I heard your voice every evening. Now I am done waiting for a recording.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-19.tr: Elise. Sesini her akşam duydum. Artık bir kayıt beklemiyorum.

dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-20.de: Dann antworte mir. Hier, vor der offenen Tür.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-20.en: Then answer me. Here, in front of the open door.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-20.tr: O zaman bana cevap ver. Burada, açık kapının önünde.

dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-22.de: Ich komme heute mit hinunter. Vorher sehen wir uns an, was neben dem Schlüssel liegt.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-22.en: I am coming downstairs with you today. First, let us look at what lies beside the key.
dialogue:b1-atlas-intro-22.tr: Bugün seninle aşağı iniyorum. Önce anahtarın yanında ne olduğuna bakalım.

dialogue:b1-atlas-gate-0.de: Die siebte Glocke läutet gleich. Auf dieser Seite bleibt Platz für eine Regel, die auch mich bindet.
dialogue:b1-atlas-gate-0.en: The seventh bell is about to ring. This page has room for a rule that binds me too.
dialogue:b1-atlas-gate-0.tr: Yedinci çan birazdan çalacak. Bu sayfada beni de bağlayan bir kural için yer var.

dialogue:b1-atlas-gate-1.de: Damals sprach ich erst, als alles geschlossen war. Was vereinbaren wir, bevor wieder jemand allein entscheiden muss?
dialogue:b1-atlas-gate-1.en: Last time, I spoke only after everything was closed. What do we agree before someone must decide alone again?
dialogue:b1-atlas-gate-1.tr: Geçen sefer ancak her şey kapandıktan sonra konuştum. Biri yine tek başına karar vermek zorunda kalmadan önce neyi kararlaştırıyoruz?

dialogue:b1-atlas-gate-1:variant:0.en: What do we agree together now?

choice:b1-atlas:reopen.en: The council keeps it, in public.

choice:b1-atlas:remember.de: Der Kreis verwahrt ihn für die Städte.
choice:b1-atlas:remember.en: The Circle keeps it, for the towns.

dialogue:b1-atlas-choice-0.de: Ich schreibe „wir“. Dann halte ich den Stift an. Für deinen Namen lasse ich Platz neben meinem.
dialogue:b1-atlas-choice-0.en: I write “we”. Then I pause. I leave room for your name beside mine.
dialogue:b1-atlas-choice-0.tr: “Biz” yazıyorum. Sonra kalemi durduruyorum. Adın için benimkinin yanında yer bırakıyorum.

dialogue:b1-atlas-choice-1.de: Die Tinte bleibt. Auf der Linie nach Waldruh erscheint wieder ein Halt. Und einer nach Lindenhafen.
dialogue:b1-atlas-choice-1.en: The ink holds. A stop reappears on the Waldruh line. And another towards Lindenhafen.
dialogue:b1-atlas-choice-1.tr: Mürekkep kalıyor. Waldruh hattında yeniden bir durak beliriyor. Bir tane de Lindenhafen’e doğru.

dialogue:b1-atlas-choice-2.de: Ruth. Meine Mutter heißt Ruth. Ich habe es nie aufgehört zu wissen. Ich habe nur aufgehört, es zu sagen.
dialogue:b1-atlas-choice-2.en: Ruth. My mother’s name is Ruth. I never stopped knowing it. I only stopped saying it.
dialogue:b1-atlas-choice-2.tr: Ruth. Annemin adı Ruth. Bunu bilmeyi hiç bırakmadım. Sadece söylemeyi bıraktım.

dialogue:b1-atlas-choice-3.de: Auf dem Stein in Waldruh steht wieder ein Name. Ruth Lenz.
dialogue:b1-atlas-choice-3.en: A name stands on the stone in Waldruh again. Ruth Lenz.
dialogue:b1-atlas-choice-3.tr: Waldruh’daki taşta yeniden bir isim var. Ruth Lenz.

dialogue:b1-atlas-choice-4.de: Ich schreibe den Satz auch in mein Buch. In das Buch, das jetzt im Rathaus hängt.
dialogue:b1-atlas-choice-4.en: I will write the sentence in my ledger too. The ledger that now hangs in the town hall.
dialogue:b1-atlas-choice-4.tr: Cümleyi defterime de yazacağım. Artık belediyede asılı olan deftere.

dialogue:b1-atlas-choice-5.de: Der Schlüssel bleibt vor mir liegen. Ich nehme ihn nicht mehr mit nach oben.
dialogue:b1-atlas-choice-5.en: The key stays in front of me. I will not take it upstairs again.
dialogue:b1-atlas-choice-5.tr: Anahtar önümde kalıyor. Onu bir daha yukarı götürmeyeceğim.

dialogue:b1-atlas-choice-6.de: Das „wieder“ galt dem Schlüssel, den du geerbt hast. Meine Schuld macht dich nicht schuldig.
dialogue:b1-atlas-choice-6.en: “Again” meant the key you inherited. My guilt does not make you guilty.
dialogue:b1-atlas-choice-6.tr: “Yeniden” sözü miras aldığın anahtar içindi. Benim suçum seni suçlu yapmaz.

dialogue:b1-atlas-choice-7.de: Der Schlüssel braucht einen festen, öffentlichen Platz. Wer verwahrt ihn: der Rat oder der Kreis?
dialogue:b1-atlas-choice-7.en: The key needs a permanent, public place. Who will keep it: the council or the Circle?
dialogue:b1-atlas-choice-7.tr: Anahtarın kalıcı, herkese açık bir yere ihtiyacı var. Kim saklayacak: kurul mu, Çember mi?

dialogue:b1-atlas-after-reopen-0.de: Ada nimmt den Schlüssel entgegen. Ich lege meine Entwürfe daneben. Beide bleiben unten bei den anderen.
dialogue:b1-atlas-after-reopen-0.en: Ada takes the key. I lay my drafts beside it. Both stay downstairs with the others.
dialogue:b1-atlas-after-reopen-0.tr: Ada anahtarı alıyor. Taslaklarımı yanına koyuyorum. İkisi de aşağıda, diğerlerinin yanında kalıyor.

dialogue:b1-atlas-after-reopen-1.de: Morgen beantworte ich ihre Fragen. Auch wenn der erste Zug ohne mich fährt.
dialogue:b1-atlas-after-reopen-1.en: Tomorrow I will answer their questions. Even if the first train leaves without me.
dialogue:b1-atlas-after-reopen-1.tr: Yarın sorularını cevaplayacağım. İlk tren bensiz kalksa bile.

dialogue:b1-atlas-after-remember-0.de: Greta nimmt den Schlüssel für den Kreis. Lina schreibt auf, wo er liegt. Keine versteckte Schublade mehr.
dialogue:b1-atlas-after-remember-0.en: Greta takes the key for the Circle. Lina records where it is. No more hidden drawers.
dialogue:b1-atlas-after-remember-0.tr: Greta anahtarı Çember için alıyor. Lina nerede olduğunu yazıyor. Artık gizli çekmece yok.

dialogue:b1-atlas-after-remember-1.de: Ich bekomme einen Stuhl bei den Menschen, denen ich antworten muss.
dialogue:b1-atlas-after-remember-1.en: I get a chair among the people I must answer to.
dialogue:b1-atlas-after-remember-1.tr: Cevap vermem gereken insanların arasında bir sandalyem oluyor.

dialogue:b1-atlas-complete-0.de: Der erste Zug fährt. Nicht jeder Anschluss steht schon fest. Ich bleibe bei den Leuten am Bahnsteig.
dialogue:b1-atlas-complete-0.en: The first train runs. Not every connection is settled yet. I will stay with the people on the platform.
dialogue:b1-atlas-complete-0.tr: İlk tren kalkıyor. Her bağlantı henüz kesin değil. Peronda insanlarla kalacağım.
