dialogue:b1-atlas-complete-1.de: Die Leute fahren heim. Fehlende Adressen suchen wir gemeinsam; sie kommen nicht mit dem Fahrplan zurück.
dialogue:b1-atlas-complete-1.en: People are going home. We will look for the missing addresses together; they do not come back with the timetable.
dialogue:b1-atlas-complete-1.tr: İnsanlar eve dönüyor. Eksik adresleri birlikte arayacağız; tarifeyle geri gelmiyorlar.

dialogue:b1-atlas-complete-2.de: Jede Stadt entscheidet über ihre Verbindung. Lina bringt jede Antwort zurück.
dialogue:b1-atlas-complete-2.en: Each town decides on its own connection. Lina brings every answer back.
dialogue:b1-atlas-complete-2.tr: Her kasaba kendi bağlantısına karar veriyor. Lina her cevabı geri getiriyor.

dialogue:b1-atlas-complete-3.de: Die Züge warten auf die Antworten. Heute trage ich die Medikamente zu Fuß. Morgen frage ich wieder.
dialogue:b1-atlas-complete-3.en: The trains wait for the answers. Today I carry the medicines on foot. Tomorrow I will ask again.
dialogue:b1-atlas-complete-3.tr: Trenler cevapları bekliyor. Bugün ilaçları yaya taşıyorum. Yarın yine soracağım.

dialogue:b1-atlas-complete-4.de: Mein Stempel bleibt beim Rat. Ada prüft jede alte Genehmigung. Ich beantworte die Fragen unter meinem eigenen Namen.
dialogue:b1-atlas-complete-4.en: My stamp stays with the council. Ada checks every old authorisation. I answer questions under my own name.
dialogue:b1-atlas-complete-4.tr: Mührüm kurulda kalıyor. Ada her eski onayı inceliyor. Soruları kendi adımla cevaplıyorum.

dialogue:b1-atlas-complete-5.de: Die strittigen Verbindungen bleiben vorerst zu. Auch gute Arbeit wartet jetzt auf eine Prüfung. Ich beginne heute.
dialogue:b1-atlas-complete-5.en: Disputed connections stay closed for now. Even good work now waits for review. I begin today.
dialogue:b1-atlas-complete-5.tr: Tartışmalı bağlantılar şimdilik kapalı kalıyor. İyi iş bile artık incelemeyi bekliyor. Bugün başlıyorum.

dialogue:b1-atlas-complete-6.de: {name}, ich gehe jetzt mit hinunter. Frau Berg kennt meine Stimme. Diesmal soll sie auch mein Gesicht sehen.
dialogue:b1-atlas-complete-6.en: {name}, I am coming downstairs now. Frau Berg knows my voice. This time she should see my face too.
dialogue:b1-atlas-complete-6.tr: {name}, şimdi aşağı iniyorum. Frau Berg sesimi tanır. Bu sefer yüzümü de görsün.

dialogue:b1-atlas-complete-7.de: In der Gartenstraße 7 steht wieder ein Name am Haus. Ich habe es vom Fenster aus gesehen.
dialogue:b1-atlas-complete-7.en: At 7 Gartenstraße there is a name on the house again. I saw it from the window.
dialogue:b1-atlas-complete-7.tr: Gartenstraße 7’de evde yeniden bir isim var. Pencereden gördüm.

dialogue:b1-atlas-complete-8.de: Drei Städte stehen wieder im Atlas. An seinem Rand erscheint eine Küste. Noch fehlt der Name.
dialogue:b1-atlas-complete-8.en: Three towns stand in the Atlas again. A coast appears at its edge. Its name is still missing.
dialogue:b1-atlas-complete-8.tr: Üç kasaba yeniden Atlas’ta. Kenarında bir kıyı beliriyor. Adı hâlâ eksik.

objective:b1-atlas:0.en: Climb to the old signal room

objective:b1-atlas:1.en: Look at the desk with the drafts

objective:b1-atlas:2.en: Read the blank line on the council board

objective:b1-atlas:3.en: Write that we agree to discuss problems early.
objective:b1-atlas:3.tr: Sorunları erkenden konuşmaya karar verdiğimizi yaz.

dialogue:b1-atlas-topic-life-0.de: Mit Tee, alten Fahrplänen und einer Aufnahme, die ich nicht ausschalten konnte.
dialogue:b1-atlas-topic-life-0.en: With tea, old timetables and a recording I could not switch off.
dialogue:b1-atlas-topic-life-0.tr: Çayla, eski tarifelerle ve kapatamadığım bir kayıtla.

dialogue:b1-atlas-topic-life-1.de: Abends habe ich die Züge gezählt, die nicht kamen. Otto hätte das verstanden.
dialogue:b1-atlas-topic-life-1.en: In the evenings I counted the trains that did not come. Otto would have understood.
dialogue:b1-atlas-topic-life-1.tr: Akşamları gelmeyen trenleri saydım. Otto bunu anlardı.

topic:b1-atlas:life.de: Wie hast du hier oben gelebt?
topic:b1-atlas:life.en: How did you live up here?

dialogue:b1-atlas-topic-next-0.de: Ich fange bei Ada an. Dann besuche ich Frau Berg. Sie entscheidet, ob sie die Tür öffnet.
dialogue:b1-atlas-topic-next-0.en: I will start with Ada. Then I will visit Frau Berg. She decides whether to open the door.
dialogue:b1-atlas-topic-next-0.tr: Ada’dan başlayacağım. Sonra Frau Berg’i ziyaret edeceğim. Kapıyı açıp açmayacağına o karar verir.

dialogue:b1-atlas-topic-next-1.de: Wenn sie mich wegschickt, schleiche ich mich nicht zurück. Ich hinterlasse meine Adresse.
dialogue:b1-atlas-topic-next-1.en: If she sends me away, I will not sneak back. I will leave my address.
dialogue:b1-atlas-topic-next-1.tr: Beni gönderirse gizlice geri gelmeyeceğim. Adresimi bırakacağım.

dialogue:b1-atlas-topic-recording-0.de: Ich wollte, dass jemand antwortet, auch wenn ich schlafe.
dialogue:b1-atlas-topic-recording-0.en: I wanted someone to answer, even while I was asleep.
dialogue:b1-atlas-topic-recording-0.tr: Ben uyurken bile birinin cevap vermesini istedim.

dialogue:b1-atlas-topic-recording-1.de: Und dann habe ich sie nicht ausgeschaltet. Sie war der letzte Teil von mir, der noch rief.
dialogue:b1-atlas-topic-recording-1.en: And then I did not switch it off. It was the last part of me that was still calling out.
dialogue:b1-atlas-topic-recording-1.tr: Sonra onu kapatmadım. Benden hâlâ seslenen son parçaydı.

topic:b1-atlas:recording.de: Warum hast du die Aufnahme gemacht?
topic:b1-atlas:recording.en: Why did you make the recording?

evidence:b1-atlas:nebelstadt-observatory.de: Auf dem Pult ein Stapel Briefentwürfe an {name}. Die ersten haben nur ein paar Wörter. Daneben ein leerer Platz für einen Schlüssel.
evidence:b1-atlas:nebelstadt-observatory.en: On the desk a pile of draft letters to {name}. The first ones are only a few words long. Beside them an empty place for a key.
evidence:b1-atlas:nebelstadt-observatory.tr: Kürsüde {name} adlı kişiye yazılmış bir yığın taslak mektup. İlkleri sadece birkaç kelime. Yanında bir anahtar için boş bir yer.

evidence:b1-atlas:nebelstadt-council-boa.de: Auf der Ratstafel ist eine Zeile frei geblieben. Darüber steht in Adas Schrift: „Unsere Regel:“
evidence:b1-atlas:nebelstadt-council-boa.en: One line on the council board has been left blank. Above it, in Ada’s handwriting: “Our rule:”
evidence:b1-atlas:nebelstadt-council-boa.tr: Kurul panosunda bir satır boş bırakılmış. Üstünde Ada’nın el yazısıyla: “Kuralımız:”

clue:b1-atlas:text:0.de: Elise hat die Strecke geschlossen, um einen Kinderzug zu schützen. Dann konnte sie nicht mehr loslassen.
clue:b1-atlas:text:0.en: Elise closed the route to protect a children’s train. Then she could not let go.
clue:b1-atlas:text:0.tr: Elise bir çocuk trenini korumak için hattı kapattı. Sonra bırakamadı.

clue:b1-atlas:text:1.de: Sie hat deinen Kaffee bezahlt, damit jemand deinen Namen laut sagt.
clue:b1-atlas:text:1.en: She paid for your coffee so that someone would say your name aloud.
clue:b1-atlas:text:1.tr: Kahveni, biri adını yüksek sesle söylesin diye ödedi.

clue:b1-atlas:text:2.de: Der Schlüssel bekommt einen öffentlichen Platz.
clue:b1-atlas:text:2.en: The key gets a public place.
clue:b1-atlas:text:2.tr: Anahtar herkese açık bir yere kavuşuyor.

clue:b1-atlas:lead:0.de: Hinter der Strecke erscheint eine Küste ohne Namen.
clue:b1-atlas:lead:0.en: Beyond the route a coast with no name appears.
clue:b1-atlas:lead:0.tr: Hattın ötesinde isimsiz bir kıyı beliriyor.

clue:b1-atlas:letter:0.de: Ich schreibe diesen Brief unten, bei den anderen. Der Schlüssel liegt nicht auf meinem Tisch. Ada hat meine Entwürfe. Frau Berg hat meine Adresse. Wenn du zur Küste fährst, schreib mir.
clue:b1-atlas:letter:0.en: I am writing this letter downstairs, among the others. The key is not on my desk. Ada has my drafts. Frau Berg has my address. If you travel to the coast, write to me.
clue:b1-atlas:letter:0.tr: Bu mektubu aşağıda, diğerlerinin arasında yazıyorum. Anahtar masamda değil. Taslaklarım Ada’da. Adresim Frau Berg’de. Kıyıya gidersen bana yaz.

npc:pip:role.en: Lina’s brother · keeper of the chalk wall

npc:hilde:role.en: Marta’s grandmother · nobody ever asked her

npc:falk:role.en: Ink seller · ink that never fades

npc:jakob:greeting:0.de: Hast du ein rotes Boot gesehen?

npc:ruth:greeting:0.de: Hallo. Bist du müde? Setz dich.

map-object:lindenhafen-chalk-wall:prompt.en: Read the names on Pip’s chalk wall.

object:lindenhafen-chalk-wall:detail:0.de: Eine Wand am Kanal. Überall stehen Namen in Kreide.
object:lindenhafen-chalk-wall:detail:0.en: A wall by the canal. Chalk names everywhere.
object:lindenhafen-chalk-wall:detail:0.tr: Kanalın yanında bir duvar. Her yerde tebeşirle isimler.

object:lindenhafen-chalk-wall:secret:0.en: At the bottom, very small: Mama. Papa.
object:lindenhafen-chalk-wall:secret:0.tr: En altta, çok küçük: Annem. Babam.

map-object:lindenhafen-office-window:pro.en: Look through the Brass Office window.

object:lindenhafen-office-window:detail:.de: Ein Schalter, ein Register und ein Stempel.
object:lindenhafen-office-window:detail:.en: A counter, a register and a stamp.
object:lindenhafen-office-window:detail:.tr: Bir tezgâh, bir kayıt defteri ve bir mühür.

object:lindenhafen-office-window:secret:.de: Auf jedem Zettel steht: Regel vier.

map-object:waldruh-hilde-window:prompt.en: Read the name on Oma Hilde’s window.

object:waldruh-hilde-window:detail:0.de: Ein Fenster zum Wald. Am Rahmen steht ein Name in blauer Tinte.
object:waldruh-hilde-window:detail:0.en: A window facing the forest. A name in blue ink on the frame.
object:waldruh-hilde-window:detail:0.tr: Ormana bakan bir pencere. Çerçevede mavi mürekkeple bir isim.

object:waldruh-hilde-window:secret:0.de: Von hier sieht man beide Städte. Wenn die Tür offen ist.
object:waldruh-hilde-window:secret:0.en: From here you can see both towns. When the door is open.
object:waldruh-hilde-window:secret:0.tr: Kapı açıkken buradan iki kasaba da görünür.

map-object:waldruh-ink-cart:prompt.en: Look at the ink seller’s cart.

object:waldruh-ink-cart:detail:0.de: Flaschen in Blau, Schwarz und Grün. Ein Schild: Verblasst nie!
object:waldruh-ink-cart:detail:0.en: Bottles in blue, black and green. A sign: Never fades!
object:waldruh-ink-cart:detail:0.tr: Mavi, siyah ve yeşil şişeler. Bir tabela: Asla solmaz!

object:waldruh-ink-cart:secret:0.de: Unter dem Schild klebt ein altes Etikett: Messingamt Nebelstadt.
object:waldruh-ink-cart:secret:0.en: Under the sign sticks an old label: Brass Office Nebelstadt.
object:waldruh-ink-cart:secret:0.tr: Tabelanın altında eski bir etiket yapışık: Pirinç Dairesi Nebelstadt.

map-object:waldruh-old-rails:prompt.en: Look at the old rails in the forest.

object:waldruh-old-rails:detail:0.de: Rostige Schienen. Daneben elf Steine in einer Reihe.
object:waldruh-old-rails:detail:0.en: Rusty rails. Beside them eleven stones in a row.
object:waldruh-old-rails:detail:0.tr: Paslı raylar. Yanında sıralanmış on bir taş.

object:waldruh-old-rails:secret:0.de: Auf einem Stein ist ein schwarzer Fingerabdruck. Wie von Tinte.
object:waldruh-old-rails:secret:0.en: One stone carries a black fingerprint. As if from ink.
object:waldruh-old-rails:secret:0.tr: Taşlardan birinde siyah bir parmak izi var. Mürekkepten gibi.

map-object:waldruh-mill-cellar:prompt.en: Open the cellar under the clockmill.

object:waldruh-mill-cellar:detail:0.de: Eine niedrige Tür unter der Mühle. Ein Schloss mit einer kleinen Laterne.
object:waldruh-mill-cellar:detail:0.en: A low door under the mill. A lock with a little lantern.
object:waldruh-mill-cellar:detail:0.tr: Değirmenin altında alçak bir kapı. Küçük fenerli bir kilit.

object:waldruh-mill-cellar:secret:0.de: Drinnen riecht es nach Tinte und alten Stempeln.
object:waldruh-mill-cellar:secret:0.en: Inside it smells of ink and old stamps.
object:waldruh-mill-cellar:secret:0.tr: İçeride mürekkep ve eski mühür kokuyor.

map-object:nebelstadt-record-room:prompt.en: Open the Brass Office record room.

object:nebelstadt-record-room:detail:0.de: Schubladen voller Zettel. Alle in derselben ordentlichen Schrift.
object:nebelstadt-record-room:detail:0.en: Drawers full of slips. All in the same tidy hand.
object:nebelstadt-record-room:detail:0.tr: Fiş dolu çekmeceler. Hepsi aynı düzenli el yazısıyla.

object:nebelstadt-record-room:secret:0.de: Unter jedem Zettel steht: Wer schweigt, stimmt zu.
object:nebelstadt-record-room:secret:0.en: Under every slip: whoever stays silent agrees.
object:nebelstadt-record-room:secret:0.tr: Her fişin altında yazıyor: Susan kabul etmiş sayılır.

map-object:nebelstadt-signal-slate:promp.en: Read the slate beside the signal.

object:nebelstadt-signal-slate:detail:0.de: Oben steht: Keine Beschwerden. Unten, ganz blass: Jonas.
object:nebelstadt-signal-slate:detail:0.en: At the top: No complaints. At the bottom, very pale: Jonas.
object:nebelstadt-signal-slate:detail:0.tr: Üstte: Şikâyet yok. Altta, çok soluk: Jonas.

object:nebelstadt-signal-slate:secret:0.de: Auf der Rückseite: alte Liedzeilen für die Fischer.
object:nebelstadt-signal-slate:secret:0.en: On the back: old song lines for the fishermen.
object:nebelstadt-signal-slate:secret:0.tr: Arkasında: balıkçılar için eski şarkı dizeleri.

map-object:nebelstadt-observatory-stairs.en: Unlock the stairs to the observatory.

object:nebelstadt-observatory-stairs:det.de: Eine schmale Treppe nach oben. Am Schloss eine kleine Laterne.
object:nebelstadt-observatory-stairs:det.en: A narrow staircase upwards. A little lantern on the lock.
object:nebelstadt-observatory-stairs:det.tr: Yukarı çıkan dar bir merdiven. Kilitte küçük bir fener.

object:nebelstadt-observatory-stairs:sec.de: Auf der obersten Stufe: 17:59, in Elises Schrift.
object:nebelstadt-observatory-stairs:sec.en: On the top step: 17:59, in Elise’s hand.
object:nebelstadt-observatory-stairs:sec.tr: En üst basamakta: 17:59, Elise’in el yazısıyla.

side:ticket-anna-kuehn:memory.de: Anna Kühn hat hier Brot gebacken. Jeden Morgen um sechs.
side:ticket-anna-kuehn:memory.en: Anna Kühn baked bread here. Every morning at six.
side:ticket-anna-kuehn:memory.tr: Anna Kühn burada ekmek pişirirdi. Her sabah altıda.

side:ticket-paul-winter:memory.de: Paul Winter hat die Uhren am Bahnhof gestellt.
side:ticket-paul-winter:memory.en: Paul Winter set the clocks at the station.

side:ticket-lotte-brandt:memory.de: Lotte Brandt hatte ein blaues Boot. Alle Kinder kannten es.
side:ticket-lotte-brandt:memory.en: Lotte Brandt had a blue boat. All the children knew it.
side:ticket-lotte-brandt:memory.tr: Lotte Brandt’ın mavi bir teknesi vardı. Bütün çocuklar onu tanırdı.

side:ticket-max-vogel:memory.de: Max Vogel hat jeden Tag die Zeitung gelesen. Laut, auf der Bank.
side:ticket-max-vogel:memory.en: Max Vogel read the newspaper every day. Aloud, on the bench.
side:ticket-max-vogel:memory.tr: Max Vogel her gün gazete okurdu. Yüksek sesle, bankta.

side:ticket-ida-sommer:memory.de: Ida Sommer hat alte Bücher repariert. Frau Berg hat sie oft besucht.
side:ticket-ida-sommer:memory.en: Ida Sommer repaired old books. Frau Berg often visited her.
side:ticket-ida-sommer:memory.tr: Ida Sommer eski kitapları onarırdı. Frau Berg onu sık sık ziyaret ederdi.

side:ticket-karl-fink:memory.de: Karl Fink war Emils Lehrer. Er hat ihm die erste Lampe gezeigt.
side:ticket-karl-fink:memory.en: Karl Fink was Emil's teacher. He showed him his first lamp.
side:ticket-karl-fink:memory.tr: Karl Fink, Emil’in ustasıydı. Ona ilk lambasını gösterdi.

side:ticket-rosa-klein:memory.de: Rosa Klein hat Blumen verkauft. Rote und gelbe.
side:ticket-rosa-klein:memory.en: Rosa Klein sold flowers. Red ones and yellow ones.
side:ticket-rosa-klein:memory.tr: Rosa Klein çiçek satardı. Kırmızı ve sarı.

side:ticket-hans-moeller:memory.de: Hans Möller hat Boote gebaut. Kleine und große.
side:ticket-hans-moeller:memory.en: Hans Möller built boats. Small ones and big ones.
side:ticket-hans-moeller:memory.tr: Hans Möller tekne yapardı. Küçük ve büyük.

side:ticket-emma-roth:memory.de: Emma Roth hat im Gasthaus gekocht. Ihre Pflaumensuppe kannte jeder.
side:ticket-emma-roth:memory.en: Emma Roth cooked at the inn. Everyone knew her plum soup.
side:ticket-emma-roth:memory.tr: Emma Roth handa yemek yapardı. Erik çorbasını herkes bilirdi.

side:ticket-georg-keller:memory.de: Georg Keller hat hier Stühle gebaut. Drei stehen noch im Gasthaus.
side:ticket-georg-keller:memory.en: Georg Keller built chairs here. Three still stand in the inn.
side:ticket-georg-keller:memory.tr: Georg Keller burada sandalye yapardı. Üçü hâlâ handa duruyor.

side:ticket-klara-engel:memory.de: Klara Engel hat jeden Sonntag die Glocke geläutet. Seitdem läutet niemand.
side:ticket-klara-engel:memory.en: Klara Engel rang the bell every Sunday. Nobody has rung it since.
side:ticket-klara-engel:memory.tr: Klara Engel her pazar çanı çalardı. O zamandan beri kimse çalmıyor.

side:ticket-walter-busch:memory.de: Walter Busch hat im Wald Holz gesammelt. Sein Hund wartet noch vor der Tür.
side:ticket-walter-busch:memory.en: Walter Busch gathered wood in the forest. His dog still waits at the door.
side:ticket-walter-busch:memory.tr: Walter Busch ormanda odun toplardı. Köpeği hâlâ kapının önünde bekliyor.

side:ticket-erika-lang:memory.de: Erika Lang hat Briefe für alle geschrieben, die nicht schreiben konnten.
side:ticket-erika-lang:memory.en: Erika Lang wrote letters for everyone who could not write.
side:ticket-erika-lang:memory.tr: Erika Lang yazamayan herkes için mektup yazardı.

side:ticket-peter-fischer:memory.de: Peter Fischer hat Leute über den Fluss gebracht. Für einen Apfel.
side:ticket-peter-fischer:memory.en: Peter Fischer took people across the river. For an apple.
side:ticket-peter-fischer:memory.tr: Peter Fischer insanları nehrin karşısına geçirirdi. Bir elma karşılığında.

side:ticket-sophie-wolf:memory.de: Sophie Wolf hatte zwölf Hühner. Sie kannte jedes beim Namen.
side:ticket-sophie-wolf:memory.en: Sophie Wolf had twelve hens. She knew each one by name.
side:ticket-sophie-wolf:memory.tr: Sophie Wolf’un on iki tavuğu vardı. Her birini adıyla bilirdi.

side:ticket-heinz-albrecht:memory.de: Heinz Albrecht hat die Uhren der Mühle gestellt. Seitdem fehlen elf Minuten.
side:ticket-heinz-albrecht:memory.en: Heinz Albrecht set the mill’s clocks. Eleven minutes have been missing since.
side:ticket-heinz-albrecht:memory.tr: Heinz Albrecht değirmenin saatlerini ayarlardı. O zamandan beri on bir dakika eksik.

side:ticket-johann-becker:memory.de: Johann Becker hat Boote gebaut, die nie gesunken sind. Er war stolz auf die Boote, nie auf sich.
side:ticket-johann-becker:memory.en: Johann Becker built boats that never sank. He was proud of the boats, never of himself.
side:ticket-johann-becker:memory.tr: Johann Becker hiç batmayan tekneler yaptı. Teknelerle gurur duyardı, kendisiyle asla.

side:ticket-mia-hansen:place.en: Fishing boat on the west quay

side:ticket-mia-hansen:memory.de: Mia Hansen ist jeden Morgen um vier hinausgefahren. Ihre Netze hängen noch am Kai.
side:ticket-mia-hansen:memory.en: Mia Hansen went out every morning at four. Her nets still hang on the quay.
side:ticket-mia-hansen:memory.tr: Mia Hansen her sabah dörtte denize açılırdı. Ağları hâlâ rıhtımda asılı.

side:ticket-ole-petersen:place.en: Fishing boat on the south quay

side:ticket-ole-petersen:memory.de: Ole Petersen hat mit Jonas am Hafen gesungen. Die Lieder stehen noch auf der Rückseite der Tafel.
side:ticket-ole-petersen:memory.en: Ole Petersen sang with Jonas at the harbour. The songs are still on the back of the slate.
side:ticket-ole-petersen:memory.tr: Ole Petersen limanda Jonas’la şarkı söylerdi. Şarkılar hâlâ tahtanın arkasında yazılı.

side:ticket-lene-voigt:memory.de: Lene Voigt hat Blumen nach Waldruh gebracht, als die Strecke noch offen war.
side:ticket-lene-voigt:memory.en: Lene Voigt took flowers to Waldruh when the route was still open.
side:ticket-lene-voigt:memory.tr: Lene Voigt, hat hâlâ açıkken Waldruh’a çiçek götürürdü.

side:ticket-konrad-weiss:memory.de: Konrad Weiß hat Laternen verkauft. Die letzte hängt noch im Fenster.
side:ticket-konrad-weiss:memory.en: Konrad Weiß sold lanterns. The last one still hangs in the window.
side:ticket-konrad-weiss:memory.tr: Konrad Weiß fener satardı. Sonuncusu hâlâ pencerede asılı.

side:ticket-elsa-graf:place.en: Second shop on the harbour front

side:ticket-elsa-graf:memory.de: Elsa Graf hat Karten gezeichnet. Auf ihren Karten gab es immer drei Städte.
side:ticket-elsa-graf:memory.en: Elsa Graf drew maps. Her maps always had three towns.
side:ticket-elsa-graf:memory.tr: Elsa Graf harita çizerdi. Haritalarında her zaman üç kasaba vardı.

side:ticket-friedrich-kurz:memory.de: Friedrich Kurz hat Seile verkauft. Im Sturm haben seine Seile gehalten, auch ohne seinen Namen.
side:ticket-friedrich-kurz:memory.en: Friedrich Kurz sold ropes. In the storm his ropes held, even without his name.
side:ticket-friedrich-kurz:memory.tr: Friedrich Kurz halat satardı. Fırtınada halatları tuttu, adı olmasa bile.

side:ticket-hanna-seidel:memory.de: Hanna Seidel hat jeden Brief im Hafen gestempelt. Mit einem Stempel, nie mit zwei.
side:ticket-hanna-seidel:memory.en: Hanna Seidel stamped every letter at the harbour. With one stamp, never two.
side:ticket-hanna-seidel:memory.tr: Hanna Seidel limandaki her mektubu mühürlerdi. Tek mühürle, asla iki kez değil.

side:pupil-ella:memory.de: Frau Berg hat mir Lesen beigebracht. Mit Briefen, nicht mit Büchern.
side:pupil-ella:memory.en: Frau Berg taught me to read. With letters, not with books.
side:pupil-ella:memory.tr: Frau Berg bana okumayı öğretti. Kitaplarla değil, mektuplarla.

side:pupil-karl:memory.de: Ich war immer zu spät. Frau Berg hat trotzdem gewartet. Jeden Tag.
side:pupil-karl:memory.en: I was always late. Frau Berg waited anyway. Every day.
side:pupil-karl:memory.tr: Hep geç kalırdım. Frau Berg yine de beklerdi. Her gün.

side:pupil-bea:memory.de: Frau Berg hatte eine rote Brille. Sie hat sie immer verloren.
side:pupil-bea:memory.en: Frau Berg had red glasses. She was always losing them.
side:pupil-bea:memory.tr: Frau Berg’in kırmızı bir gözlüğü vardı. Onu hep kaybederdi.

side:pupil-theo:memory.de: Ich habe die Brille gefunden. Unter der Bank. Ich bringe sie ihr.
side:pupil-theo:memory.en: I found the glasses. Under the bench. I will bring them to her.
side:pupil-theo:memory.tr: Gözlüğü buldum. Bankın altında. Ona götüreceğim.

side:customer-hilde:memory.de: Falk hat meinen Namen auf das Glas geschrieben. Nach drei Tagen war er weg.
side:customer-hilde:memory.en: Falk wrote my name on the jar. After three days it was gone.
side:customer-hilde:memory.tr: Falk adımı kavanoza yazdı. Üç gün sonra gitmişti.

side:customer-paula-brenner:memory.de: Ich war Patientin bei Greta. Mein Name auf der Liste war blau, dann grau, dann nichts.
side:customer-paula-brenner:memory.en: I was Greta’s patient. My name on the list was blue, then grey, then nothing.
side:customer-paula-brenner:memory.tr: Greta’nın hastasıydım. Listedeki adım maviydi, sonra gri, sonra hiçbir şey.

side:customer-fritz:memory.de: Ich habe meinen Namen mit Falks Tinte auf den Topf geschrieben. Jetzt steht nur noch Suppe darauf.
side:customer-fritz:memory.en: I wrote my name on the pot in Falk’s ink. Now it only says soup.
side:customer-fritz:memory.tr: Adımı Falk’ın mürekkebiyle tencereye yazdım. Şimdi üstünde sadece çorba yazıyor.

clue:a1-arrival:heading:0.de: Der Name auf der blassen Fahrkarte
clue:a1-arrival:heading:0.en: The name on the faded ticket

clue:a1-timetable:heading:0.de: Das blasse Wort auf der Tafel
clue:a1-timetable:heading:0.en: The faded word on the board

clue:a1-room:heading:0.en: Room three and the guest book
clue:a1-room:heading:0.tr: Üç numaralı oda ve misafir defteri

clue:a1-market:heading:0.de: Ein Platz am Tisch von Fritz

clue:a1-neighbour:heading:0.de: Frau Berg auf der Bank am Brunnen
clue:a1-neighbour:heading:0.en: Frau Berg on the bench by the fountain

clue:a1-pharmacy:heading:0.de: Der blasse Name auf dem Beutel
clue:a1-pharmacy:heading:0.en: The pale name on the bag

clue:a1-lost-parcel:heading:0.de: Der Brief, der zu viel will
clue:a1-lost-parcel:heading:0.en: The letter that asks too much

clue:a1-departure:heading:0.en: Platform seven, six in the evening

clue:a2-evening-plans:heading:0.de: Zwei Teller am Ende des Tisches
clue:a2-evening-plans:heading:0.en: Two plates at the end of the table

clue:a2-rail-trip:heading:0.de: Die Minute, die niemand gesehen hat

clue:b1-work:heading:0.de: Die Hand, die alles am Laufen hielt
clue:b1-work:heading:0.en: The hand that kept it all running

item:successor-letter:story:0.de: Elise schreibt: Du bist die Nachfolge der Hüterin.
item:successor-letter:story:0.en: Elise writes: you are the keeper’s successor.

item:successor-letter:story:1.de: Die Warnung gehört zu ihrem Schlüssel.
item:successor-letter:story:1.en: The warning belongs to her key.

item:successor-letter:story:2.de: Sie sagt nicht, dass du schuldig bist.
item:successor-letter:story:2.en: It does not say that you are guilty.

item:lamplighter-key:story:0.de: Otto gibt dir den Schlüssel zum Archiv am Bahnhof.
item:lamplighter-key:story:0.en: Otto gives you the key to the station archive.
item:lamplighter-key:story:0.tr: Otto sana istasyondaki arşivin anahtarını veriyor.

item:lamplighter-key:story:2.de: Jetzt vertrauen dir die Laternenhüter mehr.
item:lamplighter-key:story:2.en: Now the Lamplighters trust you more.
item:lamplighter-key:story:2.tr: Artık Fenerciler sana daha çok güveniyor.

item:inspector-ledger:story:0.de: Hier steht, was du dem Messingamt gesagt hast.
item:inspector-ledger:story:0.en: Here is what you told the Brass Office.
item:inspector-ledger:story:0.tr: Burada Pirinç Dairesi’ne ne söylediğin yazıyor.

item:inspector-ledger:story:1.de: Jetzt kannst du es mit den Worten der Leute vergleichen.
item:inspector-ledger:story:1.en: Now you can compare it with what the people say.

item:restored-atlas:story:1.de: Die Strecke hat jetzt ein öffentliches Versprechen.
item:restored-atlas:story:1.en: The route now has a public promise.
item:restored-atlas:story:1.tr: Hattın artık herkesin önünde verilmiş bir sözü var.

item:restored-atlas:story:2.de: Dahinter erscheint eine Küste ohne Namen.
item:restored-atlas:story:2.en: Beyond it, a coast without a name appears.
item:restored-atlas:story:2.tr: Arkasında adı olmayan bir kıyı beliriyor.

item:receipt-copy:story:0.de: Marta hat dir eine zweite Rechnung geschrieben.
item:receipt-copy:story:0.en: Marta wrote you a second receipt.
item:receipt-copy:story:0.tr: Marta sana ikinci bir fiş yazdı.

item:receipt-copy:story:1.en: Voss is meant to read it.

item:receipt-copy:text.en: Marta wrote a second receipt so Voss can read it.
item:receipt-copy:text.tr: Marta, Voss okuyabilsin diye ikinci bir fiş yazdı.

item:original-receipt:story:0.de: Auf der Rechnung ist der Stempel vom Messingamt.
item:original-receipt:story:0.en: The receipt has the Brass Office stamp.
item:original-receipt:story:0.tr: Fişin üzerinde Pirinç Dairesi’nin damgası var.

item:original-receipt:text.en: The receipt carries the Brass Office stamp. Voss does not know you have it.
item:original-receipt:text.tr: Fişin üzerinde Pirinç Dairesi’nin damgası var. Voss onun sende olduğunu bilmiyor.

item:berg-address:story:0.de: Fritz hat ihren Namen wieder aufgeschrieben.
item:berg-address:story:0.en: Fritz wrote her name down again.

item:berg-address:story:1.de: Sie wohnt in der Gartenstraße sieben.
item:berg-address:story:1.en: She lives at Garden Street seven.

item:berg-address:text.en: Fritz wrote her name down again. She lives at Garden Street 7.
item:berg-address:text.tr: Fritz onun adını yeniden yazdı. Gartenstraße 7’de oturuyor.

item:station-register:story:0.de: Im Büro am Bahnhof lag Ottos altes Register.
item:station-register:story:0.en: Otto’s old register lay in the station office.
item:station-register:story:0.tr: İstasyondaki büroda Otto’nun eski kayıt defteri duruyordu.

item:station-register:story:1.de: Daneben lagen hundert Fahrkarten für Gleis sieben.
item:station-register:story:1.en: Next to it lay a hundred tickets for platform seven.
item:station-register:story:1.tr: Yanında yedinci peron için yüz bilet vardı.

item:station-register:story:2.de: Auf jeder steht E. Otto hat sie nie verkauft.
item:station-register:story:2.en: Each one says E. Otto never sold them.
item:station-register:story:2.tr: Her birinde E yazıyor. Otto onları hiç satmadı.

item:station-register:text.en: Otto’s old register lay in the station office, next to a hundred tickets for platform seven that he never sold.
item:station-register:text.tr: Otto’nun eski kayıt defteri istasyon bürosunda duruyordu; yanında hiç satmadığı, yedinci peron için yüz bilet vardı.

item:registered-lamp:story:0.de: Voss hat die Lampe in sein Buch geschrieben.
item:registered-lamp:story:0.en: Voss wrote the lamp into his ledger.

item:registered-lamp:story:1.de: Sie ist Lampe Nummer eins, mit Stempel.
item:registered-lamp:story:1.en: It is lamp number one, with a stamp.

item:registered-lamp:story:2.de: Wo ein Name weggeht, wird sie dunkel.
item:registered-lamp:story:2.en: Where a name fades, it goes dark.

item:registered-lamp:text.en: Voss wrote the lamp into his ledger: lamp number one, with a stamp. It goes dark where a name fades.
item:registered-lamp:text.tr: Voss lambayı defterine yazdı: bir numaralı lamba, damgalı. Bir adın silindiği yerde kararıyor.

item:signal-lamp:story:0.de: Emil hat die Lampe aus der alten Laterne von Gleis sieben gemacht.
item:signal-lamp:story:0.en: Emil made the lamp from the old lantern of platform seven.
item:signal-lamp:story:0.tr: Emil lambayı yedinci peronun eski fenerinden yaptı.

item:signal-lamp:story:1.de: Wo ein Name weggeht, wird sie dunkel.
item:signal-lamp:story:1.en: Where a name fades, it goes dark.

item:signal-lamp:text.en: Emil made the lamp from the old lantern of platform seven. It goes dark where a name fades, and Otto wants his lantern back.
item:signal-lamp:text.tr: Emil lambayı yedinci peronun eski fenerinden yaptı. Bir adın silindiği yerde kararıyor ve Otto fenerini geri istiyor.

item:notice-list:story:0.de: Auf der Liste stehen die Namen, die leise werden sollen.
item:notice-list:story:0.en: The list has the names that are meant to go quiet.

item:notice-list:story:1.de: Jetzt sehen alle, was Regel vier bedeutet.
item:notice-list:story:1.en: Now everyone sees what rule four means.
item:notice-list:story:1.tr: Artık herkes dördüncü kuralın ne anlama geldiğini görüyor.

item:notice-list:text.en: The list holds the names that were meant to go quiet. Now everyone can see what rule four means.
item:notice-list:text.tr: Listede sessizleşmesi istenen adlar var. Artık herkes dördüncü kuralın ne demek olduğunu görebiliyor.

item:keeper-key:story:0.de: Am Vertrag für Zimmer sieben hängt ein schwerer Schlüssel.
item:keeper-key:story:0.en: A heavy key hangs from the lease for room seven.
item:keeper-key:story:0.tr: Yedi numaralı odanın sözleşmesinde ağır bir anahtar asılı.

item:keeper-key:story:2.de: Mit ihm öffnest du die Tür nach Waldruh.
item:keeper-key:story:2.en: With it you open the door to Waldruh.

item:keeper-key:text.en: A heavy key with a little lantern hangs from the lease for Room 7. It opens the door to Waldruh.
item:keeper-key:text.tr: 7 numaralı odanın kira sözleşmesinde küçük fenerli ağır bir anahtar asılı. Waldruh’un kapısını açıyor.

item:falk-ink:story:0.de: Herr Falk sagt: Diese Tinte verblasst nie.
item:falk-ink:story:0.en: Herr Falk says: this ink never fades.
item:falk-ink:story:0.tr: Herr Falk diyor ki: Bu mürekkep hiç solmaz.

item:falk-ink:story:1.de: Emil sagt: Das ist ganz normale Tinte.
item:falk-ink:story:1.en: Emil says: it is completely ordinary ink.
item:falk-ink:story:1.tr: Emil diyor ki: Bu tamamen sıradan mürekkep.

item:falk-ink:text.en: Herr Falk says his ink never fades. Emil says it is ordinary ink. It cost twelve euros.
item:falk-ink:text.tr: Herr Falk mürekkebinin hiç solmadığını söylüyor. Emil bunun sıradan bir mürekkep olduğunu söylüyor. On iki avroya mal oldu.

ending:routes-reopened:story:0.de: Otto und Marta öffnen die Strecken und zeigen den Fahrplan.
ending:routes-reopened:story:0.en: Otto and Marta open the routes and show the timetable.
ending:routes-reopened:story:0.tr: Otto ve Marta hatları açıyor ve tarifeyi gösteriyor.

ending:routes-reopened:story:1.de: Familien können heute nach Hause kommen.

ending:routes-reopened:story:2.de: Aber die Städte müssen jeden Streit noch klären.
ending:routes-reopened:story:2.en: But the towns must still settle every dispute.
ending:routes-reopened:story:2.tr: Ama kasabalar her anlaşmazlığı hâlâ çözmek zorunda.

ending:routes-reopened:story:3.de: Für die Küste ohne Namen gibt es noch keinen sicheren Fahrplan.
ending:routes-reopened:story:3.en: There is no safe timetable yet for the coast without a name.
ending:routes-reopened:story:3.tr: Adı olmayan kıyı için henüz güvenli bir tarife yok.

ending:towns-consent:story:0.de: Jede Stadt hat eine Stimme im Atlas.
ending:towns-consent:story:0.en: Each town has a voice in the Atlas.
ending:towns-consent:story:0.tr: Her kasabanın Atlas’ta bir sesi var.

ending:towns-consent:story:1.de: Der Schlüssel bleibt an einem öffentlichen Ort.
ending:towns-consent:story:1.en: The key stays in a public place.
ending:towns-consent:story:1.tr: Anahtar herkese açık bir yerde kalıyor.

ending:towns-consent:story:2.de: Greta und Lina fragen zuerst die Leute an der Küste.
ending:towns-consent:story:2.en: Greta and Lina first ask the people on the coast.
ending:towns-consent:story:2.tr: Greta ve Lina önce kıyıdaki insanlara soruyor.

ending:towns-consent:story:3.de: Niemand entscheidet für sie, auch wenn das Warten schwer ist.
ending:towns-consent:story:3.en: Nobody decides for them, even when waiting is hard.
ending:towns-consent:story:3.tr: Beklemek zor olsa da kimse onların yerine karar vermiyor.

ending:brass-reformed:story:0.de: Ada öffnet die Akten für alle.
ending:brass-reformed:story:0.en: Ada opens the records to everyone.

ending:brass-reformed:story:1.de: Voss gibt seinen Stempel ab, aber seine Unterschriften bleiben als Beweis.
ending:brass-reformed:story:1.en: Voss gives up his stamp, but his signatures remain as evidence.
ending:brass-reformed:story:1.tr: Voss damgasını bırakıyor ama imzaları kanıt olarak kalıyor.

ending:brass-reformed:story:2.de: Die Städte haben jetzt ein Amt, das Antwort geben muss.
ending:brass-reformed:story:2.en: The towns now have an office that has to answer.
ending:brass-reformed:story:2.tr: Kasabaların artık hesap vermek zorunda olan bir dairesi var.

ending:brass-reformed:story:3.de: Es ehrlich zu halten, ist ihre tägliche Arbeit.
ending:brass-reformed:story:3.en: Keeping it honest is their daily work.
ending:brass-reformed:story:3.tr: Onu dürüst tutmak, onların günlük işi.

dialogue:a1-cafe-complete-1.de: Aber jetzt wartet Otto am Plan.
dialogue:a1-cafe-complete-1.en: But right now Otto is waiting at the timetable.
dialogue:a1-cafe-complete-1.tr: Ama şimdi Otto tarifenin başında bekliyor.

dialogue:a1-market-intro-room-three.de: Marta sagt, du hast Zimmer drei. Gut so!
dialogue:a1-market-intro-room-three.en: Marta says you have room three. Good!
dialogue:a1-market-intro-room-three.tr: Marta üç numaralı odan olduğunu söylüyor. İyi!

dialogue:a1-market-intro-room-five.de: Marta sagt, du hast Zimmer fünf. Ruhig, oder?
dialogue:a1-market-intro-room-five.en: Marta says you have room five. Quiet, right?
dialogue:a1-market-intro-room-five.tr: Marta beş numaralı odan olduğunu söylüyor. Sessiz, değil mi?

dialogue:a1-shopping-complete-2.de: Marta hat ein Zimmer für dich.
dialogue:a1-shopping-complete-2.en: Marta has a room for you.
dialogue:a1-shopping-complete-2.tr: Marta'nın senin için bir odası var.

dialogue:a1-station-complete-1.de: Geh morgen zu Marta. Sie hat ein Telefon.
dialogue:a1-station-complete-1.en: Go to Marta tomorrow. She has a telephone.
dialogue:a1-station-complete-1.tr: Yarın Marta’ya git. Onun telefonu var.

dialogue:a1-workshop-complete-1.de: Sieh, die Lampe! Beim Messingamt geht sie aus.
dialogue:a1-workshop-complete-1.en: Look, the lamp! By the Brass Office it goes out.
dialogue:a1-workshop-complete-1.tr: Bak, lamba! Pirinç Daire’nin yanında sönüyor.

dialogue:a1-shopping-intro-receipt-kept.de: Marta sagt, du hast die Rechnung noch. Gut so!
dialogue:a1-shopping-intro-receipt-kept.en: Marta says you still have the receipt. Good!
dialogue:a1-shopping-intro-receipt-kept.tr: Marta, fişin hâlâ sende olduğunu söylüyor. İyi!

dialogue:a1-shopping-intro-receipt-filed.de: Marta sagt, Voss hat deine Rechnung. Er hat alles.
dialogue:a1-shopping-intro-receipt-filed.en: Marta says Voss has your receipt. He has everything.
dialogue:a1-shopping-intro-receipt-filed.tr: Marta, fişinin Voss’ta olduğunu söylüyor. Her şey onda.

dialogue:a0-wagen-gate.tr: Birinci vagon mu? Üçüncü vagon mu?

gate-prompt:a0-ticket.en: Brandt wants your ticket. Hand it over.

evidence:a0-ticket:prologue-ticket.en: Ticket: Lindenhafen. Below it, a name — so pale you can hardly read it.
evidence:a0-ticket:prologue-ticket.tr: Bilet: Lindenhafen. Altında bir ad var; o kadar soluk ki zor okunuyor.

objective:a0-name:0.en: Talk to Brandt about the ticket

gate-prompt:a0-wagen.en: Brandt asks which carriage you are in. Answer him.
gate-prompt:a0-wagen.tr: Brandt hangi vagonda olduğunuzu soruyor. Cevap verin.

objective:a0-wagen:0.en: Talk to Brandt by the fern

evidence:a0-wagen:prologue-wagen.en: Carriage one… carriage seven. The track curves and you count seven glass carriages. Yours is the last.
evidence:a0-wagen:prologue-wagen.tr: Birinci vagon… yedinci vagon. Ray kıvrılıyor ve yedi cam vagon sayıyorsunuz. Sizinki sonuncusu.

gate-prompt:a0-tee.en: Brandt offers coffee. You would rather not. Say no, politely.
gate-prompt:a0-tee.tr: Brandt kahve ikram ediyor. İstemiyorsunuz. Kibarca hayır deyin.

gate-prompt:a0-wo.en: You need the washroom. Ask Brandt where it is.
gate-prompt:a0-wo.tr: Tuvalete gitmeniz gerekiyor. Brandt’a nerede olduğunu sorun.

objective:a0-wo:0.en: Ask Brandt where the washroom is

evidence:a0-wo:prologue-wo.en: Toilet: occupied. Someone is in there. Never mind — now you know where it is.
evidence:a0-wo:prologue-wo.tr: Tuvalet: dolu. İçeride biri var. Olsun, artık nerede olduğunu biliyorsunuz.

gate-prompt:a0-langsam.en: That was far too fast. Tell Brandt.

gate-prompt:a0-morgen.en: This is your stop. Say goodbye to Brandt.
gate-prompt:a0-morgen.tr: İneceğiniz yer burası. Brandt’a veda edin.

quest:a0-name:subtitle.en: Say your name before it fades

quest:a0-name:objective:0.en: Talk to Brandt about the ticket

quest:a0-wagen:objective:0.en: Talk to Brandt by the fern

quest:a0-wo:objective:0.en: Ask Brandt where the washroom is

dialogue:a1-arrival-after-report-0-prolo.en: Thank you. My ledger, for you.

chapter:A0:description.en: A first conversation for players who know no German.
chapter:A0:description.tr: Hiç Almanca bilmeyen oyuncular için ilk konuşma.

resident:title-schaffner-lantern-bearer.de: Hallo, Laternenträger! Deine erste Spur ist gerettet.
resident:title-schaffner-lantern-bearer.en: Hello, Lantern Bearer! Your first clue is saved.
resident:title-schaffner-lantern-bearer.tr: Merhaba, Fener Taşıyıcısı! İlk ipucun kurtuldu.

resident:title-schaffner-lamplighter.de: Willkommen, Laternenhüter! Lindenhafen kennt deinen Namen.
resident:title-schaffner-lamplighter.en: Welcome, Lamplighter! Lindenhafen knows your name.
resident:title-schaffner-lamplighter.tr: Hoş geldin, Fenerci! Lindenhafen adını biliyor.

resident:title-schaffner-route-keeper.de: Willkommen, Streckenhüter! Du verbindest unsere Städte.
resident:title-schaffner-route-keeper.en: Welcome, Route Keeper! You connect our towns.
resident:title-schaffner-route-keeper.tr: Hoş geldin, Hat Bekçisi! Kasabalarımızı birbirine bağlıyorsun.

resident:title-schaffner-atlas-keeper.de: Willkommen, Atlashüter! Unsere Stimmen bleiben in deinem Atlas.
resident:title-schaffner-atlas-keeper.en: Welcome, Atlas Keeper! Our voices stay in your atlas.
resident:title-schaffner-atlas-keeper.tr: Hoş geldin, Atlas Bekçisi! Seslerimiz atlasında kalıyor.

paced:a1-arrival:a1-arrival-intro-14.en: Good morning. Voss. The Brass Office.

paced:a1-arrival:Fahrkarte nicht gültig..de: Fahrkarte nicht gültig. Bahnsteig sieben nicht im Plan.
paced:a1-arrival:Fahrkarte nicht gültig..en: Ticket not valid. Platform seven not on the timetable.
paced:a1-arrival:Fahrkarte nicht gültig..tr: Bilet geçersiz. Yedinci peron tarifede yok.

paced:a1-arrival:a1-arrival-choice-0.de: Langsam: Die Fahrkarte ist nicht gültig.
paced:a1-arrival:a1-arrival-choice-0.en: Slowly: the ticket is not valid.

paced:a1-arrival:report.de: Bitte, Herr Voss. Hier ist die Fahrkarte.
paced:a1-arrival:report.en: Here you are, Mr Voss. Here is the ticket.

paced:a1-arrival:a1-arrival-topic-who-vo.en: Voss: the Brass Office. Names, names, names.
paced:a1-arrival:a1-arrival-topic-who-vo.tr: Voss: Pirinç Dairesi. Adlar, adlar, adlar.

paced:a1-arrival:a1-arrival-topic-lanter.en: Platform seven: closed for twelve years.
paced:a1-arrival:a1-arrival-topic-lanter.tr: Yedinci peron: on iki yıldır kapalı.

paced:a1-arrival:a1-arrival-topic-lanter.de: Kein Zug. Die Laterne bleibt hier.
paced:a1-arrival:a1-arrival-topic-lanter.en: No train. The lantern stays here.

paced:a1-arrival:lindenhafen-noticeboard.de: Bahnsteig eins, zwei, drei, vier, fünf, sechs.
paced:a1-arrival:lindenhafen-noticeboard.en: Platforms one, two, three, four, five, six.
paced:a1-arrival:lindenhafen-noticeboard.tr: Birinci, ikinci, üçüncü, dördüncü, beşinci, altıncı peronlar.

dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-who-voss-0-pac.en: Voss: the Brass Office. Names, names, names.
dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-who-voss-0-pac.tr: Voss: Pirinç Dairesi. Adlar, adlar, adlar.

dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-lantern-0-pace.en: Platform seven: closed for twelve years.
dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-lantern-0-pace.tr: Yedinci peron: on iki yıldır kapalı.

dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-lantern-1-pace.de: Zug? Nein. Die Laterne bleibt hier.
dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-lantern-1-pace.en: A train? No. The lantern stays here.
dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-lantern-1-pace.tr: Tren mi? Hayır. Fener burada kalıyor.

objective:a0-langsam:1.en: Tell him you did not understand

quest:a0-langsam:objective:1.en: Tell him you did not understand

evidence:a0-name:prologue-name.en: The name… good! The ink on your ticket is dark and clear again.
evidence:a0-name:prologue-name.tr: Ad… güzel! Biletinizdeki mürekkep yine koyu ve net.

evidence:a0-tee:prologue-tee.en: Tea. Coffee. A copper samovar hums on the counter.
evidence:a0-tee:prologue-tee.tr: Çay. Kahve. Tezgâhta bakır bir semaver mırıldanıyor.

evidence:a0-langsam:prologue-langsam.en: Lindenhafen? No, not yet. Only dark forest and the moon.
evidence:a0-langsam:prologue-langsam.tr: Lindenhafen mi? Hayır, henüz değil. Yalnızca karanlık orman ve ay.

evidence:a0-morgen:prologue-morgen.en: Good morning, Lindenhafen! Roofs and a canal glitter in the sunrise.
evidence:a0-morgen:prologue-morgen.tr: Günaydın, Lindenhafen! Gün doğumunda çatılar ve bir kanal parıldıyor.
